Hybrid Aquatic.title: Hybrid Aquatic
Hybrid Aquatic.body: Hybrid Aquatic Hybrid Aquatic is a mod that enhances your underwater Minecraft experience! Explore improved rivers, swamps, oceans, and undersea caves with new creatures, blocks, and biomes. We're passionate about capturing the beauty and mystery of real-life marine ecosystems. Brace yourself for a world that balances stunning wonders with thrilling adventures in the oceans. Hybrid Aquatic blends creativity and realism. Dive in, explore new horizons, and uncover the secrets of the deep blue. Get ready to make a splash and encounter wonders like never before in Minecraft's aquatic realms! Features Hybrid Aquatic adds a large collection of marine creatures, including new fish, sharks, crustaceans, critters, otters, nautiluses, a new miniboss, and more! The mod also adds a variety of items and blocks, such as diving armor, sea sponges, fishing hooks, crates, anemones, and new types of corals! Frequently Asked Questions Q : Are you going to update to [Insert Version Here]? A : Undecided, but hopefully so. Q : Are you going to backport the mod to [Insert Version Here]? A : Nothing prior to 1.20.1 will be getting backports. Q : Is compatibility planned with [Insert Mod Here]? A : Our mission includes adding compatibility for as many mods as possible.

The Man From The Fog.title: The Man From The Fog
The Man From The Fog.body: The Man From The Fog This mod adds a creature to Minecraft that appears in the Night and stalks you. Eventually it will start to chase you kill you. In the config you can change these options: "spawn_rate": "normal", - options - often, normal, rare "jumpscare": true, "max_chase_duration": 1000, - in ticks "min_chase_duration": 400, - in ticks "climbing": true, "vanish_distance": 30, - The distance from you to the man until it despawns "spawn_at_day": false, "darkness_effect": true, "all_dimensions": false, "break_blocks": true Join the Discord for leaks and updates GECKOLIB MOD IS REQUIRED!

Bosses of Mass Destruction Forge.title: Bosses of Mass Destruction Forge
Bosses of Mass Destruction Forge.body: Are you looking to add some more exciting boss fights to your world? The aim of this mod is to create epic endgame boss fights. This is an unofficial port of Barribob's Bosses of Mass Destruction mod from Fabric to Forge. Click here to go to the original project. Right now, this mod has four bosses. - Night Lich, found in rare towers in cold biomes. Locate the towers by following soul stars. - Obsidilith, which appears in rare structures in the end islands. - Nether Gauntlet, which appears in rare structures in the nether. - Void Blossom, appears in rare caves at the bottom of the world. Void lilies will point the way. - They can be accessed in creative via the /summon command. Installation: Installed like any regular Forge mod with dependencies below. CERBON's API (1.20.1+) Geckolib Cloth Config API Support Please report all bugs, issues, and feature requests to the issue tracker or use my discord server and report at the appropriate channel. Please leave the comment section only for comments about the mod or simple questions. Please read the FAQ before reporting a bug, issue or feature request. Need a Server?

The Bumblezone - NeoForge/Forge.title: The Bumblezone - NeoForge/Forge
The Bumblezone - NeoForge/Forge.body: 1.20.1 OR NEWER MC RECOMMENDED [[Click here for the Fabric version of this mod!]](https://modrinth.com/mod/the-bumblezone-fabric) Bumblezone's code is LGPLv3 License while its assets are ARR. The actual jar itself is ARR as a result but you are free to look at and use Bumblezone's open source code! WHAT IS THE BUMBLEZONE?     The Bumblezone is a bee dimension filled with many brand new bee-related blocks! There's even quite a few structures to explore and a unique bee armor you can obtain! If you are lucky, you may find a special Throne-Locating Honey Compasses from certain structures that leads you to a Bee Queen! The dimension itself looks like it is the inside of a bee nest and you will find giant walls in rows with canals of water between them. Maybe you'll even find a pollen covered section of the dimension or a canyon full of massive honey-based crystals! Check the Bumblezone advancements tab for how to enter dimension and what to do!     Also, you will find bees are extremely protective of their honey in this dimension. If you mine vanilla's Honey Block, destroy or take honey from Honeycomb Brood Block, or you hit a bee, all bees around you will get many buffs and will become VERY angry at you because you now have the Wrath of the Hive effect! But by feeding bees or the Honeycomb Brood Blocks with the honey foods that you have, you might be able to calm them down. By feeding bees or that brood block, you get Protection of the Hive that makes bees defend you against anyone attacking you! (You can nerf the bees in the config if you find them too strong or buff them if you want to die!) Note: If you have severe trypophobia and the current Bumblezone textures are too much, you can enable the internal mod Anti-Trypophobia resourcepack by going into the resourcepack screen and move the resourcepack to the top of the right side to activate it. And yes, you can use this mod in a modpack! ____________________________________________________________________________ WHAT DOES THIS MOD HAVE?   Check out the wiki below for all the info! It is kept up to date on latest Bumblezone releases. https://github.com/TelepathicGrunt/Bumblezone/wiki   ____________________________________________________________________________ If you find an issue, glitch, or have a suggestion about my mod, let me know! But if you don't have a GitHub account to report in the Issue tab above, just comment what the problem is below and I'll try and get back to you ASAP! :)   Discord Link to telepathicgrunt-mods channel for my mods! https://discord.gg/K8qRev3yKZ My Ko-fi page if you wish to help donate to support me! https://ko-fi.com/telepathicgrunt

Rotten Creatures.title: Rotten Creatures
Rotten Creatures.body: Available on both Forge and Fabric          Rotten Creatures is a mod created by RPorotos and developed by Fusion Studio dedicated to adding many new zombie mobs with lots of personality! Requires Platform API   MOBS INFO: - When a Zombie dies in powder snow it may turn into a Frostbitten, the chance of this depends on the difficulty - Currently spawn at Cold Biomes - While attacking, it will apply Freeze to the target, the duration depends on the difficulty - When walking on water it will set it on ice, similar to the Frost Walker Enchantment - On Baby's death, it will create a snow explosion and apply Freeze to any nearby entities - Will attack any Burneds on sight - Drops Frozen Rotten Flesh FROZEN ROTTEN FLESH - Dropped by Frostbittens - Can be cooked to get Rotten Flesh - When eaten, there's a 80% chance to apply Freeze to the user - Can be used to brew the Freeze Effect FREEZE EFFECT - When applied to an entity, it will apply a buffed slowness that may even paralize the user - Frozen entities will lose the ability of jumping - Frozen entities will also shake and receive Frozen Hearts along with a Frozen Screen - Can be created into potions and tipped arrows There is 4 variants of Undead Miner: Rank C (Stone Pickaxe),  Rank B (Iron Pickaxe),  Rank A (Diamond Pickaxe) and Rank M (Golden Pickaxe).  - Will spawn underground at any overworld biomes and below sea level - Similar to skeletons, they will restrict sun - There aren't and will not be any baby variants for this mob, you monster. - Has four different ranks: Stone, Iron, Diamond and Gold + Stone is the most common variant + Iron is an uncommon variant + Diamond is the rarest variant + Gold will replace any Stone variants at Mesa biomes - Each variant can be identified by their pickaxes and have an unique loot - Currently spawns at Swamp Biomes - Will leap towards the target when attacking - On attack, it will have different behaviors: + If adult, it will apply blindness and poison, the duration depends on the difficulty + If baby, it will explode and spawn a lingering cloud of poison - While on water, it will receive a movement speed boost - On death, it has a 50% chance to spawn a lingering cloud of poison - When a Zombie dies in lava it may turn into a Burned, the chance of this depends on the difficulty - Currently only spawns at nether wastes - Has three different variants: Normal, Crazy and Obsidian - While attacking it will set the target on fire, the duration will depend on the difficulty - Will attack any Frostbittens on sight - Drops Magma Rotten Flesh CRAZY BURNED + When low health, it will turn into the Crazy Variant + Will emit lava particles while in this state, Crazy Obsidian Variant will emit obsidian tear particles + When Crazy, it increases it's attack damage, knockback resistance and moving speed + There's a 0.5% chance for a Crazy Variant to spawn naturally OBSIDIAN BURNED + When in contact with water, it will turn into the Obsidian variant (excluding rain and splash potions) + When in contact with lava, it will reignite + When Obsidian, it becomes immune to projectiles and gains resistance to fall damage + When Obsidian, it increases it's attack damage and knockback resistance, however it becomes slower MAGMA ROTTEN FLESH - Dropped by Burneds - Can be used as Furnace fuel, however it requires three of these to cook a single item - When eaten, there's a 50% chance to apply Fire Resistance to the user, but there's also a 50% chance to set the entity on Fire   Drops:  1-2 Rotten Flesh, 1 Leather, 1-2 Raw Cod or 1 Cooked Cod.   Spawn: Rare chance to spawn in  Snow Biomes . His wolf  has 50% chance to spawn near him. His variant with a  Spear  has 40% chance to appear. Extra Info: - He applies  Slowness   II   when he hits a player.  (effect duration depends on difficulty) - If you punch it, he has a chance to drop a Raw Cod. Every hit counts,

Illage and Spillage: Respillaged.title: Illage and Spillage: Respillaged
Illage and Spillage: Respillaged.body: DISCLAIMER: I did NOT make the original mod. This is a port and continuation of the original mod made with the original creator’s permission. Original coding, textures, models, sounds, animations, and everything else is from the original mod by Yellowbross Productions which can be found HERE This mod is a continuation of Yellobross Productions's Illage and Spillage mod, which has been discontinued. Goons Engineer: Spoiler _Despite being a redstone genius, the Engineer is frequently mocked by other Illagers for his lack of skills in combat... at least until they meet his inventions_ While not able to attack on their own, Engineers will run around villages occasionally building hostile machines. These machines are: _Chagrin Sentry_: A stationary turret that has two cannons for arms and can fire arrows at extremely rapid rates. They are prone to overheating though, so use that window when they do to dismantle them _Hinder_: A small but durable machine with healing capabilities. Low health Illagers nearby will flee to them for healing. Hinders heal Illagers rapidly, but only in a fairly small range _Factory_: A miniature factory that can produce smaller minions that serve as bodyguards to the Engineer. These minions range from small and fast melee pokers, to flying snipers, and even to little beeping creepers! Additionally when one of the Engineer's machines is damaged, the Engineer will quickly come over and try to repair it. Bosses: Freakager: Spoiler _twisted biologist from the depths of the Nether, sure to give you nightmares for days!!!!!_ Along with all of his attacks from the original mod, Freakager and Ragno can also do the following: Freakager: _Minions_: Freakager will throw out several minions. Depending on his health, he'll either throw Funnybones, annoying little miniature skeleton rascals that throw bones and laugh at your pain, or Eyesores, erratically slithering eyeballs which can fling you in the air if you slip on them _Axe Barrage_: When under half health, Freakager gets extremely infuriated with you and hurls hundreds of axes at you at once! This is easily his most devastating attack, so be careful Ragno: _Whack_: If you get too close when Freakager is still alive, Ragno will try to whack you away _Jump_: When Freakager or Ragno is under half health, Ragno will occasionally jump to a location nearby. If Ragno is under half health, it'll try to jump directly on top of its target _Web Net_: Ragno can spit a net at you. If it catches you, run as fast as you can in the opposite direction before Ragno can reel you in! _Mutation Breath_: When under half health, Ragno can try to grab you. If you get grabbed, Ragno sprays mutation substance all over you! Other Mobs: Spoiler This mod has many other mobs and bosses. See the original mod's description for info on all of those Future Plans: Spoiler Next update: - More goons (normal enemies) - Some other minor features Future update(s): - Re-implement and complete Devastator (maybe. Cant say for sure if this will actually happen) - Port my Harder Illage and Spillage mod in the form of a Nightmare Mode config - Add Grim Freakager? (Very unlikely, but not impossible) - Add Inventor? (Very unlikely, but not impossible) Known Issues: Spoiler Currently there are no known issues (yay!) If you find any issues, report them on the issue tracker and I'll add them to this list to be fixed next update FAQ: Spoiler Can I use this in my video/modpack? Sure! Just make sure to leave a link back to the original page here on Curseforge. Can you make a port to version/mod loader? Maybe in the future I will port this mod to newer versions, but there will be no official backports of new features to older versions. As for mod loaders, most likely not. I have never learned any other mod loader, nor do I plan to. However, if you'd like to make a port to any version or mod loader, the source code is available here. Just remember to ask me for permission first if you plan to upload it publicly :) I

[Let's Do] WilderNature.title: [Let's Do] WilderNature
[Let's Do] WilderNature.body: Unleashed Wild & Bountiful Bounties The mod that adds a variety of wildlife to the Let's Do Collection "Tame the untamed" Wilder Nature adds a wild variety of tamable and untamable wildlife, with intricate visuals and functions that enhance vanilla immersion. Breathe, steady yourself, and face any challenge with valor. Venture forth. Show no fear. Wilder Nature expands the roster of wildlife within the Let's Do Collection and breathes life into the world of Minecraft through dynamic creatures and hunting systems. Brave the Wilderness - Set sight on and interact with the various wildlife found across your world - New meats obtained by hunting the new wildlife - New friends to make on your journeys Grab your blunderbuss, the hunt awaits. Fulfill Bounties and Collect Rewards - Use the Bounty Board to obtain cool rewards from hunts. Temporarily disabled in 1.21.1 - Obtain a Bison Horn, the best way to show you're a master huntsman - Turn fish into oil and fuel the fire to keep you warm at night The hunt rewards only the valorous. Decorative Elements - Cool banners to decorate your hunting lodge - Trophies of your kills that have useful effects - A Stylin' Purple Hat, because why not? Face the wilderness. Tame the untamable. Reap the rewards. Dedicated to MissLilitu Many of the animals featured in this mod were originally created by Nog and serve as the foundation of Wilder Nature, used with permission. More of their work can be found here: https://mcmodels.net/vendors/24/nog The Let’s Do Collection Support & Community Let’s Do grows through its community. GitHub • Discord • Patreon

Nether Depths Upgrade.title: Nether Depths Upgrade
Nether Depths Upgrade.body: Nether Depths Upgrade is a small mod that adds some extra flora and fauna to the lava seas of the nether. A total of nine fish have been added, a new enchant and a potion in order to explore the lava in the nether. Dependencies Geckolib 3.0

Tiny Skeletons.title: Tiny Skeletons
Tiny Skeletons.body: Tiny Skeletons brings baby skeletons to Minecraft at last! 💀 If baby zombies exist, why not skeletons too? Normal skeletons, strays, bogged, parched, and even wither skeletons can now spawn as tiny variants, each with their own unique behaviors, attacks, and rewards. Cute? Sometimes. Harmless? Absolutely not. ✨ 💀 Natural Spawning: Baby skeleton variants spawn naturally with a 5% chance, just like baby zombies. 🏹 Baby Skeletons: Fight with bows at range, then quickly switch to melee combat with a wooden sword when you get too close. ❄️ Baby Strays: Throw icy snowballs mixed with pebbles that deal a small amount of damage and knock targets back. They may even drop blue ice when defeated. 🍄 Baby Bogged: Toss mushrooms at their enemies from a distance, dealing light damage while providing unique mushroom themed drops. 🏜️ Baby Parched: Throw chunks of sand at nearby targets and can provide a handy source of sand. 🖤 Baby Wither Skeletons: Surprisingly timid creatures that flee when approached, terrified you might steal the wither skeleton skull they always carry. Defeat one for a guaranteed skull drop, or trade it a wither rose instead. 🎁 Unique Rewards: Several baby skeleton variants offer special drops and alternate ways to obtain useful resources. ⏩ INSTALLATION REQUIRED ON CLIENT & REQUIRED ON SERVER ⏩ REQUIRES PUZZLES LIB TO BE INSTALLED (FABRIC & NEOFORGE) ⏩ REQUIRES FABRIC API TO BE INSTALLED (FABRIC) ⏩ REQUIRES FORGE CONFIG API PORT TO BE INSTALLED (FABRIC) If available for a mod, configuration is possible directly from in-game using the mod menu (requires Mod Menu by Prospector to be installed on Fabric). For manual configuration using an external text editor all files are found at .minecraft/config , named as MOD_ID-client.toml , MOD_ID-common.toml , or MOD_ID-server.toml , depending on the type of config. Not all types might exist for a mod, if any at all. 🌟 Thanks to Daveyx0 for inspiring the baby skeleton's combat behavior with the skeleton warrior from their Primitive Mobs mod. 🌟 Thanks to Globox_Z for some of the code for rendering items on the back of baby skeletons from their BackSlot mod. 🌟 Thanks to Furgle for inspiring baby wither skeletons carrying skulls from their Baby Mobs mod.                                        © 2026 @heyitsfuzs. All rights reserved. This page was last edited on 11 September 2026, at 06:44 (UTC).

Youkai's Homecoming.title: Youkai's Homecoming
Youkai's Homecoming.body: Discord Required Dependency: - Farmer's Delight 📖 Introduction. Youkai's Homecoming is an add-on mod for Farmer's Delight. Mainly add new crops and food. 📦 New Additions. New crops: - Red beans: Can be found in birch forests, bamboo jungle, and sunflower plains. Plantable only on clay, mud, or coarse dirt. - Soybeans: Can be found in the dark forest, jungle, and swamp. - Coffea: Can be found in all kinds of jungles. Plantable only on podzol, mud, or soul soil. - Tea: Can be found in flower forest, meadow, and groves. - Udumbara: can be found in swamp. Grows under moonlight and shrinks under sunlight. Flowers for very short period of time only under full moon. New Foods: 100+ food including: - Japanese cuisine such as mochi, miso soup, tricolor dango and tobiko gunkan. Placeable dishes and feasts - Coffee: A new drink that has a Caffeine effect and sober effect preventing phantoms from spawning, but also prevents sleeping and drinking another sober drink. - Tea: Each type of tea has a different effects, but all of them gives sober effect as well. - Sake: Alcoholic drinks that makes your screen wabble but gives strong effects - Tofu burger, bamboo water restaurant, and other foods added to the Touhou Project fan fiction. New Mobs: - Lamprey: spawned in oceans and rivers except for the warm ocean. Cooked ones have night vision effect. - Rumia: spanwed inside youkai nest. Will start a danmaku battle with you if you try to attack her. Other: Plates of food can be placed, please hold shift and right-click. 💬 Author's statement Future update will include more Touhou related contents, and adding some curios with interesting effects

Mobs of Mythology.title: Mobs of Mythology
Mobs of Mythology.body: Mobs of Mythology brings mythological creatures to your Minecraft world! This mod introduces a whole new level of challenge and adventure, allowing you to face unique and formidable foes while exploring. For more details checkout the wiki!

Mythic Mounts.title: Mythic Mounts
Mythic Mounts.body: News and Announcements! May Updates! New Mob added, the legendary Żar-ptak ! (Thanks @Le flémmard! ) Added mini-mounts for inchlings!        - A baby mount that is given a warped fungus before it matures will grow into a miniature mount        - Mini-mounts can only carry very small players (like inchlings)        - The mini effect can be cancelled by feeding a baby mount a crimson fungus before it grows up The config updater now automatically carries over players' custom settings when updating to a new version. April Updates: New Mob added, the from the fabled mooshroom islands, Colelytras! (Thanks @Atlan! ) Added a Summoning Staff item that can warp mounts to a player/flying mounts to the ground. Added the ability to give wander/follow/sit commands to mounts in-game using either the command item or a summoning staff. Added a Patchouli guidebook with lore, instructions, and info on each of the mounts! Get it by:        - using a regular book on any mount, or by        - using a summoning staff on a book (held in offhand) Happy Modding ^_^   Mod Highlights: Adds 14 new tameable animals which can be found in various biomes across the world. Includes flying, aquatic, and terrestrial mounts. Each mount can be equipped with armor and additional inventory slots. Cute baby variants! Customizable config file to adjust spawn settings, mount stats, entity AI/behavior, and more.   Important: This mod requires Geckolib and Patchouli for Fabric or Forge Supported Mod Loaders: Fabric/Forge   Mod Features: Interactions: T aming: Mounts may be tamed by left-clicking them with an empty hand to repeatedly ride them until the mount stops bucking the player off. Like horses, this may take a few attempts before the mount is successfully tamed. Careful! Some mounts are hostile and will fight back during the taming process! Riding Mounts: Tamed mounts can be ridden by left-clicking them with an empty hand and controlled with saddles. Flying mounts can be flown by repeatedly pressing the jump key to gain altitude, or by aiming via camera controls while flying. Aquatic mounts can similarly gain a “swim boost” by using the jump key underwater. Instruct a Mount to Stay/Sit: Tamed mounts will naturally wander near (and remain close to) the last place their owner dismounted. To have a mount remain in an exact location without wandering off, right-click them with a stick to have them sit down. Breeding Mounts: Two mounts of the same species can be bred if the following conditions are met: the mounts must both be tamed ; the mounts must both have full health ; and, the mounts must be each given the appropriate breeding item . Mini Mounts: If a baby mount is given a warped fungus before it matures, it will grow into a miniature mount. These mounts cannot be ridden by normal-size people, but otherwise are the same a their larger counterparts. The mini effect can be cancelled by feeding a baby mount a crimson fungus before it matures. Pet Mount: Right-click a tamed mount with an empty hand while sneaking to pet it.   Equipment: Add/Remove Inventory: Mounts may be equipped with chests to add additional inventory slots to their equipment screen, and can unequip chests with shears. Total inventory capacity varies between different types of mounts, and can be adjusted in the configuration file if needed. Open Mount Inventory: Double right-click a tamed mount with an empty hand while sneaking to open the mount inventory. Mount Armor: Tamed mounts can be equipped/unequipped with horse armor from the inventory screen. Summoning Staff: Can be used to teleport mounts a short distance. Link a mount by using the staff on them, and summon them by using it again. (Mounts must be in loaded chunks and there must be enough room for them to teleport in)   Other Behaviors: B

It Takes a Pillage.title: It Takes a Pillage
It Takes a Pillage.body: 📖 About: A Pillager mod for 1.16.5+ aiming to expand on the pillager civilization, as well as provide additional challenges and compelling gameplay in the survival game mode. The Pillagers have expanded their Civilization! They have set up encampments and fortresses all over the world! Do you have what it takes to overcome these new threats, and seize their precious loot? See the Images Tab for Spoilers! Listen to the soundtrack on SoundCloud. This is my first mod in release. Check out my others, and keep an eye out for more!. Please considering supporting me below, as that will allow me more time for updates and fixes. 🎥 Videos: ❗ Dependencies: No other mod dependencies! 📦 Integrations with other mods: Visit the It Takes a Pillage page on CurseForge for the full integration list! 🕷 Report Bugs below: ✔️ Fixes to Old Issues: tldr: update It Takes a Pillage and Forge! Visit the It Takes a Pillage page on CurseForge for an extensive list of fix recommendations! Acknowledgements: Special Thanks to: Telepathic Grunt, Sizable Shrimp, Commoble, and Cadiboo from the Mod Development Discord for their assistance and direction during the development process. Special Thanks to: ZestyBlaze for the initial It Takes a Pillage Fabric Port!

Modular Golems.title: Modular Golems
Modular Golems.body: This mod adds golems that players can craft from metal materials. Each part of the golems can be made from different metals with unique properties and attributes. Upgrades can be applied for additional abilities or stats. Discord: https://discord.gg/BCHNhsDMXz Dependency: L2library Golem types: - Metal Golem : similar to Iron Golem, has high health and attack - Humanoid golem : player-like, can use armor, weapons and shields - Dog golem : wolf-like, run fast Things humanoid golems can do: - Use melee weapons - Wear armors - Use shields to block attack - Use bows and crossbows (consumes arrow, so infinity bow is recommended) - Use Tridents (Drowned-like, doesn't need loyalty enchantment) Be aware that humanoid golem will consume durability of used items Golem materials - Copper (vanilla) - Heal when struck by lightning - Iron (vanilla) - Vanilla-like high health and attack golem - Gold (vanilla) - Heal over time, but weak stats - Netherite (vanilla) - Area attack, high health and damage - Skulk (vanilla) - as strong as Wardens! - Steeleaf (Twilight Forest) - High attack - Ironwood (Twilight Forest) - High health, heal over time - Knightmetal (Twilight Forest) - Thorn on your golems - Fiery (Twilight Forest) - Deal higher damage to mobs not immune to fire - Zinc (Create) - Reduce damage taken - Andesite Alloy (Create) - Cheap and mass producible golem - Brass (Create) - Resistant to magic damage - Railway (Create) - Move fast, high knockback, area attack. Hit mobs like trains! - Brimsteel (Blaze Gears) - Shoot fireballs - Totemic Gold (L2 Complements) - Higher healing - Poseidite (L2 Complements) - Special abilities in rain, including conduit attack - Shulkerate (L2 Complements) - Extremely tough, immune to projectiles - Eternium (L2 Complements) - Invincible! Upgrades Each golem can have one upgrade per part: metal golem can have 4, humanoid can have 3, and dog golem can have 2. - Diamond Upgrade : Add armor value - Netherite Upgrade : Add armor and toughness - Golden Apple Upgrade : Add health regeneration - Enchanted Golden Apple Upgrade : Add higher health regeneration - Sponge Upgrade : Reduce explosion damage, prevent explosion from breaking blocks - Quartz Upgrade : Increase melee attack damage - Thunder Immune Upgrade : Negate lightning bolt damage, heal when struck by lightning bolt - Recycle Upgrade : When golem dies, drop the item form of the golem at 0 health instead of metal ingots - Swim Upgrade : Allow golems to swim in water efficiently - Player Immune Upgrade : Negate damage from player and player's pets - Ender Sight Upgrade : Allow golems to see enemies through walls. Useful for mob farms or guarding. - Bell Upgrade : When golem find or switch attack target, highlight all surrounding enemies and attract them to attack the golem - Float Upgrade : Allow golem to float on water and lava. Cheaper version of swim upgrade. - Fire Immune Upgrade : Negate fire damage. - (Twilight Forest) Naga Upgrade : Increase Armor, Attack, Speed, and Knockback. - (Twilight Forest) Ironwood Upgrade : Golem heals faster in twilight forest. - (Twilight Forest) Knightmetal Upgrade : Thorn. When golem is attacked, reflect a percentage of that damage as magic damage. - (Twilight Forest) Carminite Upgrade : When golem takes damage, become invisible and invincible for a short period of time. - (Twilight Forest) Steeleaf Upgrade : Golem deals higher damage in twilight forest. - (Twilight Forest) Fiery Upgrade : Damage dealt to mobs not inherently immune to fire will be significantly higher. Deal no damage to mobs with fire resistance potion effect. - (Create) Zinc Upgrade : Damage taken is reduced by a flat amount. Effect against a crowd of weak mobs. - (Create) Extendo Upgrade : Increase golem knockback. - (L2Complements) Teleport Upgrade : Golem will attempt to teleport to avoid damage. - (L2Complements) Wither Armor Upgrade : Golem will repel arrows and projectiles, and negate all projectile damage. - (L2Complements) Freezing Upgrade : A

Duckling.title: Duckling
Duckling.body: Quack quack! Duckling is a mod that aims to add ducks to liven up your Minecraft world!    What does this mod add? 🦆 A white duck and mallard. They spawn in river biomes 🐥 Quacklings: A fisherman duck which is tradable! Find these guys wandering around swamps! 🍰 Holiday fruit cake, a sweet treat the quacklings LOVE! 🦆  Join our Discord!  🦆    Credits: 🎨 Frogipher 4778 (Artist) 💻 ThatGravyBoat 0001 (Developer) The horror aspect of the mod has been removed as of the 1.19 release. -- As long as credited, Duckling may be used in modpacks, youtube videos, etc.

Realm RPG: Fallen Adventurers.title: Realm RPG: Fallen Adventurers
Realm RPG: Fallen Adventurers.body: Welcome to Realm RPG - a medieval fantasy mod series! 📖 About Fallen Adventurers is a mod that will greatly diversify Minecraft's adventure and exploration aspects by adding the skeletons of your less fortunate predecessors across the world, without going too far away from vanilla game balance & graphics style. Available on Curseforge & Modrinth For Minecraft Java Edition (Forge & NeoForge). 💀 Features - 50+ types of skeletons that generate in different biomes and dimensions (see gallery). - All skeletons drop various items like ores, materials, food, gear and enchanted books. - Several skeletons have some unexpected surprises for you. Be prepared for everything. - Rare underground chambers generate both in stone and deepslate caves. - You can decorate your buildings and dungeons with skeletons (use Silk Touch). - This mod is compatible with most biome & dimension mods by default. - Special features for some skeletons in Twilight Forest, Aether and Undergarden dimensions. - Skeleton loot tables and generation is easy to edit with a simple datapack. 💬 Permissions ✔️ You are allowed to include this mod in Curseforge & Modrinth modpacks. Also feel free to use this mod in your videos (I would appreciate it if you leave a link to the mod page in the description). ❌ You are not allowed to reupload this mod to any other websites/launchers/apps, use any contents of this mod (textures, models, recipes, tags, etc) in other projects, sell this mod in any way or include in paid modpacks - this mod is free for all players.

Verity JE.title: Verity JE
Verity JE.body: Discord This mod adds Verity, a personal assistant powered by AI at Groq.com to replecate the video made by ThatMob in Minecraft Java Edition. Verity JE is an official adaptation of the Verity property, created and published with explicit permission and contractual agreement from ThatMob. SETUP You will need to do a bit of setup to use the ai. Here is the tutorial: FEATURES The features of this mod are the following: - Verity (Your personal helper friend) - The box (Verity spawns in his own animated box) - Verity Demon (The monster that Verity can spawn in or cause.) - Several changes that vastly affect normal gameplay, like extreme darkness (seen in ThatMob's video) and more Language Support The AI Supports all languages, but the Speech To Text and Text To Speech only works (was tested) in English. Playthrough: If you want to support my channel, and watch an epic playthrough of the mod, watch this vid: I BROKE VERITY... The End of Herobrine.title: The End of Herobrine
The End of Herobrine.body: WORK IN PROGRESS Join the Discord to be notified of the updates! Ever wondered what a lore-accurate Herobrine would be like? 📄 About:   Unlike other Herobrine mods, you don’t have to spend hours gathering resources to build a totem for him to start haunting you. He's already in your world before you join it, and only your actions will determine how aggressive he becomes. ⚙️ Features: -  Herobrine Variants    Herobrine's behavior has been divided into the following variants: - Lurker Actively stalks players, occasionally finding new positions to observe them. - Builder Places structures (letters of his name, traps, and signs). ...and 4 more in development! -  Possessed Mobs    During gameplay, you will encounter mobs gifted with a fraction of Herobrine's power. Watch out! - Possessed Animals Each has unique abilities and won't attack unless provoked. Consider carefully what you will do around them. - Possessed Monsters Each may have higher health, armor, attack damage, attack range, or debuff duration. Prepare for a fight or run away while you still can! -  Enchantment    Having trouble fighting the possessed mobs? Enchant your weapons! - Notch’s Blessing Deals extra damage to all creatures, especially the possessed ones. Prevents Herobrine's wrath from rising after each kill. -  Totems    The totems are the key to weakening Herobrine and making him viable to fight. WARNING: The current boss fights are just placeholders, they are not final in any way. - Netherrack Totem Weakens Herobrine and lures him into battle. - Blackstone Totem Makes Herobrine mortal and forces him to fight to the death. Right-click while holding a wither star to activate It. -  Paintings    Want to build a spooky gallery? Be my guest! Cry(4×4); Fight(2x4); Netherrack(1x2); Blackstone(1x2); Altar(2×2); Lurker(1×2); Empty(1x2); -  Recipes - Cursed Head - Netherrack Totem Block - Blackstone Totem Block 🏅Special Thanks:   Possessed Villager Textures based on: TheBartman's - Uncrossed Villager Arms (Jappa).

The Hordes.title: The Hordes
The Hordes.body: For Forge, requires Atlas Lib. This mod will only support Neoforge instead of forge in 1.21 + Invasions _You hear the howls of a nearby horde_ On a configurable nights hordes of monsters will attack your base in waves from midnight until morning, with the encounterable mobs and times of day also being configurable. For guides about configuring the mod in version 1.2.0+ check here. Infection If enabled players and horses can be infected after being hit by a zombie, turning into a zombie after 5 minutes have passed or they die with the infection. In a players case this will kill them and spawn a zombie player in their place. This infection can be cured with a golden apple with the default settings, but can be configured to be any item which can be consumed, but not reversed. Optional settings that are enabled by default extends this to villagers, preventing zombie villagers from being cured. Has an option in the config to add any zombie variants of other mods mobs to the list of entities that can become zombified, providing there is a corresponding zombie for it to convert into. 1.3.0+ now has support for custom textures to make it possible to add zombified variants of similar mobs. Zombie Players When a player dies from infection or dies when an optional setting is enabled a zombified version of that player spawns in their place, containing all their items, or when underwater a drowned version. By default zombie players are immune to sunlight, but this can be disabled in the config. Other Misc Tweaks Optional settings to make zombie horses a hostile mob (enabled by default) and to prevent undead mobs from burning in sunlight (disabled by default). Special thanks to bstylia14 for the original mod concept and for providing ideas and help during development, as well as Ski_Z for helping find a lot of bugs and giving mod suggestions.

Doctor Who: Weeping Angels.title: Doctor Who: Weeping Angels
Doctor Who: Weeping Angels.body: Weeping Angels Mod Weeping Angels is a Minecraft mod that adds the iconic creatures from Doctor Who to the game. This mod was originally created by a_dizzle for Minecraft 1.5.2, and this version is a tribute to that original mod. Features - Weeping Angels will teleport you to a random location in a random dimension, including dimensions added by other mods and data packs. - The Timey Wimey detector item will alert you when there are angels nearby. - The mod is fully compatible with Vivecraft. - Weeping Angels can only be damaged with a pickaxe or zapped out of existence with a Chronodyne generator. - The mod is fully configurable, so you can customize its behaviour to your liking. Installation 1. Make sure you have Minecraft Forge or Fabric installed. 2. Download the latest version of the mod from the releases page. 3. Drag and drop the downloaded .jar file into the mods folder located in your Minecraft directory. Configuration To configure the mod, open the config/weeping_angels-common.toml / config/weeping_angels-client.toml file located in your Minecraft directory. From here, you can customize the behaviour of Weeping Angels, including whether or not they can teleport players between dimensions. Bug Reports If you encounter any issues while using this mod, please report them here. License This mod is licensed under the AGPL License. See the LICENSE file for more details. Server Sponsership

Born in Chaos.title: Born in Chaos
Born in Chaos.body: Born in Chaos is a mod that adds many new aggressive mobs with their own characteristics, it also adds a new boss, weapons and armor, decorative blocks, as well as new structures. Mod aims to diversify and complicate your survival by adding a variety of opponents that require a specific approach and tactics. With Born in Chaos, you will once again have a sense of fear of going out at night and exploring the dark caves, because now there will be dangers everywhere. Born in Chaos is also compatible with the Better Combat mod. This modification will make the combat system with new weapons more dynamic. Mod made with MCreator. To disable mobs and structures, the game rules are used before the creation of the world or with the help of the command _/gamerule_ in the game itself. Also, for configuration, you can try using mods such as Born In Configuration, Bad Mobs, or In Control VIDEOS AND REVIEWS Spoiler Gameplay Mod requires GeckoLib to work. Mod adds a lot of new mobs. Everyone differs in their level of threat and danger. Monsters are classified into types such as undead, spirits, arthropods, and monsters without a special type. All mobs spawn in specific biome types, making them compatible with any mod that adds new biomes. UNDEAD Spoiler Decrepit Skeleton A decrepit version of a normal skeleton. Can only attack in melee. It does not differ in special properties and is a rather weak opponent. Skeleton Demoman Almost everything is similar to Decrepit Skeleton. However, it does not burn in the sun and, when health drops to a certain limit, it starts detonating before the explosion, at this time it does not move and you have the opportunity to kill it before the explosion or manage to run away from it. Decaying Zombie It behaves like a normal zombie. This mob's attacks inflict Hunger and Rotten Stink on the victim. When the zombie is low on health, its flesh falls off, revealing a decrepit skeleton (turns into Decrepit Skeleton). Baby Skeleton Children's version of the skeleton. Runs pretty fast, but doesn't pose much of a threat on its own. Often serves as a servant of more powerful monsters. Bone Imp It is an enhanced version of the Baby Skeleton, found primarily in the Nether, immune to fire. Siamese Skeletons In many ways they are similar to the Baby Skeleton, but at less than half health they are divided into two separate skeletons. Drops Fused Bone upon death. Barrel Zombie A zombie stuck in a barrel is found primarily near water bodies, unlike ordinary zombies, it does not drown, and also has protection from the sun. Has increased armor. A wide variety of items can fall out of this monster, as well as complete garbage, as well as extremely rare and valuable things. Door Knight A zombie that uses everything that comes to hand as its equipment. The monster has protection from sunlight, increased armor, and is also able to block your attacks, which will be accompanied by a special sound. To deprive a mob of the ability to block attacks, you need to set it on fire or make an attack with an axe. Zombie Clown Slow and rather dense enemy. Attacking smashes an Intoxicating Decoction on the enemy, which slows down the victim and also causes a short-term poisoning and dizziness in her. When this zombie's health drops below half, it breaks a bottle of Stimulating Decoction under its feet, increasing the movement speed of all monsters around it, including itself. Zombie Fisherman Appears near bodies of water. Does not burn in the sun, hiding behind a hat, attacks the player with rotten fish, causing a long-lasting Rotten Stink effect. Has the highest chance of summoning maggots after death. Zombie Lumberjack In many ways it is similar to a regular zombie, but is armed with a special ax that can instantly break a vanilla wooden shield, and also has high damage. After death, he has a chance to drop his axe. Swarmer A zombie infected with flies, which has become a living nest for them. No longer burns in the sun. This zombie's attacks wil

Enlightend.title: Enlightend
Enlightend.body: Enlightend is a mod for 1.19.2 and above , enhancing the ends feel while also preserving its intended style. It expands on the desolate nature of the end while adding new biomes scattered few and far between the end islands. The mod also adds more exploration below and above the end islands. Travelling upwards in the End will lead you into the Upper End, which is like a massive asteroid belt far out from the end islands acting as an opposite to overworld caves, featuring its own distinct biomes, blocks, and items. Similarly you can also travel downwards too, and find the radioactive Enderneath or other rare materials to use. Just be weary of the threats in the end, whether it be biological or inorganic, after-all, you're in unknown territories. (also available for older versions but they aren't up to date with new content.)   Features : Plentiful and unique end biomes with their own ecosystems, theming, and ambience. New area far up from the regular end asteroids called the "Upper End" featuring its own biomes and materials Lots of new crops that all grow uniquely from other vanilla crops Ooze rain, a new weather event for the end Upgrades to the regular end with new stone, ores, foliage, and a new liquid Lots of decorative blocks New music tracks for the end Almost all of the blocks, items, and mobs in the mod have their own unique mechanics, it isn't just bloated purple end forests!   The Ennegel Grove The Ennegel grove is a biome based off of bounciness, with bouncy blocks of ennegel that make up the trees "leaves" and a good portion of the biomes floor. New plants called "springleaves" are scattered about, which will launch the player at a high velocity depending on the direction of the springleaf. There's also an indigo colored wood-set called and few other decorative plants.  A New food source called Bouncer Nuts grow under the indigo tree branches. These will eventually become too heavy and fall off of the tree, breaking open into a few bouncer "mobs" which will become squished and dropped as an edible item after about 10 seconds. Squished Bouncers eaten or fed to ringlings, but they cannot be replanted and will only grow off grown indigo trees. Furthermore, another new mob spawns here, called the ringling. The ringling will eat bouncers dropped from nuts or fed by hand from the player. When ringlings are fed bouncers, they become full and will begin digging through the indigo eylium below them, they will occasionally dig up ancient roots and rarely a rooting blade. Ancient roots can be eaten to submerge yourself one block into the ground, it can also be brewed into a rooting potion, which causes this effect for a longer duration. The Rooting Blade will apply that effect on hit for about 3 seconds.  The Enderneath The enderneath is an upside down ancient overgrowth, hidden below the end islands and lightly based around radioactivity. Lots of irradium ore generates within the biome and new threats called "stalkers" lurk here. Stalkers are very tough mobs, some of the toughest in the game as a matter of fact! They'll try to knock you off the platforms in the enderneath giving you an effect called "burdened" in the process, which will greatly increase your falling speed. Furthermore, killing a stalker will cause it to drop stalker its meat and ocassionally its teeth. Stalker meat is a very good food source since the stalker is a challenge to slay, and the stalker teeth can be crafted together with bismuth ingots to make a serrated hook, which has extra range and will bring mobs to your position when attacked.   glow gourds, azure berries, and cerulean stalk are also found only within this biome. Glow gourds grow down from cerulean vines, and overtime they'll sprout open with fronds off the sides, which allows them to be harvested slices that cause radiation when eaten. Azure berries grow off of lichen-like vines. These berries are very useful as they provide levitation to any player that eat

What Are You Voting For? 2023.title: What Are You Voting For? 2023
What Are You Voting For? 2023.body: The Minecraft Mob Vote is back, and that only means one thing: What Are You Voting For? is returning for 2023! If you aren’t familiar with my What Are You Voting For? mods, they’re mods that add all of the Mob Vote’s contestants into the game as accurately as possible before the vote even starts, so you can get a better idea of what you’re actually voting for! The mobs in this year’s Mob Vote, and What Are You Voting For?, are the Crab, Armadillo, and the Penguin! There are versions of the mod for both Minecraft 1.20.1 and 1.19.2! If you like the mod, please share it everywhere you can, so as many people as possible can see the mobs in-game! Made By If you like my mods, you might want to join my Discord server ! If you like my mods and want to support me, consider becoming a patron , it’s really appreciated! Patrons also get access to some cool rewards, like access to WIP builds of my mods! Mojang Studios’ introduction to the Mob Vote About the mobs: If a feature is surrounded by , it means the feature hasn’t been confirmed for the mob, but had to be added to this mod. If a feature is surrounded by , it means the feature was heavily implied for the mob, but wasn’t explicitly confirmed. Crab Mojang Studios’ introduction to the Crab Crabs are found in Mangrove Swamps, \ and are slightly rarer than Frogs. they’re able to climb up blocks, similarly to Spiders. \ The Crab’s left claw comes in three different sizes: small, medium, and large. This claw grows over time, increasing in size at a random time between 5 and 10 minutes. \ \ Crabs occasionally wave their left claws. \ when a Crab with a full size claw waves, it has a 1 in 30 chance to drop the claw (revealing a small claw underneath), claws dropped by Crabs only stay on the ground for a minute, so you’ll have to be quick if you want to get your hands on one! Crab Claws can be held to increase the maximum distance you can build at \ by 2 blocks. Every time a Crab Claw is used to build further away, it loses 1 durability, it has 100 durability in total and can’t be repaired. \ Crabs can’t be bred. Armadillo Mojang Studios’ introduction to the Armadillo Armadillos are found in Savannas, \ they’re rare, and only spawn in groups of one. Armadillos get scared easily, and will curl up into a ball when frightened. \ \ Curled up Armadillos are solid like blocks, \ take massively reduced damage, and are immune to arrows. Things that scare Armadillos are: . \ Monsters . \ Mobs that aren’t monsters (Armadillos calm down even if the mobs stay near them) . \ Getting hurt (scares nearby Armadillos too) . \ Players walking without crouching . \ Players turning too quickly . \ Players falling more than 0.6 blocks \ Armadillos can be tempted and bred using Eggs. \ When a baby Armadillo grows up, it drops an Armadillo Scute. \ 4 Armadillo Scutes can be used to craft Wolf Armour, which can be equipped to a tamed Wolf \ using the use button (right-click by default), and can be removed by crouching and using the use button on the Wolf with an empty hand. \ Because of potential confusion between Scutes and Armadillo Scutes, Scutes have been renamed to Turtle Scutes. Penguin Mojang Studios’ introduction to the Penguin Penguins are found on Stony Shores, and \ \ swap between being on land and in the water. \ \ Penguins are able to move quickly out of the water and leap onto land, but are clumsy when on land, and may trip and fall when hopping down blocks! \ \ Penguins occasionally look at mobs and happily flap their wings. \ \ Penguins occasionally approach and look at Players and other Penguins for a while. \ Penguins can be bred using Salmon or Cod. After being bred, one of the Penguins will go back to land and lay an egg. The Penguin will then try to sit on the egg until it hatches. Penguin Eggs will only hatch when Penguins are sitting on them. If an egg is left unattended, a nearby Penguin may claim it as its own. When using a Boat near Penguins, the Penguins will swarm around the Boat and spee

Vampirism.title: Vampirism
Vampirism.body: Important Note: Starting with Minecraft 26.1, Vampirism requires FactionAPI as a mandatory dependency. Please ensure it is installed alongside Vampirism. Vampirism Vampires are fast, strong and blood-thirsty entities, which do not like the sun, but don't fear the night, and the best thing is: You can become one! This mod allows you to become a vampire with all it's benefits and drawbacks. After being bitten by a vampire or manually injecting some vampire blood you get an effect called "Sanguinare Vampiris" which eventually turns you into a vampire. Alternatively you can decide to become a vampire hunter and start fighting those evil creatures. Get an overview about this mod here: Overview 🧛 Vampire As a vampire you don't need to eat that dry bread or strange fruit called "apples", you prefer some red and tasty blood, which you can to drink from animals or preferably villagers. If you are careful they might regenerate their blood over time, but if you suck all their blood at once, they will die. As a skilled vampire you may turn them into vampires instead. Furthermore, you may notice that you now have red eyes and fangs. In the beginning you are a very normal and weak vampire, but by performing vampiric rituals you can level up and gain new powers. Aside from becoming stronger and faster, you gain skill points which can be used to unlock abilities like night vision, transformation into a bat, teleportation and many more. However, becoming a strong vampire also has its drawbacks as you will receive damage from sunlight and have to face stronger vampire hunters. So you probably want to shift your activities to the night, unlock night vision and craft yourself a coffin to sleep through the day. Don't forget to color your coffin to make it match the rest of your home decor. 🏹 Vampire Hunter If you don't like vampires, this mod might still have plenty to offer. You can choose to become a vampire hunter instead and start hunting down those evil vampires. Equipped with crossbows and other useful weapons, you have a full arsenal at your disposal. By collecting items, fighting strong vampires and exploring the world you can level up and unlock advanced skills which improve your hunting ability or even allow you to use some of the vampires powers against them. ⚙️ Configuration This mod is highly configurable, besides several general settings you can change a ton of balance related values to your liking or disable parts of the mod you do not like. More information here: Wiki 🛠️ Troubleshooting FAQ: FAQ Troubleshooting: Troubleshooting Discord: Official Server 🗣️ Feedback Please direct all feedback to the Discord server here. 🌌 Addons - Vampirism Integrations: Add compatibility to several other mods - Werewolves: Become a werewolf - Vampires Need Umbrellas: Add umbrellas for sunprotection - Godly Vampirism: Reduce downsides from being a vampire - Vampiric Ageing: Adds an ageing mechanic for Vampires and, if installed, Werwolves. Elder vampires are more powerful - Vampire's Delight: Expanding vampirism into the world of Farmer's Delight - Bloodlines: Adding different bloodlines with additional skills for vampires 💻 Development This mod is Open Source. The code can be found on Github under the LGPL licence. It is actively developed by maxanier and Cheaterpaul as much as spare time permits. If you want to support the development you can give feedback, report issues, help to translate or if you have some coding experience even contribute to the development itself. Coding help is always wanted, alternatively you can develop you own addon mod or mod integration using Vampirism's API. 🏰 Official Server Official Server sponsored by Apex Hosting There is an official server sponsored by Apex Minecraft Hosting Join it here: https://vampirism.maxanier.de/server 🌟 Credits We hope you like this mod, please tell us what you like, what you would improve and what you would add! Created by maxanier, Cheaterpaul, Mistadon and wildbill22 Special thanks to lun

Threateningly mobs.title: Threateningly mobs
Threateningly mobs.body: Please do not install this mod on an existing save file. This mod includes biomes and dimension content,remove it may cause the save file cannot read. Hypocritical Saint process Find the dungeons located in the forest, snowy land, and desert respectively. Enter them and defeat the bosses inside, and each boss will drop its corresponding badge. After collecting all three badges, combine them to create the "Triple Eyes", which serves as the key to unlock the Distortion Dimension. Right-click the summoning stele with “Triple Eyes” to immediately generate a portal frame (consuming the summon stele),then use the “Triple Eyes” again to activate the portal. After entering the dimension, you will arrive at the center of the Saint Palace. Hold the " Hypocritical Saint Summon Rune" and right-click the central block to summon the Hypocritical Saint. This mod introduces several new mobs designed to make survival significantly more challenging. Specifically, their purpose is to hinder your progress. These mobs often possess unique abilities or resistances, and some may even target your livestock. Each biome now features 1-2 new creatures, categorized into medium and heavy types. Medium mobs typically have an HP of 40 or more, while heavy mobs boast an HP of 200 or higher. Additionally, some functional utility mobs have been added. Most of these mobs are hostile toward players, with abilities that make them even more dangerous. Their HP is often several times—or even ten times—that of vanilla mobs, making them formidable opponents. recommended to avoid them whenever possible. Tide 2.title: Tide 2
Tide 2.body: Tide is a Minecraft mod that expands the fishing experience, adding many new fish, mechanics, and rewards. Join the discord server if you have a question, feedback, or want to see what's happening! --- The Mechanics To get started, craft a fishing rod. This can be either the regular fishing rod from the base game, or one of the new fishing rods added by Tide. Some are craftable via a smithing table and string, while others can only be found throughout the world. Cast your line by holding right-click and releasing, then wait patiently for a fish to arrive. Fish not biting? Try crafting some bait to increase your fishing speed or provide special bonuses. Fishing rods will have different amount of bait slots, and by applying multiple different types of bait, you can stack their effects together. Tide also adds a simple fishing minigame for each fish you catch. Right click when the bar is inside the colored region to reel in the fish, but be careful not to lose it! Each fish has its own unique movement behavior and strength, so stay alert. _Some fish are easy to catch, while others aren't..._ --- Fishing Rod Customization You can add hooks, lines, and cosmetic bobbers to any fishing rod using a new block, the Angling Table . A variety of accessories can be created with unique effects. Some of the bonuses include easier catches, extra luck, or even lava and void fishing ! (or making your fishing rod look cool, in the case of the bobbers) _You can create any combination of hooks, lines, and bobbers at the Angling Table_ --- The Journal Keep track of all the fish you’ve caught via the fishing journal , a special book that gets updated every time you catch a fish. You can use it to track your completion progress, biggest catches, fish habitats, and much more. _Can you catch them all?_ Want to know where you can catch a fish? You can find fishy notes in crates that hint at the locations of individual fish. --- Customizability Many aspects of the mod can be changed to your liking. Need to tweak something? You might be able to find what you need in the config screen. Looking to add a fish or modify existing ones? Tide has a versatile fish data system, allowing mod or datapack developers to add their own fish to find in the world via JSON files. In addition to fish, you can also use datapacks to insert custom loot tables or crates to the fishing loot. Need help customizing something? Feel free to ask in the discord server. --- Compatibility Tide is compatible with many amazing mods: - Hybrid Aquatic - Nether Depths Upgrade - Stardew Fishing - Fishing Real - Fish of Thieves - Serene Seasons - Fabric Seasons - Ecliptic Seasons For more mod compatibility, check out this datapack!

Cobblemon: Legends Untold.title: Cobblemon: Legends Untold
Cobblemon: Legends Untold.body: This datapack/mod adds 8 Legendary, & 1 Mythical Pokémon, 5 structures, & 7 new items to cobblemon. _If you are using the datapack version please put the file in both your resource pack folder and the datapack folder. You may need to relocate some structures when updating your world._ This has not been tested on servers, use at your own risk. New Legendary (And Mythical) Pokémon & How to get them: - Rayquaza Rayquaza is found in the Sky Pillar, a new rare structure that you can find in mountian biomes. Bringing a Jade Orb to the top of Sky Pillar will spawn in a level 70 Rayquaza. Rarely in some structures you will find a Jade Orb or a Jade Map, a map that leads you directly to Sky Pillar. Every player on the server will get only one chance to catch Rayquaza. - Mewtwo Rarely in Legendary Structures like Sky Pillar you will find a new item called Mew DNA, using this & a nether star or a comet shard you can create Mewtwo in a Resurrection Machine. - Mew Mew is found in the Faraway Ruin, a new rare structure that you can find in jungle biomes. Entering the Faraway Ruins will spawn in a level 30 Mew. Rarely in some structures you will find an Old Map, a map that leads you directly to the Faraway Ruins. Every player on the server will get only one chance to catch Mew. The Faraway Ruins are based on the Faraway Island from Gen III. - Xerneas Xerneas is found at the Tree of Life, a new rare structure that you can find in oak forest biomes. Getting near the Tree of Life will spawn in a level 50 Xerneas. Rarely in some structures you will find a Life Map, a map that leads you directly to the Tree of Life. Every player on the server will get only one chance to catch Xerneas. The Tree of Life is based on a location from Pokemon Mystery Dungeon. - Legendary Birds The Legendary Birds are roaming legendarys that will randomly spawn in any biome, but they are 3 times rarer than starter pokémon. Different weather conditions will affect how likly they are to spawn. Articuno spawns 2 times more often during the rain, Zapdos spawns 2 times more often during a storm, & Moltres spawns 2 times more often during clear weather. - Walking Wake & Iron Leaves Walking Wake & Iron Leaves are found at Tera Dens, a new set of underground structure that come in 2 types: Water Tera Dens, & Psychic Tera Dens. Getting near the center of a Tera Den will spawn in the respective legendary at level 75. Walking Wake in Water Dens, & Iron Leaves in Psychic Dens. Rarely in some structures you will find a Tera Map, a map that leads you directly to either Tera Den. Every player on the server will get only one chance to catch them. Why these set of legendaries? ¯\\\_(ツ)_/¯

Aquaculture 2.title: Aquaculture 2
Aquaculture 2.body: Aquaculture 2 Only works with NeoForge from 1.20.4 and onwards Aquaculture 2 expands the fishing system in Minecraft with over 30 new fish to catch either with a rod (any modded or vanilla rod will work!) or found swimming in the wild . It also adds a series of new rods which allows you to equip hooks & bait for additional functionality. Customized fishing Line & bobbers are also available to make your fishing rod truly unique. Modifiers & customization items can be applied in the Tackle Box, which also allows you to store additional hooks, bait, line & bobbers. Each biome type - even modded biomes - have new types of fish that'll spruce up your fishing experience and your world with fish mobs swimming around in rivers, ponds and the ocean! The fish caught can be turned into fish fillets, the amount of fish fillets will depend on the fish   (Or weight, if the config option is enabled). Furthermore, you can get shiny new loot while fishing! (Including the fabled Neptunium tools or armor!   (Configurable) ) The Fishables Freshwater  Smallmouth Bass Bluegill Brown Trout Carp Catfish Gar Minnow Muskellunge Perch Arid Bayad  Boulti (Nile Tilapia) Capitaine (Nile Perch) Synodontis Arctic Ocean Atlantic Cod Blackfish Pacific Halibut Atlantic Halibut Atlantic Herring Pink Salmon (Also in rivers) Pollock  Rainbow Trout Saltwater Jellyfish Red Grouper Tuna Jungle Arapaima  Arrau Turtle Piranha Tambaqui Swamp Leech Box Turtle _& Freshwater fish_ Mushroom Island Red Shrooma Brown Shrooma _& Freshwater fish_ Other Loot  Driftwood  Tin Can  Goldfish  Message in a Bottle [Right click to reveal a message!]  Algae (Freshwater biomes)  Box  Lockbox  Treasure Chest  Neptune's Bounty Recipes Screenshots Media Older versions All older versions can be found on CurseForge Rights of Use You as the user may do the following with this mod without asking my permission. \-You may create videos or take screenshots and post them anywhere you please, I just ask that you note what the mod is and let people know where to get it. \-You may add it to a modpack as long as the modpack gives proper credit and links back to this page. You as the user, may NOT do the following with the mod. \-You cannot redistribute or re-upload this mod without permission! \-You cannot decompile the code or reuse the artwork for other mods, special circumstances may be granted upon request!

Ben's Sharks.title: Ben's Sharks
Ben's Sharks.body: THIS MOD REQUIRES GECKOLIB Ben's Sharks is a mod for both Forge and NeoForge that attempts to answer the question "What if sharks were added to Minecraft?" This mod currently adds 26 New Mobs and several Noteworthy items, each with unique uses. Install Just Enough Items (JEI) to view crafting recipes. Info about this mod will be provided in the Wiki (W.I.P). Disclaimer: Ben's Sharks does not encourage or condone with any form of Shark Hunting. It is worth noting that 1/3 of every shark species around the world is either endangered or flagged under protection. Sharks are a beautiful part of their respective ecosystems and must therefore be preserved. As of version 1.2.0, the "Shark Fin" item has been completely removed, essentially eliminating any form of Shark Hunting through the use of this mod. As of version 1.2.5, the "Shark Fin" item was re-added, but in the hands of the evil Illagers. Don't try and kill any sharks to get this item as they don't drop it. It can only be obtained by looting Pillager Outposts and Woodland Mansions. This mod is a solo project solely done by me, so expect there to be a lengthy gap between updates. Stay tuned. Click Here to get this mod in CurseForge.

The Obsessed - Advanced Psychological Ho.title: The Obsessed - Advanced Psychological Horror, Arachnid Stalker
The Obsessed - Advanced Psychological Ho.body: Welcome to The Obsessed. A mod by Vllax, the creator of Arthropod Phobia Expansions, with original direction from IDK Someguy. The Obsessed is a mysterious entity defined by one thing: it finds you fascinating, but in a way that is twisted and dangerous. Though it may initially seem friendly, its mood can shift without warning, and when it does, it will make your life a living nightmare. It hides many secrets that will be revealed in coming updates... A complex modular entity that truly feels as though it has a mind of its own, with countless advanced mechanics that will continue to be expanded upon drastically in future updates. You can find a spoiler with more information at the bottom of this page. Shaders and dense biomes, like the redwoods from biomes o' plenty, are recommended in conjunction with this mod. More info + MC versions! ⚠️ This is a highly complex mod receiving frequent updates, so transferring the full description and all versions between sites is challenging. For the full mod details, see its Curseforge page here!: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/obsessed

The Graveyard (Forge).title: The Graveyard (Forge)
The Graveyard (Forge).body: This project is for Forge. Forge support ends with Minecraft 1.20.1. 1.21.1, 1.21.7 to 1.21.8, 1.21.11, 26.1.2, 26.2 and 26.3 run on NeoForge and Fabric and are on the main project: The Graveyard Structures, mobs, blocks and a boss with a graveyard theme. Graveyards, crypts and overrun villages, the Corrupted Champion in its prison, and a Chronicle that collects the lore. Version: 1.20.1 Boss music "Incarnated Evil" thanks to Rotch Gwylt Support my work on The Graveyard adds graveyards, crypts and undead to the Overworld. Small graves generate in plains, deserts, savannas and on mountains. Larger graveyards generate in forests and taigas, a haunted house in the dark forest, and a crypt in the caves far below. The undead spawn at night, and a horde can appear near a player. Overrun villages are burnt-out vanilla villages: charred and scorched houses, smoldering embers, skeletons, corrupted illagers on guard and flocks of crows. At night tormented villagers wander through the ruins. Ringing a bell redeems them. If nobody rings it, they fade away at dawn. The lore is written in the Chronicle. Its 36 pages come in two ways: 19 lie as Lore Books in structures of the mod, and the other 17 are in chests. The Corrupted Champion waits in its prison above the ocean. Structures Structure Where it generates --- --- Small Grave forests and plains Small Graveyard plains and meadows Small Desert Grave, Small Desert Graveyard deserts Small Savanna Grave savannas and badlands Small Mountain Grave peaks, slopes, groves, meadows and cherry groves Medium Graveyard forests, flower forests and windswept forests Large Graveyard taigas and snowy taigas Crypt underground in cave biomes, between Y -40 and -10 Haunted House dark forests, swamps and old growth taigas Ruins forests Altar snowy plains and ice spikes The Corrupted Champion's prison at Y 210 above deep and frozen oceans Dead Tree dark forests and swamps Memorial Tree birch forests Giant Mushroom mushroom fields and swamps Mushroom Grave mushroom fields, jungles and swamps Overrun Village plains and meadows, deserts, savannas, snowy plains and taigas, one variant for each Mobs The undead Ghoul , Revenant and Nightmare roam at night. Ghouls and Revenants burn in daylight. Skeleton Creeper : an undead creeper. It swells before it explodes. By default the explosion does not break blocks. Wraith : can rise when you open a coffin or sarcophagus below ground. It puts out torches and other lights near it. Reaper : off by default, can be turned on in the config. The corrupted Acolyte : an illager in the service of the Corruption. It drops the Bone Dagger. Corrupted Vindicator , Corrupted Pillager and Corrupted Evoker : undead illagers that guard the overrun villages. Tormented Villager : appears in overrun villages at night. Weapons do not hurt it. Ring a bell within 48 blocks to redeem it and get experience. Left alone, it fades away at dawn. Nameless Hanged : a trader that only deals at night. It takes Corruption, which the mobs of this mod drop, as payment. Birds Raven : sits on gravestones, fences, walls and leaves. Crow : flies in flocks, eats crops and scatters when startled. Crows keep away from scarecrows: a carved pumpkin or jack o'lantern on a hay bale with a fence next to or under the bale, or an armor stand that wears a pumpkin. Magpie : picks up shiny items from the ground, such as nuggets, ingots, raw ores and gems. Hit it and it drops what it took. The Ghouling Use a bone staff on a block to raise a Ghouling. It follows you, fights for you and waits when told to. You can draw it into the staff and set it down again somewhere else. Give it a coffin or a sarcophagus and it carries 54 slots of items and picks up what lies around. How to get a bone staff is in the spoiler under The Corrupted Champion. Blocks and items Skeleton decorations : 39 skeletons, skulls and bone piles in normal and wither versions. They are carved from bone blocks in the Ossuary . Gravestones in 13 stone types. You

The Anomaly.title: The Anomaly
The Anomaly.body: The anomaly is a steve like abnormal creature that has slipped into your minecraft world, run from it. (inspired by the creepypasta series of "debase") YOU NEED GECKOLIB'S MOD FOR THIS MOD TO WORK! if you want to donate me on ko-fi: Minecraft Mod Trailer: P.S. Pet Cemetery.title: Pet Cemetery
Pet Cemetery.body: 📖 About: When one of your beloved pets die, they will drop a Pet Collar. Pet Collars can be dropped by Wolves, Cats, and Parrots. They do not burn in lava. Pet Collars display information about the pet in the description and are colored the same color as the pet's original collar. To respawn your pet, you must take the Pet Collar to a charged Respawn Anchor. Right-clicking the Respawn Anchor with the collar will consume the collar and respawn your fallen pet as a Zombie version. Zombie pets have decreased movement speed, decreased damage, and increased health compared to their living counterparts. Like Zombie Villagers, Zombie pets can be cured using a Weakness potion and a Golden Apple. If your Zombie pet dies, it will also drop a collar and can be respawned. Attempting to respawn a Zombie pet at a Respawn Anchor will respawn the pet as a Skeleton pet. Skeleton pets have decreased health, but increased damage and movement speed. Be careful - if a Skeleton pet dies, it does not drop a collar. Skeleton pets can also not be cured or turned back into their original form in any way.

Fungal Infection:Spore.title: Fungal Infection:Spore
Fungal Infection:Spore.body: - A Bioweapon gone wrong, this mod adds a hostile fungal infection to your peaceful Minecraft world. Face off against bloodthirsty mutated mycelium beasts as you fight back against a dormant bioweapon reawakened at the smell of fresh blood. Reemerging from centuries of slumber, this ancient project of a bygone era is ready to retake the world. Fight tooth-and-nail against an infection built to work against mankind, and try to get your own foothold and uncover the secrets of the infection's backstory before the infection takes over. - Infection: As you start your world, you'll find infected humans emerge, ready to spread the infection. Their bite inflicts Mycelium Infection, and upon a suitable host falling, they will rise again, as a pawn of the infection. This... thing is a bioweapon, built to eradiate mankind, and will only infect other humans. - Mutation: As the horrific infecteds eat and consume more biomass, they'll begin to undergo an evolution, mutating into new stronger forms, with the sole goal of elimination... and the reconstruction of a fallen hivemind. - The Hivemind: The infection wishes, beyond the culling of mankind, to rebuilt their hivemind. They have improved A.I. compared to vanilla mobs, and will attempt to group up into hordes, request back-up, build a hierarchy, and even begin the reconstruction of the hivemind, an interconnected network of minds. Be prepared, for as the infection begins to take root in this peaceful Minecraft world, you might just encounter horrific constructs of fallen humans, constructed by the contorted minds of their fallen brethren. Link This mod has compatibilities with : -Better Combat -Create -Farmer's Delight Wiki: https://www.fungalinfectionspore.wiki/ Discord: https://discord.gg/733Q8u83ux

YDM's Fennec Fox.title: YDM's Fennec Fox
YDM's Fennec Fox.body: This mod adds the Fennec Fox to the game. It can be tempted and tamed with rabbit meat items and you can bred them with rabbit foot, sweet berries and glow berries. They have the same behavior as the vanilla fox in the game. So it will hunt chicken, rabbits and fishes. If you tamed it, then it will follow you, but when it starts to hunt it will mind its own business. You can find them in the desert. Spawn settings can be changed in the biome modifier and biome tag.

Rainbow Reef.title: Rainbow Reef
Rainbow Reef.body: Rainbow Reef is a mod that adds various real-life species of reef fish to your world! check out our wiki to learn more! https://sites.google.com/view/rainbow-reef-site/home The mod now also adds several food items, one for each fish with a drop. Most of these foods have their own uses and niches that make them handy to have in all sorts of situations!

More Critters.title: More Critters
More Critters.body: !! Requires Geckolib !! More Critters is a Forge mod that adds new fantasy creatures (or as we like to call them, "Critters") to Minecraft. All of these new Critters have some sort of use to the player, have it be something as simple as food or something more complex like a new weapon. Besides just having uses, Critters also make the world of Minecraft more lively. There are currently 25 Critters in the mod Each major update will have a theme and add new Critters around that theme. But Critters aren't the only thing this mod adds! Side Content: Spoiler The Wandering Collector can be found in their wagon with their trusty Carrybug. These wagons can be found in many biomes from plains to badlands to even swamps! The Wandering Collector will buy any Critter related items from you so Critter drops are never useless. And the Carrybug can carry items and be ridden. In the wagon chest you can find the Critter Atlas, a sort of field guide to help you learn about the Critters. But there is something else that you might like in those chests... The Critterlings are small and passive creatures that can only be found in wagon chests. They are only an ambient mob but they instantly give life to any build. They can be transfered around easily with Critterling Sacks and they even dance to music discs! Deep underground, you might stumble upon Fossil Blocks. If broken, they have a chance to drop a Fossil. These Fossils can be placed on Fossil Displays and are excelent decorations! Hold onto them tight, they might come in handy later...
