Mutated Items.title: Mutated Items
Mutated Items.body: I'm exited to introduce you to a brand new mod called "Mutated Items". This mod is all about taking some of the most iconic items from Minecraft and turning them into new creatures called Mutated Items. To create one, you need to throw an item into a Nether portal. As the item passes through, there is a 10% chance that it will mutate into a new creature. Whether you're looking for a new challenge to face or just want to explore the world in a fresh and exciting way, this mod has got you covered. This mod was initially designed for a video of a French youtuber "FuzeIII" which consisted in a duel between him and me (and I won). I'm French and this mod was done with Mcreator (Sorry if I make mistakes in English 😅)   Spoiler Torchy is a small companion who will grow fond of you as soon as you place him down. It’s quite fragile but determined to light up your world. It doesn’t have much regard for his own life and will transform into a torch as soon as it enters a dark area.   Torchy will set zombies and other attacking creatures on fire, despite its low health.   Spoiler This cage can be obtained by placing a Jack’o Lantern on a Dungeon Spawner, granting it arms and legs. It behaves just like a regular spawner, with one key difference. It has a taste for Zombie Flesh, Blaze Rods, Magma Cream, Bones, and Gunpowder.   Once digested, the Spawning Hutch will absorb the mob into its core and then spawn it every 30 seconds.   Spoiler This repressed ninja is a perfect training dummy and will show you the strength of your strikes. However, be careful not to hit it too hard with swords or axes, as you might get them stuck in the hay.   It’s rather indiscreet and will attract the attention of all hostile creatures around you. Beware of blazes, as they can set it on fire and deal extra damage.   Spoiler This jelly bear may not taste great at first, but in its bear form, it becomes more and more appetizing. If it feels too bland, you can infuse it with a potion to change its color and flavor accordingly.   You can regenerate any parts you’ve removed by filling the gaps with Slimeballs.   Spoiler This demon, exiled from the underworld for his thirst for power, will tear pages from the book he came from to transform them into energy blades when attacking. When these blades turn red, they may carry a curse that clings to your armor and deals massive damage.   Legend says that one of these creatures was powerful enough to defeat a Wither.   Spoiler These endermites, trapped within their pearl, harbor great instability. If you strike their shell, the Ender Hull will swap its position with yours. They have a chance to appear when an Enderman dies.   They make many Enderman farms obsolete. If your structure isn’t equipped with a filter for these creatures, you may find yourself face-to-face with the Endermen you intended to exterminate.   Spoiler This hammerhead shark roams between the central island of the End and the End Cities. Its bedrock skin makes it impervious to physical attacks, but its heart, made of End Crystal, is vulnerable. The crystal is responsible for synchronizing its monstrously heavy limbs.   If you manage to target its heart, it will explode. It’s recommended to use a ranged weapon, as the explosions are deadly.   Spoiler This sculk goblin has skin that stores experience. Its gloves allow it to steal XP levels from players. However, you can recover all your lost levels by defeating this creature.   Unlike its counterpart from the Deep Dark, it has health comparable to a player’s and can be easily defeated with an iron sword.   Spoiler You can summon a Furnace Golem by placing a Carved Pumpkin on a Furnace. By default, it will be unlit, and you will need to light it with fuel (coal, lava, etc.). The stronger the fuel, the longer the golem will stay lit.   You can put an item in its main hand for it to hold. If the item can be smelted, the Fu

Whispering Spirits.title: Whispering Spirits
Whispering Spirits.body: Whispering Spirits is an atmospheric horror mod which introduces glowing eyes that appear around your world. These spirits are harmless, although if you look at them, they will vanish and you will hear unsettling whispers around you. Feel free to use in modpacks This mod is no longer in development or supported, feel free to use the idea or recreate it in your own style.

Unusual Fish.title: Unusual Fish
Unusual Fish.body: Unusual Fish Mod --- Unusual Fish Mod adds a plethora of fictional fish and other aquatic creatures to the game, as well as new gear, blocks, and foods! The unusual fish from this mod can be found in many of the games aquatic biomes. Many of these fish will drop their item form when killed, which can be cooked into a fish fillet, or crafted into one of the culinary delicacies this mod adds. Alternatively, enchanting a fishing rod with the Unusual Catch enchantment will allow the unusual fish to be caught, among other items. Craft a sea spine block to defend your underwater base, collect ripper teeth after they prey upon another fish, feed a sea pancake for a rare weather shell, or use the volt detector block to track nearby volt anglers for a redstone signal! ---

Distant Friends.title: Distant Friends
Distant Friends.body: "Distant Friends" is a Minecraft mod that adds eerie player-like mobs to your game. These mobs stand still in the distance and punch the air / sneak as if they were real players. But as you approach them, they disappear without a trace. Need a server? Get 20% off your first month by using promo code "mrbysco" For questions feel free to join my Discord. Want to support us?   -Mrbysco

Dracolotl.title: Dracolotl
Dracolotl.body: _(Requires GeckoLib)_ With this mod, you will gain the ability to hatch the Ender Dragon egg into the cutest apex predator, the Dracolotl. When you summon your Dracolotl, it will be bonded to you, and follow you into battle! Or stay at home like the rest of your minecraft pets. To summon your Dracolotl, create a three block tall pillar with the dragon egg on top, then place either Obsidian or Bedrock one block away from each of the pillar's faces. Place an end crystal atop each of those blocks, and interact with the Dragon Egg to hatch it. Check the images tab for an example. If you spawn a wild Dracolotl through a bucket or spawn egg from the creative mode menu (or commands), it can be tamed using Eyes of Ender. Like Axolotls, Dracolotls can breathe underwater, and will play dead upon taking enough damage, causing hostile mobs to ignore it. When a Dracolotl recovers, it will give itself and its owner the Strength effect. The Dracolotl can also fly, and be interacted with by its owner using a bottle to obtain Dragon's Breath. If a Dracolotl is fed a Chorus Flower, there is a very slim chance for it to produce a new Dragon Egg. By naming your Dracolotl 'Hellkite,' you can give it a special 'Red Dragon' skin.

Monster Expansion.title: Monster Expansion
Monster Expansion.body: Overview Tired of the same old "click-and-slash" Minecraft combat? Do you wish that fighting a monster felt less like a chore and more like an epic, strategic hunt ? Welcome to Monster Expansion. This mod is a ground-up recreation of the skill-based combat from games like Monster Hunter, built with zero dependencies on other mods. We haven't just added new mobs, we've added a whole new, dynamic way to fight them. Check out the Wiki for the most detailed information The Hitzone & Part-Break System Gone are the days of mindlessly hitting a giant, invisible health bar. Combat Mechanics Target Specific Parts: Monsters have different body parts with seperate health pools. These parts also have a damage type weakness. For example BLUNT is usually preferred to break a monster's head, while SLASHING deals more damage to its tail. Break & Sever Parts: Focus your attacks on a single part to break it, or use a slashing weapon to completely sever a monster's tail! These actions reward unique crafting drops. Elemental Weaknesses: Each individual part has its own unique set of elemental weaknesses. We've just introduced our first element, Ice, with many more planned for the future! A monster's head might be immune to Ice, but its wings might take massive damage from it. Monster armor also inherit the resistances/weaknesses for elements from the monster it was made from. Your Skill is What Matters Monster Expansion rewards precision, positioning, and movement. You can't just stand still and trade blows. Active Dodging, Not Tanking: Monster attacks are specific and telegraphed, requiring good movement to dodge. Most heavy attacks will punch right through a vanilla shield or temporarily disable it. Eating too many attacks repeatedly will stun you, and some monsters have a chance to inflict unique status effects. Its advised to not face tank the monsters. Dynamic Gameplay: Breaking a monster has real consequences. Sever a monster's tail, and its tail-swipe attack will have less reach because the parts that deal the damage are literally gone. Credits: Textures are done by Cliosow :3 Japanese translations by day Russian translations by lacrite Many of the monster roars and sound effects were created by mixing and editing high-quality, Creative Commons 0 (CC0) assets from community-driven sites like: Freesound Pixabay Zapsplat I am incredibly grateful to the original artists who make their work available for everyone to use! Note: The previous GPLv3 tag was a configuration error. The source code for this project has never been public/open-source; v0.5.1 aligns the license text with the project's actual status.

Hunter's Return.title: Hunter's Return
Hunter's Return.body: Hunter's Return (formerly hunterillager mod) Add the evil Hunter mob! They hunt wild animals while making a cheeky laugh... This mod adds a new mob, the Hunter Illager! They spawn in a new structure so keep an eye out for it! This mod doesn't only add the hunter though... (Forge version needs Bagus Lib for 10.0.1 or above!) - Features Hunter Illager These little menacing dudes live in a wooden hut that spawns in forested biomes. If he spots a player or animal, he will attack them with a bow n' arrow! When he successfully corners his enemy, he will creepily laugh... After being sufficiently damaged, Hunters will eat food to replenish their health. The boomerang is the Hunter's secondary weapon, which can also be crafted by the player. It can be enchanted with Bounce to become more bouncy when striking walls. Also Hunter Love to use Mini Crossbow... Having mini crossbows on both sides will make it easier to load arrows and unleash a barrage of arrows on enemies at once. The mini crossbow has low firepower, but it's an easy-to-use weapon for people who move around a lot. Warning: backport and fabric port not planned also do not ask a port Credits: Bagu_Chan: (Coder and Model designer) MCVinnyq: (Original Texture-artist) Fuffles: (Overhauled the textures) Evo (Documentation) Akogiri (Sound design and new model!) andrejulio90: (Overhauled the textures) mcfella: (Overhauled the textures) ilyymira:(new mobs texture!)

Occultism.title: Occultism
Occultism.body: Magicians are widely known as powerful wielders of magic. In truth, however, they rely on summoned spirit slaves, known as demons, who perform magic on their behalf. This mod is inspired by the world of Jonathan Stroud's Bartimaeus. If you haven't read the books, do that now! With the help of occult rituals you will summon spirits, also known as demons, from "The Other Place" to aid you in your adventures.       Contents  A ritual magic system centered around summonable spirits allows you to automate various tasks , store vast amounts of items , let demons mine in void dimensions , create powerful enchanted tools and jewelry, get support from familiars,  and much much more. Begin your journey by crafting the Dictionary of Spirits , and following that in-game guide , discover the secrets of the spirit world, find otherworld groves hidden in plain sight by gaining the " Third Eye ", and finally summon your first spirit.     See  Screenshots  for some impressions. Looking for an overview of how things work? Take a look at the  Feature Diagram .   First Steps  1. Break grass until you drop  Demon's Dream   Seeds , much like you would obtain vanilla wheat seeds. 2. Craft the seeds with a book to obtain the  Dictionary of Spirits 3. Follow the instructions in the dictionary.    Or simply jump right in with Vallen's Bit-By-Bit on Occultism:          Feedback, Bug reports or Questions? Join our Discord!   Alternative link:  https://discord.gg/trE4SHRXvb     Use in Modpacks Use in modpacks is allowed without restrictions, as long as you link back to this page. If you create the modpack on curseforge a link will be automatically created in the files sections, you do not need to add a manual link.     Configuration, Recipes, Balancing If you need help configuring the mod for your modpack, or need a specific feature for compatibility please join  Discord and get in touch!       License The source code for this mod is released under the MIT license, but some assets are available under different licenses. View https://github.com/klikli-dev/occultism/blob/master/LICENSE for the full text. Contributions and derivative works are welcome!   All the good-looking textures have been graciously provided by Ridanisaurus (all programmer's art is on me!), check out their texture pack for the Enigmatica mod pack .   Special Thanks To the (neo)forge team , without whom mods would be in the Stone Age. To Ridanisaurus  for creating the best textures this mod will ever see. To  vemerion   for their new familiar content. To  feelian who made awesome new spirit models. To  Aldahel ( @Aldael on X) who made the fantastic new demonic husband model. To naj77  for providing proper skeleton skull models that can be rendered by Patchouli. To  Oblivionaire897 , AlgorithmLX ,  Krypt0p ,  kappa-maintainer ,  IgroGames2227 , Dimagreg and NiceClown for their translations. To Lorc , Delapouite and Skoll at game-icons.net for various icons and parts of icons. To Bonemouse for the Isabella Texture Pack that provides the basis of some block textures

GoatMan.title: GoatMan
GoatMan.body: ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Inspired by the cryptid legend, GoatMan adds a monster that reacts dynamically into your world, stalking silently until it's seen, then chasing, fighting, or fleeing depending on how the encounter unfolds. (UPDATE 3.0) FEATURES: Spoiler BEHAVIOR - Stroll: wanders around, eats crops, attacks mobs, mimics nearby mob sounds - Creep: slowly creeps toward the player that either triggers flees, chase, or vanish - Stare: stalks when player looks directly at it, may break into chase or flee depending on the interaction - Chase: begins chasing when player either looks at it, get too close, or in stalk state for a period of time - Flee: runs away when low on health, set on fire over time, hurt by other mobs, nearby mobs it usually avoids or damaged by player - Vanish: forces itself to instantly disappear and can inflict darkness effect on player depending on the interaction - Anger: everytime the GoatMan is harmed or stunned increases the risk of being killed that resets a few seconds - Abduction: instead of always killing you, grabs you instead. Steals your items and stashes it near the last location you were abducted, places you somewhere else with half-heart that leaves debuffs depending on the level of abduction. Becomes more punishing the more you are abducted with the chance of just killing you on the third abduction. Each level of abduction decays after a few days without interacting with GoatMan ABILITIES - Mimicry: can mimic nearby or killed mob sounds - Charge: does a brief charge then lunges at player; destroying blocks and applies status effect if it manges to hit any mobs. Breaks shield and gets stunned if it hits a shield while player manages to block it in time - Leap: Jumps when player is too far or high; destroying blocks and applies status effect if it manages to hit any mobs. Temporarily disables shield if it manages hit it while player is blocking ENVIRONMENT - Hunt: attacks nearby mobs - Crop: eats nearby planted seeds or crops - Avoid: actively avoids and flees during chase when wolves, villagers, and iron golems are nearby - Pick Off: attacks isolated villagers, wandering traders, or wolves EVENTS - Goat Omen: spawns a few goats that marks GoatMan's territory - Goat Herd: spawns a herd of goats along with GoatMan - Watched: goats will sometimes stare silently at the player within the vicinity; chance for GoatMan to appear if any of the goats are harmed during this state. Occurs more at night - Followed: a goat will sometimes follow player at a distance for amount of time before it rushes at you; chance for GoatMan to spawn if the goat manages to get close to you. Occurs more at night MISC - Loot: drops goat horn, rotten flesh, bones, crop seeds, golden apples, golden carrots, and enchanted golden apple - Config: almost any feature such as break block, drop block, charge, leap, creep-stalk, herds, omens, music, spawn rates, etc. to be turned on, off, or tweaked (Configured Mod Highly Recommended) HIGHLY RECOMMENDED: Configured (Use it to customize the behavior, soundfx, features, etc.) Credits: Gargin, Cadentem, Voxla

The Pale Hound (DISCONTINUED).title: The Pale Hound (DISCONTINUED)
The Pale Hound (DISCONTINUED).body: ! THIS MOD IS NO LONGER BEING WORKED ON ! _(It sucked ass anyways)_ A COMPLETE REMAKE IS ON THE WORKS. "With arrows still lodged in its back, they serve as a reminder of its fearsome nature. Lurking in the icy landscape it calls "Home" where the cold has not slowed it down." Hiding behind the blizzard and the darkness, this creature will hunt you down the moment you enter its domain. You won't know where it lurks... You won't know where the footsteps come from... But you will feel the starving void in its eyes piercing the back of your neck. This mod greatly enhances the fearsome Cave Dweller, giving him better animations to make him feel more alive and a better texture to fit this creature's name. Making some changes in the model to create this terrifying entity. I give huge credit to Gargin, Schpalrbo and Cadentem for making the great Cave Dweller. And to Llamii_Llama for helping me out with the AI! Have fun! And remember... There are all sorts of things lurking in the dark. The file should be in: " .minecraft\saves\"your_world"\serverconfig "

Omni-Mobs.title: Omni-Mobs
Omni-Mobs.body: Omni-Mobs adds some powerful and overpowered mobs into Minecraft for mob battles. --- - As of version 0.1.3, no additional mods are required . - You can disable music , camera shake , and the coremod , in the config. Disable the coremod if you have problems with launching the game. (It should be okay now though.) Coremod is used for: - Metapotent Flashfur's enhanced defence. - Defence against Mixins. - getHealth() modification defence. - Flashfur's getHealth() -modification. - The mod currently does not work on servers. LAN might work, but it isn't tested often. - This mod is still in alpha. There may be bugs, and anything might be changed at any point! - Status: For the past several months, I have been working on a ground-up technical rewrite of the mod to make it more powerful and easier to update in the future. In the meantime, updates will be limited to bug fixes. - Porting: Currently, I'm not allowing ports to other platforms such as Bedrock Edition, or other Minecraft versions. --- Mobs Common Boss Entity Features "Boss Entities" ( BossEntity ) refer to every mob except Metapotent Flashfur. They are still normal entities, but they override many core game systems. This Includes: - "Absolute" Defences : While they can't be truly absolute, Boss entity defences are immune to DATA_HEALTH_ID setting, setter-method invoking, and field/ EntityDataAccessor traversal, as well as some other things. - Immunity Bypassing: Boss entities bypass conventional defences such as damage caps and custom health. - Set-Target Immunity: Boss entities cannot be forced to switch targets. - TP Immunity: Boss entities are immune to /tp , teleportTo() , setPos() , and setPosRaw() . - Despawn Immunity: Boss entities are immune to being removed from existence by methods such as discard() , remove() , setRemoved() , levelCallback.onRemove() , EntitySection.remove() , etc. - Other Random Immunities: Boss entities are also immune to getNavigation.stop() , freezing, setNoAI() , setNoGravity() , potion effects, and much, much more. Flashfur Appearance: A black and white cat with blue eyes. He wears blue clothes, and is twice the size of a normal Minecraft cat. Powers/Stats: - Supernatural Condition: Flashfur is far faster, stronger, etc, than a normal cat. - Health: 750. - Damage Reduction: 95%. - Damage Cap: 2% max health (15). - getHealth() Modification: An additional 5% of his damage will be a getHealth() delta - this means it adds a value into the return of other mod's getHealth() methods to change the final value. - Invulnerability Detection: Bans healing and erases entities if invulnerable or not taking much damage. - Anti-Respawn: If an entity tries to respawn while Flashfur is attacking, it will be cancelled. - I-Frames: 10 ticks. - Weak Damage Negation: ~0.02667% max health (0.2). - Regeneration: 0.01333333% max health (1) health per second. - setDeltaMovement() Resistance: 100% (immune). Offence Moves: - Swipe: Flashfur will swipe at his target, dealing 75 + 10% max health damage to entities in a 1.5-block radius. He can do this many times a second. - Ground Slam (Shockwave Generation): Flashfur will slam his paws on the ground, creating a massive explosion that deals 1,500 + 50% max health damage, and affecting entities in a 1,500-block radius, getting weaker by distance. - Super-Speed-Slashes: Flashfur will fling entities into the air, and will slash them every tick (1/20th of a second) for 100 ticks, each slash dealing 5 + 1% max health damage. During the 100 ticks, entities cannot move, and Flashfur is invisible (to simulate the fact he is moving so fast, you cannot see him). - Supernatural Speed: Flashfur will run towards his target, reaching them instantly. Entities caught in the speed trail will be swiped, and are flinged into the air. He will sometimes do this a bunch of times in a row. Defence Moves: - Parry: Flashfur will parry 80% of attacks. - Dodge: Flashfur will dodge 80% of damage if he didn't parry it (any type). - Jump Dodge: Flas

Mo' Zombies Wave.body: This is a port of the outdated 1.7.10 mod, Mo'Zombies, which features 100% of the original content. It was created to fill the need in the +1.12.2 of Minecraft for a simpler zombie mod, like the original version, but that had greater peculiarities in relation to the behavior of the mobs and their drops and, mainly, to finish the Survivor mob Mob list: - Survivor - Zombie Notch - Zombie Herobrine - Zombie Dwarf - Zombie Chef - Nether Zombie - Zombie Miner - Zombie King - Zombie Knight - Zombie Pirate - Zombie Pa - Zombie Cyborg - Zombie Creeper - Disco Zombie

EarthMobs.title: EarthMobs
EarthMobs.body: Remember the mobs from  Minecraft Earth ? Well they're back! In this mod, we have added an array of mobs you might've seen from Minecraft Earth. From the Muddiest Pigs to the Jolliest Llamas, & new dangers like the climbing Boulderer & overwhelming Viler Witches. You can find all these mobs scattered across the Overworld! Most of the ideas & concepts originated by Mojang Studios, but brought to the base game by us!  With some tweaks to integrate with vanilla gameplay & style. (Requires:  Bagus Lib )    !Backports & Fabric ports are not planned! :Credits:     Evo_934 (Lead artist) baguchi (Lead coder)   Farcr & MCVinnyq (Former artists and owner)   Special Thanks elliebear  azzy Achefslife

Advent Of Ascension.title: Advent Of Ascension
Advent Of Ascension.body: Welcome to Advent of Ascension! Advent of Ascension is a modern adventure and exploration sandbox mod designed to expand and extend gameplay during and beyond vanilla, catering to all playstyles. Add new content to the Overworld and the Nether, and new dimensions beyond! Play it as the featured mod or throw it into your existing pack to add more content without ruining the balance or stability! AoA is being rebuilt from the ground up, with modern modding design principles and styles in mind. Discover a brand new experience! - All mobs being redesigned from scratch with all new AI, loot, and extra interactivity and designs - All dimensions being reimagined from the ground up with brand new worldgen, biomes, mobs, and content - All skills being reimagined on a brand new system designed to be both enjoyable and rewarding - All equipment and items rebalanced to fit in almost any pack without destroying balance - Brand new boss challenge system, built to challenge your combat skills without becoming a grind Written with a serious focus on optimisation and performance, AoA can be installed on almost any standard Minecraft install with only a moderate RAM cost. AoA's latest version is fully documented on one of the most detailed Fandom wikis in Minecraft modding. Find any mob, check any weapon, learn about any ore - it's all explained in detail on the Advent of Ascension Fandom

The Boiled One: Reimagined.title: The Boiled One: Reimagined
The Boiled One: Reimagined.body: THE BOILED ONE This horror mod adds a "The Boiled One" into Minecraft. He is an entity with a custom AI system and is highly configurable. This entity was created by the YouTuber Doctor Nowhere. What does he do? - Stalk the player if he's not attacking by slowly moving closer to the player. If the player leaves his sight of 120 blocks he will teleport closer. - After a while of stalking, he will either choose to attack the player, scare the player (runs up then despawns) or just despawn. - Configurable chance to watch you sleep, he will move closer to the bed until he is on top of it and wakes the player giving them paralysis, unless they leave the bed in which he will despawn. - Spawn blood rain around the player in which they receive paralysis. What is configurable? - Time delay between spawns [default 6000 in-game ticks] - Daytime spawning [default is FALSE] - Minumum & Maximum time delay between The Boiled One spawning & him attacking you [default min: 800, max 1400 in-game ticks] - Attack damage dealt by The Boiled One to the player [default is 200] - Blood Rain probability [default 5000, the higher the number, the rarer it is] - Despawn When attacking timer [default min 800 & max 1200] - Spawn Chance [default 4000, the higher the number is the rarer he'll spawn after the delay timer] - Step height addition [default 10, number of additional blocks The Boiled One can climb] - Watch player sleep [default 0.2, Min 0.0 & Max 1.0, 0.2 would be 20% chance when you sleep] - Paralysis timer after The Boiled One wakes player [Default 300 in-game ticks] The config file can be found in the "serverconfig" folder in your game save. Info & Credits: - Use command "/the_boiled_one spawn_delay get" to see how many ticks have passed for The Boiled One's spawn delay. - Use command "/the_boiled_one spawn_delay set [number]" to set how many ticks have passed for The Boiled One's spawn delay. - Mod based on "The Boiled One Phenomenon" by Doctor Nowhere. - Mod was created using MCreator, a mod-making tool by Pylo. - I only release downloads of my mods via CurseForge, Modrinth and my website, please do not download from anywhere else as they may contain viruses!!

The Anomaly Rephased.title: The Anomaly Rephased
The Anomaly Rephased.body: Warning! This mod requires GeckoLib! (Development Paused) The Anomaly is the new entity added by the mod, this entity seems to reside mostly in the caves, tormenting anyone who delves deep into them. Stay awake or it might evolve over time. For those who have played this mod before, the anomaly might have changed slightly it's behaviour. The mod is meant for long playthroughs, you will not encounter the entity during the first days, make sure to make the most of it. The mod is meant to be played without much more knowledge about the entity. I won't respond to most questions about the entity's behavior. Sounds were made by Mazellmi and SCP Containment Breach. Commands · "/anomalyconfig (entityspawn/anxietyeffect/crashenabled)": For changing settings that may be annoying. "entityspawn" does not change spawnrate, you can try "/give @p the_anomaly:deathmode_switch" tho. This mod was possible thanks to MCreator!

Saint's Dragons.title: Saint's Dragons
Saint's Dragons.body: Adds rideable and usable companion dragons. Dragons can be tamed and ridden, with configurable stats and behaviors. Designed for players who want powerful fantasy creatures without complex progression systems. Wiki.

Alshanex's Familiars.title: Alshanex's Familiars
Alshanex's Familiars.body: Description Alshanex's Familiars mod is an addon for the Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks mod for minecraft Forge 1.20.1 and NeoForge 1.21, which adds new mobs called "Familiars", which can be found scattered around the world. These familiars can be tamed using Arcane Essence, which will make them follow you in your adventures and fight at your side using powerful spells. These familiars can also be transported by using a Familiar Tome, and these tomes can be put in a Familiar Bed to recover the health of the pet contained in the tome. Check the wiki section to know about everything this mod adds! Support and troubleshooting Disclaimer Item sprites made by PixelMine: https://mcmodels.net/vendors/2/pixelmine Familiar models and Sound School assets were made by SamusDev and were bought in: https://mcmodels.net/products/9249/rpg-pet-pack-giga-bundle https://mcmodels.net/products/10220/rpg-class-series-bard

Kobolds.title: Kobolds
Kobolds.body: This mod adds in an underground civilization of kobolds which can be traded with and they defend their dens from the common threats of the Overworld! ~Features~ Friendly Kobolds that can be traded with! Kobolds enjoys consuming Amethyst Shards! Kobold defends their homes from hostiles. Peaceful Kobold Enchanters that offers potions and Prospector, a new enchantment! Kobold Den structures that spawns under Forests. Zombolds from when Kobolds die to any Zombie & be cured just like Zombie Villagers!

Cosy Critters & Creepy Crawlies.title: Cosy Critters & Creepy Crawlies
Cosy Critters & Creepy Crawlies.body: Adds adorable and abstruse atmospheric animals, accentuating aesthetics. A client mod. Does not need to be installed on the server. All effects can be individually disabled or configured: use command /cosycritters or the mod list menu. Birds Birds flock together in the sky and occasionally land on blocks, favoring locations high up. Birds will take off and scatter when disturbed by a nearby entity such as a vehicle, mob, or projectile. Tiny Spiders Appear from within cobwebs , crawling out along the walls, floors, and ceilings. Moths Attracted to lights. Will surround any light emitting block left exposed to the sky. The Hat Man sleep paralysis demon easter egg - disabled by default Additional Links - discord - update notes - issue tracker

DivineRPG.title: DivineRPG
DivineRPG.body: DivineRPG offers multiple Dimensions worth of content for you to explore. Find the secrets that lie within   DivineRPG has many bosses for you to battle. Can you beat them all?   Not every mob inside of DivineRPG is trying to kill you. Some mobs want to trade with you   DivineRPG has lots of new armor, tools and weapons, each with different perks. What will you choose?   📺 Video FAQ Series We’ve put together a helpful YouTube playlist to answer common questions and showcase DivineRPG's features in action. ▶ Click here to view the full DivineRPG FAQ Playlist ⚠ Episode 6 specifically demonstrates the brand-new portal system – don't miss it!   If you wish to join our Discord just click the banner above. If you have questions about DivineRPG, we have a channel for that as well   Click the picture above to see the credits

Aether bedrock mobs.title: Aether bedrock mobs
Aether bedrock mobs.body: Aether bedrock mobs This modification brings content from the addon of the same name for bedrock to the original Aether. This addition is necessary for those who are tired of the usual Aether and are looking forward to new adventures. To download you need geckolib and the original Aether. New entities and structures will not spawn in biomes added by other addons. New dungeons This modification adds new dungeons to the world of aether. Crystalite dungeon: Labyrinth: Spirit dungeon: Salt dungeon: Elder dungeon: In data structures you can name new bosses, their henchmen and get new, unique weapons. New bosses Crystalite golem, enemy with powerful blows and a large number of assistants. Can only be summoned at night. Aether Naga, a huge worm with fast attacks. Can only be summoned at night. Spirit, is an equal opponent to you, can be summoned at any time. Salt crab king, slow but with strong hits, can be summoned at any time. New mobs The fashion has a large number of new ambient mobs living in this dimension. Next updates In the future it is planned to add a large number of new structures and bosses.

Wan's Ancient Beasts.title: Wan's Ancient Beasts
Wan's Ancient Beasts.body: _Please note that this is a BETA version of the mod that adds only a few content and is not bug-free. In case you want to leave feedback, feel free to use the comment space below or the dedicated channel in the WanMine Discord server._ Are you ready to meet all the beasts of Minecraft's ancient past? Like the Sniffer, they are all creatures from prehistory and each one brings with it amazing new features! Version 1.4.0 (16/01/2026) – The Good, the Bad & the Ugly Update Spoiler NEW ANCIENT CREATURES 1) Charger Neutral Mob that can be brought back to life with its eggs From time to time it will sit down and loaf Natural enemy of Raiders: attacks them on sight Attacks the player only if attacked first or if the player is holding a Beetroot If fed a Beetroot it becomes over-aggressive , attacking anyone on sight and dealing double damage (effect ends after the first hit) Can be tamed like a horse, but it’s much harder: When you fall from it, it will attack you once Feeding Sweet Berries makes taming easier Once tamed, it can be equipped with a saddle and ridden Abilities Press C → Headbutt attack Press Spacebar → Charge attack (double damage + knockback, straight line, requires recharge) Can be bred with Glow Berries --- 2) Raider Hostile Mob that can be brought back to life with its eggs Highly aggressive predator that attacks every mob (similar to the Eater) Scared by the Eater, but the Eater does not attack it Can be made neutral by giving it Ancient Meat Once neutral, it will attack only if provoked Pack hunter: attacking one will aggro the entire pack Natural enemy of Chargers Looting Mechanic When it kills a mob, it drops more loot (base Looting I ) Can be increased up to Looting IV by feeding it the new Pitcher Plant When attacking with its head, it has a chance to drop one of its horns Can be bred with any type of meat Found as Illager troops in their own structures and during Raids --- 3) Snatcher Neutral Mob that can be brought back to life with its eggs Small and fast, can climb surfaces thanks to hooked claws Occasionally steals food or items from player inventories and chests To retrieve stolen items, hit it once: If not hit in time, it will devour the item and it will be lost forever Taming Make it steal its favorite food, the Nasty Stew , from your inventory Once tamed, it can be equipped with a Barrel Abilities Press C while looking at it → it climbs onto your shoulder Press C again → throw it If thrown near a chest or barrel, it will steal loot and bring it back to the owner --- NEW MOBS 1) Tamer New Illager variant Found during Raids and in Raider structures Usually rides a Raider troop Equipped with a sword --- NEW ITEMS 1) Charger Armor Found in dungeons (commonly in Charger structures) Can be dyed Works exactly like Golden Horse Armor --- 2) Raider Horns Dropped by Raiders and craftable into three variants: • The Fearsome Horn Crafted with Eater Teeth Applies the Fear effect to all mobs in a 20-block radius for 5 seconds 10s cooldown • The Shrieking Horn Crafted with Echo Shards Emits a powerful blast dealing heavy damage in a 20-block radius 10s cooldown • The Spectral Horn Crafted with Phantom Membrane Instantly kills all Phantoms and Vexes in a 20-block radius 10s cooldown --- 3) Nasty Stew Used to tame the Snatcher --- NEW SNIFFER PLANTS The Sniffer can now find the following new seeds: 1) Rafflesia Decorative flower Works like a Spore Blossom , but on the ground 2) Sundew Decorative plant Attracts flies (similar to a firefly bush) 3) Equisetum Decorative prehistoric plant 4) Moonflower Decorative flower Behaves like Pink Petals Can be placed on earth-like blocks 5) Ginkgo Trees New saplings that grow into 1x1 or 2x2 trees Includes a full Ginkgo Wood Set (planks, doors, etc.) 6) Olden Moss New moss variant --- NEW BLOCKS & MECHANICS 1) Paleo Table Crafted with 4 planks and 2 pottery sherds Used to: Duplicate pottery sherds Transform beast eggs into decorative blocks Acts as the job site block for the Paleo

LivingThings.title: LivingThings
LivingThings.body: Adds various new mobs to Minecraft, to make the world feel more alive Ingame information about mobs/items is provided through Patchouli (by Vazkii)  download here (not required but strongly recommended ) This mod is available for Forge, Fabric (since 1.18.2) and NeoForge (since 1.20.4). Check the versions tab to see all versions of the mod. The Fabric version requires the Fabric-API get it here Detailed information about the mobs / items can be found at the wiki   click me Currently Added Mobs (for ingame images see gallery) Elephant Giraffe Lion Shark Penguin Ostrich Flamingo Crab Mantaray Raccoon Owl Ancient Blaze Koala Snail Monkey Nether Knight Shroomie Seahorse Baby Enderdragon Peacock Compatible Resource Packs: LivingThings Compat Compatibility for Xaero's Minimap, JourneyMap and What Did I Just Kill? Environmental.title: Environmental
Environmental.body: 📖 About: Environmental is a general overworld surface expansion mod that further incentivizes exploring existing biomes, and completes and improves them visually. Introduces new biomes such as Blossom Woods, Pine Barrens, and Marshes! Alongside these are several new mobs, including Slabfish, Deer, Zebras, Tapirs, and more!

Fossils and Archeology: Revival.title: Fossils and Archeology: Revival
Fossils and Archeology: Revival.body: Fossils and Archeology is a Forge and Fabric mod that offers a variety of prehistoric creatures that are brought back to life through discovering bones, extracting DNA, creating Embryos, and making eggs. Along with dinosaurs there are other prehistoric creatures such as mammoths, smilodons, terror birds, dodos, and more. There are currently 60+ prehistoric creatures added by the mod! Alongside with the new mobs you are able to make, there is an archaeological aspect for the people who like to explore more or collect beautiful new blocks. Fossils and Archeology Revival also now has built-in support for Farmer's Delight, Roughly Enough Items and Jade. Thank you all for the continued patience! We are proud to have made the jump to 1.18.2 after so many years of what basically amounts to rewriting everything from scratch. We are very thankful for everyone that continued to have hope in us even when in times everything seemed hopeless. As for the people who gave up, we hope that we'll see you again when you rediscover our mod! Next update should take much less time... hopefully haha! Fossils and Archeology first started off in Minecraft beta 1.7.2 under the original author, Flammarilva and Team July. Since going open source at the end of 2012, the Revival project started under a new team and has been going since. For more information, visit the official mod wiki here. We are on discord! Cave Dweller Evolved.title: Cave Dweller Evolved
Cave Dweller Evolved.body: Original mod : Cave Dweller Features - Cave Dweller has lots of additional (configurable) behaviour - Some issues fixed (e.g. it works in multiplayer) FAQ - Another user has created a Fabric port: Cave Dweller Evolved (Fabric) "Cave Dweller Evolved (Fabric)") - There are no plans for < 1.18.2 ports Commands Ther are some commands when you use /cave_dweller - fast_forward : Increase (or decrease) the current spawn or noise timer (in ticks) - get_target : Displays the current spawn target (cave dweller will spawn at its destination and target it) - get_timer : Displays the current spawn or noise timer (in seconds), format being: current / target Biomes - Datapack config takes priority (\cave_dweller\tags\worldgen\biome\cave_dweller_surface_biomes.json), by default it contains forge:is_spooky - In the configs you can set whether surface biome list is handled as a white- or blacklist - You can also configure the biomes in the configs but you'll have to enable the override config for that to take effect Dimensions - You can manage the dimensions it can spawn in through the configs - by default the Cave Dweller will only spawn in minecraft:overworld - The entries are based on the dimension resource key, not the dimension type resource key - If a dimension contains no valid players it it will not tick its logic (e.g. timers will not go down) - The maximum amount of cave dwellers is per dimension Compatibility - If you're using the mod Enhanced AI you will need to add the Cave Dweller to the [Base.Targeting."Entity Blacklist"] config entry

Jagm's Kiwis.title: Jagm's Kiwis
Jagm's Kiwis.body: JAGM'S KIWI MOD Welcome! This is a mod I made as a moving present for a friend who went to live in New Zealand. I decided to polish it up and release it to the public. It is inspired by the Cute Kiwi Birds mod by Lordloss_ which hasn't been updated since 1.16. All code and assets are original. FEATURES Kiwi birds spawn in most forest biomes . They will occasionally dig for items , including seeds, berries, and sometimes nuggets of iron and gold, according to a loot table that can be configured using a data pack. They can be bred with seeds , and they lay eggs which work the same way as chicken eggs. If you slay a kiwi bird (you monster) they will drop kiwifruit which can be eaten or crafted into delicious pavlova . There is a small chance that a laser kiwi will spawn instead of a normal one. Watch out. Just like real life, kiwi birds are vulnerable to invasive predators . Don't let your pet cats get too close! CREDITS Created by Jagm! Translations: 简体中文 (Chinese, Simplified): Nuttar2004 繁體中文 (Chinese, Traditional): Lobster0228 Français (French): Jagm Русский (Russian): itsrec0very toki pona (Toki Pona): Jagm If you want to help translate the mod into another language, get in touch with me on Discord (jagm) or submit a pull request on Github. NOTES This mod is available for Forge, NeoForge, and Fabric! You have permission to use this mod in mod packs. Refer to the license for other questions about distribution. The source code and issue tracker are available on Github.

Book Wyrms.title: Book Wyrms
Book Wyrms.body: Book Wyrms adds Book Wyrms to your forests, lizards that come in a variety of colors. You can herd them for their meat and colorful scales, using plain books to breed them. Most importantly, you can feed them unwanted enchanted books to recycle them into new random enchanted books. Wyrms come in 7 colors, each with a different pool of enchantments they can provide: Gray , most common, can produce any enchantment Red , can produce enchantments for melee weapons like Swords Orange , can produce enchantments for ranged weapons, like Bows or Crossbows Green , can produce enchantments for tools, like Pickaxes or Shovels Blue , can produce enchantments for armor or Shields Teal , can produce enchantments for Fishing Rods and Tridents Purple , can produce enchantments for some misc modded items like Domestication Innovation's Collar Tag (if none are present, they will act as Grays) Additionally, Wyrms have various genes that affect their recycling behavior, which you can see using the Book Wyrm Analyzer: Enchanting level , determines how many levels the Wyrm needs to digest before making a new book (stronger enchantments are worth more levels) and how strong are the enchantments it can produce Digesting speed , determines how fast does the Wyrm digests books Indigestion chance , determines how likely the Wyrm is to have an indigestion and regurgitate some shredded paper and (magical) digestive fluids While the boluses produced by indigestion may feel bad, they can be refed to recover part of the magic of the digested books, or made into Wyrmutagen . This substance will let you modify the stats or color of your Wyrms. Changing a Wyrm's color will also cause it to shed its previous scales, letting you peacefully obtain more (even if you changed it to the same color). Spotlight (outdated textures): Current mod compatibility: Any modded enchantment can be produced by Gray Wyrms, and also by the appropriate colored one if it's for a matching vanilla item (for example, Ars Nouveau's Mana Boost/Regen go on vanilla armor, and as such will automatically be added to the Blue pool if the mod is here) Guns Without Roses's guns go in the Orange pool Domestication Innovation's Collar Tag goes in the Purple pool Alex's Mobs's Straddleboard goes in the Purple pool Superior Shields's Shields go in the Purple pool Create's Potato Cannon goes in the Orange pool, Copper Backtank in the Blue pool I Wanna Skate's Skateboards go in the Purple pool If Farmer's Delight is present, you can slice Wyrm meat just like you can slice other meats, and the Stews will require the Cooking Pot to be made If Mekanism, Create, Thermal Expansion, or Integrated Dynamics is present, you can grind Scales into Dye using their machines If Botania is present, you can cycle through the Scales' color using a Mana Pool and the Alchemy Catalyst Configuration: Natural spawns are done with a biome tag and a forge biome modifier, maybe a datapack/kubejs/crafttweaker can change them, let me know if that works Stats of wild Wyrms, the stat caps, and how effective are the various Wyrmutagens can be changed in the common config Enchantments that the various colored Wyrms can provide can be changed through the pool_ item tag (the enchantment pool is any enchantment that can be applied to at least one item in the tag, empty tag = default to all enchantments) If you get reported about a "Suspicious Chad Bolus", it means that there are no enchantments for a given color pool at a given enchanting level, check the configs for ways to mitigate if necessary (it shouldn't happen in vanilla with unconfigured values, might come up with higher enchanted values, modified pools, or unlucky mod compat with the purple pool)

Knight Quest.title: Knight Quest
Knight Quest.body: Knight Quest is a mod that adds over 30 armor sets, each with passive abilities, hostile mobs with unique skills, new weapons, tameable mobs, a boss with 3 phases, and much more. The mod revolves around a block called the Great Chalice , which must be filled with Great Essence (crafted by combining 4 Small Essences obtained from killing monsters).   This mod is highly compatible with Better Combat and Epic Fight , so their use is recommended. For the latter, you'll need to download the Epic Fight x Knight Quest Compatibility resourcepack. The Item Obliterator mod is highly recommended if you want to block certain items. For example, if you want to prevent all armor from being available in the mod during gameplay, you can block them using this mod. Its alternative for mobs is You Shall Not Spawn . The JEI mod is also recommended for viewing the recipes of all items within the game.   The mod is highly configurable through the config file. For any questions, problems, contributions, new ideas about content/mods, and more, you can join our official Discord and comment in the appropriate channels.        Great Chalice     It is the main object of the mod. Craftable as if you were making a cauldron, but with copper ingots. Its primary function is to create the item " filled goblet ". This block can be filled by interacting with it (right-clicking) using great essence , an item craftable by combining 4 small essences obtained by killing monsters. When it is completely full, you can fill an "empty goblet " to use it as a craftable item for most items in the mod, or you can interact with a radiant essence to spawn the boss Netherman, the Architect of Chaos, or you can interact with a Chaotic Essence to activate the weapons' abilities.        Small Essence Small Essence is a special item dropped by both vanilla mobs and the mobs from this mod, with a low probability that can be configured.   Great Essence   Great Essence is the main item of the mod, obtained by crafting 4 small essences in a square. It is used to fill the great chalice by interacting with it (right-clicking).   Empty goblet A filled great chalice can be emptied with this item to generate the filled goblet.   Filled goblet The filled goblet is used to craft the majority of items in this mod.   Ratman eye Eye of the Ratman , dropped by Ratman, is used in various crafting recipes. It shines brightly...   Lizzy Scale Lizzy scale , dropped by one of the mod’s mobs, the Lizzy, is used as a crafting item.   Radiant Essence Radiant Essence is crafted using small essence and a nether star. If you interact with it on a filled great chalice, it will summon the boss Netherman, the Architect of Chaos.   Radiant Essence   Chaotic Essence is obtained by killing the boss Netherman, the Architect of Chaos . If you interact with it onto a filled Great Chalice, you'll be able to activate the weapon's abilities.        Most of the weapons have passive and active abilities, that must be activated using a chaotic essence to be able to use them.   Paladin Sword   Radiates the justice and valor of a lost paladin. It features an active ability that grants the wielder temporary invulnerability, allowing them to endure even the most challenging battles. Its passive ability gradually regenerates health over time until reaching a certain percentage of maximum HP, making it a reliable weapon for prolonged engagements.   Kukri Silent as a shadow and cruel as winter. Its active ability temporarily increases movement speed, giving the wielder an edge in both offense and evasion. Its passive ability allows consecutive quick attacks to freeze the target, immobilizing enemies and opening opportunities for follow-up strikes.   Nail   Wielded by those who dare the hollow. Its active ability allows for a fast das

Kimetsu no Yaiba (Demon Slayer).title: Kimetsu no Yaiba (Demon Slayer)
Kimetsu no Yaiba (Demon Slayer).body: DISCLAIMER This is a NON-PROFIT , fan-made project created for community enjoyment. It is NOT affiliated with, endorsed by, or associated with Koyoharu Gotouge, Shueisha, Aniplex, ufotable, or the "Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba" Production Committee. NO COPYRIGHT INFRINGEMENT IS INTENDED . All intellectual property rights belong to their respective owners. Use of internal data such as textures and models is PROHIBITED . This mod adds decorative blocks, weapons, characters, biommes, armors and foods! How to progress in Slayer, just follow the advancements! For demons you have to consume blood, 3 drops of blood will make you go up one level (50 drops will make you go up to the max level, but if you keep consuming blood you will get more hearts! ) Survival Path to Joining the Demon Slayer Corps Your initial trial to join the Demon Slayer Corps is to defeat one Demon . In the original story, Demons can only be vanquished with a Nichirin Blade, but in this mod, you can defeat them with any weapon. However, Demons are considerably more powerful than vanilla zombies or skeletons, making solo defeat quite challenging. If a Demon Slayer Corps member is nearby, cooperating with them will make the fight significantly easier. After Joining the Demon Slayer Corps Upon defeating a Demon, the "Demon Slayer Corps" advancement will automatically be achieved. Simultaneously, you will be supplied with a Nichirin Blade, a Corps Uniform, and a Kasugai Crow to serve as your messenger. Holding the Nichirin Blade in your hand will change its color, and you can switch forms with the R key and use Breathing Techniques by right-clicking. In this mod, your techniques will clash with and mitigate enemy attacks while they are in use. Almost all weapons in this mod generate a weak attack when swung. Use these swings to clash with and mitigate enemy attacks when you cannot use Breathing Techniques or Blood Demon Arts. Demon Transformation By drinking "Muzan's Blood," an item rarely obtained after defeating Demons, you can choose the path of becoming a Demon . Upon transforming, sunlight becomes your weakness, you become neutral towards other Demons, and you become hostile towards the Demon Slayer Corps. Naturally, you will no longer be able to progress with your Demon Slayer Corps advancements. Advancement System As a Demon Slayer As a Demon Slayer, continuously defeating Demons will cause your rank to rise and, consequently, your stats to improve . To become a Hashira, the great objective of defeating the Twelve Kizuki awaits you. As a Demon If you choose to become a Demon, your rank within the Twelve Kizuki will increase by challenging other Demons to Blood Battles or by continuously defeating Demon Slayer Corps members. To become an Upper Rank Demon, you must defeat an Upper Rank Demon or a Hashira. Special Advancements - "Hashira Training": This advancement is achieved by defeating a Hashira. It is uniquely prepared for each Hashira, and completing it will increase specific stats. - "Pinnacle of Martial Arts": This ultimate advancement is achieved by defeating a Hashira or Upper Rank One. From this point, by continuously fulfilling the conditions outlined in the advancement description, you can acquire powerful abilities such as the Demon Slayer Mark. World Generation Biomes Numerous unique biomes modeled after locations from the original story exist. Some entities (e.g., Rui, Sabito, etc.) will only spawn in their respective, dedicated biomes associated with their character. Structures Many structures that appeared in the original story are faithfully reproduced and appear in the world. The interiors of these buildings even meticulously recreate hidden lore revealed in the fan books, offering plenty of exciting exploration for fans. Key Setting R : Change breathes or blood demon arts Right Click : Use breathing or blood demon art (need nichirin sword or blood demon art item) S + Jump : Back Step M : Demon slayer mark (need advancement grant) Commands /
