Myths & Legends.title: Myths & Legends
Myths & Legends.body: Myths & Legends introduces unique creatures inspired by folklore from around the world, each with distinctive abilities and mechanics.The mod focuses on delivering a dark and immersive atmosphere, bringing a fresh layer of exploration and danger to your Minecraft experience. The creatures you’ll encounter include: - Imp - Possessed Armor - Knight/Archer/Inquisitor - Gargoyle - The Black Charro - Condemned Soul - Alp - Lampad - Abaddon - Karakondjul - Scorched Sentinel - Amarok Items: - Fire Heart - Cursed Core - Bound Soul Ingot - Possessed Armor Fragments - Ironshade Armor - Soulpiercer Armor - Stony Shield - Gargoyle Axe - Gargoyle Fragment - Gargoyle Shard - Altar of the Dead - Ethereal Flame - Soulbinder Amulet - Umbra's Whisper - Molten Fist - Scorched Skin - Scorched Bone - Core of Abaddon - Svarog's Ring - Antique Emblem - Amarok Essence - Amarok Hide - Frosthowl Armor - Necklace of Torngarsuk - Structures: - Ancient Vestiges - Mausoleum - Old Camp - Scorched Nest Spoiler Note: _This mod is currently in alpha, meaning it is still under active development. Features and entities may be adjusted or removed in future updates, and there may be bugs or performance issues. I appreciate feedback and patience as I work to improve and expand the mod!_ Addons: - https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/reanimated-myths-legends Other Projects: - https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/reimagined-myths-of-the-sea - https://modrinth.com/mod/fablesmod

Piglin Proliferation.title: Piglin Proliferation
Piglin Proliferation.body: Piglin Proliferation diversifies Piglins by giving unique features to their vanilla variants, as well as adding new Piglin types to fill specific gameplay niches. Along with a few more miscellaneous additions (and lots of content planned for the future), this mod aims to flesh out Piglins and establish their unique identity as a diverse and multifaceted people of the Nether. Vanilla Piglin Additions Piglin Brutes and Zombified Piglins have been expanded upon! Zombified Piglin Variants Zombified Piglins now keep the equipment and appearance of the Piglin type they were converted from: Fig. 1: This Zombified Piglin was clearly a Brute in its past life. Each piglin type has a corresponding zombified piglin variant, and they can spawn naturally as well as being created through zombification. By default, these are: - Piglin, holding either a sword or a crossbow - Piglin Brute - Piglin Alchemist _(new Piglin type from this mod)_ - Piglin Traveler _(new Piglin type from this mod)_ Zombified Piglins can now actually use any ranged weapons they're holding - you don't want to anger them! Configuration In the config, you can: - Disable this feature entirely- Tweak the spawning chances for Brute, Alchemist and Traveler variants Data Pack - If you want to make a zombified variant for a modded Piglin type, you can use a resource pack to add a new overlay skin under assets/piglinproliferation/textures/entity/piglin/clothing_[piglinid] , where [piglinid] is the namespaced in-game ID of the modded piglin - If you want them to spawn naturally, make a datapack that modifies data\piglinproliferation\data_maps\entity_type\zombified_piglin_variants.json and follow the format below: - { "values": { "minecraft:skeleton": { // the texture file for this would be named "clothing_skeleton" "weight": 100, "item": "minecraft:diamond_axe" // spawns with a diamond axe in it's main hand } } } - If you're going to copy and paste this, remove the comments (aka the // fields) - By default, Bygone Nether's Piglin Prisoner and Piglin Hunter have textures in this format and will thus keep their clothing when zombified. They will not spawn naturally unless put in a datapack manually. - Make sure the mob id exists in game before putting it inside the field Piglin Brute Changes Piglin Brutes now have a special attack, making them more dangerous than ever before: Fig. 2: A Piglin Brute charging at the player. If you're not careful around them, they can knock you to your doom... Inspired by the arm brace on their vanilla texture, Piglin Brutes now carry a Buckler , a specialised shield which they use in a new charge attack; they rush towards their enemies at high speed and try to bash into them, dealing massive damage and knockback if they land a hit. If you defeat a Brute in combat or raid a Bastion chest, you can get a Buckler of your very own! It lets you charge forward for 0.75 seconds, during which you cannot turn, jump, or be knocked back. Bashing into an entity while charging deals 6-8 Attack Damage and activates your Critical Aura (exclusive to players), which ensures that your next attack is a critical one. However, you can't charge in water - this was implemented to avoid overlap with Riptide Tridents. Full details can be found in-game by hovering over a Buckler item and pressing Sneak : Enchantments The Buckler has exclusive enchantments! Both of these replace Critical Aura with a different, unique ability. Fig. 3: A nether enchanting setup, perfect for the Buckler. - Turning (Levels I-V): Each level increases your turning speed and charging time but decreases the shield bash's attack damage. At max level, you have complete turn control for 2 seconds but only deal 1-2 damage. _Disables Critical Aura gain after shield bashing._ - Bang! (Levels I-III): Shield bashing creates an explosion instead of a regular attack, which is larger at higher enchantment levels. It deals heavy damage to any entities in the area, but that includes you! It also decreases the Buckl

CorndumGuardianReborn.title: CorndumGuardianReborn
CorndumGuardianReborn.body: This mod adds a boss called "corundum guardian", which was included in "corundum meadows" mod in 1.16.5. I liked the design of it so decided to remake it with permission. For now, you can't meet it in survival. So play this mod if you want to meet some challenge or need a good boss for your mod packs. The boss's properties - Swing its both arms. - Leaping toward target after certain amount of time. Can leap in chain after landing by 20%. - After using leaping, its landing will cause shockwave. Can be avoided by jumping. Watch this video for better understanding https://youtu.be/E6ZzfyYt-OE?si=z68fw_a3042R53tO Available config options - All of its stats - Stats of its shockwave - Melee attack casting speed Curseforge link https://legacy.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/corundum-guardian-reborn Original mod link https://legacy.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/corundum-meadows

Unusual Prehistory.title: Unusual Prehistory
Unusual Prehistory.body: About Unusual Prehistory Unusual Prehistory is a mod that adds ways to revive a variety of prehistoric creatures and plants and various ways to use them! This mod requires Geckolib! Quick Start Guide To begin your journey to resurrect prehistoric plants and animals, you need to find fossils found throughout the world. Stone fossils yield mesozoic fossils while deepslate fossils yield paleozoic fossils, there are other types of fossils to be found as well! Once you have fossils you will need an analyzer to extract DNA from them, and from there you can use a cultivator to create eggs, embryos, or plants using the DNA and organic ooze as fuel. Every prehistoric creature and plant has something to offer, whether it be useful items or simple ambience. You can learn more about them and the rest of the mod through the Encyclopedia of Prehistory, which you can craft with any fossil and a book! Mod Loader and Version This mod is available for Forge 1.18.2-1.20.1. We will no longer be updating this mod because we have moved on to its sequel mod, Unusual Prehistory 2!

Nyctophobia Dread.title: Nyctophobia Dread
Nyctophobia Dread.body: Nyctophobia - This Datapack is Smithed Compatible! Fear the dark, enter the caves, but be careful. Carry a light, it hunts in the dark. This data pack adds a mysterious new monster that will stalk you in the dark, stay too long and it will attack. The creature will try its best to avoid you seeing its body, it will disappear when you get night vision, and when it enters light As soon as you enter your world you will be plagued with TRUE darkness. Light level 0 is now pitch black, giving the creature a perfect home. If you are using optifine or sodium, download the version of the resourcepack under the datapack with "[OPTIFINE]", attempting to load the default resourcepack with sodium or optifine will give you an error. For the fullest experience, if you are using optifine, try setting the minimum light level in your shader to the lowest it can go to make dark areas pitch black. Please do not ask for dynamic lights support as I have already decided im not adding it Recommended Settings Brightness - Low (Somewhere around 25 - 50) 📠 Commands Set Difficulty: /function nycto:difficulty/(difficulty) Give Creature: /function nycto:grue/give 💀 Difficulties Easy - Creature takes longer to arrive Normal (Recommended) - Creature takes normal time to arrive Hard - Creature arrives sooner than normal. Give you slowness upon arrival Credits Programming and Models - HAK0TA538 Sound Design - At Dead of Night Datapack based on Grue Mod True Darkness Shader - Shock_Micro

Book of Dragons.title: Book of Dragons
Book of Dragons.body: Discover the dragons and tame them to learn more about their behaviors. Explore together, build your bond and see the world, because now? Now you have _ DRAGONS _! Dragons aren't mobs waiting for you to wander into range. Each one sees, hears and remembers, has a temperament all its own, and juggles a whole set of instincts: hunting, resting, exploring, playing, guarding its turf. None of it is scripted. It all _emerges_ from who the dragon is and what's going on around it, courtesy of the Fauna Engine . Watch for a while before you walk up. You'll learn a lot, and so will your Book. Every dragon carries its own genes, which decide its colors, markings and patterns, and how tough, fast and fiery it turns out. Common coats are everywhere; some are rare enough that you'll remember where you were when you saw one. The Dragon Manual - _Everything we know about every dragon we know of!_ Immersive 3D Flight - _Fly in styles & places none have flown before!_ Expansive Genetics System - _Limitless combinations of variants, coats, and markings!_ Emergent AI - _Simulated dragons behave like animals with real drives and instincts!_ Engaging Dragon Taming - _You can really train your dragons_ Dragon Variety - _Fully unique dragons with individual personalities_ Personal Progression - _Research and bond with the dragons of the world!_ Custom Advancements - _For the achievement hunters!_ Ultra Configurable - _Tune flight, camera behaviors, griefing, and accessibility in-game!_ Data Driven - _Customize or create your own genetics, custom spawns, and more with datapacks!_ Ultra Compatible - _Works with many popular mods, support for map mod icons, shaders, and more!_ Any Hooligan worth their salt carries a BOOK OF DRAGONS . To get your own copy, buy it from a certain travelling Hooligan merchant who shows up as soon as you first _ Acquire Hardware _. A _totally not suspicious_ trader, check out his wares! The Book of Dragons updates as you interact with each dragon. Not sure where to find them? The Hooligans can sell you some maps pointing to the nearest roost ! That handy _viking anvil_ also helps you turn an unemployed villager into your very own Hooligan trader! Viking Anvil Craft it with the recipe above, or buy one from the Hooligan Drifter. Dragon Whistle Call one dragon over from anywhere, as long as you're outside in the Overworld! Rattle-Staff Command your entire army of dragons with even more authority! Taming is a long process of befriending a dragon. Make sure to Strip all armor and make sure you're not holding any weapon/ shield ; Pay close attention to the dragon, tend to its needs, and you'll soon earn the trust of a new dragon friend! Always make sure to check the BOOK OF DRAGONS for data on the dragons and progression! Food is only the start, though. Every species has its own idea of how trust is earned. _Slowly now!_ This mod is licensed under All Rights Reserved, and the mod is provided as is. All screenshots were taken with Complementary Reimagined + Euphoria Patches, and the Reimagined resource pack for the visuals and lighting shown! CREDITS RU-RU Russian Translation provided by HoVeTLw ! DE-DE Standard German Translation provided by the TLOTD group ! SCH-DE German Dialect Translation provided by Isla Nublar ! PL-PL Polish Translation provided by TikereQ ! FR-FR French Translation provided by Enzo Demarle ! PT-BR Brazilian Portuguese Translation provided by MrMagister and Will !

Scorched Guns 2.title: Scorched Guns 2
Scorched Guns 2.body: Now Requires Curios and Geckolib and Framework SCORCHED GUNS V2 is a total standalone remake featuring a massive arsenal of over 40 guns, from muskets, to shotguns and machineguns, to automatic missile launchers, and rayguns. Discover new resources, battle formidable enemies, and explore treacherous dungeons in this expansive Minecraft mod. New Weapons: Progress from blackpowder firearms to advanced copper, iron, treated brass, and diamond steel weaponry. Unique weapons crafted from blueprints found in buried treasure, bastions, ancient cities, and end cities. Attachments: Scopes: Reflex, Medium, or Long scopes provide different magnefication, or go tactical with a Laser Sight. Magazines: Attach a Extended Mag to increase magazine capactity, or a Speed Mag to increase reload speed. Underbarrel: Use different grips to provide stabilization, or attach different bayonets for melee strikes or Bayonet Charges, which increases damage based on player speed. Stocks: Use different stocks to increase stability of weapon. Barrels: Attach Silencers to stealthily take out mobs, useful as some certain mobs dont appreciate loud gun shots. Or muzzle brakes to decrease spread. Explosives: Molotov Cocktail: Creates fire in a large area. Grenade: Explodes, dealing damage. Choke Bomb: Puts out fire and mobs. Swarm Bomb: Summons a swarm of bugs to attack your target. Healing Items: Various tiers of healing items for survival Enemies: Face off against 10 new mobs including Zombie Redcoats, Illager Blunderers, Skycarriers, Cog Knights, Cog Minions, Hives, and more. Resources: Find Anthralite and Sulfur ore in themines. Niter from ocean Geothermal Vents,collect using Vent Collectors. Rare vehement coal in the Nether Use these materials to create the powerful Scorched ingot. Dungeons: Explore new dungeons like Trenches, the Asgharian tower, and Osgood lab. Find blueprints in Dungeons, Bastions, The Ancient Cities and from the new Gunsmith Villager in villages or by using the new Gun Bench. Crafting Stations: Mechanical Press: Used to make casings and press bullets. Macerator: Grind down materials to create mixtures like Gunpowder, Sheol dust, and More . Gun Bench: Use blueprints to craft different tiers of weapons. Unique Features: Supply Scamp: Tame with ancient brass, this cowardly mobile storage unit can be customized with dyes to change its mask. Geothermal Vents: Structures in oceans emitting niter, which can be used to make gunpowder and niter glass. Niter glass changes transparency when powered by redstone. Ammo Boxes: Can be used to store ammunition, featuring a dynamic model that changes based off its contents. Compatabilities: Features Compatability with Create, allowing weapon creation with Mechanical Crafting, processing of the mods resources, and creating ammo with the Sequenced Assembly. Immersive engineering compatability, with this Press, and crusher. If farmers delight is loaded, you can create an Anthralite Knife Thanks to MigaMi for Just Enough Guns, which helped immensely in the development of this mod, and to zaeonNineZero, for his fork of CGM, which provided lots of wonderful UI aspects.

Brazil Legends.title: Brazil Legends
Brazil Legends.body: ❗ Note: There will be no ports of this mod for Fabric. About: Brazil Legend is a content-rich mod that introduces the diverse and captivating folklore of Brazil into Minecraft, expanding the game with new entities, weapons, and gameplay systems all designed to integrate seamlessly with the game’s aesthetics and mechanics. This mod adds a variety of legendary creatures, including Saci, Cuca, Mapinguari, Headless Mule, and Capelobo. Each entity features unique AI behaviors, biome-specific spawning conditions, and distinct combat or interaction mechanics. Brazil Legend delivers a distinctive exploration and progression experience, offering players a unique adventure deeply rooted in Brazilian folklore. The 'Allow distribution to 3rd party' option is enabled solely for use with Aternos. I strongly oppose the redistribution of this mod on other websites. Any distribution outside the official sources is strictly prohibited unless I have given explicit permission. For detailed information about creatures, mechanics, item recipes, and progression systems, please refer to the Brazil Legend Wiki. The Wiki provides in-depth guides and technical details to help you get the most out of the mod. ? FAQ Spoiler Q. Which Minecraft versions are supported by Brazil Legend? A. Currently, Brazil Legend is supported on Minecraft 1.20.1. Updates for additional versions will be released in the future. Q. Will there be updates with new creatures or features? A. Yes! Brazil Legend is an ongoing project, and updates will bring new creatures, items, and mechanics. Keep an eye on the changelogs and announcements for details on upcoming features. Q. Can I include Brazil Legend in my modpack? A. Absolutely! Feel free to add Brazil Legend to your modpack and customize it as needed. Just remember to: Give proper credit to the mod and don’t claim it as your own creation. Q. Will you backport Brazil Legend to older Minecraft versions? A. No, backporting to older versions is not planned. Older Minecraft versions lack essential features for the mod, and making it compatible would be too complex. Please refrain from requesting backports! Q. Why create a mod about folklore when there are others with similar ideas? A. Folklore is a vast and diverse theme, and every culture has unique stories to tell. Brazil Legend aims to highlight Brazil's distinctive mythology and creatures, offering something different from mods inspired by other traditions. Additionally, I wanted to create a mod that reflects my own style and vision, designing the creatures and their mechanics in a way that I personally would love to see them integrated into Minecraft. This mod is not just about bringing folklore to life, but doing so in a way that feels fresh, exciting, and true to my creative ideas. That said, if you're curious about other folklore-themed mods, you’re welcome to explore and install them too! Combining different mods can enhance your experience by blending various mythologies and creatures into your Minecraft world. Just ensure that your mods are compatible and use tools like Modpack launchers to manage them efficiently. Q. Will you add creatures from other cultures or mythologies? A. No, Brazil Legend focuses exclusively on Brazilian folklore. The goal is to showcase Brazil’s unique myths and legends in Minecraft, rather than blending elements from other cultures.

Hadean Breathe.title: Hadean Breathe
Hadean Breathe.body: Background Story At the dawn of civilization in the Overworld, the war brought by the Nether Lord had already spread throughout the Nether. He had three loyal but ruthless generals: one excelled in close combat and heavy weapons, another was skilled in cavalry charges and firearms, and the last had a strong affinity for shields and heavy armor. After unifying the Nether, the tyranny of the three generals and their king plunged the Nether into misery, eventually forcing the native inhabitants to unite and rebel. In the end, the residents overthrew the oppressive rule. The Nether Lord disappeared, and his three generals were defeated, reduced to remnant spirits now lurking in a corner of the Nether, awaiting new explorers. Content Overview This mod is in mid-stage development and currently adds to the game: - A powerful boss-level mob: the Hadean Enforcer, - A powerful weapon: the Ember. Future Plans The mod will add in the near or future: - The second and third bosses, - More skills for the existing boss, - More unique boss materials, weapons, and armor, - Boss summoning methods and structures, - Structures, items, and equipment related to the background story. Notes Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/P9jVXCS8AS 1.Before loading the mod, be sure to add the prerequisite mod VzlingLib and use its latest version to avoid game crashes. 2.The mod currently can be played normally in survival mode. The current development progress only supports boss challenges or boss battles. 3.This mod allows others to include it in modpacks or for server use, but no one may claim the mod as their own in any form.

The man from the shadow (horror).title: The man from the shadow (horror)
The man from the shadow (horror).body: Big update coming soon... RECOMMENDED PLAYING IN SINGLEPLAYER GECKOLIB REQUIERED THE MAN FROM THE SHADOW A psychological horror mod that preys on your mind. You are trapped in a nightmare with a relentless, perverted entity from your past. Your only solace is a bottle of pills, but every dose makes the shadow more real. Watch your sanity His activities depends on your sanity level. Take your pills and you will be just fine, unless you get overdosed. To control your sanity i added dandelion in the corner of the screen that represents level of your sanity. If you encounter shadow figure Try not to make any contact and do not approach him. Taking pills will make him dissapear for a while. Remember that. As doctor said he's not real. What if you loose your sanity? If that happens, things will get worse. Visions will appear more and more until Man gets physical form and tries to bring you to the "paradise", and this time you won't escape him. KEEP FIGHTING Find out about your past and all of the tortures he did to you. Be strong. Be bold. Don't let him toy with you. About the next update: I'll rework some of the mechanics and will add more interactions. Also full story mode will be added. Will you able to defeat your fears? Only you decide that.

Chococraft.title: Chococraft
Chococraft.body: \ banner made by galindorf About Chococraft (This Mod is the continuation of ChocoCraft which can be found here) This mod adds a mob called Chocobo to the game. This includes different colored mob types with different attributes in their grown-up and juvenile form. The most basic type can be found in the wild and can be tamed by using "Gysahl Greens" on them. Gysahl Greens is a plant found in the wild, but also can be planted by sowing Gysahl Seeds. Gysahl Seeds can be received by crafting from Gysahl Greens or by harvesting planted Gysahl Greens. Chocobos can be breed and procreate. The offspring will be a Chicobo, the juvenile form of a Chocobo. After a while a Chicobo will grow into a Chocobo. Chicobos will be born wild and have to be tamed. Chicobos will inherit the type from one of their parents or mutate into new types. Thus by repeatedly breeding Chocobos all normal types of Chocobos can be acquired from tamed wild Chocobos. There are a few special Chocobo types though, which can only be acquired by special means. If you want to know more about the mod I urge you to install Patchouli alongside as it'll allow more information to show in the Chocopedia.

Evil Hunter.title: Evil Hunter
Evil Hunter.body: A Path Forced Upon You --- Mod Trailer --- Story mode can corrupt or destroy your world and inventory. That is intentional. You can turn off story phases in evilhriver-server.toml ( enablePhases = false ) and tune how often events fire. 18+ content: loud sounds, jumpscares, body horror, and themes that can cause anxiety or discomfort. Do not play if that is not for you. By downloading and playing, you confirm you are 18+ and accept this content. --- What It Is improved. Version 3.0 is a complete overhaul: less blood, more atmosphere, mechanics, and a story that unfolds as you progress through the game, along with custom music and assets. Story Mode (default) Spoiler The full campaign - phases, hunts, bosses, and an ending. A branching storyline - lore reveals itself over time, not all at once Three endings in one world - replay different paths without starting a new save Two boss fights - the ritual battle against Pg-00Z5 and the final confrontation Custom dimensions and set-pieces - the church chase, interlayer, the dark forest, the OMEGA terminal, and more Hunts - run, fog, silence, giant, and other pursuit modes 23 atmospheric events - paranoia, glitches, entities, fake houses, whispers Silver - ore, armor, ritual items 15 advancements with full localization Sandbox Mode (RNG / horror pack) Spoiler The same mod with story phases disabled - set enablePhases = false . Events and entities spawn without story progression Fits horror modpacks and “just scare me” playthroughs Same 20+ events and hunts, frequency adjustable in config --- !Requires: Minecraft 1.20.1, Forge 47.3.0, GeckoLib recommended! --- Soundtrack An official album is in the works. Announcements and previews on Discord --- This mod was commissioned by the YouTuber Vivilly and I recommend subscribing to his channel! On video 1.0 version!

Zombies+.title: Zombies+
Zombies+.body: Save 15% For The First Month on Your Next Server!—Use Code _Paragon_ and Click Here to Get Started! Zombies+ is a vanilla-friendly Minecraft mod that spices up your gameplay with a bunch of new mobs that fit right into your standard, vanilla world. Zombies+ is all about adding more variety to the usual zombie encounters. These new zombies look and feel like they belong in Minecraft, but they also bring a fresh twist perfect for realistic zombie-survival modpacks. _With some easy tweaks in the configuration file (.json5) and by adding other mods and resource packs, you can turn these zombies from regular vanilla mobs into truly terrifying, realistic zombies._ Currently, this mod adds: - Runner Zombie - Crawler Zombie - Brute Zombie - Crossbow Zombie - Bow Zombie - Shrieker Zombie - Axe Zombie - Sword Zombie - Vile Zombie - Cave Zombie - Weak Zombie - Slow Zombie - Leaper Zombie Whether you want to keep that classic Minecraft vibe or you're in the mood for a zombie apocalypse, this mod offers you the flexibility to make your experience just to your liking. Explore a world where you'll be forced to encounter these new, groaning monsters. (Only for Versions 2.0.3+) (Only for Versions 2.0.0+)

Mob Catalog.title: Mob Catalog
Mob Catalog.body: Mob Catalog currently adds 5 new mobs. It also comes with a config file, freely allowing you to enable or disable whichever mob(s) you want from spawning. All are enabled by default. Help with item textures, sound effects and animations would be appreciated! Capybara Capybaras spawn in jungles, sparse jungles and swamps, they can be bred with Melon Slices. Feeding a Capybara certain items will have it cut them for you, some examples are Wood into Stripped Wood, Melons into Melon Slices and Mangrove Roots into Sticks. Crab Crabs spawn in beaches and mangrove swamps, they drop Crab Claws when they grow up, which can equipped in your main or off-hand to extend your block placing/breaking range. On death, they drop Crab Legs which can be eaten and cooked. They can be bred with Kelp and breathe both underwater and on land. Crabs can also climb logs and mangrove roots. Penguin Penguins spawn in stony shores, waddling on land or swimming. If a Penguin is in the water, boating next to one will grant you a speed boost. They can be bred with Crab Legs or fish if Crabs are disabled. Sloth Sloths spawn in jungles and come in two different species, only Sloths of the same species can breed with each other. Sloths can climb and hang on the underside of logs. They can be bred with leaves and currently have no utility, but in the next update you can use them to farm saplings. Stonemaw Stonemaws spawn uncommonly in caves, they're hostile towards players but can be tamed if fed a Diamond. Tamed Stonemaws will follow you around and can be ordered to sit. Shift right clicking a tamed Stonemaw will give you access to its mouth-inventory.

Doctor Nowhere mod.title: Doctor Nowhere mod
Doctor Nowhere mod.body: you will be alone in silence DrNowhere mod This mod not only adds entities, but also slightly changes minecraft so that it can be scary. Makes the player alone in the game - mobs (nothing at all, not even monsters) will no longer appear, and there will always be fog. The player will walk around the world alone and occasionally strange creepy events will occur - the lights will turn off, unpleasant sounds will be heard. In the caves, their own unique events will occur. Also, sometimes two monsters will appear, that you can strongly doubt that there are no other creatures in this quiet world. Please suggest your ideas on issues. I'll be glad to read them. credits: Doctor Nowhere mod in Alpha !

outln.frombelowland.title: outln.frombelowland
outln.frombelowland.body: PLEASE join our discord!!! :( do not use Sodium Forks/Embeddium, it breaks most of the mod's shaders because they rewrite the way the game renders. same with optifine since it's not open source. below the remnants of a broken server you go in your own expedition find us and join your friends --- (also known as belowland) BEFORE YOU START!! this mod takes around 3-4ish days to start doing events that are SCARY. if you wish to make the mod "more aggressive", theres a list of commands you can do by doing /belowland. Description Currently in alpha. outln.frombelowland is a horror mod inspired mostly by wonderland.jar . It's intentionally slow-paced — roughly 3 in-game days pass before anything unsettling begins. Multiplayer is supported, though not recommended. wonderland.jar inspired me to make my own horror mod, and I loved the process so much that I went ahead and built one in my own style. I really hope you enjoy it — this is my first horror mod. Project started: May 8th --- Requirements - GeckoLib --- Features !Spoilers! 1. Spooky imagery 2. Entities 3. Dimensions 4. New items 5. The Deep Void.title: The Deep Void
The Deep Void.body: ''_Whatever you do, do not fall in the void. Dangers are lurking every corner and darkness envelops everything. Do not stay there for too long, for It may come after you..._'' This mod adds a new horroresque dimension to explore with a ton of different and unique biomes, from wastelands of bones to flesh plains reeking of death, and multiple entities, hostile and passive alike­. Test your skill against new bosses with complex attack patterns and get rewarded with strong weaponry and armor. The lore will keep you guessing on the history of a lost civilisation and their connection to the unholy. Official Discord Server Wiki The Merciless Void __________________________________________________________ To enter this dimension, you must fall in the Void. A hole in the bedrock can be found at the deepest layer of your world at 0,0. Simply jump in and you'll be there. Alternatively, you can also fall in the Void in the End or get abducted by an Abducter. To exit the dimension, craft and use a Void Pendant. __________________________________________________________ Many creatures await in these bone dunes for a prey. One of those creatures isn't like the others. It likes to watch from afar, in the dark, and waits for an unexpecting victim to step out of the light. But be careful, the inhabitants aren't very fond of light and will destroy any sources present. Whatever you do, STAY IN THE LIGHT , or you might be this thing's next meal... Official Trailer __________________________________________________________ Frequently asked questions : Spoiler Q: Where can I share my ideas?/Where do I report bugs? A : You can join the discord server, where you'll be able to discuss with other people, share your thoughts and ideas and report bugs and crashes. I am also very active on the server, so if you want to discuss with me directly, it'll be a pleasure to talk :). You can also go to the GitHub page of the mod and open a new issue ticket. Finally, please don't report bugs in the comments, use the appropriate places to do so. You can also provide feedback in the comments, I read every single one of them. Q: Why is the Stalker so OP!?/Why does the Stalker exist?/How do I even survive the Stalker? A : The Stalker is a way to punish players who don't stay in the light, kind of like the Warden. It's the whole gimmick of the dimension. To prevent encountering the Stalker, just stay in the light. You have a very generous window of time to find light and two warnings before it even shows up. You can also go to the Gloomy Deathgrounds, Staring Hills or Crawler Nest, where the Stalker doesn't spawn. When it does spawn, you have a lot of ways to counter it. Simply hiding in a hole works, but be careful as it can dig to you. You can also stay in light, since the Stalker hates light and will run away from any source. The Flare Gun is also another way of stopping the Stalker. When hit with the Flare, the Stalker won't be able to move for some time, it will be stunned. The Stalker Treat is another option. You can throw it to redirect the attention of the Stalker. If you absolutely don't like the Stalker, you can change the config file. TLDR : stay in light, use the items provided to you, take advantage of the environment, you can change the configs. Q: How do I get Voidrium? A : Voidrium can be gotten by mining Voidrium Ore with a Shatterbone Pickaxe. It will give you one Rough Voidrium. The Shatterbone Pickaxe needs to be crafted with materials that you get from the Glutton Block, a very important block for progression. Feed it Desolate Soil. You also need Void Essence, which can be crafted from the heart dropped by the Voidborn. Q: Where do I find Voidrium? A : Voidrium can be found under specific biomes. Some of these biomes are: Mourning Graveyard, Filled Graveyard, Drifting Monoliths, Gloomy Deathgrounds, Staring Hills and Gathering Grounds. Q: Where do I find the Voidborn? A : The Voidborn can be spawn by stabbing yourself with an onyx needle while hall

Luminous: Nether.title: Luminous: Nether
Luminous: Nether.body: Consider joining the LUMINOUS discord, where you can report bugs/get some sneek peaks on projects/updates! LUMINOUS:NETHER expands the base nether experience, adding 2 new biomes, 16 new mobs, 3 legendary beasts with unique drops and abilities, 3 RARE beasts with some unque drops, tons of new blocks, and new gameplay mechanics! THE FUNGAL PLAINS The Fungal Plains is one of two new biomes in LUMINOUS: NETHER - it houses a new faction of piglins, the CULTISTS - which are hostile towards players unless holding a cultist flag, a new item found in the biome. Explore a new variety of infectious yellow blocks, craft a new "mushroom" woodset, build with new fungirrack bricks, and discover unique structures aroundthe biome ranging from ruined portals to bases built in the bones of old monsters. Also find and fight a new curious breed of monster - the MUSHLINS, which find and push the player back with their bouncy head! THE ASH FOREST The Ash Forest is the second biome added with LUMINOUS: NETHER, and it houses minecrafts undeadliest mobs yet! Find new spooky structures like the one pictured above, build with new ash bricks and a "withered" woodset! Check out the ceiling to see a new feature, Driprot! a strange and twisting vine which grows a new food source in the nether - pale melons! Driprot has its own brick set, bringing a gross and ghastly vibe to your world! ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ TO EDIT THE WEIGHT/SIZE OF THE BIOMES - DOWNLOAD "LUMINOUS NETHER TWEAKS" HERE! ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ NEW MOBS _(From left to right)_ Mushlin Bumper - These curious mobs love to bounce players back with their heads! Kill them to get mushlin protein - a new food source! Piglin Cultist - Having given their life to the call of the mushlin king, these cultists will attack ANYONE who gets near them with a new weapon - the Cultist axe! Piglin Cultist Leader - These elite cultists have the ability to summon backup when attacked! Take them out quickly! Piglin Cultist Rider - After learning how to tame the ferocious hoglin, this Cultist rides him into battle, at your health bars expense! Piglin Ghost - Having been killed long ago, these angry souls are confined to spawners in different structures in the ash forest - fight them if you dare! Pottergeists - Long believed to be the souls of lost pets, these curious spirits were captured by the piglin ghosts, held captive in structures found in the ash forest. Right click on one to tame it, and it will follow you, hold items for you, and even wear decorative vases for some added style! Spirit - The spirits roam the ash forest, and will only attack if attacked first! They drop a new valuable item - ghostly essense Guzzleghast - The only thing bigger than the guzzleghasts insatiable appetite is its head! Guzzleghasts roam the ash forest, attacking players unless killed or pacified. If fed, they have a chance to drop Ectoplasm balls, a unique throwable projectile capable of affecting the gravity of blocks! Crimson Walker - Watch your swing around these infectious undead, as when they die, they POP! Crimson walkers explode into an infectious cloud when killed, giving the player a new negative effect, hemmorrhage. Glider - The glider has long been hated by its striding cousins for the fact they never have to get their hands dirty, or, in lava. Feed a glider crimson flesh to keep it well fed, and it may let you hitch a ride! Revenant - Roaming the soul sand valley, this skeleton has the ability to heal itself when shooting the player! ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ NEW LOOT Scattered around the Nether wastes, soul sand valley, fungal plains, and ash forest, you can find new LOOT VASES . When broken, these have a chance to yield blocks, food, xp bottles, resources, and more! _(from left to right)_ "Cultist" armor

The Midnight.title: The Midnight
The Midnight.body: The Midnight The Midnight is a dark and dreary place of eternal night. --- The Midnight is a Minecraft mod, brought to you by Cryptic Mushroom, that adds a new, mysterious and scary dimension to explore. It is a dimension of darkness; the only light comes from crystals and the various life of the dimension. You may travel willingly to this dimension, though you may find yourself being unwillingly dragged into this strange and hostile world... 🚪 Enter the Midnight The dimension can be entered through a Rift . These have changed in design in some versions, so specific instructions can be found below: Minecraft 1.19.4 and later: You will need to defeat a mysterious new mob found in the overworld. This creature's demise will allow Rifts to open randomly at night similarly to the earliest versions of the mod. In this version, however, they will only appear above ground level.\ Minecraft 1.12.2 and 1.14.4: To enter, you will need to find a glowing, red rift. These will spawn randomly during the night both above ground and in caves. Rifts are often accompanied by unfriendly figures known as rifters. Minecraft 1.15.2: To enter, you will need to find a red heap of mass in the overworld. At nighttime, the portal will activate, and you will be able to traverse into the Midnight. Though before you go into The Midnight, make sure to be prepared! The Midnight does not welcome newcomers. \ Rifts in the latest version of the game are currently experimental and are still undergoing active reworks. ❓ The 1.19 Rewrite You might've noticed that we had been dormant for quite some time. Apart from our Discord server, almost all of our platforms had been quiet and lacking activity. During this time, however, we were hard at work rewriting the entire mod from scratch. The result of our efforts is our recent release of The Midnight for 1.19.4 and experimental versions for 1.20.1 ! If you are interested in chatting with us directly about the ongoing development of the mod, we encourage you to join our Discord server, read our about-us channel, and ask us any additional questions you might have in chat. 🕑 Regarding Previous Versions To address the elephant in the room, yes, we have completely dropped support for all versions of the Midnight prior to the 1.19 release. This is to allow us to focus on the development of the current, rewritten version without needing to worry about old bugs. 0.5.12 will continue to remain the last version of classic Midnight. Moving forward, the Midnight has opted to continue development as a closed-source project, meaning that the source code is no longer publicly available. However, the source code is still available for the classic version of the Midnight on GitLab. That code still is, and will continue to be, licensed under the GNU General Public Licence v3.0, so you are free to do whatever you want with that old code given that it follows the licensing of that license. - If you want to use this source code, we simply ask that you include a link back to the Midnight's mod page. - A common misconception is that since the repo is labeled as GPLv3, the assets (textures, sounds, etc.) are covered by the license as well. However, this is not the case. You do not have permission to use any of our assets, old or new. A notice in the repo saying that the assets are ARR does not exist, and that is merely an oversight on our part in the past. - If you are a programmer and want to work with us to resolve a known issue that you have expertise in, please join our Discord server and help us out! 📜 Credits The Midnight would not be possible without all of the effort put in by each person who worked on it. While every individual may not be listed on the mod platform's "members" sidebar, we still want to acknowledge and honor the efforts of everyone who worked on this mod. 🌚 The Midnight Team The team behind the Midnight is, who would've guessed, The Midnight Team! We are a group of passionate Minecraft modders who want to create an exp

Infinity Golem Boss Fight.title: Infinity Golem Boss Fight
Infinity Golem Boss Fight.body: This mod adds NEW BOSS INFINITY GOLEM. You can't find it in survival. It has such attacks as: 1. Hitting the ground with its hands 2. Summoning falling fireballs 3. Jump with the summoning of fireballs 4. Super ROAR! This mod is not finished, it's in beta testing. I will make his story in my original mod

Alex's Mobs Continued.title: Alex's Mobs Continued
Alex's Mobs Continued.body: Alex's Mobs Continued Alex's Mobs, by AlexModGuy , added around 116 animals and monsters to Minecraft — each with its own model, textures, animations and behaviour. It stopped at Minecraft 1.20.1 on Forge. This is an unofficial continuation. Same mod, same content, kept running on current Minecraft. Nothing has been redesigned or rebalanced. Versions Minecraft 1.20.1 through 26.3, on Forge, NeoForge and Fabric — 52 builds, every version on all three loaders. Download the file that matches your Minecraft version and your loader. What you get The full roster, spawning naturally in its matching biomes: grizzly bears, tigers and gorillas on land, sharks, orcas and catfish in the water, soul vultures and straddlers in the Nether and beyond. Taming, breeding, mounts, egg-laying, bucketing, the items and blocks and armour that go with them, and the Animal Dictionary and advancements to track what you've found. In Creative, every creature has a spawn egg. Installing You need CodxLib for your Minecraft version and loader. On Fabric you also need Fabric API — each Fabric file lists the exact build it wants. You do not need Citadel. The parts Alex's Mobs uses are built into the jar, and they stay out of the way if you already run Citadel for something else. Credit Every mob design, model, texture and animation is the work of AlexModGuy and the Alex's Mobs team. This project only ports it forward. Feedback Something behaving differently from the original? Discord or the issue tracker — reports get fixed.

Wetland Whimsy.title: Wetland Whimsy
Wetland Whimsy.body: About Wetland Whimsy is a mod which completely overhauls Minecraft's swamps! It includes a whole new subbiome, several new plants and blocksets, and ancient ruins that dot the landscape of these overhauled wetlands. While these ruins contain plenty of treasure, be warned - some of them may not be as abandoned as they first seem! Features: - Overhauled Swamps with completely redone visuals! - The Marsh , an all-new biome that spawns between Swamps and the ocean! - New Flora in the form of Pennywort, Cordgrass, and unique mushrooms! - New Fauna , such as the friendly Cranes and not-so-friendly Infested Spiders! - New Building Blocks including Lemonstone and the all-new Bald Cypress woodset! - Wetland Ruins , ancient structures built from lemonstone with plenty of loot for those who look. - The Swamp Dungeon , a mysterious, mazelike structure built for an unknown purpose. Ancient Pots with strange symbols may be found down there... their loot may not be that great, but maybe there's a way to improve it? Compatibility Wetland Whimsy uses biome modifiers to modify the vanilla Swamp, meaning it should be compatible with most other mods that redo the Swamp biome as well! This is true for both the 1.21.1 and the 1.20.1 releases, so you don't need to worry about adding this mod to any of your modpacks. Currently, Wetland Whimsy has explicit support for YUNGs Better Witch Huts , YUNGs Extras , and Supplementaries . Additionally, it has been tested with Nature's Spirit , Swampier Swamps , and Extra Compat , all with no isssues. If you are unsure if a mod will be compatible, try it out! The worst that could happen is that they aren't. Version Support Wetland Whimsy currently supports Neoforge 1.21.1 . 1.20.1 is deprecated - it may recieve bugfixes, but most likely will not get any new content. Unfortunately, this mod will not have official Fabric support. Maintaining one modloader is already difficult and time-consuming, two would be too much for me to handle. However, this mod is free and open-source , so if you know how to port it and would like to, go ahead! Credits Spoiler - Music Disc: Quizzly - OST: Skyllaremon

Pigzilla.title: Pigzilla
Pigzilla.body: Mod showcase: This mod adds the pigzilla, giant pig that attacks everything, and the biting pig which can evolve into the pigzilla after killing several mobs. Pigzilla has two attacks: stomp, tusk attack Stomp attack makes shockwaves around the pigzilla and also makes a quake that damages all mobs in the radius and throws them into the sky. Tusk attack makes the mobs thrown into the air, and before stomping the ground it will bite mobs in the sky, giving additional damage. After stomping, it will also make shockwaves and quake same as stomp attack. Biting pig is a mob that looks the same as usual pigs, but they will eat every living thing with its strong jaw. After feasting several mobs, it will evolve into the pigzilla. So make sure to find those suspicious pigs and kill them before it's too late!

Luminous: Overworld.title: Luminous: Overworld
Luminous: Overworld.body: IF YOU ARE EXPERIENCING A CRASH AS OF UPDATE 1.4.73 - Go to %appdata%/minecraft/config and DELETE the LUMINOUS.toml config file! This will reset the configs due to me changing the syntax! Text Alternative! The LUMINOUS mod aims to illuminate and expand the base Minecraft experience. Adding new ambient mobs, biome specific hostile mobs, decorative blocks, many new blocks and wood sets, and huge legendary beasts to hunt! LUMINOUS has something for everybody! This mod is a part 1 of 2. A second and much larger mod is in development, and will focus on story, combat, new dimensions to explore, and new bosses to fight! BIOME OVERHAULS - the first biome overhauled is the Forest Biome, adding Deer/Fawn that run from the player if they get too close, and drop venison equivalent to Mutton (Inspired by the familiar Fauna mod by FortStride) The forests are also home to Squirrels, which come in 4 variants, scattered across Forest, flower forests, dark oak forests, and snowy taigas. Another new mob is the BUTTERFLY, floating around the world with 21 different variants. Another Biome being overhauled is the Birch forest, with 3 butterfly variants, new soft birch trees; with taller appearance and yellow leaves. the taiga forest will become the home of the new FIREFLIES - ambient creatures that bring the forest to life. New, taller taiga trees populate these now dense forests. The desert biomes are also getting overhauled, with palm trees, crabs, and buried ancient structures. Finally, the savannah gets a massive overhaul, adding Baobab trees, Zebras, and new grass and dirt types native to the savannah biome. DECORATIONS -Using the new tool, the HAMMER, you can rotate and change new DECORATIVE blocks through their variants. Place 3D potions, book stacks, tables, double height torches, cauldrons, shelves, and more! MOB VARIANTS - 10 new mob variants include frigid zombies and skeletons, found in cold biomes, Miner zombies and skeletons, found underground, the sunken, a skeletal variant of the drowned, the hollow, a skeleton variant of the husk, variant savannah zombie/skeletons, and swamp zombies/skeletons. LEGENDARY BEASTS - these tougher, rarer monsters can be found rarely in select biomes around the world. Each will drop trophies, custom music discs, and, after each is slain once, they have a chance to drop a rare and legendary item! Check out the TRAILER here I GRANT FULL PERMISSION TO USE THIS MOD IN MODPACKS!

Ghost.title: Ghost
Ghost.body: This mod will add a variety of new ghost mobs to your game, each with their own unique functions! Current features: Ghost: Ghosts spawn in forests at night, and can be tamed with glow berries. Once tamed, they can be given items, and will use them to perform specific tasks. When holding torches, they'll place them in dark areas. When holding a totem of undying, they can activate it on behalf of their player. When given an enchanted item, it will remove a random enchantment and reward the player with xp, similar to a grindstone. Seedling ghost: Spawns in forests at night. These ghosts will pick up dropped saplings, and hold onto them until they can find a place to plant them. Some seedling ghosts will hide throughout the night by burying themselves in the ground. Kodama: The kodama are the mysterious little forest spirits. They live in forests, and will trade random saplings for amethyst shards! Among these saplings is the new haunted sapling, which grows into a haunted tree. Haunted tree: Haunted trees are grown from haunted saplings, and will occasionally contain haunted eye blocks. Paired with a redstone comparator, haunted eye blocks can output a redstone signal when detecting entities. Calibrated haunted eye: Crafted with 6 haunted planks, 2 redstone, and one haunted eye in the same pattern as an observer, calibrated haunted eyes can detect entity distance, and will output a dynamic signal strength depending on how far away the closest detected entity is. Josh/Joosh - Art Xylonity - Coding & maintenance SizableShrimp & GlitchedMastery - Coding Wanmine - Assisting with code

The John Mod Reborn.title: The John Mod Reborn
The John Mod Reborn.body: About: The John Mod Reborn is a horror mod inspired from the 2011 Minecraft Mod, The John Mod, and the 2012 remake, along with the 2020 remaster of the mod. The mod aims to recreate a modern look of the John, featuring new items, textures, and new creatures to discover, while keeping the same creepy vibe from the original mod, and more. Anymore about the mod please visit the Github Wiki Any issues with the mod please vist Github Issue Tracker John: A rare creature, colloquially known as "John." Its origins are completely unknown. As far as what we do know, well, very few have ever lived to tell the tale. Its skin is extremely thin and almost completely white. With two mouths, one on its torso and the other on its head, the humanoid creature is known for ripping its victims apart and consuming their husks simultaneously. Its face bears a striking resemblance to that of a crying man, its mouth wide open, constantly emitting a piercing cry, all with a constant stream of bloody tears coming from its soulless eyes. It preys on fear and will often toy with its victims before it strikes. They are fast, strong, efficient, and brutal. Do not approach. Baby John: These infant variants are the young versions of the previous variants. They have not yet developed any special "skills," as it were. But they can still be dangerous, especially in groups. They emerge in groups of up to 15, and are remarkably fast, much faster than most adult versions. However they are also much weaker. Contrary to most biological fauna, these infants have a low pitched voice that gets higher the older they get, their screams cannot be heard from far. Regardless, they are still hostile despite their infancy. Do not approach. Mega John: When the moon is full, the Hunted changes. A bolt of energy strikes him. Similar to a lighting bolt. This transforming him, into a Mega John. It's height dwarfs the trees in the forest. It is 15 meters tall, has a 200-meter range of vision, and can be heard shrieking from a distance of more than 500 meters. If you see it, run away, hide, and wait. It'll be gone for the next three lunar cycles.. Because it is the most terrifying thing I have ever seen.. Edition Support: This mod is for Forge 1.16.5, 1.18.2, 1.19.2, 1.19.4, and 1.20.1. And maybe a small Fabric port is comin' soon Credits: Of course, this wouldn't be possible without the original mod from beta 1.8 by Kurtss Minecraft Forum Page The SCMowns 2012 recreation. Who also gave me permission to post the mod. Textures also got influence from the 2022 The Return of John texture pack by Pixperfect. Special thanks to Legodamen (Head Development) BlueBowTie (for helping with the writing) FinchyMcFinch CollinTheBard Whiteboard Nibroc SenatorSeatBelt Damen's Music (For commissioning the music), If you are wondering, the Shaders I use in any screenshots, it is Complementary Shaders v4.2.2. Warning! The only official places to find the mod is on: Curse Forge, Planet Minecraft, and Modrinth. Be careful where you go, don't trust sites like 9Minecraft. Consider Joining Our Discord!

The Ravenous.title: The Ravenous
The Ravenous.body: If you want to leave feedback, feel free to use the comment space below or the dedicated channel in the  WanMine Discord server . _You are allowed to include this mod in a modpack hosted on CurseForge, provided that you do not redistribute it elsewhere and only use versions uploaded directly by us. Additionally, the modpack must not be sold or offer paid access to the mod in any form. You must also fully comply with the terms of the license applicable to the version of the mod you are using._ NEW 2.0 BIG UPDATE OUT! Features below An Endless Hunger A piercing wail shatters the darkness. The Screech has seen you. It runs away, too weak to fight… but its scream is not one of fear. It’s a call. A call to something bigger. Something hungrier. In the shadows, the Ravenous awakens. Not to protect… but to feed. Now it has heard you. And it’s coming. The Screech is small, fast, and ruthless. It doesn’t fight, it doesn’t flee to survive. It bites you with quick attacks, then screams with all its might. It’s not a mistake. It’s not instinct. It’s intent. Because it knows that, at its signal, something will answer. Even if the Ravenous is far away, it will carve a path to reach you. You can’t hide. You can’t fight. The Ravenous is not just a hunter. It’s a nightmare that grows, evolving with every strike it takes. Its arms extend, its speed increases, every wound makes it stronger, every encounter leaves it hungrier. And as it devours everything in its path, your only hope is silence. The Ravenous (THIS MOB IS NOT IMMORTAL) Spoiler Main Features 🎖 Drop The Ravenous drops his echolocator organ, useful to charge at the max capacity the Anti-Ravenous. 🔊 Acoustic Tracking The Ravenous is blind but hunts using sound. Walking, jumping, or breaking blocks will draw it toward you. If you stay still, it might not find you… but it will keep searching. 🛠️ Block Destruction Building walls won’t save you. The Ravenous can destroy nearly all blocks, except obsidian and bedrock. No shelter is truly safe. 📢 Devastating Scream If you try to escape by climbing a pillar or hiding high up, the Ravenous will unleash a powerful roar. The shockwave will send you flying, leaving you stunned for a few seconds, making your screen shake. 🌑 Total Darkness Its scream extinguishes light sources and shatters glass. Torches go out, lanterns break. The darkness becomes your prison. 🦴 Progressive Evolution Every hit the Ravenous takes makes it stronger. It grows in size, becomes faster and more aggressive. Its mouths multiply, its claws extend, and its roar starts dealing damage. Attacking it is never the best choice. 🍖 Insatiable Hunger The only way to distract it is to feed it. You can sacrifice a Villager or 10 animals (small animals count as half). If the Ravenous is full, it might lose interest… at least for a while. 🥚 Cycle of Hunger Each time the Ravenous devours prey, it may leave behind a Screecher egg. The more it feeds, the faster the threat spreads. Its hunger never ends… it multiplies. The Screech The Ravenous is a distant threat… until the Screech brings it straight to you. Spoiler Main Features 🎖 Drop The Ravenous drops his echolocator organ, useful to craft the Anti-Ravenous, and can load 1 charge.  🌙 Origin of the Screech The Screech spawns naturally in the dark of night. It searches, it finds… and it will scream. 🦷  Bite and Run The Screech doesn’t fight directly. It attacks with small bites and then moves away. 📣 Predator’s Call The Screech will try to scream at the first opportunity. If you don’t stop it quickly, it will do what it was born to do: summon something much worse. If the Ravenous is not nearby, it will spawn. 🌱 Lethal Growth If a Screech is left alive for too long, it will grow and become an adult Ravenous. Ignoring it only delays the inevitable. Anti-Ravenous A powerful weapon, as the name suggests, it could be useful in a fight with The Ravenous. Spoiler Main Features 😵 Stun When activated, the Anti-Ravenous will instantly

Ender Zoology.title: Ender Zoology
Ender Zoology.body: Ender Zoology brings a new layer of excitement and danger to your world in thrilling ways! Face off against fierce new mobs like the cunning Enderminy, deadly Fallen Knights, and the twisted Wither Witches—each bringing their own brand of chaos. Explore snow-filled forests hunted by Dire Wolves, and wield the power of Owls to rise above the dangers below. Craft teleportation explosives, brew cursed potions, and unlock game-changing enchantments like Soulbound and Repellent to protect yourself from these hostile new threats. With new mobs, deadly loot, and mind-bending effects, every corner of your world holds something terrifying—and every adventure promises new challenges. Get ready for a world where danger doesn't just watch you... it’s on the move. 🌌 New Mobs 🧍‍♂️ Enderminy : Tiny but fierce! These little Endermen pack a serious punch and love chasing Concussion Creepers . 💥 Concussion Creeper : Explodes without wrecking blocks—teleports you instead! Drops Confusing Powder for special TNT variants. ⚔️ Fallen Knight : Deadly undead warriors, sometimes riding evil mounts! Defeat them for the powerful Hunting Bow . 🐎 Fallen Mount : Fierce zombie horse ridden by Fallen Knights . Cure it to ride your very own dark steed! 🧙‍♀️ Wither Witch : Wicked witches that inflict Wither! Defeat them to brew powerful Decay Potions from Withering Dust . 🐱 Wither Cat : Cute? Think again. These vicious cats protect Wither Witches and strike fast! 🧟‍♂️ Infested Zombie : Enderman-Zombie hybrid that teleports you when it attacks! Rarely drops a unique enchanted book. 🐺 Dire Wolf : Snowy forests just got more dangerous! Beware their glowing red eyes! 🦉 Owl : Friendly forest companions that attack spiders. Drops Owl Eggs used for brewing Potions of Rising . 🛠️ New Items 🎇 Confusing Powder : Craft powerful teleport-themed explosives! Dropped by Concussion Creepers . 🧪 Withering Dust : Brew potent Decay Potions to turn the tide in battle! Dropped by Wither Witches . 🏹 Hunting Bow : Enchantable with Bow and Crossbow upgrades like Quick Charge and Multishot. A rare drop from Fallen Knights . ✨ Ender Fragments : Combine to craft your own Ender Pearls ! Dropped by Enderminies . 🥚 Owl Egg : Brew Potions of Rising and soar into the sky! Dropped by Owls . 🧪 New Enchantments 📜 Soulbound : Keeps items after death, but the level may decrease when triggered. ⚔️ Decay and 🏹 Withering : Inflict the deadly Wither effect on targets. 🚪 Repellent : Teleports attackers away when you get hit, mimicking the Infested Zombie’s trickery! 🧪 New Potions 🌀 Displacement : Randomly teleports entities away. 🖤 Decay : Applies the deadly Wither effect. 🤯 Confusion : Applies the Nausea effect to disorient foes. 🕊️ Rising : Grants levitation and lets you ascend into the air. ⏩ INSTALLATION REQUIRED ON CLIENT & REQUIRED ON SERVER ⏩ REQUIRES PUZZLES LIB TO BE INSTALLED (FABRIC & NEOFORGE) ⏩ REQUIRES FABRIC API TO BE INSTALLED (FABRIC) ⏩ REQUIRES FORGE CONFIG API PORT TO BE INSTALLED (FABRIC) If available for a mod, configuration is possible directly from in-game using the mod menu (requires Mod Menu by Prospector to be installed on Fabric). For manual configuration using an external text editor all files are found at .minecraft/config , named as MOD_ID-client.toml , MOD_ID-common.toml , or MOD_ID-server.toml , depending on the type of config. Not all types might exist for a mod, if any at all. 🌟 Thanks a lot to CrazyPants for their Ender Zoo mod which I really loved and was very eager to bring back to modern versions of Minecraft and a new generation of players. Almost all code is an original rewrite, meaning especially things like mob behaviors will differ from the old mod. 🌟 Huge thanks to Tamlighter for creating all those amazing new textures.                                        © 2026 @heyitsfuzs. All rights reserved. This page

Sculk Horde.title: Sculk Horde
Sculk Horde.body: The Sculk Horde unleashes an ultimate end-game challenge that will push you to your limits. Once triggered, the ancient Sculk Horde awakens from its slumber, hungering for the assimilation of all life forms in your world. This highly intelligent and adaptive horde will stop at nothing to grow stronger and more powerful, making it your sworn duty to eradicate them before they consume everything in their path. Are you ready to take on this perilous mission and emerge victorious? In the early stages of the Sculk Horde, the Gravemind summons Sculk-infused mobs, skillfully wielding them in defense and attack. But in the advanced phases of the Horde's evolution, the Gravemind takes matters into its own hands, crafting hybrid monstrosities of unparalleled power and cunning. The Sculk Ecosystem is a relentless force of nature, an insatiable devourer of life itself. Yet, even in the face of such destruction, there is hope. The Sculk corruption can be fought and defeated, and the land reclaimed... Behold the Sculk Horde, a formidable force that grows in power as it absorbs entities into its ranks. As it reaches certain thresholds of Sculk Mass, the Horde evolves, becoming more adaptive, stronger, and smarter. Each evolution brings forth a new breed of creature that the Horde can unleash upon its foes, making it a force to be reckoned with. The Sculk Horde is but a mere extension of the Gravemind, an omnipotent entity that only emerges in the second stage of the Horde's evolution. With a strategic mind unmatched by any other, the Gravemind orchestrates the Horde's every move, tirelessly plotting to expand its reach and thwart all who would dare to challenge it. Armed with a memory system that stores every encounter with other beings, the Gravemind can effortlessly assess the level of danger posed by any potential threat and adapt the Horde's tactics accordingly. Its ability to learn and evolve makes the Horde a formidable and unpredictable force, capable of unleashing devastating attacks on its enemies at a moment's notice. Note: These screenshots contain mobs from Guard Villagers and villages from Better Villages . Videos Credits Mikeatron – Lead programmer Zack – Brainstorming ideas MoonlitLamps – Textures Potato345 – Models & animations Yvain – Sculk Vindicator & Ravager textures Shenyx110 – Simplified Chinese translation Karat Feng – French translations

Endless Biomes.title: Endless Biomes
Endless Biomes.body: This is a Vanilla+ mod for the End modelled around the Nether update, adding biomes, structures and a whole bunch of miscellaneous features to the End; biome blobs spawn with large empty spaces between them so the dimension is still mostly dead with the occasional vibrant flare. The Penumbral Forest is a lavender coloured biome full of the tallest trees in the game and is themed around resistance/strength. Everything from the leaves to the moss to the wood is tougher than normal; if you plan on getting of the wood from these tall forests, you'll need an axe to mine it, in fact it is also often quicker to strip the tough outer layer of the stem blocks and then mine it to get the wood. Some of the leaves glow, break them to get endurians which give short bursts of resistance when eaten. A lot of people like the idea of an upside down biome in the End but to me upside down isn't enough, the twisted reef has plants which grow in every direction. The Twisted Reef is an ender-pearl-coloured biome themed around teleportation with big floaty cubes made of coral that go all the way to y = 255; the higher you climb in the biome, the more likely you'll find riftite crystals and shiftling mobs. The Arkan Bungles is a biome inspired by Australia's Purnululu national park with iceburg-esque "bungles" made of arkan (a new secondary stone block found commonly in the End). This biome is themed around radioactivity (weird I know) and across the central belts of the bungles, you'll find bright pink radon blocks which damage you as you get close. They damage you more the closer you are but thankfully, all arkan derived blocks will block the radiation, more specifically there has to be a straight line of sight between the centre of the player and the centre of the radon block for it to damage you. Rarely throughout the End you'll find numerous other structures including Arkan Ruins (small structures with occasional loot) and the Bulwark (a larger dungeon with unique mobs and loot). The Overworld has villagers, the Nether has piglins and now the End has it own unique trading system too: Ruinous Altars. Rather than trading items, you 'sacrifice' yourself to a Ruinous Altar which spawn on various 'podiums' throughout the End. After sacrificing yourself, you get one of six special debuffs (for 15 to 30 minutes) called hexes and some unique items in exchange, this (can) include a new weapon, armour piece and enchantment. Hexes can't be fully removed with milk, instead drinking it will half the remaining time of the effect. This is important as you cannot sacrifice yourself while you still have a hex; transporting a cow to the End could be a good idea for this very reason but just exploring the dimension and being able to get some items every so often is also not a bad idea. This mod was made with MCreator, using it mod packs is fine and credit would be nice if you do :)

Whisperwoods.title: Whisperwoods
Whisperwoods.body: Whisperwoods was created for MMD Spookyjam 2019 Whisperwoods is a spooky forest themed mod adding multiple creatures designed to make your gameplay experience not only spookier but more interesting overall. Whisperwoods is available for both Forge and Fabric, thanks to Architectury. Content Content Moths Moths are harmless and rather stupid flying insects. They spawn at night, especially in forests. They are attracted to light sources, even harmful ones like fire. However, they can clutter up torches and break them. Hidebehind The Hidebehind is a fearsome critter believed to be responsible for the disappearances of woodsmen and other forest travelers. It stalks its prey silently, and will duck behind trees and seem to melt into them if spotted, but gradually move towards its quarry. However, its vibrant eyes can give it away, and its eyes are sensitive to light and it will try to avoid bright lights. If it manages to reach its prey, it will consume them in a few violent bites, leaving no remains... Wisps Wisps are strange gaseous spirits found in forests and swamps. They often flit around aimlessly, and tend to vanish if approached. However, a few Wisps can rip the soul from a person, and try to burn it up as fuel for its fire. If this happens, it can only mean certain death, unless the Wisp is killed in time and releases the soul. When a Wisp is killed, it may drop a Ghost Light, which can be placed as a light source. Ghost Lights Ghost Lights are wisp-like lighting that can be placed anywhere, producing a colorful flame and a moderate amount of light. Wisp Lanterns Wisp lanterns are crafted by putting iron nuggets around a ghost light. Hirschgeist The Hirschgeist is a mini-boss spirit of the forest with powerful flame attacks that can summon wisps to fight for it. Hirschgeist Skull An item dropped upon the death of a Hirschgeist. It wards off dangerous spirits. It can also be placed down as decoration. Hand of Fate An occult artifact used to summon spectral beings from the Otherworld. It can be lit with ghost lights or blaze powder as part of the wisp recipe (press SHIFT while viewing its tooltip to get recipe information) Zotzpyre A vampiric beast found in caves and at night in the jungle. Frequently Asked Questions Below is a collection of frequently asked questions. Spoiler How does the Hand of Fate work? I put in the first item, but it just shows another and nothing is summoned? The item that appears in the Hand is the next item needed to be added. Add that then the next one(s) it shows, then when all are added, the mob is summoned. Can I use this mod in a pack? Yes, so long as it is hosted on CurseForge or private. If you wish to publicly host a pack on another platform (like Technic), please ask or consider using CurseForge as it supports developers. Where can I find the configs? Spawning/Server: saves/(world)/serverconfigs/whisperwoods-server.(toml/json5) Dedicated Server: /world/serverconfigs/whisperwoods-server.(toml/json5) Client: (minecraft folder)/configs/whisperwoods-client.(toml/json5) How do I craft (insert item) Use the mod "Just Enough Items" to view recipes in game. They will not be documented here. Is this mod compatible with (Insert biomes mod here)? Yes, so long as the mod uses the Biome Dictionary provided by Forge. This includes Biomes O Plenty and Traverse, as well as many other biome mods. How do I disable/modify the spawning of (insert entity here)? Use the configs, you can see where to find them in "Where can I find the configs?" above. Switch "spawn_naturally" (formerly "do_spawning") to false in order to disable spawning. You can also adjust weight and what biomes they spawn in. How can I set a default / automatically place a server configuration because new worlds don't have my configuration? Placing whisperwoods-server.(toml/json5) in the defaultconfigs folder will make it automatically be copied into new saves. 1.12 backport? No. Why isn't the Hidebehind doing anything or moving? The Hidebehin

The Outer End.title: The Outer End
The Outer End.body: The Outer End adds new biomes, structures, and mobs to the End Dimension. Biomes: - The Azure Forest, a blue and life-filled oasis filled with giant flowers and spectraflies - The Crystal Crag, a barren stone landscape made of arches and crystals, which grow slowly over time. - The Primordial Pools, an ancient zone filled with large pools of brine and Sinkers, ancestors of the Shulkers. End Towers: End Towers are a new structure in the End. They have multiple levels, and will eventually contain a boss on the top level. Underneath them are giant underground labyrinths, which have a lot of loot, but come with challenges. Elytra and other valuable items can also be found rarely in the maze's loot rooms, so be sure to fully explore each one. The Catacombs: The Catacombs are a structure consisting of an opening staircase and a maze. There is some great loot that can be found here, so conquering them is beneficial. Mobs: Purpur Golem - Purpur Golems spawn nearby end cities and will hurl you away if you get too close. They are strong, so be careful when approaching them. Himmelite - Himmelites spawn in the End Tower Labyrinths and will swarm and bite you. Entombed - Entombed are the guards of the Catacombs. Stalker - A neutral creature native to the Crystal Crag. Breedable with Chorus Fruit. Sinker - Mollusc-type creatures that cover themselves in a bubble of brine and shoot projectiles at the player which slow them down. Compatibility: The Outer End is compatible with both The Endergetic Expansion and BetterEndForge. Music: In this mod, it features 14 new amazing ambient tracks! The Azure Forest and the Crystal Crag have custom biome music, the end has its own custom creative mode music, and more survival end music. There is even music discs. The soundtrack is a mixture of multiple artists, LudoCrypt, Pyrocide, BlueDuck, and Y! For LudoCrypt's soundtrack, it is on Spotify, Itunes, and all other streaming services. It is also on Bandcamp here. For Y's music, it was a collaboration between LudoCrypt and Y. This album features some of the mod's tracks. You are allowed to use the music in videos, reviews, streams, etc. You won't get a strike or a claim for featuring the music! Though if its being used outside of a mod review, it would be nice to credit the music source!

Flower Mimics.title: Flower Mimics
Flower Mimics.body: Flower Mimics is a mod made for SpookyJam 2023. It's highly configurable. By default, whenever a player walks around at night, any flower can be a mimic and turn into a mob. When this happens, lightning will strike. The mimic will have a custom name. When the player kills the mimics, extra items and experience are dropped. The flower from which it transforms, will be placed back in the original location. There is a 1/50 chance that a flower is a mimic. Can cause some jump scares! 👻 While there are default values for an instant experience, it's possible to change a lot of behaviour. Which flowers can become mimics, what items are dropped and various settings when and how mimics should appear.    All available config options: Show Spoiler flowerIsMimicChance   default 0.02, min 0, max 1.0 The chance an encountered flower is a mimic, and transforms into a mob. extraExperienceOnMimicDeath   default 30 The amount of extra experience that should drop whenever a mimic is killed. dropExtraItemsOnMimicDeath   default true Whether the items specified in ./config/serilum/flowermimics/.. should be dropped whenever a mimic is killed. onlyTransformMimicsAtNight   default true Whether flowers should only transform into mobs when it is night time. When disabled, they can always transform. resetMimicsBeforeNightTime   default true Whether mimic flower possibilities should be reset when the day turns into night. removeFlowerBlockOnMimicSpawn   default true Whether the flower block from which the mimic transforms should be removed on spawn. dropFlowerItemOnMimicDeath   default false If the mimic flower should be dropped on death. Must have 'removeFlowerBlockOnMimicSpawn' enabled. replaceOriginalFlowerBlockOnMimicDeath   default true If the original flower block should be replaced when a mimic dies. Must have 'removeFlowerBlockOnMimicSpawn' enabled. Destination must have an air block. placeFlowerBlockWhereMimicDies   default false If the a flower block should be placed where a mimic dies. Must have 'removeFlowerBlockOnMimicSpawn' enabled. Destination must have an air block. showLightningOnMimicSpawn   default true If lightning should be shown whenever a mimic spawns. showLightningOnFlowerBlockReturn   default true If lightning should be shown if a flower block is re-placed into the world. preventMimicsOnPlacedAndBoneMealFlowers   default true Whether manually placed and bone mealed flowers should not spawn mimics. checkForMimicAroundBlockRange   default 15, min 1, max 30 How many blocks away from the player the mod should check for mimics. Increasing this will take more processing power. mimicTransformAroundPlayerRange   default 5, min 1, max 30 How close the player should be to a mimic flower in order for it to transform. checkForMimicFlowersDelayInTicks   default 50, min 1, max 3600000 How often the mod should check for flower mimics around the player. 20 ticks = 1 second There are also two config files located in ./config/serilum/flowermimics/. : Both can also be edited in-game via Mods -> Flower Mimics -> Config, in the 'Extra Config Files' tab. The flowers and mobs can be picked from a list there. It's possible to configure what flower mimics will turn into. Will also work with modded entities and flowers: ./config/serilum/flowermimics/flower_mimics.txt You can change what items flower mimics will drop: ./config/serilum/flowermimics/flower_item_drops.txt Be careful when walking around at night! A flower might just be something else: Show Spoiler   By default, whenever you kill a mimic it'll place the original flower back. Extra items and experience are dropped by the mimic: Show Spoiler You may freely use this mod in any modpack, as long as the download remains hosted within the CurseForge or Modrinth ecosystem. Serilum.com contains an overview and more information on
