Invasion Code Red Reborn(Illager Boss).title: Invasion Code Red Reborn(Illager Boss)
Invasion Code Red Reborn(Illager Boss).body: This mod adds a raider boss called the Gashslit: orginal Creator: min01 New Creater: magispeller_illagebossmaker,Theillagecoder - · It has a chance (configurable) to appear during raids; - · Has 680 (×340) HP and can deal 13~24 damage depending on the attack move; - · The lower this boss's remaining HP, the higher its defense/attack damage; - · When HP is 40% or less, it will change phase: unlocking new attack methods and additionally increasing attack damage and range; - · After performing a melee attack, this boss gains Speed level 10 for a very short time; - · This boss can also shoot sword energy to attack targets from a distance; - · Charge attack: quickly rushes toward the target and deals at least 46 damage; - · Summon: summons several Riftblade King Dragons to assist in battle; - · Block: during this action, the boss becomes immune to most damage; - · Slash barrage: this move can deal very high damage in a short time (20 damage/second); - · This boss currently has no added drops.

Jurassic Reborn.title: Jurassic Reborn
Jurassic Reborn.body: Jurassic Reborn (JR) is a mod based on prehistoric creatures from different games, movies, and fandoms relating to the Jurassic Park / World Universe. JR has added 112 different creatures such as dinosaurs, marine reptiles, prehistoric fish, animals, and hybrids to Minecraft, all having unique A.I, animations, textures, and models! Each update developed is extensively bug tested in order to ensure that we send out a finished product that is up to the highest quality standards, with as few bugs and inconveniences for users as possible. In the event of a bug, however, new versions of the mod will be promptly released with appropriate bug fixes. There's much to see here. So, take your time, look around, and learn all there is to know about us. Hope you enjoy our ultimate Jurassic World Minecraft experience!

Snuffles.title: Snuffles
Snuffles.body: Made during WinterJam 2021. Snuffles are fluffy mobs with a big tongue found in snowy biomes with unique frosty fur. They can be bred with potatoes, they'll flap their tongues and run towards you if you're holding them. Their fur is covered with frost, which can removed with magma cream or fire. Frosty Snuffles leave a trail of snowflakes wherever they go. Their fluff can be harvested by shearing them, trimming the excess fluff and exposing their eyes. If a Snuffle is warm, it can turn frosty again by being in the open when it is snowing or by walking into powder snow. This can be seen here. Slimeballs can be used on them to cycle through 4 hairstyles. Snuffle Fluff and Snuffle Fluff Carpets are decoration blocks and Frosty Fluff and Frosty Fluff Carpets make snowflakes when stepped on. Frosty Fluff also makes snowflake particles below it if there are no blocks under it.

Playmate (horror).title: Playmate (horror)
Playmate (horror).body: PLAYMATE Playmate - is a brand new horror mod that adds one single entity you can play hide and seek with. When you haven't slept for 2 days, game will start at 3rd night and one of roles will be given: Hiding You must hide in the darkest corner and don't make any noice because he hears everything (except microphone xd) If 60 seconds pasts you will win. Congratulations you survived! Seeking In this case you must find Playmate 3 times before timer runs out. Otherwise... Congratulations you survived! There are also chance of him burning your bed so if you hear that your house on fire - it is indeed. COMMANDS Bedfirefalse - disables Playmate's ability to burn your house. Bedfiretrue - enables Playmate's ability to burn your house. Endgame - if game bugged or other thing happened use this. Play - (for content creators) starts the game

000.jar.title: 000.jar
000.jar.body: 000.jar =========== _Something went wrong in your world , someone else came before you, and they're out to get you. Can you avoid it?_ A corrupt entity invaded your world. You need to avoid him because he will do everything he can to kick you out of your own game. Hide, wait, don't look for it or things will get worse. What's new with this mod? This is a horror mod focused on the player exploring the environment, they are not random scares or creatures chasing you like typical Dwellers. This mod wants to focus on giving the feeling that the old versions of Minecraft gave. Without bothering the player but giving them the feeling that something is not right. The player has the decision whether to advance or not. It is an environmental and psychological mod with surprises that the player will have to experience. The events are completely random and configurable to the player's taste. What is recommended to play this mod and have a good experience? I recommend having textures and sounds from Minecraft Alpha or Beta. Classic mods like Herobrine to give more tension and atmosphere. Play it in singleplayer, play it patiently and explore. If you are not comfortable with the default configuration, you can change it to your liking and reset it whenever you want. It is compatible with multiplayer servers (tested by the community itself in previous versions) and there are almost no bugs or errors that can happen with the mod. Necessary for the mod to work correctly: Click here for Download Geckolib Mod (for animations, etc) Click here for Download Configured Mod (for the mod config menu) You can uninstall it whenever you want, it will not corrupt or affect your world. If you have problems or doubts, suggestions, you can contact me through the Discord server: Click me PATREON ------------------------------------------------------------------------ Do you want to have early access to features, leaks of this or other mods that I am making and have many other benefits? You can join by being a paying member on my Patreon. After joining make sure to also join my Discord server to give you your respective role. If you are a developer you can publish your mod on the server so people can try it. https://www.patreon.com/EBALIA Credits: Phenomal, VantablackDEV (deep testing) riverr (sounds) https://www.mado-hosting.com/?ref=ebaliakmzl

DragonMine Z - Dragon Ball in Minecraft!.title: DragonMine Z - Dragon Ball in Minecraft!
DragonMine Z - Dragon Ball in Minecraft!.body: DragonMine Z is an immersive WIP (Work-In-Progress) Minecraft mod inspired by Akira Toriyama's most-famous work, Dragon Ball. Also check out the mod in CurseForge! Our plan is to take the complete Dragon Ball experience into Minecraft, adding everything we can and revamping the vanilla experience. -- Requires [GeckoLib 4.8.3+, TerraBlender and CuriosAPI]-- In DMZ, you can create your own character between five Races: Human, Saiyan, Namekian, Frost Demon, Bio-Android and Majin. You also can customize the hair, eyes, skin, aura, colours, and more! Once you create your character, you'll have access to the Stats system, with six values: Strength, Strike Power, Resistance, Vitality, Ki Power and Energy. You can level up your Stats and Skills to be more powerful than your opponents. Currently, the mod adds a few structures: The Kami's Lookout, Korin's Tower, Elder Guru's House, Goku's House, Roshi's House and Red Ribbon Towers. We also added some new dimensions: The Hyperbolic Time Chamber, Namek and Sacred Kai Planet. In the future we will add more planets like Beerus Planet and Cereal Planet! (Do we have to mention that you can also craft a Dragon Radar, search the Dragon Balls and summon Shenron to make a wish? No, right?) Obviously there are plenty items, armors and weapons that you can craft. All of them are planned to have a Vanilla-Like experience. In Namek, there are Namekian Villages, with Warriors and Traders, similar to Villagers and Golems. If you attack or kill a Trader, you'll become Evil. We worked hard on allowing the player to tweak almost any setting, whereas you can modify: The Stats limit, Stats Cost, Stats values/increments, Races/Forms Multipliers, and more. Perfect for a server! The mod has been tested in both singleplayer and multiplayer environments, as of the latest version, (unless otherwise stated) DragonMine Z is compatible with forge dedicated servers. Supported Languages: Too much to list, take a look at our DragonMineZ dashboard in Crowdin! You can also add yours! You can join our Discord to give us suggestions, reviews, or report issues. Just open a ticket! Also, you can support the mod development via PayPal. (or Patreon and get some rewards) NOTE: DragonMine Z is and will always be a free mod. It will never be a paid mod or have pay-to-win features. From Another World.title: From Another World
From Another World.body: Important note: This mod is not currently being developed as I have been losing interest in modding Minecraft. It's not abandoned and I would like to do more with it in the future (at least one update to make it feel like a more complete and refined experience) but for now there won't be any updates for a while. I hope you understand :) Adds everyone's favourite alien shapeshifter to Minecraft 1.20.1! Requires AzureLib and FromAnotherLibrary (and Fabric API if you're using the fabric version) This mod has a unique take on the concept of invasion and infection mods: -The mobs have a consistent presence - they cannot spawn or despawn randomly. They spread through your world like a real organism with a consistent method of reproduction and never "cheat." -Survival is the focus - everything is balanced and tested for survival mode with no other mods installed. If something is unfair/unfun, this is not intended, please report it. Tips: -USE FIRE. Flint and Steel can set mobs from this mod on fire just by right clicking them. -The Alien Thing may seem impossible to kill at first but it is beatable. You just need to be a bit smarter to make sure it can't survive. Questions: Q: Can I use this mod in a video or modpack? A: Yes! If you're making a video, please link this page. Q: Will you backport this mod? A: No, I only want to support the latest version but anyone is welcome to backport it themselves (and if you do I apologise for the state of my code, I never took any actual lessons to learn Java, it's a miracle I managed to make a functional mod). Credits: Shaders used in the icon: Builder's QOL Shaders Sounds used in the mod are from the 2002 video game "The Thing"

Companions!.title: Companions!
Companions!.body: Companions! is a mod that adds 10 tameable creatures, each with special abilities, hostile mobs with unique skills, new weapons, a boss, and much more.   Mod versions 1.19.2 and 1.21.1 are coming very soon   The mod JEI (which this mod is compatible with) is recommended for viewing the recipes of all items within the game.   Companions can be healed using Small Essence and Great Essence, obtained by killing hostile mobs. Summoned companions (spawned by companions) cannot be healed. All companions have three states: wandering, sitting, and following the player. For summoned companions, you can choose whether they follow the companion or the player.   The mod is highly configurable through the config file. For any questions, problems, contributions, new ideas about content/mods, and more, you can join our official Discord and comment in the appropriate channels.        The Great Chalice    Craftable as if you were making a cauldron, but with copper ingots. This block can be filled by interacting with it either using great essence or small essence , both obtained by killing monsters. When it is completely full, you can fill an "empty grail", thus obtaining a filled grail, which is an item required by some recipes.   Soul Furnace                        This special furnace can be filled by placing a chalice on top of it,, and filling it. It can cook different things into their soul-like state, such as the big bread, that can be cooked into a weird croissant "egg"? What would that be for...   Frog Bonanza                      A frog-shaped bonanza. I swear its shape reminds me of something... Too bad there's no color reward at all, because I'd go all in on red without even thinking.   Voltaic Pillar                              One of the components of the Tesla Network. It generates a continuous current between columns of pillars of the same height. Not recommended to touch it, as it carries a high current and will electrocute anything it doesn't like.   Recall Platform                      Another component of the Tesla Network. A teleportation platform that only allows travel between two platforms within the same Tesla Network. In other words, you won't be able to teleport to other recall platform within another Network. This is meant as an "intuitive" alternative to fast travel, since fully automated teleportation (or movement in general) systems tend to make the players overly simplistic. That breaks the intended complexity and spirit of the game (and modpacks). After all, the fun lies in the journey, not in having everything handed to you.   Voltaic Relay                             One of the components of the Tesla Network. It generates (and extends) a temporary current to connected nodes. Similar to the redstone repeater.   Plasma Lamp                             Another component of the Tesla Network. It emits light when connected to the current.   Tesla Coil                           One more component of the Tesla Network. It generates a temporary current to connected nodes.   Respawn Totem                        A respawn totem craftable using items dropped by the mod’s boss, which is detailed further below. It has several uses. Most notably, it can serve as a respawn beacon: when interacted with a Hourglass, the totem activates and allows all tamed entities within a c

Cobblemon Alatia's Fakemon Pack.title: Cobblemon Alatia's Fakemon Pack
Cobblemon Alatia's Fakemon Pack.body: This addon adds new fakemon from the Alatia Region ! How to set custom starters set - Extract from the .zip file the "starter screen" folder (attached as additional file in each version page), inside it there are two files: main.json and starters.json - Move your files in ".minecraft\config\cobblemon" (there's already a main.json, replace it with the new one) - Enjoy it! NOTE: - If you are using this addon with other ones with different starter set, you have to manually edit starters.json - If you are using multiple addons, some evolution could be unavailable due to config conflict There's a document where you can find every information you need HERE Common Q&A: Spoiler If you need more help you can find me in the official Cobblemon Discord Server. Q : The world won't start with the addon, what's wrong? A : If you are using the GEB version of my addon, make sure you also downloaded Gravel's Extended Battles, it's necessary since is used for custom types and moves. Q : I added the addon in my world but doesn't work, what's wrong? A : My addon is a mod (basically dapatack + resource pack pagacked as mod), so you just have to add it in your mod folder and it will work fine. Q : I donwloaded GEB but I don't have any new types, what's wrong? A : There are two versions of my addon (each of them for Fabric and NeoForge): One where you have the custom types (called "GEB") and one without (called "No GEB") where you don't need Gravel's Extended Battles to play it. Q : The battle freezes and I can't do anything but run away. A : This is a common issues caused by Gravel's Extended Battles with Cobblemon: Mega Showdown or Cobblemania used together, please report this issue to the mod authors, my addon is not the issue. Q : I'm using Xaero's Minimap and I would like to have icons of your fakemon. A : You can use E19 - Cobblemon Minimap Icons, this icon pack supports my addon. Q : I have issue with the addon, I'm using -insert modpack name- . A : I can't help with this because the issue could be anything. Q : I need some information about a pokemon, can you help me? A : HERE you can find every information you need Q : I would like to add this addon in a modpack, can I add to it? A : Yes, as long as you credit me. And please let me know since I like to look at some good modpacks. Q : I would like to edit some data of your fakemon, how and can I do it? A : Yes, you can edit the addon by making a new datapack to change some fakemon properties, such as stats, movepool and spawns. You can find the tutorial in the official Cobblemon Wiki. Q : Hi, I'm an admin of -insert server name- , we would like to add your addon in -insert some method to earn money from players- A : This addon is made to be free and no-profit, you can't block my content behind any sort of paywall (specifified in my CC license, NO COMMERCIAL USE) and mostly important: no one is allowed to use this addon in public server without my permission. Credits: - Every fakemon from the Alatia Region is designed by Doctor_X_Art (me) - Aster Region starters by Poke.Nova - Frinx and Avalinx from the Impetia Region by Cioxmon - Iron Stalker is designed by Nengland and Aleskiin - Every cry sound is made by me, Ganbare-Lucifer and FloppaTyann Cobblemon Alatia's Fakemon Pack © 2024 by Giuseppe D'Antonio (Doctor X) is licensed under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 Guidelines My CC license has some information regard what you may and not may do with my addon, but I'll prefer to specify a couple of additional things to avoid some greedy jackals: You may: - Include the pack into a private and public modpack WITH explicit permission and credit. (Provide a screenshot of the conversation as proof of my permission) You may not: - Use any of this content for profit. This include but not limited to: - Make server-exclusive skins and/or variant of fakemon inside this project. - A paywall of skins and distribution of fakemon via loot crates, keys, or any form of gambling and shiny boost. Each fakemon can be found natural

Super Powers.title: Super Powers
Super Powers.body: ☄️ SVM Powers Datapack Experience Minecraft like never before! This DataPack adds a variety of new content, adding new bosses, NPCs, custom structures, powerful items and most importantly, epic abilities! Abilities vary from being used for movement, survival, building, fighting, mining and whatever you can imagine! Currently, the most recent version adds a total of 16 different powers which are: Phasing, Lightning, Flora, Slime, Explosion, Ice, Gravity, Dimension Travel, Harpie, Fire, Void, Time, Healing, Death, Copy and Water! 🔴 Installation 🎨 Resourcepack/Textures In "Options", click "Resource Packs..." and click "Open Pack Folder", now just drag-drop the datapack, go back to Minecraft and go to "Options", then "Resource Packs", click the SVM Powers Pack and click "Done" and that should load your resources (In short, assets are inside of the Datapack file, so just copy-paste it in the resourcepack folder) 📁 Datapack Download newest full version of the datapack For new world In "Singleplayer", click "Create New World", then go into "More" and click "Data Packs", then click "Open Pack Folder" and datapack folder will open, then just drag/copy-paste the downloaded file to the opened folder, then click on the datapack in-game so it's in "Selected" instead of "Available". For existing world In "Singleplayer", select your world where you want to install the pack, click "Edit" and then "Open World Folder", then go into "datapacks" folder and drag/copy-paste the downloaded file to the opened folder. 📜 Mod Mod version doesn't require anything besides putting the downloaded file to .minecraft/mods folder AND requires the "Load My Resources" Mod to work ❓ FAQ Q - How to get powers? - Various powers have various obtainment methods, you have all the guides on the menu! Use either "/trigger svm_ep.menu" command or shift-click at 9th hotbar slot which should display a "Menu" Q - Is it multiplayer friendly? - Yes! Q - How do I progress? - Various mobs drop various golden food such as: Golden hearts, bones, fleshes and more, they are rare variants of the normal items and for example: Golden Heart - Gives more HP, Golden Eye - Upgrades your mana bar. Faunify.title: Faunify
Faunify.body: 1.3.0 - Cutie Crawlies Update! Faunify adds a small collection of cute, tameable creatures to your Minecraft world! Currently, Faunify adds 6 different creatures, all with unique AI mechanics, as well as over 15 ambient critters! Weasels - A common mustelid that spawns in forests and plains. White, winter coat weasels can be spotted in snowy biomes! They are able to be tamed with raw rabbit, and can dig in gravel, sand, or dirt for resources if you drop an egg nearby! Two different types of Ferrets are also uncommonly obtainable by breeding two tamed Weasels! Chinchillas - Cute, fluffy, and docile rodents that live in meadows in the mountains. They can be tamed with dandelions and bred with wheat. They are able to bathe in gravel and turn it into Dust, which can be dug up and used to throw at monsters to slow them down and blind them! They can also bathe in suspicious gravel, and have a 30% higher chance of sifting up rare items like armor trims, discs, and sherds! This only works on naturally-generating gravel, so go out in your world and find some treasures! Fennec Foxes - An adorable, tiny species of fox that spawns in deserts and badlands. They are able to be tamed with raw chicken, if you can lure one close to you! Tamed Fennecs are weak, but can alert you to nearby monsters with their shrill barks. Hedgehogs - Spiky little critters that live in the plains and forests! You can tame them with insect flesh, and they absolutely love pumpkin seeds! When hit they curl into a ball, and when touched they can give you a prick, so be careful around them! They drop quills every few minutes which you can shoot out of a blowpipe, and have some secret nametag variants! Ringtail Cats - Rare and fluffy mining companions that live in wooded badlands. They can be tamed with rabbit feet and bred with cod or salmon! If you tame one and take it down into the caves alongside you, it can give you a handy Haste buff to help you with your mining journey! They can also make a special sound when they sense ore nearby, and tunnel through soft blocks like dirt or sand to unearth different ores! Opossums - These merry marsupials can be found in meadows, forests, plains, and taiga biomes! They're untamable, but love to take care of their young, which can spawn on their backs! Baby opossums like to trail behind adults, and can even climb onto their backs! If you want to take one of these cute babies, you can either feed an adult opossum some sweet berries, or punch them off... (you monster!) Opossums love sweet berries and can even harvest sweet berry bushes, and can be bred with berries too! If at any point an opossum loses a large chunk of health, it will play dead... don't mistake it for sleeping!   There are even Ambient creatures, such as..   Mice - Adorable little thieves that spawn in forests that will sneak up on you to steal any seeds out of your inventory! You can breed them using sweet berries. You might even be lucky enough to get a rare breed-only variant! Leaf Sheep - Adorable and squishy sea slugs found at the bottom of the ocean that are untamable and unbreedable, but can be a good source of slime balls! As well as a massive array of different insects and other invertebrates! I plan to add a lot more cute animals to this mod, so keep an eye out for future updates! There are many more creatures I want to add, and I'm always open to suggestions! An update to 1.21.1 is planned after all features I want in the mod are available for 1.20.1 first !   Update 10/2/2026 A new update has dropped! Please welcome the massive new 1.3.0 update which adds 13 new insect species, as well as loads of new changes, features, blocks and items! A brand-new Wiki has also been published which you can view here . It includes information about the entire mod! Credits Code, Models, Textures, Entity Sounds, (some) Animations - Peppercorn Animations - Rat Music - KaktusDoesMusic Lang - That_DogNugget, Pygargue00fr, vadim33mx

The Root of Fear.title: The Root of Fear
The Root of Fear.body: About The Root of Fear adds the Wilted, a monstrous relative of the Creaking that has fused with its heart and become independent of the Pale Garden, now roaming freely throughout the Overworld. The Wilted draws power from darkness, which means that you, the Overworld's main source of light, are its prime target. It's also extremely unpredictable due to its complex AI, which includes behaviours that are randomised every time it spawns... Good luck. How to play - You will occasionally hear the Wilted at night 2 days before it comes. - A dense fog will cover the Overworld on the day of its attack. - The Wilted will come at night, disguising itself. Try to hold it off for as long as possible. - Do not attempt to engage the Wilted in combat. - When the Wilted reveals itself, get to a safe, lit up area as quickly as possible. - Break the roots that cover your lights. - Survive the onslaught until day. - The Wilted will come first on the second night, it will come back between 2 and 10 days after its last attack. Commands - /rootoffear spawnday get tells you which day the Wilted will spawn on - /rootoffear spawnday getrelative tells you how many days there are until the Wilted can spawn - /rootoffear spawnday set lets you set which day the Wilted will spawn on - /rootoffear spawnday setrelative lets you set how many days there are until the Wilted can spawn - /rootoffear assignedwilted get tells you which Wilted is connected to the dimension you're in - /rootoffear assignedwilted set lets you connect an existing Wilted to the dimension you're in - /rootoffear assignedwilted clear lets you disconnect the dimension you're in from its Wilted - /rootoffear ultimatetarget get tells you the ultimate target of the selected Wilted - /rootoffear ultimatetarget set lets you set the ultimate target of all selected Wilted - /rootoffear ultimatetarget clear lets you clear the ultimate target of all selected Wilted - /rootoffear setdisguised lets you set the disguised state of all selected Wilted Credits - Certain sounds are modified versions of sounds from Minecraft and Minecraft Dungeons If you need a server to play Minecraft with your friends, try out Bisect Hosting! Animal Garden - Sea Otter.title: Animal Garden - Sea Otter
Animal Garden - Sea Otter.body: Adds the tamable sea otters into the game, that will fight and protect you when in need. You can tame, tempt and breed them with any fish item. (item tag json file is added so you can change the food items at data- tags- item(s)) It has 3 type of behavior that can be changed after taming. -wandering(will not follow the player), -sitting (lay down and waits until attacked or gets another behavior command) -following owner It moves slowly on land so use them in the water if possible. If it is damaged they will help protect their kin and if there is food (fish) item or mob near to it, then it will go and eat it to restore its health a bit. But they will sometimes just go and attack a fish even with full hp. They move in groups.(If there are more otters nearby one of them will be selected as the leader and every other otter will follow that otter) Baby sea otters only follow the parent and will attach themselves to their them They are light brown, while adults can have 4 color variations. The default variant is when its head is white and its body is brown, but it has a chance to spawn dark colored. It can spawn as a rare albino variant with a 3% chance having white coat and pink eye. And there is even a chance that it spawns with leucism having just a white coat. You can find them in the ocean and cold ocean biome. (In forge you can change this and other spawn settings by editing the json files in the data - biome tags and biome modifier folders or via resource pack and in fabric there is a config file for it) By default sea otters will disappear when they are too far away except when its tamed, was fed by someone, has a nametag or if "isAlwaysPersistent" is set to true in the config. Before the mob spawns it checks the area around the position if there is already another mob of this type around. If yes then it will check how many. And in the config you can also change how big of an area it should check around the mob spawn point and a max number. If there are more mobs in that area then the max number then it wont spawn the new mob. This option is to prevent overspawning. Face of Horror.title: Face of Horror
Face of Horror.body: FACE OF HORROR , _Mod version 3.0_ Face of Horror is a horror mod that turns ordinary survival gameplay into a tense, unpredictable experience. Instead of adding constant enemies, it watches the player from the background: strange faces appear in dark corners, voices whisper nearby, sudden sounds break the silence, and full moon nights may become something far more dangerous. The main feature is a dynamic jumpscare system. Over time, the mod searches for suitable places around each player, prioritizing corners, walls, shadows, and partially hidden spots. A face may appear where the player least expects it, sometimes waiting silently until it is seen. When triggered, the player can be briefly paralyzed, the camera may lock, and custom horror sounds play to make the encounter feel sudden and invasive. This mod creates an atmosphere of constant tension by intermittently triggering terrifying face entities that appear in dark or secluded areas, instantly startling the player. Face of Horror also includes ambient horror audio. Distant whispers, giggles and voices, and other unsettling sounds can play around the player at random intervals, creating tension even when nothing is visible. JUMPSCARES TYPES Spoiler Simple Jumpscare Peeping Jumpscare Screamer Jumpscare CUSTOMIZATION Face of Horror add a system where Players can add their own .png face textures and .ogg sounds. The in-game client config lets players enable or disable individual custom files, as well as toggle packaged default sounds. Newly discovered custom assets are enabled by default, and F3 + T reloads them while the game is running. The mod creates a folder in the Minecraft game directory: CONFIGS Server settings control jumpscare timing, full moon behavior, paralysis duration, ambient sound playback, and whether the Harvest Moon event is allowed. Spoiler Client settings control selected textures and sounds, making the mod flexible for singleplayer worlds, multiplayer servers, modpacks, or personalized horror setups. Spoiler SPIRIT OF THE HARVEST MOON For players who want deeper events, the mod includes the optional Spirit of the Harvest Moon encounter, based on the iconic monster from _“Courage the Cowardly Dog”_. When enabled, full moon nights can trigger a special entity that descends before a player and demands an offering. If the correct offering is given, the player survives the encounter. If not, the spirit may begin hunting, spawning faces and applying dangerous effects until the night ends. Spoiler Face of Horror is designed for players who want atmospheric, unpredictable horror without completely replacing Minecraft’s normal survival loop. It works best in dark caves, abandoned builds, night exploration, and survival worlds where the player is never fully sure if they are alone. Credits: Guim Tio Zarraluki Scout The Entity darkmindarts Liminal Land Main Features Spoiler • Randomized jumpscares that target each player individually. • Face entities that appear in corners, walls, shadows, and hidden places. • A paralysis effect that can stop movement and lock the player’s camera. • Ambient horror sounds that play around the player. • Multiple built-in jumpscare, stinger, whisper, giggle, ambience, and death sounds. • Custom face textures using external .png files. • Custom sound support using external .ogg files. • Configurable client and server settings. • Optional full moon “Spirit of the Harvest Moon” event. • Admin/debug commands for testing jumpscares and opening config screens. • EE

In Your World.title: In Your World
In Your World.body: 𝐈𝐍 𝐘𝐎𝐔𝐑 𝐖𝐎𝐑𝐋𝐃 ============================ _ You are a player who has created his world but something is wrong, someone else inhabits it before you. _ Imagine you are in Minecraft Alpha or Beta. You are calm in your world, and suddenly you hear sounds, footsteps, you see strange things in the sky without meaning......strange structures floating.....you feel watched.....you hear footsteps... ..but nothing happens....yet... What's new with this mod? This is a horror mod focused on the player exploring the environment, they are not random scares or creatures chasing you like typical Dwellers. This mod wants to focus on giving the feeling that the old versions of Minecraft gave. Without bothering the player but giving them the feeling that something is not right. The player has the decision whether to advance or not. It is an environmental and psychological mod with surprises that the player will have to experience. The events are completely random and configurable to the player's taste. What is recommended to play this mod and have a good experience? - I recommend having textures and sounds from Minecraft Alpha or Beta. - Do not have too intrusive mods that affect the generation of structures or biomes (this mod uses vanilla biomes). - Have classic mods like Herobrine to give more tension and atmosphere. - Play it in singleplayer. - Play it patiently and explore. - If you are not comfortable with the default configuration, you can change it to your liking and reset it whenever you want. - It is compatible with multiplayer servers (tested by the community itself in previous versions) and there are almost no bugs or errors that can happen with the mod. _ I also recommend installing the following mods: _ Click here for Download Geckolib Mod (for animations, etc) Click here for Download Configured Mod (for the mod config menu) You can uninstall it whenever you want, it will not corrupt or affect your world. If you have problems or doubts, suggestions, you can contact me through the Discord server: https://discord.gg/ZrgMwfdwZB PATREON ----------- Do you want to have early access to features, leaks of this or other mods that I am making and have many other benefits? You can join by being a paying member on my Patreon. After joining make sure to also join my Discord server to give you your respective role. If you are a developer you can publish your mod on the server so people can try it. https://www.patreon.com/EBALIA https://www.mado-hosting.com/?ref=ebaliakmzl

[TACZ] NPCs.title: [TACZ] NPCs
[TACZ] NPCs.body: Requirements __TACZ__ Features Rendering and use of armors and TACZ guns - NPCs will use TACZ guns from any addon pack just like a player would, including rocket launchers, grenade launchers and flamethrowers, to name a few. Full PlayerAnimator and Player skin support - NPCs will use animations from PlayerAnimator and can be configured with Player names and skins Configuration - Extensive configuration files which can be used to create entirely new NPCs with different relationships, textures and equipment. Factions and Relationships - Configure the tacznpc\_factions.json file to set up various teams and watch them fight out real time battles. How to Use See Configuration below on how to modify the mod. You can summon npcs with /summon tacznpcs:npc {"template":""}, not adding the template nbt: ({"template":""}) will use the "default" template, otherwise you specify a template name based on the npc\_loadouts.json config file. Configuration NPCs are configured using the mod's config files. Custom loot tables or tags should be added the normal Minecraft way using datapacks. IDs can then be referenced by the config. tacznpc\_factions.json Maps entity IDs to faction names. { "villagers": [ "minecraft:villager", "minecraft:iron_golem" ], "illagers": [ "minecraft:pillager", "minecraft:evoker" ] } Keys are faction names. Values are lists of entity IDs. tacznpc\_loadouts.json Defines NPC equipment, weapons, factions, and textures. { "illagers": { primary The NPC's primary weapon or item. helmet Helmet item (optional). chestplate Chestplate item (optional). leggings Leggings item (optional). boots Boots item (optional). ID Prefixes for Extra Fields Several fields accept different ID types using prefixes: Prefix Meaning Example ------ ----------------- -------------------------------- (none) Minecraft item ID minecraft:iron_sword % TACZ gun ID %tacz:glock_17 Item tag c:swords $ Loot table ID $minecraft:chests/simple_dungeon A default loadout is recommended and is used whenever no other loadout applies. Built-in Factions These faction names are always available (case-insensitive): monster creature ambient axolotls underground_water_creature water_creature water_ambient misc You may also reference any custom faction defined in npc_factions.json . tacznpcs\_structures.json Defines structures for specific loadouts to spawn in. { "minecraft:mansion": [ <-- structure id { <-- object "entities": [ "minecraft:pillager", "minecraft:vindicator" ], "loadout": "illagers", "chance": 0.25 } ], "minecraft:village_plains": [ { <-- there can be more than one spawning object per structure "entities": [ "minecraft:villager" <-- list of entity ids that can be replaced ], "loadout": "villagers", <-- loadout to replace entities with "chance": 0.05 <-- chance for entity to be replaced on spawn }, { "entities": [ "minecraft:iron_golem" ], "loadout": "villagers", "chance": 0.5 } ] } I accept commisions or questions on discord @ jeducklet. (DMs open)

Player Mobs.title: Player Mobs
Player Mobs.body: A mod that adds hostile player mobs to the game. You can add names to the config for more more names in game. You can also add links to pages returning a list of names divided by a newline. You can use pages like this whitelist.gorymoon.se to get lists of twitch subs. When used on a server you can add the whitelist the the available names for the mobs. The mobs can be friendly to players with the same name as them. The mobs can drop the heads of the skin they have. Players can drop their head when killed based on a config option. To manually reload the list of remote names the following commmand can be used: _/playermobs reload_ To manually spawn a mob there is the following command: _/playermobs spawn <name> [pos]_ (where pos is optional) This is an example on how to spawn a mod with the summon command: _/summon player_mobs:player_mob ~ ~ ~ {"Username":"Gory_Moon"}_ Custom skin textures More info about adding/overriding textures of the player mobs can be found here TODO/Next Adding datapack support for special spawns. Bugs/Ideas/Requests? Post bugs/ideas/requests on my Github issue tracker. Modpacks? You are free to use this mod in modpacks.)

You've Goat to be Kidding Me.title: You've Goat to be Kidding Me
You've Goat to be Kidding Me.body: You've Goat to be kidding me! 📖About 📖 Formerly "Oh My Goat!" A vanilla like mod which aims to flesh out 1.18 goats a bit more. Its main features are Ram Block, Geep, Barbaric Helmet and Chevon meat: 🐐 Features 🐐 Ram Block The Ram Block is a block-breaking oriented block crafted from goat horns. With the help of a piston, the Ram block can damage and break blocks, much like a goat ramming into a tree. Break speed depends on the hardness of the block. Additionally it will be able to break anything up to obsidian hardness but only iron tier blocks will drop Does not work with enchantments as it's a block Also inflicts knockback and damage on entities when pushed Barbaric Helmet The Berserker Helmet is a life-saving piece of equipment crafted from goat horns and copper. It provides the player with strength and speed on lower health. Chevon Chevon is a new meat dropped from goats. The Geep Geeps are the result of breeding a goat with a sheep. they cannot breed themselves, but does yield wool and chevon, and can be milked. Also they are more frail with less health and cannot be dyed Thatch Decorative building block perfect for your nordic builds! ⚙️ Mod Integration ⚙️ If Windswept is installed, Chevon meat will be disabled in favor of its ones Chevon can be used in some Farmers Delight recipes Make sure you have enough ram! Valarian Conquest.title: Valarian Conquest
Valarian Conquest.body: Valarian Conquest aims to enhance the overall feeling of combat and exploration in the overworld. It adds new factions, structures and mobs in an effort to make the world feel more alive, medieval and explorable. As of update 4.0 the mod now has numerous factions and unique armor and structures for each of them. Some of the human and fantasy factions from previous versions are still being worked on and will be readded over time in updates. Each of these factions can be joined and allied with and within these factions structures you can find citizens that can be rescued and claimed as your own. Once claimed, these citizens can hold villager professions or combat roles and will remain with you on your journey. Over time my hope is to expand on the features of this mod and add even more exciting gameplay elements. Just keep in mind this is the first time I have attempted a mod so if you find bugs or issues feel free to let me know and I'll do my best to address them. Curseforge Discord Ko-Fi

Tiny Dragons.title: Tiny Dragons
Tiny Dragons.body: Hatch, tame and explore with Tiny Dragons! Find rare eggs, hatch your dragons with warmth and discover faithful allies who not only protect you but make your journey even more incredible. Download now and have a companion who is pure fire! 1. Find the Dragon Egg: Search inside chests in structures such as temples, fortresses, bastions, dungeons, etc. 2. Hatch the egg: - Place the egg in bonfires, magma blocks, lava cauldrons or directly into lava. The egg needs intense heat and takes about 10 minutes to hatch. - You will know it is working if the egg starts to shake and emit smoke. Dragon eggs are ancient relics, petrified by time. Its true origin is a mystery, as no one knows what species it belongs to. When you hatch them, a unique dragon of random breed will be born. Good luck in obtaining a magnificent and rare specimen! 3. Tame the Dragon: - Once hatched, the dragon will be wild. It will not attack, but may try to run away if it is outdoors. - To tame it, offer raw rabbit meat or raw chicken meat. 4. Dragon Skills: - When tamed, it can give you the Fire Resistance effect when fed raw rabbit or chicken meat. - The dragon can be set to follow you or roam freely by right-clicking on it. - In combat, dragons defend their owners with blasts of fire, making them powerful allies! (poison, ice and lightning attacks planned in the future)

IMPORTANT FROM 5.0 AND ABOVE: ENTITY SPAWNING IS FIXED! spawning now works on a delay which you can config, ussually, entities spawn every 4000 ticks but if you don't like that, you can always customize it to your preference This mod has a config, You should use the configured mod to find it in the main menu. --------------------------- What are the entites? In The Corners adds 43 Entities that will roam your world, stalk, watch and kill you. --------------------------- What's the entity hierarchy? Tier one Tier one entities are known as the stalkers or manipulators. They are basic and easy to understand, hence tier one. Tier two Tier two entities are known as the creators, they have sophisticated AI and are almost unpredeictable. They take a player form and are easy to tell apart from normal entities. Tier three Tier three entities are known as the entities from the abyss. They serve progression post vainglory and are more complicated to escape and figure out. Like, buffed versions of normal entities. Tier four Tier four entities are the bosses of this mod. These include: Speech, Providence, Vainglory and Void. They are the most powerful beings and lore impacted story tellers of the mod. --------------------------- Tier one - entities Hide-- Spoiler Hide likes to play games with you. Hide will either try to convince you to come over to him or he will want to play a game of hide and seek. (you will have to find him.) Shadow-- Spoiler You should see shadow as a warning. he poses small threat. he will stand still or walk towards you. Stalk-- Spoiler Stalk is an entity simillar to hide's stalking phase. he will dissapear and reappear closer to you. Glitch-- Spoiler Glitch may not harm you if he is in his glitching phase, his glitching will be very annoying. Name.err-- Spoiler Name.err is completely harmless. It will only try to INFECT your world with err.name.blocks. Scatter-- Spoiler Scatter is very dangerous, he will shoot projectiles in all directions. these projectiles will jumpscare you on contact Anonymous-- Spoiler Anonymous will speak to you, then he will start chasing you with a piercing scream. Eyes-- Spoiler You'll know when eyes is hunting you. A loud sound followed up with a jumpscare will play at whenever time he spawns. Observe-- Spoiler Observe will either observe you from a distance, stalk you, or run at you. Integer-- Spoiler Integer will play a realistic door knocking noise, and then blare a loud bass sound. Once the bass is over, Integer will spawn near the nearest player and will chase them. On contact, the Integer will transport the player to a new creepy dimension. Excruciate-- Spoiler Excruciate is one of the most deadliest entities besides anonymous. Excruciate will black out the screen on spawn and will slowly approach the player. Watching-- Spoiler Watching is always watching Root-- Spoiler Root is basically name.err but can't move. Glare-- Spoiler Glare doesn't like to be looked at, do not stare directly. Whisper-- Spoiler Whisper always knows where you are, and is not frightened by your gaze. Disgrace-- Spoiler Disgrace will stop and stare from far away, just dont get too close to her or she will chase you down. Corrupted-- Spoiler find.me.in.the.corrupted.chunks. Lurker-- Spoiler Wandering

MCDoom.title: MCDoom
MCDoom.body: Slayer background without logo is credited to THIS MCDoom is a thrilling and action-packed mod that is specifically designed to add new elements to the Minecraft gameplay experience. The mod introduces the demonic monsters and diverse weapon selection from the popular Doom series, allowing players to enjoy a new level of excitement and challenge as they navigate through the game's unique world. The mod is packed with more than 50 different types of demons, each with its unique abilities, strengths, and weaknesses. From the menacing Imps to the powerful Archviles, players will face a diverse range of monsters as they journey through the mod. With such a broad range of foes, players are sure to encounter a challenging battle in every gameplay session. Whether it's the classic chainsaw or the explosive BFG-9000, there is a weapon to suit every playstyle. Players can mix and match different weapons to create the perfect loadout that will give them the upper hand in every combat encounter. Additionally, the mod offers a variety of custom armors, with over 20 different sets to choose from. The custom armors provide an added layer of strategy, giving players the opportunity to tailor their gameplay experience and dominate in any situation. The names and such are owned by id Software, of which I claim no ownership ever. This is just a fan mod of one of the most awesome game series to date! Overgrown's Cobblemon: Darkrai.title: Overgrown's Cobblemon: Darkrai
Overgrown's Cobblemon: Darkrai.body: Overgrown's Cobblemon: Darkrai is an open-source Cobblemon datapack/mod for Fabric, Forge, and NeoForge. --- The goal of the pack is simple. To add a beloved Pokémon for everyone to enjoy! The source code is open and I encourage not only community contributions, but also forking. Installation _Fabric:_ - Requires the recommended Fabric Loader version for your version of Minecraft. - Requires Fabric API. - Put Fabric API and Cobblemon-Fabric in the mods folder. _NeoForge:_ - Requires the recommended NeoForge version for your version of Minecraft. - Requires Kotlin for Forge. - Put Kotlin for Forge and Cobblemon-NeoForge in the mods folder.

Undead Unleashed - Continued.title: Undead Unleashed - Continued
Undead Unleashed - Continued.body: Undead Unleashed is a mod aiming to expand the variety of enemy encounters, giving Minecraft a dark/medieval fantasy style while keeping the familiar aesthetic. Just underwent a massive rework and got ported to 1.21.1! Note that some of older content may not be present anymore and it's intentional. Currently supported Minecraft versions: Neoforge 1.21.1, Forge 1.20.1 Also on CurseForge. If you are creating a modpack and want to modify spawn weights of each mob, use the Spawn Weight Config datapack! Content: Spoiler Creatures: - Dreadknight Durable warriors roaming the overworld. Facing one can end poorly if you are unprepared - they can both aggressively hack away at their foes as well as act defensively using their shield - Wraith Dark malevolent undead inhabiting underground caverns. They vanish after getting attacked and then ambush the target. When exposed to sunlight, they burn. - Flamebreather Large half-flying beasts native to the Nether, most notably the Wastes, Crimson Forests and Basalt Deltas. As their name suggests they can spew out flames and turn you to ash. They are very dangerous especially near overhangs so be careful not to let them push you off to lava! A natural enemy for Piglins. Other: Plate Armor - made out of Heavy Plating dropped by Dreadknights, each piece gives you additional chance to block arrows up to a 50% when wearing a full set. Great armor if you want to survive a rain of arrows or be slightly less annoyed by Skeletons or Pillagers! Knight Sword - a fancy sword used by Dreadknights, has a chance to be dropped from them. Makes mobs caught in the sweeping range take more damage than from a normal sword, a decent choice against crowds (only on 1.21.1+, sweeping damage ratio attribute is unavailable on 1.20.1). Can be repaired using Heavy Plating Demon Stew - A soup made of Nether Wart, Brown Mushrooms, Carrots and Demon Horns. Gives you Fire Breath for a few seconds, much like a Flamebreather! Paintings - currently one, depicting the Flamebreather. Important: Spoiler Q&A: Q:Port to x.xx.x version? A:When the time is right... Q:Different mod loaders? A:I don't plan going outside of Forge/Neoforge Q:Can I use it in a modpack? A:Absolutely, as long as it's hosted either on Modrinth or Curseforge. Q:Why did you remove some content? A:Because it lacked the quality I'm looking for. I am trying to provide quality above all else first, even tho it might be difficult sometimes. Old content will be selectively readded on top of new ideas. Q:Can I republish this mod? A:Not without my permission. If I allow the mod distribution to a separate website, the download option MUST be linked to here, the official mod page on Curseforge or Modrinth. Do not download it from other sources! Please report any bugs you find! Credits: - fredzik - the original author, basically everything in the mod Made using MCreator If you're enjoying my work and want to contribute, consider donating on Ko-fi - it means a lot!

Wandering Ribbit.title: Wandering Ribbit
Wandering Ribbit.body: Adds the wandering ribbit, a little merchant that you can trade items related to the Ribbits mod. -- VERSION 4.0 -- _Now spawns on a new small structure that are a small tent, instead of a natural spawn. If you find one but not the ribbit maybe just walked away, because the wandering ribbit can't despawn. The structure only spawn on biomes with the minecraft:is_forest tag -- VERSION 4.1 -- _Added natural spawning but is a low probability. _Added random trades that are items/blocks of the ribbits mod. If you right click on it while crouching and holding an amethyst all the trades will be restocked, and the random ones also will be rerolled. Trades: The "Ribbit Map" when you right click while holding it, you will get a map that points to the nearest ribbit village. The "Umbrella Leaf" that give you slow falling while holding. Configuration -- OLD VERSION 3.0 STUFF -- In the 3.0 update now you can configure the spawn ratio of wandering ribbit. The config file is in the config folder on .minecraft folder. Dependencies: Ribbits: https://modrinth.com/mod/ribbits GeckoLib: https://modrinth.com/mod/geckolib YUNG's API: https://modrinth.com/mod/yungs-api Credits: The original Ribbits mod creators: Josh/Joosh - Art yungnickyoung - Coding HellionGames - Coding scratchy\_sd - Sounds wesleybenjamin - Music joakota - Builds joshesque - Logo DEV COMMENT Hello, the new versions 4.0+ is a complete remake of the addon. Originally the mod was made on MCreator, now I remade all on Intellij. That changes just a few details like now the trade screen is an actual trade gui, not a simulation like before due to MCreator limitations. The only big change is that the wandering ribbit doesn't spawn naturally anymore, now it spawns on a small structure. I changed that because I think is better. I would like to also remake the ~~neoforge version~~ (The Neoforge version was remaked :) ) or make a fabric one, but I don't think so because of lack of time. So I want to say that this was a random idea that I have someday and I'm happy that some people actually liked it, thank y'all. This mod was originally made on mcreator.

Animal Garden - Bull Shark.title: Animal Garden - Bull Shark
Animal Garden - Bull Shark.body: This mod adds the aggressive underwater creature, the bull shark into the game. They can be found in warm oceans, lukewarm oceans and rivers and are rare, but if they are there, they will make you treasure your life more. These hunters will not leave their target until they get a good bite out of it to solve their big appetite while leaving pool of blood behind. It has a invisible hunger bar. So it gets hungry over time. (5 minute until fully hungry) Its hunger can be restored by handfeeding it, when it eats dropped meat or fish items in water or when it bites someone. (each will restore 30 second) Damaging it makes its hunger go to 0 and goes on a rampage! When it spawns its first hunger value will be a random number from 0 to 5 minute so its possible that you encounter a really hungry one. Has three behavior mode! This will decide what it does with its selected prey. Curious: (slow speed, when hunger is above 3 minute) sometimes it will bite someone near to it and that will restore 30 sec hunger and will not continue the attack Hungry: (normal speed, when hunger gets to 3 minute) looks for smallest target near to it and bites it until its hunger is restored Aggressive: (fast speed, when hunger gets to 1 minute) when very hungry or when its attacked it will look for prey and until its hunger is restored it will attack everything by biting and slamming its target. They stop attacking when its prey is on ground. It prefers items over living targets when searching for a prey, so you have a chance to escape it if it still isn't locked on you! Oh yeah and when it bites something it will restores its health a bit. In forge you can change this and other spawn settings by editing the json files in the data - biome tags and biome modifier folders or via resource pack and in fabric there is a config file for it. Mod currently supports Forge 26.x 1.21.11 1.21.10 1.21.9 1.21.8 1.21.7 1.21.6 1.21.4 1.21.1 1.20.1 Fabric 26.x 1.21.11 1.21.10 1.21.9 1.21.8 1.21.7 1.21.6 1.21.5 1.21.4 1.21.1 1.20.1 Neoforge 26.x 1.21.11 1.21.10 1.21.9 1.21.8 1.21.7 1.21.6 1.21.4 1.21.1 SEND ME A PRIVATE MESSAGE IF YOU ENCOUNTER ANY BUGS AT CURSEFORGE https://legacy.curseforge.com/members/aquarius_playz/projects Follow me on X (twitter) https://x.com/Aquarius_playz THIS MOD REQUIRES AQUARIUSLIBS TO BE INSTALLED

Feur Dungeon Spawner.title: Feur Dungeon Spawner
Feur Dungeon Spawner.body: Feur - Dungeon Spawner enhances Minecraft's underground world by adding more than 15 unique and immersive structures to explore. These new additions turn your cave adventures into thrilling expeditions full of surprises and challenges. You might stumble upon _ an abandoned prison _, _a deep_ , _derelict mine_ , or the _hidden lair of zombie miners_ . Explore a _glimmering amethyst cave_ , but beware of the _ghosts_ that guard it, or delve into a mysterious _redstone laboratory_ , protected by hostile robots.

Block Factory's Biomes.title: Block Factory's Biomes
Block Factory's Biomes.body: Block Factory's Biomes adds 5 brand-new vanilla+ biomes, packed with unique animals, plants, blocks and fully custom world generation. 📋 About Block Factory's Biomes expands your world with 5 brand-new biomes that feel right at home next to vanilla Minecraft. Each one has its own atmosphere, wildlife and vegetation, woven into the world through fully custom generation, so exploration always has something fresh waiting over the next hill. Built vanilla+: more variety and detail, none of the base-game feel lost. 🌳 What's Inside 5 brand-new biomes - each with its own mood, palette and landscape Unique wildlife - new animals that roam and bring every biome to life New flora - fresh trees, plants and flowers to discover, harvest and build with Custom blocks - biome-specific blocks for decorating and collecting Fully custom world generation - natural terrain that blends seamlessly into existing worlds 🧭 Built Vanilla+ Every biome is crafted to match Minecraft's art style, so the new lands feel like they were always meant to be there - no clashing textures, no clutter, just more world to explore. 🚀 Supported Versions 1.21.1 - \[NeoForge\] 1.20.1 - \[forge\]

Cosmic Horror.title: Cosmic Horror
Cosmic Horror.body: The moment you create a new world... everything changes. Cosmic Horror is a psychological horror mod inspired by the works of H.P. Lovecraft. Instead of filling your world with constant monsters, it slowly twists the Minecraft you already know into something that feels wrong. From the very first second you spawn, the world is no longer the same. What to expect - 10+ unique events that can happen naturally while you play. - Rare encounters that become more disturbing the longer you survive. - Creatures that silently observe you from places they shouldn't exist. - Reality glitches, time distortions, strange moon events, and impossible occurrences. - Darkness that becomes more than just the absence of light. - Hidden mechanics that react to your actions and surroundings. - Unpredictable jumpscares used sparingly to keep you constantly on edge. - Secrets, hidden lore, and mysteries waiting to be discovered. - No scripted story. - No fixed progression. - Every world creates its own horror experience. You never know when something will happen... only that it eventually will. As the days pass, the world becomes increasingly unnatural, and if you're curious enough to uncover every secret, you may discover the truth behind humanity's disappearance—and why it feels like something has been watching you since the moment you spawned. You're not alone. You never were.

Critters n' Crawlers.title: Critters n' Crawlers
Critters n' Crawlers.body: Welcome to Critters n' Crawlers! - Formally a small quick project made by me and my friend and originally made for our private Minecraft server, this mod helps fix an issue not only of vanilla Minecraft but even the Modded community; a lack of wild animals/monsters associated with temperate and cold climates. This mod adds various different Critters but there may be a few Crawlers lurking... so watch out. THIS MOD REQUIRES GECKOLIB TO FUNCTION! - DISCORD - MOBS Mob list - Elk - Coyote - Timber Wolf - White-tailed Deer - Cougar - Wolverine - Ringtail - Giant Boar - Goose - Black Bear - Beaver - Mouse - Snake - Rattlesnake - Pit Viper - Turkey - Caribou - Skunk - Marmot - Mule Deer - Wendigo - Skinwalker - Chupacabra - Squonk - Howler - Sasquatch - Wechuge And many more to come! Showcase videos IMPORTANT INFO - If you find any bugs report them in the CurseForge issue tracker or on our Discord. This is a fun passion project mod that doesn't have a whole team behind it. We expect there to instantly be bugs and we will try to fix them. There are a few known bugs and minor features missing currently, and you will have to forgive us for that. If there are any suggestions feel free to notify us! Other than that, happy crawling! CURSEFORGE ALTERNATE DOWNLOAD Special Thanks to The National Parks Service. - Reupload by co-author endcollector, original author is Fae_Stricken_Fool

Aquatic Creepers.title: Aquatic Creepers
Aquatic Creepers.body: This mod introduces a brand-new underwater threat: the Aquatic Creeper ! These creatures can now spawn in oceans and rivers , adding extra danger to your aquatic adventures. Ready to play with your friends on the best hosting? I recommend BisectHosting for playing with friends because of their high-quality, lag-free servers. You can install any CurseForge modpack or your custom mods without errors. Plus, their support is available 24/7 to help with any issues. Use my code to get a 25% discount on your purchase. ⚔️ Key Features: Aquatic Creepers have half the health of a normal creeper. They can detect players from up to 15 blocks away and will swim toward them. If they get close enough and stay near you for a few seconds… 💥 they explode! Their spawn rate is low by default , but a config file is included so players can adjust spawn frequency to their liking. ✨ New Exclusive Item: Blue Gunpowder : dropped by Aquatic Creepers. Brazilian Expansion.title: Brazilian Expansion
Brazilian Expansion.body: Brazilian Expansion is a mod focused on adding to the fauna and flora of Brazil, taking a bit of the essence of the 6 Brazilian biomes: __▸ Amazon.__ __▸ Atlantic Forest.__ __▸ Cerrado.__ __▸ Caatinga.__ __▸ Pampa.__ __▸ Pantanal.__ In addition, the mod will also focus on some of Brazil's cultures, myths and legends, adding mystical and mysterious creatures to the mod. Requires - Geckolib - Terrablender ⚠️You will have problems with Optifine (used Embeddium)⚠️ _you can travel through the Amazon Jungles, navigate the rivers of the Pantanal, run through the fields of the Cerrado, burn yourself in the landscapes of the Catinga, explore the humid jungles of the Atlantic Forest or just enjoy the beautiful views of the Pampas. Be prepared to encounter ferocious creatures such as jaguars and alligators, or rare creatures such as the stunning maned wolf, or just enjoy the evening alongside docile creatures such as the capybara - it's up to you to decide how you will appreciate some of the culture of the Brazilian territory._

The Doppelganger 2.title: The Doppelganger 2
The Doppelganger 2.body: This mod is based on the legend of the doppelganger, a creature that replaces people's place by stealing their appearance and imitating their behavior. ----------------------- Mobs: - Doppelganger - Disguised cow - Disguised pig - Disguised chicken - Disguised wolf - Disguised spider - Disguised bee ----------------------- Use of the mod in modpacks authorized.

Red Panda.title: Red Panda
Red Panda.body: Description Looking for a Mod that adds the adorable Red Panda? Well here it is.   They are animals that appear in the jungle. They love to eat bamboo so if they see it they will go straight to it to eat it. Aside from bamboo, they love to eat eggs and sweet berries. You can make friends with them by feeding them that food, but they will not follow you, instead they will cling to your shoulder. They do a couple of other things but I leave it to your discovery. 👀👀   Support Suggestion and Support here! > Here! Issue Tracker here!   News?! Right now, nothing. It is the biggest BOSS in this mod. It has the largest size, the most health and armor points, as well as nearly unlimited attack power. It can summon the spirit to assist itself and thereby attract the enemy's attack. It cannot be generated naturally. It will be waiting for you in the Void Land. It is the true ultimate BOSS of Minecraft. Godzilla (some who survived the Catacomb know its real name is Regnator) is the strongest "Titan" in the history of Minecraft. Its power is so unfathomable that other Titans are afraid of it. It is the most powerful creature in Minecraft, surpassing both the player and the game itself. Its strength is second only to the God Notch. It is also the God of balance and the true owner of the Blade of Creation. The Demon Slara is one of the two ultimate bosses in this mod (the other being the Dragon of Execution), and it only generates in the Void Land. Its appearance is like an ordinary spirit magnified dozens of times, with a height of 224 grids and a width of 64 grids. It has a "fluorite lamp" shining with neon light on its head and emits a white particle effect similar to the Blade of Creation all over its body. When the health is less than half, a special "Spirit Armor" will be worn. Its height increases to 448 bars, its width to 128 bars, and its volume becomes eight times the original. The attack and defense power are enhanced. The Spirit Armor is a bright blue body with black stripes. Godzilla is the great god of balance. It can turn everything to ashes. The Godzilla cannot be truly eliminated. Even the Titans, whose status is second only to it, cannot understand its power. Never has a Titan dared to threaten the Phantom Slava. It is worth noting that the Demoness may be destructive, but the natural forces it represents and controls in the all-powerful universe are not malicious, and thus it is not. Unlike other Titans, it doesn't like or enjoy what it does. It destroys everything because it discovers the imbalance in the universe and compensates by creating 50 50. The Demon Sla is extremely intelligent. It lives and fights for the infinite. It is like a god of infinite power. Background: Godzilla is the second entity created in the All-powerful universe. It was ordered to maintain the balance of the entire all-powerfu

Animal Garden - Manatee.title: Animal Garden - Manatee
Animal Garden - Manatee.body: This mod adds the gentle giant the manatee or known as sea cow into the game. You can find them roaming the rivers or are near the beach. They are slow swimmers, but when panicking they are stepping on the gas. You can tempt them with sea grass and kelp. If they are in the water for a long time (5-10 minutes) then they will get different type of algae on their back until you clean them. You can scrub that off from them with a sponge or brush. and while doing that they will drop an item too that got stuck on their back while wandering the shallow waters. Sponge will not get destroyed when using it on them. In forge you can change this and other spawn settings by editing the json files in the data - biome tags and biome modifier folders or via resource pack and in fabric there is a config file for it. There are json item tag files also available on the data - tags - item folder So you can change the cleaning items, common-, uncommon-, rare item drops, manatee food/tempt items. Mod currently supports Forge 26.x 1.21.11 1.21.10 1.21.9 1.21.8 1.21.7 1.21.6 1.21.4 1.21. 1.20.1 1.19.4 1.19.2 1.18.2 Fabric 26.x 1.21.11 1.21.10 1.21.9 1.21.8 1.21.7 1.21.6 1.21.5 1.21.4 1.21.1 1.20.1 Neoforge 26.x 1.21.11 1.21.10 1.21.9 1.21.8 1.21.7 1.21.6 1.21.4 1.21.1 Credits: FAU Harbor Branch Oceanographic Institute - Sound of the Manatee Tom Hiddleston, Earthsounds SEND ME A PRIVATE MESSAGE IF YOU NEED THE MOD IN A DIFFERENT VERSION OR IF YOU ENCOUNTER ANY BUGS AT CURSEFORGE https://legacy.curseforge.com/members/aquarius_playz/projects Follow me on X (twitter) https://x.com/Aquarius_playz THIS MOD REQUIRES AQUARIUSLIBS TO BE INSTALLED

Ribbits: Croaks.title: Ribbits: Croaks
Ribbits: Croaks.body: Ribbits: Croaks will add evil variants of the Ribbits, so you'll have to defend your Ribbit village from them! Make Ribbot Crates to summon a Ribbot, a new mob to help defend the Ribbits! This mod also adds a variety of new blocks. Polished and Brick Amethyst, Rotten Wood, and more! Craft Song of the Ribbits music disc, to listen to the Ribbit's jam whenever! Craft a Flask of Boggy Bane using Blumelight Dust , a Glass bottle , and an Amethyst Core . By drinking this and getting the Boggy Bane effect, going near a Ribbit Village will start a Croak Raid . Swamps can be quite tricky to navigate through, and it can be easy to lose one or two Croaks . Because of this, it's reccomended that you craft an Amethyst Bell to make nearby Croaks glow! Josh/Joosh, yungnickyoung, HellionGames, wesleybenjamin, Scratchy, joakota, & joshesque - The Original Ribbits Mod, Art, Models, & Music Jonahanoj - Code, Some Art usernameusermane - Art & Models Kyoukster's MCreator tutorials helped a ton. Mod made in MCreator Models made in Blockbench Animations possible with Geckolib through Nerdy's Geckolib Plugin

Who's There?: Ghost Players.title: Who's There?: Ghost Players
Who's There?: Ghost Players.body: _You are in a cave, a very deep cave. You have been mining for many hours in search of diamonds. It's getting late, you are tired. Suddenly you see a white square in the corner of your screen and it disappears as quickly as it appeared. You swear it looked like the name of another player, but you brush it off as a simple rendering bug..._ But what if it wasn't? ___________________________________________________________________________________ ''Who's There?'' adds in entities that will sometimes appear when exploring caves. They are invisible and have names that look like the names of players. They walk around you and make noises to make you uneasy while you are mining. On top of that, a variant of the Ghost Player simply named ''White Eyes'' can spawn, stalking the player through the caves. _In the distance you see what looks like another player. You rub your eyes, telling yourself that such a thing is impossible, you're in singleplayer! When you look back at your screen, the figure is still there, standing completely still. You heard of Herobrine before, but that thing isn't Herobrine, it's different somehow..._ ___________________________________________________________________________________ ___________________________________________________________________________________ Made with MCreator

Slenderman: The Revival.title: Slenderman: The Revival
Slenderman: The Revival.body: Slenderman: The Revival Adds the Slender Forest Biome & Slenderman! Description How to visit Slenderman: - Locate a "Slender Forest" biome - Locate structures in this biome - Destroy a Page. - There is a chance (depending on difficulty) that destroying a page will grant the "Slender Attraction" effect which will have around a 0.1% chance per in-game tick to spawn Slenderman near the player. Slenderman will: - Stalk player by following/teleporting near them (if in the "Slender Forest" biome) - Attack you if you look in his direction after some time stalking (if in the "Slender Forest" biome) - Climb up pillars (how high depends on difficulty) - If you leave the "Slender Forest" biome, he will despawn after 30 seconds YOU NEED TO BE PREPARED TO FIGHT HIM! With the statics it can be quite hard to see so gear up, the fight's tough! Other details: - Slenderman may spawn "Victim's Ghost" if killed, which can drop "Slender Souls" - You can craft the "Slender Sword" with "Victim's Souls", this will grant the "Slender Attraction" effect that will spawn Slenderman in the "Slender Forest" biome. Also does 18 attack damage. - You can craft the "Slender Mask" with "Victim's Souls", this will stop Slenderman getting angry at you (unless you attack him). Also prevents Slender Statics. I only release downloads of my mods via CurseForge, Modrinth and my website, please do not download from anywhere else as they may contain viruses!! Credits: - Mod based on the games: "Slenderman: The Eight Pages" & "Slender: The Arrival" by Blue Isle Studios & Parsec Productions. - Mod was inspired by the Slenderman mod by Colossali. - Mod was created using MCreator, a mod-making tool by Pylo. Mod Showcase: Video by Dynamic Pancake

Ecological Replenishment Station.title: Ecological Replenishment Station
Ecological Replenishment Station.body: Overview Welcome to the Ecological Replenishment Station, a mod that brings fantastical creatures based on scientific conjectures into your world! In this mod, we explore a biological "what if": What if the evolution of life took a different branch, one rooted in an ancestor with a hexapod structure? This mod adds a plethora of new biomes to your world, all evolving from this conjecture. These biomes are both bizarre and wondrous, yet they strangely adhere to the laws of natural selection. Many of them even exhibit astonishing convergent evolution traits with creatures from the main world. Core Concepts All new creatures in this mod are designed based on two core principles: Hexapod Anatomy: All creatures share a basic body blueprint consisting of six limbs. These six limbs have been specialized in different environments, evolving into various organs for walking, running, climbing, digging, grasping, and even flying. Convergent Evolution: Despite their vastly different body structures, under similar environmental pressures, these hexapod creatures have evolved forms functionally similar to real-world quadrupedal or bipedal creatures. You will encounter pack hunters that hunt like "sharks," ambush predators that thrive in both water and land like "crocodiles," and even gliding flyers like "pterosaurs"—all with six legs! This mod is still very early in development.Stay tuned! To learn more about the mod, you can check out the WIki or the Discord
