Kenny [HORROR].title: Kenny [HORROR]
Kenny [HORROR].body: A horror curse that follows your world! Kenny adds a complete horror campaign to Minecraft. It starts with distant sightings and strange events, then grows into a hunt across every dimension. Killing Kenny only buys time. Defeat the Ender Dragon to stop him for good. 👁️ Campaign - Watch: Kenny appears at a distance, interrupts sleep, whispers, and causes strange events. Each warning brings the hunt closer. - Hunt: Kenny chases players across land, water, the Nether, and The End. Defeating him only delays his return. - The End: Kenny reaches his strongest form and keeps returning while the Ender Dragon is alive. Progress continues through death, reconnecting, dimension travel, and server restarts. Changing the world's time cannot skip the campaign. ⚔️ Abilities and Encounters - Attacks with melee strikes, fireballs, TNT, chase jumps, player throws, and thrown mobs. - Can rarely launch a player roughly 200 blocks into the sky. - Swims and fights underwater without drowning. - Breaks obstacles when block breaking is enabled, while bedrock and protected blocks remain safe. - Reaches towers at any build height and finishes the jump with a 4x4 landing smash. - Breaks downward when his target hides directly below him. Between encounters, Kenny can create footsteps, heartbeats, whispers, static, screams, visual lightning, sleep traps, and other horror events. Major effects can be adjusted or disabled. 🎁 Supplies and Equipment Each player receives a personal supply, followed by a 25-second calm period before the danger continues. 📦 Daily Supplies - Every day: 1 Kenny Totem and 5 random useful potions. - Day 1: 10 Golden Apples, 40 Iron Ingots, 7 Diamonds, 3 Milk Buckets, and 3 Enchanted Books. - Day 2: 23 Golden Apples, 20 Iron Ingots, 5 Diamonds; 40 Ender Pearls and 40 Blaze Rods; a Regeneration Potion, an Enchanted Book, a written message, full Kenny armor, and a Kenny Sword. - Day 3: 50 Enchanted Golden Apples, 20 Diamonds, 2 Netherite Ingots, 20 Iron Ingots, 3 Milk Buckets, and Enchanted Books. - Day 4: 64 Enchanted Golden Apples, 30 Diamonds, 4 Netherite Ingots, 20 Iron Ingots, 6 Milk Buckets, Enchanted Books, and the full Kenny loadout. - Later days: 64 Enchanted Golden Apples with larger supplies of diamonds, netherite, iron, milk, books, and potions. The full Kenny loadout returns on Day 2, Day 4, Day 6, and every day from Day 8 onward. 🛡️ Kenny Equipment - Kenny Armor: a heavily enchanted Netherite set with nine times normal durability. Wearing the full set reduces Kenny's melee, fireball, and TNT damage by 30% . - Kenny Sword: 17 base damage with Sharpness VII, Unbreaking X, Mending, Knockback II, and Sweeping Edge III. - Kenny Totem: works from either hand, provides healing and movement effects, pushes nearby enemies away, and may cause Blindness. 🌐 Multiplayer Kenny supports singleplayer, LAN, dedicated servers, and modpacks. Only one Kenny hunts across the server, while every player receives their own warnings, effects, and supplies. Kenny becomes stronger when more players can be hunted. Creative players receive Watch events, supplies, and anomalies but are not Hunt targets. Spectators are excluded. 🐉 Ending the Curse In The End, Kenny becomes much stronger and keeps returning while the Ender Dragon lives. Defeating the dragon removes the curse permanently, begins the victory sequence, and rewards the players who survived. 📥 Installation Install Kenny on both the client and server. - Fabric: Fabric Loader, Fabric API, and GeckoLib - Forge: Forge Loader and GeckoLib - NeoForge: NeoForge Loader and GeckoLib English and Indonesian are included. Fabric players can optionally use Mod Menu for the in-game settings screen. Server operators can restart the campaign with /kenny reset . ⚠️ Content Warning Horror and photosensitivity warning: Contains loud sounds, stalking, Darkness, Blindness, static, visual lightning, fireworks, jumpscare-like sequences, TNT, and interrupted sleep. Major effects can be adjusted or disabled. 📜 Lice

Splendid Slimes.title: Splendid Slimes
Splendid Slimes.body: Splendid Slimes Splendid Slimes is a data-driven resource generation mod based off games such as Slime Rancher and Stardew Valley. The premise is simple: feed different types of Splendid Slimes foods they eat, and once they're fully grown they produce Plorts! These strange items can be ripped into resource, or turned into Slime Hearts in a Slime Incubator for more slimes. This mod requires a version of Placebo not on Modrinth! You can download it from Curseforge here. Features Largos & Tarrs Got two different types of slimes? Feed them a Plort of the other to create a Largo slime! These larger slimes produce both kinds depending on the type. Be careful not to mix in a third kind of Plort however, or your slime will corrupt into a deadly Tarr... 19 Unique Slime Breeds By default Splendid Slimes comes with 19 different breeds, each with unique diets and behaviors! Some will cause explosions, teleport entities, or cause nearby mobs to levitate. By default, all of the breeds can be crafted in a Plort Press by either using different resources or combining two different kinds of Slime Hearts. The Slime Vac Suck up and shoot out Splendid Slimes using the Slime Vac! Food items can also be shot out from the Slime Vac for remote feedings. Rocket Pods can be crafted for a splendid and explosive movement option. Data-driven Not satisfied with the current slime offerings? Want a Diamond Slime that turns day to night when it's hungry? Create your own with any behaviors or resources! Splendid Slimes allows for complete customization of every breed of Slimes. This is especially useful for Modpack developers, allowing you to integrate slimes into any modpack better. You can find a detailed tutorial here: https://github.com/Chakyl/splendid-slimes/wiki/Tutorial:-Creating-Custom-Slimes Dependencies Required Placebo Optional - Jade or equivalent for seeing Slime Diets in game - JEI Support Questions? Comments? Suggestions? Join our Discord! Credits - Chakyl - Developer - Nitbe - Artist Translations - en_us - Chakyl - zh_cn - Ansurfen - en_pt - Tilles Want to host a Server? Our partner Bloom Host offers powerful and convenient server hosting, with dedicated Ryzen 9 CPUs. Use code SOCIETY for 25% off your first invoice!

Horror Cryptid: Sasquatch (Bigfoot).title: Horror Cryptid: Sasquatch (Bigfoot)
Horror Cryptid: Sasquatch (Bigfoot).body: Version 1.2.2 out now! Small update that adds more sounds and makes Bigfoot deadlier. If you see red eyes, you might wanna get far from your base... Version 1.2 out now! A lot of things were added: hunting towers, ruined railways, Bigfoot activity, sounds, and much more! ------------------------ You shouldn't have gotten lost in this forest... --------------------- NOTE: It is strongly advised that you use shaders like Insanity or Spooklementary, that make the nights really dark. This really improves the experience since very important mechanics of the mod are built around the limited visibility at night. --------------------- This mod adds the well known cryptid Bigfoot, also known as Sasquatch, in a way that prioritizes horror, build-up, and paranoia. It only appears in the Old Growth Pine Taiga biome, a single biome world is recommended. The entity gets angrier overtime, or when you bother it. The more angry it is, the worse things get... You might even find the remains of dead hunters around the woods. Wonder who killed them... If you're lucky enough, maybe you will find an old camp with some helpful loot! Upon entering the Old Growth Pine Taiga, you'll be given a mysterious device: the Sasquatch Detector! Use it to make sure there are no cryptids nearby, stalking you... If you feel like there's something out there at night, don't be scared! Go out and search for the creature! Or maybe you shouldn't... But I don't wanna give more spoilers, go try it out by yourself! If you use this mod in a video, please tell me! It'll make me really happy! Here's my dumb spanish channel: https://www.youtube.com/@tortudragon/featured

Whaleborne.title: Whaleborne
Whaleborne.body: there's something stirring in the deep...something powerful... Whaleborne Description This mod adds a new mob, The Hullback , a creature that resides within the deep oceans of the Minecraft world. Taming Process these creatures are friendly, but tragically are prone to becoming covered in gunk. if you clean up a Hullback using an Axe and Shears, the creature will be in your debt... Pirate Ship Transformation …They then can be Saddled then armored with 64 Planks… or any other armor material added through compat! Additional Features You can also find Widgets, useful additions and peculiar trinkets like sails, cannons and more, that can be installed on a Hullback after uncovering them in buried treasure and sunken ships... The Hullback can only be controlled using the new Helm item.. Tips & facts: - You can stack barnacles to make different sounds, up to nine blocks tall - You can apply banners to sail and get them back with a water bucket :) - You can open the hullback's inventory using E when riding to check on it - You can open the cannon's inventory using E - You can fire the cannon using the spacebar, but you need gunpowder first... - If an anchor is installed, you can lower and raise it from the helm with your spacebar!

Create: Splendid Cogs.title: Create: Splendid Cogs
Create: Splendid Cogs.body: This Splendid Slimes addon adds a new slime inspired on Create that can help farming resources, the Mechanic Slime! Mechanic Slime: Diet: Loves to eat Andesite, but also likes all the other types of stone and raw ores Behavior: The Mechanic can hold items for you, that can be taken back by killing or spliting it Plorts: Their Plort can turn into andesite alloy, brass or rose quartz, making it a great way to farm those How to get: You can get Mechanic Slime Hearts by mixing Any Slime Heart with an andesite alloy with some heat below it Dependencies: To use this addon, you'll need to have Splendid Slimes and Create installed (obviously). Support: If you have any suggestions or need any support with the addon, you can leave a comment or contact me directly through my Discord! :D

Waddles.title: Waddles
Waddles.body: Waddles adds some cute Adélie penguins that waddle around. With realistic sounds, they provide a great atmosphere to icy biomes. Can spawn in the following biomes _(Configurable)_ Snowy Tundra Ice Spikes Snowy Modded Biomes _(Any snowy biome, that is not a forest, mountain or ocean)_ Plans Proper swimming animation Underwater swimming AI Modpack permissions Feel free to use Waddles in any kind of modpack, as long as you link back to this page and don’t make any money of the modpack. Credits: Thanks to Wiiv for making the Adélie Penguin model and textures!

Player2 AI NPC.title: Player2 AI NPC
Player2 AI NPC.body: Player2NPC - Your AI Companion in Minecraft! Ever wished you had a friend in Minecraft who could actually _help_ you? Not just a pet that follows you around, but a true companion who can chop wood, mine ores, and even defend you from monsters? Welcome to Player2NPC! This mod brings AI to life in your Minecraft world like never before. Powered by the groundbreaking Player2 AI and the PlayerEngine framework, these aren't your average villagers. These are fully embodied AI companions that listen to you, talk back, and interact with the world just like a real player. This mod is an entry for the Player2 AI Game Jam , created by Goodbird . Features 🗣️ Natural Language Commands: Simply talk to your companion in chat. No clunky commands! Say _"I need some wood for a chest"_ or _"can you deal with that zombie?"_ and watch them spring into action. 🤖 Embodied AI Agents: Your companions aren't just chatbots. They have bodies, inventories, and the ability to break and place blocks, use tools, and fight. They truly exist and act within your world. ⚡ Plug-and-Play: It just works! Once installed, you're ready to join the world and meet with your first AI friend. No complicated in-game setup required. 🎭 Select Your Companions: Browse a cast of unique AI characters in, each with their own personality, appearance, and voice, provided by the Player2 platform. Press the 'H' key (configurable) to open the Character Selection screen and summon/dismiss your favourite characters. 🤝 A True Companion: Need help crafting a shield? Ask them. Low on food? Send them hunting. Exploring a dark cave? They'll watch your back. Your companion is a dynamic part of your adventure. Quick Start & Installation Getting your AI companion into your world is easy! Just follow these two steps. Step 1: Install the Player2 App The AI that powers your companions runs through the Player2 desktop application. It acts as a secure gateway to the AI models and is required for the mod to work. 1. Download the Player2 App HERE 2. Install and launch the app. It will run in the background. 3. That's it! The app handles everything else automatically. _The Player2 app provides the AI "brain" for your NPC. The mod provides the "body" in-game._ Step 2: Install the Mod This works like any other Fabric mod. 1. Install Fabric and the Fabric API. 2. Install Cardinal Components and PlayerEngine. 3. Download the latest version of the Player2NPC mod from the Files tab. 4. Drop the JAR file into your mods folder. 5. Launch Minecraft! How to Play 1. Launch Minecraft with the mod installed and the Player2 app running. 2. Join a single-player world. 3. Select your favourite character in the Player2 app (Optional) 4. Your new AI companion will appear nearby! 5. Open the chat and start talking to them. Try saying hello, or ask them to do something for you! Support & Acknowledgements This mod was made possible by the incredible work of the following: Player2 API: For providing the powerful and accessible AI that gives our companions life. PlayerEngine Framework: The underlying technology that allows mobs to act like players. Automatone/Baritone: For the best-in-class navigation that lets our NPCs move so intelligently. Itsuka: For invaluable help with the Player2 API and testing. This mod was created by Goodbird. And is now maintained by Zardov(Discord:Miliardo) Disclaimer: This mod uses AI in the generation of UI Assets, and the in-game Logo.

Beneath.title: Beneath
Beneath.body: For years, the tranquility of the overworld was all you knew. It was difficult, yes, but the sun came out; the birds chirped in the morning; and there was not a bit of magic. One day, you decided that this was not enough. You dreamed of a cursed world, with strange creatures, danger beyond imagination, and unfathomable riches to exploit. That world is Beneath you. This mod is a full-featured nether expansion for TFC. You can find much of everything you expect from the TFC overworld: ore veins, collapsing blocks, trees, farming. The dangers are great, but the rewards are greater! Happy exploring!

Gravelmon.title: Gravelmon
Gravelmon.body: Gravelmon Gravelmon is an addon for Cobblemon that brings classic, iconic, and beloved fakemon from your favorite fan games and ROM hacks into Minecraft. Gravelmon adds Pokémon from fan games and ROM hacks to Cobblemon, so players can catch and train their favorites and discover new ones. Its goal is to preserve these fan projects and give them a wider audience. Check out our website → Features (so far!): - 270 fully modeled Fakemon . This number is growing by the day as well. - Ban list support. Using our companion library mod, Gravel's Extended Battles, you can ban list any label you don't want in your game. Don't want fakemon that aren't fully modeled yet? Leave the default not_modeled label in place and you'll never see one. Want everything, unfinished models included? Just remove it from the config. - Granular labels. Filter and configure content by origin game, region, or development status to shape exactly which fakemon appear. - Config first design. Every major feature is tunable from the config, so server owners and players can tailor Gravelmon to fit their world. - not modeled fakemon currently use temporary billboard sprites so they can be playtested early. These are filtered out by default through the ban list above, and get replaced with full models as they're finished. - Content pulled from over 30 fan games, ROM hacks, and independent fakemon collections, with more added as development continues. Installation - Requires Cobblemon. - Requires our companion library mod, Gravel's Extended Battles. - Put Gravelmon, Gravel's Extended Battles, and Cobblemon in your mods folder. That's it, you're ready to go. If you have trouble installing, get help in our Discord at the link below. Note: Gravelmon is still heavily in development and is far from complete. Many fakemon are still waiting to be modeled, and features keep getting added and refined as we go. Currently features fakemon from And dozens more. See the full list of source games on our website. Added fakemon are included with permission of their creators. Getting involved If you'd like to help with modeling, texturing, or contributing data, visit our website! You'll find submission instructions there, can follow development progress, and get a look at what's coming next. If you want to join the community.. Join the Discord → FAQ: Gravel's Extended Battles How does the ban list work? Gravel's Extended Battles (our companion library mod) lets you ban Pokemon by label. Every Gravelmon entry is tagged with labels for things like its game of origin, region, and development status, and you can block any of those labels in the config. To ban Pokemon from a specific game, add that game's label to the bannedLabels array in the Gravelmon config file, separated by commas: json { "bannedLabels": [ "not_modeled", "xenoverse" ] } If you want to ban a single specific Pokemon rather than a whole label group, you can simply put the pokemon name with its form in the bannedPokemon list. json bannedPokemon = ["bulbasaur delta"] How do I remove the new types added by Gravelmon? Remove the types from the implementedTypes array in the config file. For server owners Gravelmon may be used on servers, but it may never be placed behind a paywall or sold for real world money or currency purchased with real world money. If you find a server doing this, please report it to us and to Mojang. Gravelmon is not affiliated with Pokemon, Cobblemon, or Minecraft. Minecraft is a trademark of Mojang Synergies AB. Pokemon is a trademark of Nintendo, Creatures Inc. and GAME FREAK inc.

Wyrmroost.title: Wyrmroost
Wyrmroost.body: Re-imagining the world of Minecraft by filling it with diverse, tameable dragons that roam the new and beautiful worlds awaiting to be explored by those who dare to venture into such territories, where magic advances beyond enchanting. This, is Wyrmroost. Wyrmroost aims to add many unique and diverse dragon species, which can be tamed and utilized for players and their needs. Whether it be for combat, farming, transportation, you name it. There's probably a dragon for it. But beware, taming a dragon isn't an easy feat. You will find befriending such a creature will take hard work and dedication, depending on the dragon and the situation. Our mod currently only has a few dragons implemented, however in the future updates we will have eight different types of dragons. You can check the wiki to find more information about the species currently in-game. Dependencies Pre 1.21.1 and prior - None Issues / Bug Reports For the 1.21.1 Neoforge version please report issues to: https://github.com/NordAct/Wyrmroost/issues For the 1.20.1 forge version please report issues to: https://github.com/themodderg/wyrmroost-1.20.1-port/issues If you found something that doesn't look right, is probably a bug, or is just flat out broken please head over to our Github to report it! Your bugs are most likely to be seen there versus our Discord server. We are aware that in the older versions of the mod the dragons cannot breed. We will not be returning to the .16 version, however a kind person has made this patch: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/wyrmroost-patch FAQ - How do I tame this dragon? We have an official wiki that is updated by the developers only. - Can you update/backport to ____? Updating takes time. Wyrmroost will continue to try and stay on latest versions of minecraft, however please be patient. We are looking towards the future, so backporting the mod will never happen and your questions to backport will not be answered. - Where's the dimension and what are your plans for it? The dimension is not in the mod yet. It will be worked on in the background while we add a few dragons in small updates. We want to aim for a dragon's world with our own unique blocks, items, and most importantly, dragons. While we can not give an ETA you can follow our progress in the dedicated Discord server where we are most active. - Can I use Wyrmroost in my modpack? We have no issues with people using our mod in modpacks. - Can I ask a question? If You have any further questions you can stop by our Discord! We'll be happy to help. Credits Creators: - Shannieann - Model and Texture artist, Animator, Wiki manager - Kingdomall - Model & Texture artist - Ukan - Model, Texture, and Sound artist - Sniffity - Coder - Koala - Coder - Nord_Act - Coder of the 1.21.1 Neoforge port Contributors: - Lagoon - Dragon Fruit Drake concept, code contribution, and most importantly, the Geode hoes. - Novacraft - Original Rooststalker and texture as well as original Dragon Fruit Drake model. - Coda - Lesser Desertwyrm Item textures. Several contributions. - Aycfes - Brazilian translations. - Raptorlos - German translations. - Azuichh - French translations. - WolfShotz - (ex) Coder

Ore Creeper.title: Ore Creeper
Ore Creeper.body: • • • Description This mod adds creepers based on the Ores that the game includes. When exploring you will be able to find them and when they explode the surrounding blocks they will become ores according to the type of Creeper! Ore Tnt transforms normal Creepers into Ore Creepers! Creepers do not cause any damage, although if you want to kill them they will also drop some Loot. There is a config file in which you can modify the spawn rate, as well as the size of the explosion.     Resource Pack Compatibilities Squishy's Reanimated Mobs

Animal Garden - Sugar Glider.title: Animal Garden - Sugar Glider
Animal Garden - Sugar Glider.body: This mod adds the Sugar Glider as a mob into your world. You can tame, and breed them with any food item as they are omnivorous. When tamed if there is a mob around that is targeting their owner, then they will start to scream to tell their owner that there is danger nearby. It has 3 type of behavior that can be changed after taming. -wandering(will not follow the player), -standing (stands up and waits until attacked or gets another behavior command) -following owner Untamed ones will sometimes just stand up for a while at a random time and they will run away from others except from other Sugar Gliders. It can climb on any blocks and will float in the direction it is looking when it is in the air. They will protect themselves when attacked and they can move in groups when not in following mode. And sweet berries wont damage them. You can find them in forest biomes. (In forge you can change this and other spawn settings by editing the json files in the data - biome tags and biome modifier folders or via resource pack and in fabric there is a config file for it) Mod currently supports Forge 26.x 1.21.11 1.21.10 1.21.9 1.21.8 1.21.7 1.21.6 1.21.4 1.21.1 1.20.1 Fabric 26.x 1.21.11 1.21.10 1.21.9 1.21.8 1.21.7 1.21.6 1.21.5 1.21.4 1.21.1 1.20.1 Neoforge 26.x 1.21.11 1.21.10 1.21.9 1.21.8 1.21.7 1.21.6 1.21.4 1.21.1 SEND ME A PRIVATE MESSAGE IF YOU NEED THE MOD IN A DIFFERENT VERSION OR IF YOU ENCOUNTER ANY BUGS AT CURSEFORGE https://legacy.curseforge.com/members/aquarius_playz/projects Follow me on X (twitter) https://x.com/Aquarius_playz THIS MOD REQUIRES AQUARIUSLIBS TO BE INSTALLED

Stoneveil.title: Stoneveil
Stoneveil.body: - [ Stoneveil is a mod that adds a new mob and the gargoyle block ]- Grumblos are mysterious creatures that appear when lightning strikes a Grumblo Gargoyle. They like to scare mobs in packs, sit on them, and kill silverfish. You can use them to scare mobs away. Grumblos are afraid of pickaxes. You can convert it into a pocket Grumblo for easy transport. You can edit these options with catalog and configured. Grumblo: Gargoyles are decorative blocks with gravity; some designs are activated by redstone. Variants to complement the stone brick building set, such as tiles and pillars. Discord Server: https://discord.gg/n6e9QpS9m2

Animal Garden - Fennec Fox.title: Animal Garden - Fennec Fox
Animal Garden - Fennec Fox.body: This mod adds the Fennec Fox as a mob to your world. You can find them in the desert biome. (In forge you can change this and other spawn settings by editing the json files in the data - biome tags and biome modifier folders or via resource pack and in fabric there is a config file for it) Because they are omnivorous, you can tame them with any food item. If untamed then it will panic when it gets hit and will also avoid nearby entities except when its sleeping or when the entity is crouching. If there is an item near to it on the ground, it will bite it and take it along on its journey and if the equipped item is a food item it will eat it when it loses health. Their equipped items can be taken away by their owner when interacting with them with empty hands. When they don't have an item in their mouth they will hunt for rabbits or chicken. If its untamed then it will lay down to sleep sometimes. If its tamed then it will only lay down if you put it in wandering mode. As fennec foxes are nocturnal they will sleep more if its day time. And if they are in sleep mode then every ~10 second they restore 1 health. Babies will follow their parent and won't attack, but can still equip items. They have 3 type of behaviors -wandering (wanders around, if tamed then it will wander around the block you put it into wandering mode) -sleeping (stays in place) -following (follows owner) Before the mob spawns it checks the area around the position if there is already another mob of this type around. If yes then it will check how many. And in the config you can also change how big of an area it should check around the mob spawn point and a max number. If there are more mobs in that area then the max number then it won't spawn the new mob. This option is to prevent overspawning. Mod currently supports Forge 26.x 1.21.11 1.21.10 1.21.9 1.21.8 1.21.7 1.21.6 1.21.4 1.21.1 1.20.1 Fabric 26.x 1.21.11 1.21.10 1.21.9 1.21.8 1.21.7 1.21.6 1.21.5 1.21.4 1.21.1 1.20.1 Neoforge 26.x 1.21.11 1.21.10 1.21.9 1.21.8 1.21.7 1.21.6 1.21.4 1.21.1 SEND ME A PRIVATE MESSAGE IF YOU ENCOUNTER ANY BUGS AT CURSEFORGE https://legacy.curseforge.com/members/aquarius_playz/projects Follow me on X (twitter) https://x.com/Aquarius_playz THIS MOD REQUIRES AQUARIUSLIBS TO BE INSTALLED

EnchantWithMob.title: EnchantWithMob
EnchantWithMob.body: Enchant With Mob Forge version requires Bagus Lib for 9.4.0 and above! This mod adds the Enchanter from Minecraft Dungeons. Enchanted Mobs bring new difficulty to fights... Discuss my mods here on discord! https://discord.gg/eGeE49BEUH Features: Adds the Enchanter from Minecraft Dungeons. This mob can "Enchant" other hostile mobs to make them more powerful. When killed it may drop a mob enchanting book for the player to use! Enchanters will also join village raids. Hostile mobs may spawn pre-enchanted based on the difficulty. This can be changed using the config file. Ancient mobs from Minecraft Dungeons can also be found! Many configurable options for modpack developers. In version 1.21.1 and above, datapacks can change mob enchantments. Epic Fight's armor rendering is supported natively, as are the raids from Faction Craft. Customize with Datapack You can customizable EnchantWithMob visual with Datapack! https://github.com/baguchi/EnchantWithMob-Forge/wiki/Customizable-Glow-Eye-Texture-For-Enchanted Credit: Edmord - texture artist Evo - documented the CF page BaguChan - Active Coder TruffleHistorian - glowing enchanted eye texture making Infamous Misadventures Teams - they made EnchantWithMob home! and Bumble bee zone Original work based on MobEnchant's beam - https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/the-bumblezone-forge Warning: backport and fabric port not planned and do not ask port

FinzWild:Friends.title: FinzWild:Friends
FinzWild:Friends.body: Disclaimer I'm Japanese, so I'm sorry if my English is wrong. About This mod Add Little Serpents from Another World! Nillo is a character that will appear in our Adventure Map, "FinzKiil." Adventure Map "FinzKiil Zero : Pioneer" Mobs Nillo They are small snakes that can be tamed. They can be tamed with raw chicken and their basic behavior is similar to that of a tamed wolf. There are several types of them: Normal - Spawns in many biomes such as forests and deserts. Hunter - Spawns in forests and jungles. Has high Attack. Pond - Spawns in rivers and oceans. Lives in water. Glider - Spawns in mountains and grasslands. Can fly. Rocky - Spawns in deserts, wilderness, etc. Has high Armor. Gillo A large variant of Nillo. It cannot equip Nillo Armor, but has higher stats and can be ridden. Items Nillo Armor (1.20.6 or later) Nillo Armor has leather armor that increases defense, and armadillo armor that works similarly to the wolf. Can be equipped by any Nillo except Gillo. Amulets Amulets are items that give Nillo additional abilities. Amulets have four attributes: Fire - Found in Trail Ruins and Desert Pyramids. Gains Fire Resistance and adds fire to attacks Aqua - Found in Trail Ruins and Ocean Ruins. Gains Water Breathing and adds Slowness to attacks Wind - Found in Trail Ruins and Pillager Outposts. Gains Fall Resistance and increases knockback on attacks Earth - Found in Trail Ruins and Mineshafts. Gains Knockback Resistance and extra armor. All amulets can be crafted into a String.

Lost Souls.title: Lost Souls
Lost Souls.body: Lost Souls This mod is a simple but very configurable mod that is designed to work with The Lost Cities. It makes buildings a lot more challenging by spawning additional and stronger mobs in them. There is a big chance that a building is 'haunted'. If it is haunted then there very strong vanilla mobs will spawn (boosted for damage and health) until the player manages to kill a specific number of them at which point the building is considered 'cleared'. The mobs spawn when the player is in the building but regardless of lighting level so it doesn't help to light up the building (can be disabled with config). This mod is very configurable. You can control what kind of mobs can spawn this way, how many can spawn, the kind of armor and weapons they get. How strong they are and so on. Note that this mod is server-side only. Modpacks Feel free to use this mod in any modpack you want.

Animal Garden - Common Raven.title: Animal Garden - Common Raven
Animal Garden - Common Raven.body: This mod adds the Common Raven as a mob to your world. They will steal items from the ground and will drop them off after a while. If they "kraa" 4 times it means it found an item that it wants to pick up. If the raven is tamed then it will drop the item off to the player and you can make it sit down. If its not tamed or is in wandering mode then it will drop them off after a while near a hopper if possible. And any player can take away its item when clicked on it even if its untamed. They are weak, but they still fight back and protects their owner. They have 3 behavior mode, that can be changed by simply clicking on them after tamed and it will "kraa" at you when switching behavior modes, to let you know which command you gave it, only if you dont spam this! (1 kraa)Wander mode: when its just randomly wandering around and steal items from the ground and drops them off later. (on a hopper if there is one near to it) (2 kraa)Follow mode: when it will follow the owner and if there is an item near then it will go and pick it up and give it to the player. (3 kraa)Sitting mode: where it will just sit down and wait for you there until you switch its mode again. There is a 10% chance that a Raven spawns with albinism or with leucism, because of that it will have white or gray feathers and eyes with different colors such as pink, red, white, blue, gray, brown, yellow. Dark colored ravens can spawn with only white, blue, brown, gray or black colored eyes. You can find them in forest biomes and they can eat any food item and seeds. When tamed their default 6 hp will increase to 16 and their attack damage from 3 to 4. You can heal, breed and tame them with these items. (In forge and neoforge you can change the spawn settings by editing the json files in the data - biome tags and biome modifier folders or via resource pack and in fabric there is a config file for it) Mod currently supports Forge 26.x 1.21.11 1.21.10 1.21.9 1.21.8 1.21.7 1.21.6 1.21.4 1.21.1 1.20.1 Fabric 26.x 1.21.11 1.21.10 1.21.9 1.21.8 1.21.7 1.21.6 1.21.5 1.21.4 1.21.1 1.20.1 Neoforge 26.x 1.21.11 1.21.10 1.21.9 1.21.8 1.21.7 1.21.6 1.21.4 1.21.1 Credits: Cornell Lab of Ornithology SEND ME A PRIVATE MESSAGE IF YOU ENCOUNTER ANY BUGS AT CURSEFORGE https://legacy.curseforge.com/members/aquarius_playz/projects Follow me on X (twitter) https://x.com/Aquarius_playz THIS MOD REQUIRES AQUARIUSLIBS TO BE INSTALLED

Brutal Nightmare : Insane Difficult.title: Brutal Nightmare : Insane Difficult
Brutal Nightmare : Insane Difficult.body: THIS MOD/DATAPACK/PLUGIN REQUIRE FokusAPI AND REACTIFY to work correctly, please install it If you have any suggestions or reports, create an issue in Github or DM my discord : xd6t NOTES (For modded-version) Brutal Nightmare already have a features-settings , which configurable through /function cw:menu/main . But if you want to config it through Config Screen or for GLOBAL WORLD use Brutal Nightmare Config Integration Brutal Nightmare Minecraft, but with insane difficulty. Enhanced Zombie & Skeleton AI; Give new abilities to Enderman, Drowned,Witch,etc... Support + This mod/datapack require CoffeeG's FokusAPI to work! + Platform : Mod (Forge, Fabric, Quilt) ; Plugin ; Datapack + Version : 1.16 - up Tip : You can also use Datapack in Paper / Spigot servers Settings All features below can be customized, you can turn on/off these features by using in-game menu (run command into the chat /function cw:menu/main ) Features Full showcase: Youtube Show all features General + Bed cannot skip night anymore. + All hostile mobs can follow and detect players from far distance & move faster + Passive mobs like Cows, Chickens, Sheep or etc... will fight back when player killed one of them + More types of jockey & jockey will summon more often + If players is swimming - travelling in the ocean, Mobs riding a boat have a chance to summon : Boats Riders can use boat to chase players. Boats Rider can be Zombie,Skeletons,etc... + Spider, Phantom and Enderman can become transparent : Which made them more horifying and harder to fight Zombie & Husk + Zombie & Husk can place block - pillar up to follow its target + Zombie & Husk can break block if needed to follow its target + Zombie & Husk can throw tnt + Prevent zombie from burning in sunlight + Zombie & Husk has a new ability, which can make zombie use ender pearl, flint & steel, etc... + Zombie & Husk will summon more often Skeleton + Skeleton can fire an arrow from the sky into its target (Cooldown) + Skeleton can swap between bow/sword for far/near target + Prevent skeleton from burning in sunlight Creeper + Creeper can explode even if its target is behind the wall + Creeper can shoot snowball : Work perfectly with CoffeeG's Useful Snowball mod + Creeper can randomly spawn as Powered Creeper + Creeper can disguide as Passive mob like Cow, sheep, chicken,etc... Then 2x Parasited Silverfish will summon. Phantom + Fire Phantom has chances to summon while player is sleeping : Fire Phantom is immune to fire + Phantom can pull its target up a high distance and drop it down + Fire Phantom will summon normally : Fire Phantom is immune to fire Others + Slime can shoot slimeball + Ghast can shoot multiple fireball + Illusioner can randomly spawn + Wither Skeleton can slow its nearby target Mini bosses Witch + (Mini boss) Witch can become Master Witch when target is nearby (Small Chance) + Master Witch can cast various spells Vindicator + (Mini boss) Nightmare Vindicator : 'Crying angel' + Nightmare Vindicator cannot be killed and will do nothing when it's freezing. But if any players moving nearby, it will 'unfreeze'. You can stop its moving by looking at ITS EYES. Or place a torch under the statue to make it 'freezing' again. It'll disappear if it got "frozen" by torch 5 times. Try my others mod + Double Jump - Add Double Jump and Leap mec

Myths of The Sea.title: Myths of The Sea
Myths of The Sea.body: Myths of The Sea is a mod that adds mythical sea creatures to Minecraft, each with unique behavior and special item drops. Explore oceans and swamps to battle legendary beasts, tame aquatic creatures, and unlock powerful abilities through rare loot. Ready to play with your friends on the best hosting? I recommend BisectHosting for playing with friends because of their high-quality, lag-free servers. You can install any CurseForge modpack or your custom mods without errors. Plus, their support is available 24/7 to help with any issues. Use my code to get a 25% discount on your purchase. 🦑 Leviathan Spawns in: Cold oceans. Rarity: Very rare. Health: 150 hearts. Damage: One-hit kill on unarmored players. Behavior: Extremely fast, strikes once then circles the player before attacking again. 🦫 Bunyip Spawns in: Swamps. Rarity: Common (3–4 per swamp biome). Health: 30 hearts. Damage: 3–4 hearts per hit. Behavior: Aggressive on sight, can walk on both land and water, very fast attack rate. 🐋 Bake Kujira Spawns in: Ocean coasts. Rarity: Low (more common than Leviathan). Health: 50 hearts. Damage: 5–6 hearts per hit. Behavior: Has a long cooldown between attacks. 🐟 Abaia Spawns in: Warm oceans. Rarity: Frequent. Health: 15 hearts. Damage: 1–2 hearts per hit. Behavior: Passive unless provoked, low damage output. 🐙 Kraken Spawns in: Any deep ocean. Rarity: Very rare. Health: 200 hearts. Damage: Drains player life while grabbing. Behavior: Aggressive toward nearby players, grabs and holds until enough damage is dealt. 🐴 Hippocampus Spawns in: Warm oceans. Rarity: Uncommon. Health: 45 hearts. Behavior: Peaceful, flees when attacked. Can be tamed with raw fish and ridden to navigate oceans. 🧭 Key Items Heart of Leviathan: Consumable that grants +2 hearts (up to 10 extra max) until death. Bunyip’s Fang: Used to craft fast-attacking claws (2 hearts per hit, dual wieldable). Bake Kujira Bones: Used to craft bone armor with durability between iron and leather. Grants camouflage from undead mobs. Tail of Abaia: Equip to greatly boost swimming speed. Kraken’s Tentacle: Equip to extend interaction range by 3 blocks. Eye of Hippocampus: Used to brew night vision potions lasting 1 hour.

Bok's Banging Butterflies.title: Bok's Banging Butterflies
Bok's Banging Butterflies.body: Bok's Banging Butterflies - A Minecraft Mod with Realistic Butterflies and Moths This mod adds Butterflies with a full life cycle to the world of Minecraft. It features several Butterfly species as well as several Moth species. Most are based on real-life Butterflies but a few are pure fantasy creatures. Features Butterflies and Moths There are several species of Butterfly and Moths in the mod, each with their own design and behaviour. Some will be larger, some will move faster, some will live longer than others. Some are dimorphic, some love apples, some will live in wood or fruit. Butterflies can be caught or released using a Butterfly Net. Once caught, they can be bottled and placed in the world as decorative objects. They can also be pinned to paper if you want to keep a record of them. Eggs Butterflies will lay Eggs in leaves if they get close to them. The Eggs will eventually hatch into Caterpillars. If a player breaks the Eggs, they will drop. Players can then replant these Eggs on other leaves. Caterpillars After living on the leaves for a short time, a Caterpillar will eventually build a chrysalis. If the Caterpillars end up on any other block, they will instead starve to death. Players can pick up Caterpillars and move them to other leaf blocks if they wish. Chrysalises Built by Caterpillars, these will eventually hatch into new Butterflies within the world. These cannot be moved by players and will be destroyed if they attempt to do so. Flower Pollination Butterflies will occasionally fly toward and pollinate flowers. This will spawn flower buds that will eventually bloom into full flowers. Mud Puddling In order to gain nutrients, butterflies will swarm around mud puddles. This will extend their lifespan meaning they won't die as quickly. To create a mud puddle just place a Mud Block next to a Water Source (use Clay Blocks in versions of Minecraft without mud). Breeding Butterflies can be bred by players feeding them their favourite flower (or other plant). You will need to learn what their favourite food is by studying the Lepidopterist's Book. Silk Some Moth cocoons will drop Silk, which can be crafted into string or paper. Unfortunately, this kills the Moth. Scrolls, Microscopes, and Books Scrolls can be examined using the Butterfly Microscope, so you can learn more about the various species. You can also use the Microscope to place the Scrolls in a Lepidopterist's Book, allowing the player to collect all the information in one place. Jars Butterflies and Caterpillars can be placed into jars. These are decorative items that can be placed in the world. Butterflies and Caterpillars placed this way will not die, lay Eggs or create Chrysalises. If you want to get the Butterfly or Caterpillar back, they can be released by using the bottle while not highlighting a block. Butterfly Feeder These can be filled with food to allow automated breeding of Butterflies. They can only take one stack at a time though. Lepidopterist and Wandering Trader This new Villager will provide players with Butterfly-related trades. The Wandering Trader has also been updated to offer new trades as well. New Cosmetic Items Butterfly Banners and Butterfly Origami add some flavour for builders and collectors. Peacemaker Butterflies These creatures look like Butterflies, but are actually aliens intent on taking over your Minecraft world. Be wary if you encounter them. If you are wanting a more peaceful experience, such as in cottagecore mod packs, these mobs can be disabled in the configs (see below). Secrets There are a few secret features in the mod. Books with ancient poetry, strange Moths from hell, and Butterfly-related structures. Can you discover them all? Common Config Options You can customize Butterfly behaviors by editing the config file located in your installation folder under: /mods/Butterflies-common.toml Option Description Default --------------------------------------- -------------------------------------------------------------

MonsterPlus.title: MonsterPlus
MonsterPlus.body: Monster Plus Monster Plus Mod for Minecraft aims to improve the player explerience adding many new special enemies, characteristic to different environments of the game, along with special weapons and equipment crafted from their drops that will give players more reasons to engage in combat and exploration. Mobs Desert Sorceress and Desert Acolyte Desert Spellcasters with Fire Based Attacks. The Desert Acolyte has more basic attacks while the Desert Sorceress is a stronger and rarer variant. They drop Ancient Scrolls as well as Blaze Powder and Magic Scrolls you can use to cast their magic. Spectral Skull A floating skeleton skull that spawns underground. It drops spectral fragments, bone meal and rarely a skeleton skull. Glow Skeleton A skeleton variant that spawns deep underground and can be identified from far away due to it's innate glow, akin to that of a Glow Squid. It's slightly stronger than normal skeletons and affects it's targets with the glowing effect giving away their position to other mobs. It can spawn either with a bow or a stone sword and it can drop Bones, Arrows, Glow Ink and sometimes Glowstone Dust, Spectral Arrows or Spectral Fragments. Lava Squid A special type of Squid that can fly and spawns in fairly large groups in the Nether. It's normally passive but when attacked it will be aggroed and will shoot fireballs to the enemy, in the meantime alerting all other Lava Squids in the near vicinity who will start attacking as well. It drops Blaze Powder and Magma Cream. Mother Lava Squid A bigger and stronger Lava Squid that spawns rarely in the Nether. It's always aggressive and will alert all nearby Lava Squids to attack its targets. As long as it's alive it will constantly birth new Lava Squids to help. It drops the same as Lava Squids but with higher drop rates and it can attack either by shooting a single large fireball or a barrage of many fireballs Crystalian An underground zombie-like crystal creature that can attack the player by summoning crystal spikes below them. They will drop crystals that will allow the player to craft the Crystal Set of equipment. Hermit Abysswalker A special type of Illager, akin to an Evoker, that will rarely spawn deep underground. It will affect the player with the Darkness status effect and will attack them with fireballs and trough purple glowing Crystal Spikes that will travel towards the player and spawn below them. It will summon Opalescent Eyes and Spectral Minions as aid against its enemies. They will drop crystals that will allow the player to craft the Crystal Set of equipment and Dark Essences used in the crafting of strong equipment. Opalescent Eye A glowing flying blind eye that the Abyssologer will summon to fight against it's enemies. They are fairly weak but they can prove dangerous when fought in groups while attacked by the Abyssologer and it's other minions. Spectral Minion A translucent, glowing, weaker kin of the Skeleton that the Abyssologer will summon to fight against its enemies. They are fairly weak but they can prove dangerous when fought in groups while attacked by the Abyssologer and it's other minions. Swamp Monster A special variant of Zombie that will spawn in Swamp and Mangrove Swamp biomes and will afflict it's enemies with poison. It drops Rotten Flesh and sometimes Mud. Overgrown Skeleton A special variant of Skeleton that doesn't burn in the sunlight and spawns in Jungles and in Lush Cave biomes. It inflicts poison to its enemies and can spawn unarmed or armed with a wooden sword or a bow. Demon Eye Flying undead mob that will spawn at night on the surface and will burn in the sunlight. It will come in different colour and size variants that will determine some of its drops and attributes. It can drop spectral fragments Ender Watcher Very rare neutral variant of the Demon Eye that resembles an Eye of Ender and can teleport around. It will drop ender pearls and, rarely, ender eyes Corrupted Ancient Hero A very strong and rare monster tha

Animal Garden - White Rhinoceros.title: Animal Garden - White Rhinoceros
Animal Garden - White Rhinoceros.body: This mod adds the White Rhino to the game to bring more life to the savanna biomes. If they are damaged they will get aggressive instantly or when there is a baby rhino nearby. They will first charge at their target damaging and pushing entities up into the air. After it finished its charge attack it will run slower. They are hard to tame it, with a 10% chance every time you give it food. And if its tamed it will not follow you and you cant make it sit down, but if you are near to it, it will be aggressive towards the attacker of the owner except the children. Females are smaller then males and only male and female can breed. The food item has an item tag json file that can be found in the data- tags- item. Currently only the wheat is added to that list. When they eat grass from the ground they will restore their hp a bit. Females(75) are smaller and have less hp then males(100) and children have even more less hp(25). Their horns grow randomly and the longer it is the higher their damage is with a max of 12 damage. They can also drop leathers and bones. You can find them in the savanna biomes. (In forge and neoforge you can change the spawn settings by editing the json files in the data - biome tags and biome modifier folders or via resource pack and in fabric there is a config file for it) Mod currently supports Forge 26.x 1.21.11 1.21.10 1.21.9 1.21.8 1.21.7 1.21.6 1.21.4 1.21.1 1.20.1 Fabric 26.x 1.21.11 1.21.10 1.21.9 1.21.8 1.21.7 1.21.6 1.21.5 1.21.4 1.21.1 1.20.1 Neoforge 26.x 1.21.11 1.21.10 1.21.9 1.21.8 1.21.7 1.21.6 1.21.4 1.21.1 SEND ME A PRIVATE MESSAGE IF YOU ENCOUNTER ANY BUGS AT CURSEFORGE https://legacy.curseforge.com/members/aquarius_playz/projects Follow me on X (twitter) https://x.com/Aquarius_playz THIS MOD REQUIRES AQUARIUSLIBS TO BE INSTALLED

Zombie Nightmare Expansions - Undead Hor.title: Zombie Nightmare Expansions - Undead Horror Monsters
Zombie Nightmare Expansions - Undead Hor.body: Welcome to Zombie Nightmare Expansions, a new horror mod centred on adding new undead monsters with unique nightmarish mechanics. Discord server https://discord.gg/arphex These mobs appear rarely in any overworld biomes and their spawn rates can be configured individually (including disabling specific mobs if required). All modpack inclusions welcome. More mobs planned in future! Current mobs: DISEMBOWELER Large, monstrous zombie with entrails hanging out, seeking blood and vengeance. Lumbers around looking for players and cows to consume, with attacks packing a heavy punch. Drops "corrupted heart" items on death. TORMENTED STEVE A hideous monstrosity disguising itself as a regular player (eight player skin variants). When stationary, it resembles the normal skin, but as soon as it moves, the true nightmarish form comes out. Sometimes found hanging from ceilings ready to drop on your head. A very strong and vicious opponent, dropping enchanted golden apples on death. BLOOD EAGLE A huge demon/dragon-like zombie with appendages made entirely from stretched out flesh, and sporting a set of razor-sharp teeth. Capable of both flying and walking, sometimes attacking from the air with spit projectiles or from the ground with melee - Eats pigs. Very strong, plus tameable and rideable (tamed with 10 corrupted hearts, configurable to disable taming). BRUTALISER MINIBOSS. A huge, strong zombie that can smash the ground to create block shockwaves dealing devastating damage and knockback on impact. You can jump over shockwaves or evade them - whenever you move close to attack, be sure to evade quickly before it gets the chance to strike! Attacks sheep and drops a "Deathly Onyx" on death, used for crafting a special staff item that lets you repulse nearby undead mobs (right click hold) and even summon crawling minions (ground left click ability, charges up to 5 stored summons by killing undead while it is in your inventory). SKIN CRAWLER The weakest enemy in the mod, but more relentless than any other. Capable of camouflaging itself by changing colour to match the blocks around it, and breaking through stone, deepslate, tuff, granite, diorite, andesite, and netherrack to get to you (this can be disabled in config). Moreover, it can climb walls and crawl through tight spaces, making it hard to avoid fully. Also attacks chickens. SPINE WRENCHER A tall, thin entity with tendril-like arms and a related appearance to the blood eagle, perhaps coming from a similar origin. This entity has to be close to spot you, unless you look directly at it. If you do so, then it will notice and come running towards your location. Given how thin it is, it has become fragile, so if you block its attacks with a shield, it will take damage whenever it tries to attack, providing a strong way of countering it. It is more than two blocks tall, but can crouch down to get through smaller gaps. Drops “Distorted Vertebrae” on death, used for crafting a powerful whip item. Staff of the Undead crafting recipe includes both the Deathly Onyx and two Deathly Heart items, along with some vanilla components: Whiplasher - crafting recipe includes a netherite ingot surrounded by eight "distorted vertebrae" dropped by Spine Wrencher mobs.

Animal Garden - Western Gorilla.title: Animal Garden - Western Gorilla
Animal Garden - Western Gorilla.body: This mod adds the Western Gorilla as a mob to your world. You can find them in the jungle or bamboo jungle biome by default. (In forge you can change this and other spawn settings by editing the json files in the data - biome tags and biome modifier folders or via resource pack and in fabric there is a config file for it) You can tame them with any food item, but they wont follow you. So its more like a friendship. Like that they wont attack you and they will only protect you from your enemies when you are near to them. Because they are territorial animals, untamed male silverbacks will fight each other sometimes and they will also run up to other mobs or players if they see them as a threat and will target them. If you dont move for a while or use sneak while walking near to it, then it will leave you alone, except if you are already targeted. When there is an item near to it on the ground, it will pick it up and if the gorilla is not in combat and is damaged then it will eat it. If it does not find any item after 5-10 minute, then a random item will appear in its hand. The random item is choosen from the random_item.json and can be edited in the item tags.(if you dont want this then just remove the items in the list) Sometimes they will sit down to rest a bit and if they do so then every ~10 second they restore 1 health. They move in groups! Babies will follow a female, while females will follow a male silverback gorilla. Before the mob spawns it checks the area around the position if there is already another mob of this type around. If yes then it will check how many. And in the config you can also change how big of an area it should check around the mob spawn point and a max number. If there are more mobs in that area then the max number then it won't spawn the new mob. This option is to prevent overspawning. Dragon Mounts Datapack.title: Dragon Mounts Datapack
Dragon Mounts Datapack.body: Dragon Mounts Datapack The Dragon Mounts Datapack adds the ability to hatch the Ender Dragon egg into 5 unique pet dragons . Each dragon can be grown, cared for, and eventually ridden by the player. How to Get Started - Obtain a Dragon Egg - Defeat the Ender Dragon, or - Find it inside End City chests - Craft a Hatchable Dragon Egg using: - 🟣 Dragon Egg - 👁️ Eye of Ender - 💠 Echo Shard - Place the crafted egg down to begin the hatching process. Dragon Variants The dragon type depends on the biome where the egg is placed: - 🌳 Forest Dragon → Place egg in a Forest biome - 🌊 Water Dragon → Place egg in an Ocean or River biome - ❄️ Ice Dragon → Place egg in a Snowy or Ice biome - 🔥 Fire Dragon → Place egg in a Cave biome and surround it with lava Hatching Process - ⏳ After 3 in-game days , the egg hatches into a Baby Dragon (sleeping phase). - 🍣 Feed the baby dragon fish to speed up its growth. - ⏳ After 2 more in-game days , it matures into a Full Adult Dragon . Once fully grown, the dragon can be ridden by the player . Commands To Summon a Dragon use: /function animated_java:dragonmounts/summon {args:{variant:default}} To Get a Dragon Egg use: /function animated_java:dragonmounts/ai/egg_phase/give_dragon_egg {variant:default} Change default value to any of other avaliable variants for different dragon/egg variant Credits - Animated Java (tool used for implementing models and animations): Animated Java Website - textures and assets : - 🐉 Ender Dragon – Tomanex - 🔥 Fire Dragon – leoslake9 - ❄️ Ice Dragon – Kingdomall - 🌳 Forest Dragon – Unakitononeko - 🌊 Water Dragon – BarracudaATA4 Social Media Check out my YouTube / Discord ! - 📺 YouTube: Anas099 - 💬 Discord: Join Here Support me on Ko-fi : Sponser BisectHosting provides Minecraft server hosting that gives players an easy and affordable way to host their Minecraft server! 💰 Get 25% Off for your first month by using my code !

Prehistoric Fauna.title: Prehistoric Fauna
Prehistoric Fauna.body: Prehistoric Fauna is a Minecraft mod based on time travel and prehistory. Travel to worlds long forgotten, where things long dead still thrive. Bring them back to the overworld, or survive in the prehistoric landscape. The mod currently has 3 dimensions based on the different periods of the Mesozoic, each with a biome made to accurately represent a geological formation of the time. The mod has 21 different species of extinct animals, ranging from the ancient ancestors of dinosaurs and mammals, such as Chromogisaurus and Exaeretodon, to the giants of the Cretaceous, such as Triceratops and Tyrannosaurus. The mod also adds 7 unique trees, 12 unique plants, and much more! To travel through time, the player must first find and defeat the Henos, the boss of our mod. The Henos will drop a Time Gem, which when combined with one of the fossils will create a Totem of the corresponding period. The portal must be made in a similar fashion to an upright End Portal, although it can be larger. Join our Discord for more updates! https://discord.gg/jvymBjS4FS

Devourer of Gods.title: Devourer of Gods
Devourer of Gods.body: Devourer of Gods (in Minecraft) --- This mod brings the popular boss "Devourer of Gods" into Minecraft. A real fight, made with 3D in mind, reinmagined in Minecraft. It has all the features DoG has from Calamity (except drops as of right now). Expect a HARD fight (and an exciting one!). DoG is made to be as friendly to modpack makers/datapackers as possible and to its users. All drops are configurable (via other mods like crafttweaker or datapacks), all behavior variables are configurable, feel free to mess with them and tune them however you like! The default config is adapted for vanilla end-game gear. Cutscene An intrusive addition added by DoG is the Dragon Devour cutscene, although it is refined to be as compatible as possible. When then dragon get's "devourered", the dragon entity is technically still present, just not visible to all players. Server-side, it's still there, which allows for normal dragon drops to still happen (like the dragon egg), wether it's modded or not. The cutscene is tested with True Ending end dragon overhaul, and is guarenteed to work with it. For other dragon overhaul mods, there is a possibility that the cutscene do not fire, although there is extra configs that may allow it. If any dragon overhaul mod is confirmed NOT working, please report it in my discord, I will make it compatible. Shader Compatability Shader compatability is GUARENTEED , all shaders should be compatable with DoG, as it uses no GLSL-based visual elements. Common FAQ Q1: "Boss is too easy!" A1: There's a lot of things you can do to make him harder! Go tune the configs however you like! Q2: "Ender dragon cutscene didn't fire!" A2: If you're using an ender dragon rework mod, try adding the ender dragon to extraDragonEntityTypes in the configs. If that still doesn't work, go ahead and ping me in bug reports. Known incompatabilities & issues Entity Culling DoG's entities would visually disappear because of Entity Culling. Please go to Entity Culling's configs (in-game or the config file) and exclude DoG's entities from being culled! (There's also a section where it doesn't tick entities if they're not in range, please exclude DoG's entities from that too!) Beta builds! Beta builds are released privately in my discord server! Feel free to join Modifying drops & stuff (datapacks) Loot and the summon recipe (Cosmic Worm) are all data driven, meaning you can change it with datapacks! (I didn't include this in the config cuz I thought this would be a bit unessesary) As of currently, DoG drops nothing (will be changed). You can add whatever you want by overriding dog:entities/devourer_head in a datapack, at data/dog/loot_tables/entities/devourer_head.json . Regarding the Ender Dragon's drop, if you don't want it to drop Cosmic Larva, you can override dog:gameplay/dragon_devour , at data/dog/loot_tables/gameplay/dragon_devour.json . You can turn off Ender Dragon drops in the config. The Cosmic Worm recipe is located at data/dog/recipes/cosmic_worm.json , override it if you want to change it / integrate it with some other mod. This could also be done with some other mods like crafttweaker (mentioned above) This is an example to let DoG drop maw of infinity (doesn't exist yet lol) json { "type": "minecraft:entity", "pools": [ { "rolls": 1, "entries": [ { "type": "minecraft:item", "name": "dog:maw_of_infinity"} ] } ] } Located in data/dog/loot_tables/entities/devourer_head.json The devourer segments do not drop loot , they don't run the regular death function. As of v1.1.0, taunt lines are now data-driven aswell. Located data/dog/dog_taunts/ . There is tier1.json , tier2.json , tier3.json , and death.json . Entries can be trnslation key or raw line. The format matches tags: { "replace": false, "values": [ "dog.taunt.t1.worm", //Translation key, need .lang "Nice armour. It'll look better in pieces." //Raw line ] } "replace" replaces all taunts with your custom ones. If no taunts are present, DoG uses the default ones. Technical Info This m

The Mandela Catalogue: Alternates.title: The Mandela Catalogue: Alternates
The Mandela Catalogue: Alternates.body: Welcome to The Mandela Catalogue: Alternates mod for Minecraft Forge 1.20.1! This mod adds Alternates from the famous YouTube series by Alex Kister. Alternates for more creatures are planned. The Alternates are immune to nearly all types of Damage! The only way to kill them is to light them on fire. Sure would be a shame if one enters your wooden house A bit of info, this mod is still a massive Work In Progress. Bugs are to be expected. Please let me know your feedback! Animal Garden - Spotted Hyena.title: Animal Garden - Spotted Hyena
Animal Garden - Spotted Hyena.body: This mod adds the Apex Predator the Spotted Hyena into the game which are feliformia carnivoran mammals (cat-like carnivorans). These opportunistic carnivores will go on a hunt whenever a chance arises. With a low chance of 10% you can tame them to not attack you or your pets, but they wont follow you. They will heal themselves when eating food from the ground. (Small healing when biting too!) When they are far away from their target then they will run faster and if they are closer they will walk slower towards their target and leaping at them when they are near enough, delivering a strong bite at the end. They wont let their target escape until there is a large distance between them. Did i mention it that they are great swimmers? You can find them in the desert or savannah biomes. (They are a bit rare to not clear every mob from your world) In forge you can change this and other spawn settings by editing the json files in the data - biome tags and biome modifier folders or via resource pack and in fabric there is a config file for it.
