Mebahel's Creatures - Draugr Invasion.title: Mebahel's Creatures - Draugr Invasion
Mebahel's Creatures - Draugr Invasion.body: Mebahel's Creatures: Draugr Invasion A Skyrim-inspired Minecraft adventure mod featuring intelligent Draugr, massive Nordic dungeons filled with puzzles and hidden rooms, boss fights, magical traps, personal multiplayer loot, and a repeatable invasion that hunts the player. Minecraft: 1.20.1 and 1.21.1 Loaders: Fabric, Quilt, Forge, and NeoForge (with Syntra Connector & Forgified Fabric API) Ancient warriors do not rest easily. Deep beneath frozen mountains, ruined forts, and forgotten crypts, the Draugr are waking again. They block attacks, heal when wounded, use magic, fight in coordinated groups, and defend ancient ruins filled with traps, puzzles, hidden mechanisms, artifacts, and treasure. Draugr Invasion turns the Draugr into a complete adventure rather than a simple mob pack. Explore Nordic structures, recover the fragments of the Golden Claw, awaken the Draugr Overlord, charge an ancient Soul Gem, and eventually call an entire Draugr invasion directly to your position. If you enjoy the mod, use the Follow button on CurseForge to be notified when new creatures, structures, features, and major updates are released. --- What Makes Draugr Invasion Different? Advanced enemy AI: Draugr can block, heal, dodge, use magic, and react differently depending on the fight. Large handcrafted Nordic structures: Explore Crypts, Bastions, Forts, and Towers filled with hostile creatures, traps, puzzles, hidden mechanisms, secrets, and valuable loot. A real progression system: Golden Claw Fragments, ancient altars, boss encounters, Soul Gems, and Draugr Raids all connect into one adventure loop. A dedicated boss encounter: The Draugr Overlord uses animated rush attacks, multi-hit combos, special abilities, and changing combat patterns. A raid built around the player: The Draugr are not attacking a village. They are coming for you . Multiplayer-friendly exploration: Personal chest loot means every player can receive their own rewards. Built for modpacks: Health, damage, armor, spawns, raid waves, traps, loot behavior, and more can be configured in game. --- Your Adventure Draugr Invasion is designed around a clear progression loop: 1. Discover a Draugr structure and survive its guardians. 2. Search for Golden Claw Fragments hidden throughout Draugr Crypts and Bastions. 3. Reassemble the Golden Claw and use it on a Draugr Altar. 4. Awaken and defeat the Draugr Overlord to claim high-tier rewards. 5. Charge an Awakening Soul Gem by defeating Draugr. 6. Trigger a Draugr Raid and survive increasingly dangerous waves at a location of your choice. You can interact with individual parts of the mod at your own pace, but following the full progression turns Draugr Invasion into a complete RPG-style adventure. --- Explore Forgotten Nordic Ruins Four structures generate naturally across the world. Each has its own scale, purpose, enemies, rewards, and exploration challenges, including traps, hidden passages, and puzzles. Draugr Bastion A massive ruined fortification hidden among cold mountains. Its halls contain treasure rooms, secret passages, environmental puzzles, Golden Claw Fragments, dangerous guardians, and a grand chamber built around a Draugr Altar . Reassemble the Golden Claw, awaken the Draugr Overlord, defeat it, and claim the reward chest that rises from the ground. Draugr Crypt The largest and rarest Draugr dungeon. Crypts contain sprawling underground layouts with interconnected rooms, environmental puzzles, hidden mechanisms, secret chambers, magical traps, treasure halls, and multiple combat encounters. Search the entire dungeon for Golden Claw Fragments before descending into the central arena to face the Draugr Overlord. Draugr Fort An abandoned Overworld fort occupied by Infernal Draugr. Smaller than a Bastion or Crypt, but still heavily defended and worth clearing for the loot hidden inside. Draugr Tower A compact surface structure built in a Nordic medieval style. Each tower contains thematic loot and a hostile garrison that can

Distant Worlds.title: Distant Worlds
Distant Worlds.body: - Created using MCreator - Requires installation of GeckoLib, Curios and Patchouli - You can also download Distant Worlds: Emissive Pack - Check out the Mod Trailer and Wiki to learn more about Trailer: Reviews: • About Distant Worlds • Description: Distant Worlds mod is full of new game elements in the style of techno magic. Let's explore new dimension with different biomes, fight and tame mobs, use many building or functional blocks and discover new crafting method! (More dimensions will be added later) Biomes: Dimensions will be colorful and diverse with many new biomes! Each of them will have its own theme and interesting features. Here you will find many new blocks for your buildings. Mobs: Fight and tame! You can meet many new enemies and friends there. Loot will be really valuable, because you can create many useful things from it. Tamed animals will be able to protect you or help in a difficult battle. Researches: Mod will be easier to understand with the research system! Find abandoned libraries, look for ancient papers, and do your own researches to find out more about what you've come across. New entries will appear in your books. Check them out to learn more. Rituals: Build structure for rituals to create stronger tools and armor using new materials. Special blocks with their functionality and various ways of receiving and moving energy are available to you. Craft and use enhancement modules to make rituals more comfortable for you! • Getting Started • Each player receives a Distant Worlds Book upon entering the world for the first time. Garhenna Book will receive new entries as you explore and travel. Use these books to learn all the information you need to start your journey.

Hybrid Birds.title: Hybrid Birds
Hybrid Birds.body: Hybrid Birds Hybrid Birds is a mod focusing on adding a variety of new birds to the world of Minecraft, with six new birds currently in the mod (plus babies!) As the mod progresses, we plan to heavily expand Minecraft's skies with new features, ranging from birds and bats to blocks and items, completely overhauling the aerial experience in Minecraft Features Rooster : Applies a new buff, Roosters Calling, if a player wakes up from a bed within 32 blocks of them, giving slight regeneration and saturation lasting until noon Scare away ocelots Can be fed glowberries to turn them aggressive, making them fight any other aggressive roosters for 10 seconds.. do with that what you will Turkey : Can be fed wheat to fatten it up to two times, fatter turkeys can drop more meat when killed Scare away ocelots Guinea Fowl : Behave exactly like chickens, but produce up to 4 keets when bred, making them a more efficient source of food Duck/Goose : Drop raw duck and raw goose respectively, which can be combined with a raw turkey to create a Turducken Swan : Ambient mob for rivers, will follow you around if you're holding fish Puffin : Drops raw puffin, which can be cooked to provide a new food source in cold and frozen ocean biomes Seagull, Pelican, & Albatross : Ambient mobs for all ocean biomes, will follow you around if you're holding any fish item Dependencies Forge: Spoiler Kotlin For Forge Geckolib Fabric: Spoiler Fabric API Fabric Language Kotlin Geckolib

Shut Your Eyes.title: Shut Your Eyes
Shut Your Eyes.body: REQUIRES GECKOLIB This entity will stalk you throughout your Minecraft world. It will attack when you are most vulnerable. Shut Your Eyes to prevent him from killing you. Only Open Them When The Sound Cue Indicates That He Is Gone. Shut Your Eyes Key Is Set To "G" As The Default. Hold Your Breath Key Is Set To "ENTER" As The Default. This mod is early access, so there most likely will me several bugs. A huge thanks to Puffsgaming81 for helping out a lot with the new model! The configuration file has all things you need to modify events. This includes: Disabling killing all entities, Changing spawn rates, and Event timers. (In order to access the config, you need to go to saves, go to the world you want to change settings for, and go to serverconfig) Type in the command "repair_sye" to repair your world for Shut Your Eyes. This could help fix som issues. Encounters :

BOB's Originium dream.title: BOB's Originium dream
BOB's Originium dream.body: [This mod need [geckolib] to load] BREEDING Oriworm Oriworm, as the name suggests, is a cute species from the land You can use iron to feed and train them，let them become ultimate creature in minecraft Or you can eat them ，It's delicious！ but you might meet some unfriendly oriworm，such as pompeii，milan，roamhouse，armed yourself and fight with them to prove yourself！ Take away the friendly oriworm and use them to cook delicious food Originium A precious ore，if you dont control it ，it will be very dangerous Remember to control it regularly，if you dont do that，you will face powerful Originium creature BOSS Fighting with Boss to get powerful weapon and armor！ They can make your farm life become better！

The Farlanders.title: The Farlanders
The Farlanders.body: A mod that adds a new species of mob called Farlanders, ancestors of Endermen, originating from the now removed Far Lands. 🍡 Requires Structure Gel API Download it here. Structure Gel is an API mod designed to make creating structures easier on the developers, specifically ones using the jigsaw system. All code is open source and documented. ⛺ Summary Check the Farlanders Wiki for detailed information, however may be outdated. Thanks to Fabiulu for letting us port and continue it! A mod that adds a new species of mob called Farlanders, ancestors of Endermen, originating from the now removed Far Lands. After the Far Lands dissapeared, the Farlanders had to adapt to the rest of the overworld, building homes, evolving into new creatures, like Endermen, Enderminions, and even Titans. The mod contains multiple structures, advancements, a new ore, and over a dozen new creatures to discover and interact with. 🧪 Latest Updates    New Ore: Endumium A rare mineral, usually located deep underground, in swamps, mountains, and jungles. It can be collected using an iron pickaxe. This is the primary currency for the Farlanders. 💱 Trading You can trade with Farlanders, Elder Farlanders and Wanderers. Functionally, this is the same as normal Villagers, though they all have different offers. Meet the Farlanders    Farlander The Farlanders are a species that originate from the now removed Far Lands. After their sudden dissapearence, the Farlanders had to move and adapt to the mainland Overworld. This included building homes, and villages, and even discovering new materials. Farlanders can be traded with, their primary currency being Endumium Crystals. They live in houses and villages usually found in plains, but can be found in a handful of other biomes as well. They usually only leave their homes at night, leaving them vulnerable, but will call for help from nearby Ender Golems and Guardians to assist them. Their eyes can come in 6 different colors. They also enjoy eating apples.    Elder Farlander The eldest of the Farlanders. They can be found in the same houses and villages as their more youthful counterparts. Their trades tend to be for more rare items, or items that are harder to get in mass. They tend to be slower moving, and due to that will use their cane to defend themselves.    Looter Looters aren't as nice as the typical Farlander, and as such they aren't welcome in Farlander villages. As their name implies, their specialty is stealing things. When attacked with a weapon, they'll steal it and use it against the attacker. When defeated, they can drop their hood. By disguising yourself with a carved pumpkin or Nightfall armor, they won't attack unless provoked.    Rebel Sometime after the Farlanders discovered Endumiuim, some began to seek more power and fight against each-other, and so began the rebellion era. Similar to Looters, Rebels too aren't welcome in places where the average Farlanders live. Though, this doesn't stop them from barging into their houses. Rebels usually wield wooden swords, and wear helmets they've made. They poison anything they attack. When defeated, they can drop their helmet. By disguising yourself with a carved pumpkin or Nightfall armor, they won't attack unless provoked.    Wanderer Wanderers are Farlanders that have left home to journey the world. They wear the same clothing as Rebels, and get along with both the Farlanders and Rebels themselves. However, the Ender Golems and Ender Guardians that often patrol the villages do not welcome their presence. To get around this, Wanderers can be seen disguising themselves using Carved Pumpkins when approaching either. They can be traded with, they sell goods from all around the world. Sometimes they will request Emeralds to trade with the Villagers they find in their travels, Wandering Traders can be seen requesting Endumium due to this as well.    Enderminion The Enderminions are the farthes

Animal Garden -Alligator Gar.title: Animal Garden -Alligator Gar
Animal Garden -Alligator Gar.body: This mod adds another Apex Predator, the Alligator Gar into the rivers of your world! This beast is an opportunistic predator and scavenger that eats both live and dead prey. It will protect itself when attacked, but by default it attacks mobs around it sometimes, taking just a bite then moving on. After death it drops its scale that can be used as an ingredient for the arrow, using this instead of a flint. Also has a chance to drop bone meal and bone too. It also can restore its health by eating meat and fish items that are in the water. Based on my past mods i decided that this mod will not be persistent and will vanish when its out of sight. It wont disappear if you gave it a custom name with a name tag. It cant spawn near other alligator gars in a 24 block radius. And it has some configurable options like: -is persistent (false by default, if you set it to true, then it wont disappear, but then you should lower the spawn weight to 1 so it wont overspawn) -attack only once (true by default, after it attacks its prey it wont keep attacking it) -random attack chance (the higher the number it has the less often will it attack) You can find them in the river and beach biomes. In forge/neoforge you can only change this and other spawn settings by editing the json files in the data - biome tags and biome modifier folders or via resource pack (the values in the config files will only apply to the fabric version) In fabric you can edit the spawns settings in the config file. Mod currently supports Forge 26.x 1.21.11 1.21.10 1.21.9 1.21.8 1.21.7 1.21.6 1.21.4 1.21.1 1.20.1 Fabric 26.x 1.21.11 1.21.10 1.21.9 1.21.8 1.21.7 1.21.6 1.21.5 1.21.4 1.21.1 1.20.1 Neoforge 26.x 1.21.11 1.21.10 1.21.9 1.21.8 1.21.7 1.21.6 1.21.4 1.21.1 SEND ME A PRIVATE MESSAGE IF YOU ENCOUNTER ANY BUGS AT CURSEFORGE https://legacy.curseforge.com/members/aquarius_playz/projects Follow me on X (twitter) https://x.com/Aquarius_playz THIS MOD REQUIRES AQUARIUSLIBS TO BE INSTALLED

Italian Brain Rot.title: Italian Brain Rot
Italian Brain Rot.body: This ITALIAN BRAIN ROT mod, as the name suggests, brings creatures from the AI-created universe called ITALIAN BRAIN ROT to MINECRAFT while maintaining a visual aesthetic that remains friendly to the vanilla art style. By executing the command /start, you will summon "Herios, the Brain Rot Seller" a silent merchant who offers spawn eggs for all the custom creatures featured in the mod. These spawn eggs are not obtained freely; each one requires a specific combination of items, encouraging players to gather, explore, and trade strategically. Each creature is unlocked through its own unique trade. For example: - Tung Tung Tung Sahur: 16 oak wood blocks + 64 sticks - Tralalero Tralala: 16 kelp + 1 water bucket - Chimpanzini Bananini: 16 melon slices + 5 melon seeds - Frigo Camelo: 16 wheat + 5 leather - Bombardiro Crocodilo: 16 lily pads + 5 iron ingots - La Vaca Saturno Saturnita: 16 leather + 10 wheat - Burbaloni Luliloli: 16 sand + 5 leather - Brr Brr Patapin: 16 oak leaves + 6 oak logs - Herioscuino Tanquini: 16 iron ingots + 2 wheat seeds - Lirili Larila: 16 cactus + 10 sand - Tripi Tropi Tropa Tripa: 16 salmon + 1 water bucket - Ballerina Capuchina: 16 pink wool + 5 white wool - Boneca Ambalabu: 16 slime balls + 5 black wool Key Features: Over a dozen original entities such as Lirili Larila, Tripi Tropi Tropa Tripa, Ballerina Capuchina, Boneca Ambalabu, and more. Spawn eggs available exclusively through custom trade interactions with the Brain Rot Seller. Fully animated using GeckoLib, with smooth transitions and detailed movement. Designed with a vintage pixel art aesthetic, perfectly compatible with vanilla Minecraft visuals. This mod is ideal for players seeking to enrich their world with unusual, creative, and mysterious creatures—adding depth to exploration, resource collection, and world-building. BrainRot is more than just a content mod: it delivers a light narrative experience through its custom entities and trading system, all while respecting the original tone and atmosphere of Minecraft.

War Wither.title: War Wither
War Wither.body: __This mod adds a powerful new boss—the "War Wither"—which is stronger and more agile than the standard Wither.__ If configuring settings, the War Wither will replace the Wither spawned via Soul Sand. You can enable/disablethis feature in the configuration settings. When disabled as an independent boss, players can transform a vanilla Wither into the War Wither by using a Nether Star on it (or by adding the warwither:change\_wither\_to\_war\_wither tag). Configuration files allow you to adjust the War Wither's attributes and enable/disable damage limitation mechanics. This mod requires Jerotes Warehouse as a prerequisite.

Midnight Madness.title: Midnight Madness
Midnight Madness.body: Midnight Madness requires Geckolib Latest version of Midnight Madness is compatible with: - Nonexistent+ - Born in Chaos - Alex's Mobs - The Twilight Forest Mobs from these mods will drop souls, if the compatibility is enabled in config file ( Midnight Madness Compatibility ). Supported languages: - English - Russian Made with MCreator

Goblin's Tyranny.title: Goblin's Tyranny
Goblin's Tyranny.body: Goblin's Tyranny adds a species of RPG Fantasy Inspired Goblins Minecraft. Goblins are new mobs that are found across the overworld in Goblin Villages and some other isolated Structures. Most Goblins are hostile to players, unless they disguise themselves as Goblins (Read the "Gameplay" section), though some Goblins are willing to interact with even undisguised players such as the Bartender and the Goblin Trader for precious mushrooms. _You can put Goblin's Tyranny in your modpack._ Spoiler The wanderer goblin can be found everywhere in the overworld. He is not aggressive and you can give him gold coins (found in goblin structures) in exchange for valuable items including the decoy. The decoy can only be obtained when trading with the wanderer goblin. When you throw it, a decoy will appear and force everyone around to attack it. Spoiler The goblin village can be found in the plains, it is not common to find one but many surprises await you inside. The village is entirely randomly generated, whether it is the buildings, decorations or the central square, the villages will all be different from each other. You can find more common small structures almost everywhere, whether they are small camps, watchtowers or even a merchant caravan. Spoiler Mini Gobs are the most common and basic goblins. They are small enough to sneak around and can quickly become chaotic when in groups. You can sometimes get their loincloth if you're feeling like a collector. Drunk Mini Gobs will always be found in the tavern relaxing, they don't want to fight unless you start attacking them. The goblin liquor has made them more resistant and stronger, be careful not to attack them otherwise they will attack you all at the same time. The bard peacefully plays music upstairs in the tavern, boosting the surrounding goblins who listen to his music. He won't attack you but will push you away if you get too close. You may be able to get one of his music discs by killing him. The bartender will always be there to welcome you to her tavern. You can buy her all kinds of liquor, useful for a good evening or make explosives. Spoiler You will always find the merchant in his caravan, almost anywhere in the world. He will sell some goblin things like a bag of bombs, engineer scrap and some random hide. Maybe there is a way to get his beautiful hat? Spoiler The blacksmith is very useful for making an ingot that only goblins know how to make. This goblin ingot will allow you to repair goblin weapons and upgrade a precious armor. Spoiler If you don't want the custom GUI, you can enable the gamerule "vanillaGUI" (still wip) The warriors are fierce goblins who defend their village at all costs, blocking your attacks before launching their offensive. With luck you may be able to get their weapons by killing them. The hunters are very primitive and will chase you from the village from a distance by shooting with a bow. You can get some hide by killing them. Unlike hunters, the engineer want to advance the village's technology. He try some experiments with explosives, regularly injuring himself and his allies, which is why he created a healing drone. You can get bombs, some engineer scrap and a bomb bag by killing him. The engineeress doesn't really like going into battle and prefers to send her creations : small explosive goblin toys. You can get some engineer scrap and her hammer by killing her. The shaman masters a few spells that will make you flee as far as possible or, on the contrary, make him your priority target. He can heal his allies, set you on fire and create a poisonous cloud. You can get his skull by "killing" him. A Glitteron is delicious to a goblin, but a goblin is delicious to a Glitteron. This endless circle allows you to tame the Glitteron by feeding it goblin meat. This faithful pet will fetch items and arrows from afar to bring them back to you. What's better than a Glitteron, if not a chubby Glitteron? You can't tame it but it will be a useful mount, taki

Special Mobs.title: Special Mobs
Special Mobs.body: Special Mobs Dive into a world teeming with unique challenges and encounters with the Special Mobs Data Pack. This data pack enhances your Minecraft experience by introducing a variety of special mobs, each with their own abilities and found in different dimensions. Overworld - Slime Spider - Barbarian - Ninja - Miner - Robbery - Ice Shooter - Water Ghost The Nether - Soul Knight - Black Knight - Berserker - Bastion Guard - Crimson Aboriginal - Wither Ghost - S1enderman - Fire Spirit The End - Chorus Ghost Explore the gallery for more information on these unique creatures. : Summons the specified special mob. - /function spm:kit/spawn_egg/ : Provides a special mob spawn egg. - /function spm:kit/spawner/ : Grants a special mob spawner. - /function spm:kit/setspawner/ : Sets the block to a spawner for the chosen special mob. For minigame creators, you have control over natural spawning: - /function spm:config/spawn_naturally_disable : Disables natural spawning. - /function spm:config/spawn_naturally_enable : Reverts to natural spawning. Configuration Fine-tune your experience by modifying spawning rates, loot tables, and enchantment levels. Access the namespace 'spm_cf' to make adjustments to suit your gameplay preferences. Compatibility This data pack is designed for server-side use and brings a fresh layer of excitement to your Minecraft adventures. Enjoy the challenge and exploration that the special mobs bring to your world. Have fun, and happy gaming! --

Legendary Creatures.title: Legendary Creatures
Legendary Creatures.body: This mod was made initially for the Minecraft Legendary Edition modpack It adds new creatures to the world. Those creatures are supposed to be aggressive and make the game more challenging. Current creatures added Shroomling Peaceful mob that lives in dark forests. Scarecrow Agressive mob that can appear when breaking crops. Hound Agressive forest creature that will charge at you and immobilize you with its bite. Desert Mojo Agressive creature that spawns in desert plants. Forest Mojo Agressive creature that can appear when breaking flowers. Wisp Rare passive flying creature that flies in the sky and drops a sack full of XP on death. Variants exist in the Nether and the End and give much more XP (Overworld = 30 XP // Nether = 80 XP // End = 240 XP) Scorpion Agressive desert creature that deals poison damages and can have baby scorpions on its back. Its variant deals x2 damage // has x2 health // gives x2 XP & loot Corpse Eater Agressive mob that has a small chance of spawning after killing a mob Peacock Spider Small creature that spawn on the beach and in jungles. Its bite will give you convulsions. Variants has a small chance to appear, and will have double HP/Damage/XP/Loot for the green one, and X4 for the black one. Good luck. Bullfrog Large creature that lives in swamps. Its tongue will bring your near its deadly bite. Rare variants have a chance to spawn (20% for tier 2, 4% for tier 3). They have x2 & x4 damage/HP/XP/Loot New ambient critters have been added to your world. Their presence is meant to add variety to the fauna. Frequently Asked Questions :__   Will the mod be ported to further versions ? Not for now. The mod will stick to the version of the modpack it was made for. Will the mod be ported to Fabric ? Not for now, no. Are you going to add new monsters ? Yes. Are you going to improve loot with unique items ? Yes. Can I disable some mobs ? Mod is very configurable. Have fun. Can I add the mod in my modpack ? Yes.

Jurassic Saga.title: Jurassic Saga
Jurassic Saga.body: 🧬 What is Jurassic Saga? Jurassic Saga is an upcoming Minecraft mod that focuses on immersive gameplay centered around Jurassic Park dinosaurs from the novels, movies, comics, and toylines. The main goal is letting you build and manage your own Jurassic Park, from creating dinosaurs to keeping them contained (or failing to). 🦖 What does it add? The mod adds a full progression system and gameplay features focused on dinosaur creation and park management, including: - 🦴 Finding fossils and amber to extract and sequence DNA - 🧫 Completing DNA sequences to bring plants and animals back to life - 🌿 Creating dynamic, artificial ecosystems for your creatures - 🧠 Advanced creature behavior that reacts to stress and environment - 🧬 Genetic modification to customize dinosaurs - 🧪 Hybrid creation, including creatures like Indominus rex and Indoraptor If your dinosaurs become stressed or unhappy, they can panic, break out, and cause destruction around your park, so containment and care actually matter. ⭐ Why download it? If you want a more in-depth, management-focused dinosaur mod instead of just spawning mobs, Jurassic Saga is built around long-term progression, realistic behavior, and park building. It’s meant for players who want both creative freedom and survival-style challenges when dealing with dangerous animals. ⚠️ Important info before downloading - This mod focuses heavily on progression, so you won’t get instant access to dinosaurs without working through the DNA system. - Creature behavior and escape events are intentional and part of the gameplay. - Balance is centered around park management and containment, not vanilla mob combat. - Some animals might be classified under experimental features. - Some animals might still be missing. 📦 Dependencies Azure Lib :---: :---: Travelers Lib

Slenderman.title: Slenderman
Slenderman.body: The Slender Man A mod that adds Slenderman and the Slender Forest where you can find him and his Notes/Pages. When you right-click the notes you will get Items as a reward but at what cost?   World Compatibility between versions 1.3 and 1.4 is not Supported! I just wanna make this very clear, you cannot load a world that used version 1.3 while running 1.4 in your Mods folder. If you do try and upgrade to version 1.4, Minecraft will attempt to load the world but it will fail and say ' This world contains invalid or corrupted save data'  But don't worry! It's not corrupted forever and your world can still be Joined if you just downgrade your version back to 1.3 and then join the world    Important Information about The Mod (Outdated, only for Versions 1.3 and below) The mod is not designed to follow the original games and the lore This means that there are an "infinite" amount of Notes/Pages in the Slender Forest that will drop loot when right-clicked or mined to Reward the player for adventuring into the Slender Forest. Another difference is that Slenderman can now be stopped/delayed when he hunts the player, all you have to do is hit him or deal damage to him in any way, and when you do that he will disappear and stop hunting you A Note   Slenderman     Questions & Answers about the Mod. Q: Can I use your mod for a modpack? A: Yes, you may add this mod to any Modpack. Both for Personal and Commercial use. Q: Can I run away from Slenderman? A: Yes, but I would highly suggest just hitting him to make him disappear for 15 seconds, it's way more effective. Q: Have you played the Original Slenderman Mods? A: Nope, but I might play them, considering how much inspiration and good ideas there are in the original mods Q: I can't find the Slender Forest A: Slender Forest spawns in 'Plains' biomes as a structure. They spawn in a 64-96 chunk grid so you might have to adventure far out from your spawnpoint. This was done to avoid constantly finding and making them rare, like an Illager Mansion for example. I w ould suggest using mods like 'Structure Compass' to easily find one or do the "/locate" command Q: My question isn't answered here A: Post your question in the 'Comments' Tab and I'll reply to it answering your question     Videos (Version 1.3) Played by Calvin on YouTube in his "From The Fog" Series ?wmode=transparent" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen>

Foolish.title: Foolish
Foolish.body: This mod requires GeckoLib! Join the Discord server! -𝕆𝕧𝕖𝕣𝕧𝕚𝕖𝕨- Foolish is a large variety mod themed around exploration and side-quests! It adds 100+ unique fully-animated mobs, biomes, gimmicky weapons, and a new dimension, the Stellar Hollow. While the Stellar Hollow is a large facet of the mod, there is quite a bit of content which doesn't pertain to it, including Overworld and Nether biomes, new mobs in all 3 Vanilla dimensions, and structures, mainly new dungeon-style structures to the Nether and End. There are also quite a few new mobs and items outside of the Stellar Hollow. -𝕋𝕙𝕖 𝕊𝕥𝕖𝕝𝕝𝕒𝕣 ℍ𝕠𝕝𝕝𝕠𝕨- This new mysterious dimension serves as a unique parallel to the Overworld. Unlike other dimensions, none of its biomes follow a particular common theme, rather some biomes seem like exaggerated versions of Overworld biomes. It is said that the Stellar Hollow was formed from the ruins of a bygone galaxy. To start your journey into the Stellar Hollow, locate an Explorer’s Cabin, which can be found in certain forest biomes, but is more common in the Aspen Forest. Aside from various peculiar items hailing from the Stellar Hollow, you will find the Stellar Lighter. Find a Stellar Portal in the Darkleaf Woods, Dark Forest, Aspen Forest, or Jungle biomes and open it with the Stellar Lighter as you would with a Nether Portal. The Stellar Hollow contains eight different types of gemstones hidden across its biomes, relics remaining from the galaxy it rose from. Each of these gemstones is guarded by a fearsome boss, but acquiring one allows you to craft powerful weapons with unique abilities. -𝕊𝕥𝕖𝕝𝕝𝕒𝕣 ℍ𝕠𝕝𝕝𝕠𝕨 𝔾𝕦𝕚𝕕𝕖- A short description and tips for each biome. 𝕊𝕒𝕔𝕚𝕝𝕚𝕥𝕖 𝔹𝕝𝕠𝕠𝕞/ℂ𝕒𝕟𝕪𝕠𝕟 Spoiler Perhaps the most curious biome of them all, the entire Sacilite biomes are made of Sacilite, a living stone. Sacilite takes multiple forms, from "trees", to even mobs, some of which resemble animals, and Sacilians can even be eaten! Most of the Sacilite mobs in the Sacilite Bloom biome spawn in groups around large Sacilic crystals. The Sacilite Canyon, a rarer biome, is formed when a Sacilite Bloom dies out. Tremors, quadrupedal, bat-like creatures, seem to like it there, and can be tamed with a copious amount of Tremor Treats. When tamed, they make powerful battle mounts as they can unleash heavy attacks from a distance, and they can glide from high places. 𝕊𝕔𝕒𝕣𝕝𝕖𝕥 𝔽𝕚𝕖𝕝𝕕𝕤 Spoiler As the name suggests, almost everything in this biome is a shade of red! If you find this biome, be sure to tame a Sanguine- an ostrich-like mob with a heart-shaped head- simply by riding it for a while, just like a horse. Sanguines don't require saddles to ride, jump high, don't take fall damage, and make for a trusty steed while exploring the Stellar Hollow. Or, if you're hungry, they can be killed for meat. This, however, will cause the whole pack to go into a defensive mode! The biome's other primary residents are the Scarlants. The small lower rankings are neutral at first, but if you attack one they will swarm! The higher rankings, only when protecting a top ranking, will be hostile. They can be carefully fought off without angering lower rankings. Offender, a pheromonic potion effect, will make the nearest Scarlants aggressive, so tread carefully! Occasionally, you'll also run into the Redwood, a large, owl-like predator which hunts by picking up its prey and dropping it on thr ground, and players are on the menu. However, you can pacify one for around 8 minutes by feeding it its favorite treat, a Terasch Worm from the Wasteland biome. The Redwood will become a sort of pet which you can ride! Remember to keep feeding it, though... 𝕊𝕥𝕠𝕣𝕞 𝕁𝕦𝕟𝕘𝕝𝕖 Spoiler A direct parallel to the Overworld's jungle, the Storm Jungle has a statically-charged air. Even the Acacite boulders found around the biome produce a small amount of Redstone energy! Under the towering trees, you will find a wide array of mobs, and some of them can be tamed. The Buzzket, a small, cricket-like mob, may hav

The Hollow Stalker (horror)(not a dwelle.title: The Hollow Stalker (horror)(not a dweller)
The Hollow Stalker (horror)(not a dwelle.body: ENGLISH: The Hollow Stalker The Hollow Stalker is a malevolent entity who's been causing a bit of disturbance in the overworld, this mod includes: actual stalking, climbing, and crawling The Hollow Stalker starts off by slowly creeping closer to the victim, the survivors often heard loud footsteps as it creeped closer. When it gets close enough, you will hear a faint "crack" then it gives chase. Once it gives chase, run as fast as you can and never stop or slow down. It is extremely fast, closing the gap between you and the entity in mere seconds. REQUIRES GECKOLIB! Authors: Notguii, UpsideDownTree Modeling and Sounds : NotGuii AI: NotGuii, UpsideDownTree PORTUGUES: The Hollow Stalker O Hollow Stalker é uma entidade malévola que tem causado alguns distúrbios no mundo superior. Este mod inclui: perseguição, escalada e rastejamento reais O Hollow Stalker começa rastejando lentamente para mais perto da vítima, os sobreviventes frequentemente ouviam passos altos enquanto ele se aproximava. Quando ele chegar perto o suficiente, você ouvirá um leve "estalo" e então ele o perseguirá. Assim que ele o perseguir, corra o mais rápido que puder e nunca pare ou diminua a velocidade. É extremamente rápido, diminuindo a distância entre você e a entidade em poucos segundos. REQUER GECKOLIB! Autores: NotGuii, UpsideDownTree Modelagem e Sons: NotGuii IA: NotGuii, UpsideDownTree

Terra Entity.title: Terra Entity
Terra Entity.body: Terra Entity -- submodule of Confluence: OtherWorld Catalog - Creatures - Monsters - Animals - Bosses - NPCs - Summonings - Items - Weapons - Yoyos - Boomerangs - Summoning staffs - Whips - Enchant Books - Whip Sweep - Multi Boomerang - Tools - House Detector - Pets - Rideable - Spawn Eggs - Gameplay - NPC System - Summoning System - Configuration Files ___ 🧬 Creatures Monsters 😈 - Slime 14 variants - Demon Eye 14 variants - Bat 5 kinds - Goblin 7 kinds - Skeleton 7 kinds - Worm 3 kinds - Hornet - Fly Fish、Crimson Kemera... 5 kinds - Giant Shelly 2 variants - Variant Zombies 4 kinds - Decayeder - Antlion Swarmer 2 kinds - Nymph - Harpy - Demon 2 kinds - Ghost - Snow Flinx - Fire Imp - Bloody Spore - Blood Crawler - Cursed Skeleton - Man Easter、Snatcher - piranha Animals 🐰 - Dusk - Squirrel 2 variants - Jewel Squirrel 8 variants - Bunny - Jewel Bunny 8 variants - Bird 3 kinds Bosses 🤡 - King Slime - Eye of Cthulhu - Eater of Worlds - Queen Bee - Skeletron - Wall of Flesh NPCs 😆 - Guide、Merchant、Nurse、Goblin Thinkerer、Demolitionist、Arms Dealer、Fish Man... 17 kinds Summonings 🐣 - Finch Staff - Iron Golem Staff - Slime_ Staff - Hornet Staff - Sculk Wisp Staff - Imp Staff - Snow Flinx Staff - Summon Sword 6 kinds - Terraprism --- ⚔️ Weapons Yoyos 🪀 Long press the mouse to shoot, and scroll the mouse wheel to change the range. You can lock onto the target pointed by the nearest pointer. Boomerangs 🪃 Right-click to fire, and it will fly for a period of time before returning to the player's hand. Summoning staffs 🪄 Right-click to fire, and it will fly for a while before returning to the player's hand. Whips 🪢 Right-click to whip all targets within range, causing the summonings to deal additional damage to the targets. --- 📕 Enchant Books Whip Sweep The whip can sweep all targets within its range. Multi Boomerang You can fire an additional boomerang. --- 🔧 Tools House Detector 🏠 It has three modes: detecting houses, adding houses (requires prior detection), and deleting houses. Right-click on NPCs to add houses, allowing NPCs to move in. Pets 🐕 - Chester, Wallet: They allow remote connection to containers and ender chests. Rideable 🐎 Right-click to summon a pet mount, and press shift to recall the pet. - Slime - Bee --- 🥚 Spawn Eggs --- 📖 Gameplay NPC System 🙋‍♂️ - Trade (data/terra_entity/npc/shop/) - Mood (data/terra_entity/npc/moods.json) - Dialog (data/terra_entity/npc/dialogs.json) - Chat (data/terra_entity/npc/chat/) - Name (data/terra_entity/npc/names.json) Summoning System 🧙🏻 - Summon Damage: Whips and Summonings cause base damage. - Mark Damage: Summonings cause additional damage when handholding a whip. - Minion Capacity: Maximum number of minions that can be summoned. Configuration Files ⚙️ - Common Configuration (config/terra_entity-common.toml) - Client Configuration (config/terra_entity-client.toml) - Attribute Configuration (config/terra_entity/attribute_config.json)

Mushrooms Realm.title: Mushrooms Realm
Mushrooms Realm.body: Русский Мод добалвяет две новые сущности: красный и коричневый гриб. Коричневый гриб асоциируется как обычный мир, а красный - незер. Коричневый гриб обменивает за изумруды алмазную броню на алмазную броню с одним рандомным зачарованием максимального лва, тоже самое с инструментами и мечом. Красный гриб обменивает незеритовую броню с такой же логикой зачарований. Как встретить одну из сущностей? - Они спавнятся вокруг игрока каждые 5 минут - 60 минут и пропадают через 10 минут (все можно настроить в конфиге) и если игрок в обычном мире - спавнится коричневый гриб, в незере - красный. English The mod adds two new entities: a red and a brown mushroom. The brown mushroom is associated as an ordinary world, and the red one is not. The brown mushroom exchanges diamond armor for emeralds for diamond armor with one random enchantment of maximum LVL, the same with tools and a sword. The red mushroom exchanges non-cerite armor with the same enchantment logic. How to meet one of the entities? - They spawn around the player every 5 minutes - 60 minutes and disappear after 10 minutes (everything can be configured in the config) and if the player is in the normal world, a brown mushroom will spawn, and a red one in the cave.

Bossominium.title: Bossominium
Bossominium.body: NOTE: This mod will no longer be updated due to the original files being corrupeted, thank you all for the great support this mod has gotten, this mod has had a great run Introduction The Bossominium mod is a mod that adds multiple bosses into the game. All these bosses have unique item drops that you could use for various items. Animal Garden - Prairie Dog.title: Animal Garden - Prairie Dog
Animal Garden - Prairie Dog.body: This mod adds prairie dogs as tamable animals to your world. You can find them in the plains and meadow biome. (In forge you can change this and other spawn settings by editing the json files in the data - biome tags and biome modifier folders or via resource pack and in fabric there is a config file for it) Because they are omnivorous, you can tame them with any food item. If tamed then it will "bark" when there is a nearby mob that is targeting its owner. If untamed then it will panic when it gets hit and will also avoid nearby entities. Also every 5-10 minutes there is a chance that it will dig out an item when its on ground. The item is chosen from a json item tag named random_item.json( that can also be configured by editing the json files in the mods jar files data - item tags folders or via resource pack) They have 3 type of behaviors -wandering (wanders around, if tamed then it will wander around the block you put it into wandering mode) -resting(stays in place) -following (follows owner) Before the mob spawns it checks the area around the position if there is already another mob of this type around. If yes then it will check how many. And in the config you can also change how big of an area it should check around the mob spawn point and a max number. If there are more mobs in that area then the max number then it won't spawn the new mob. This option is to prevent overspawning. Mod currently supports Forge 26.x 1.21.x 1.20.6 1.20.4 1.20.1 1.19.4 1.19.2 1.18.2 Fabric 26.x 1.21.x 1.20.6 1.20.4 1.20.1 1.19.4 Neoforge 26.x 1.21.x 1.20.6 1.20.4 From version 1.0.2 its diurnal (sleeps at night if untamed) SEND ME A PRIVATE MESSAGE AT CURSEFORGE IF YOU ENCOUNTER ANY BUGS https://legacy.curseforge.com/members/aquarius_playz/projects Follow me on X (twitter) https://x.com/Aquarius_playz THIS MOD REQUIRES AQUARIUSLIBS TO BE INSTALLED

Demogorgon Mod.title: Demogorgon Mod
Demogorgon Mod.body: GECKOLIB REQUIRED! This mod will not work without GeckoLib! You will need GeckoLib for all versions of the mod (1.19.2, 1.19.4 and 1.20.1) The Demogorgon The Demogorgon has strangely found it's way into your Minecraft world! It spawns in the Blighted Forest biome! The Blight has infected wood and grass, and a perfect place for a Demogorgon to live in due to the cold environment! The Demogorgon hates fire! Set it on fire and it will deal more damage, and fear you! Demogorgon shack structures can spawn, with toolsmith loot and a dangerous Demogorgon spawner! You can break it or use it to your advantage... The Tech To make flashlights and a artificial redstone lamp, you will need batteries. You can generate batteries from the Redstone Generator. Once you have crafted your generator, you can right click to toggle it on and off. You have to shift right click to open the GUI, but the Redstone Generator has requirements for this. The block needs to be exposed to the sky, so no blocks apart from transparent blocks above it, and the weather needs to be raining or thunder so the block can summon lightning. Once the GUI is opened, put a Battery Shell in the left slot, click the button and and you will get your Battery. The battery is the only crafting recipe which you would not be able to view in JEI, so you can use that to figure Links If you would like to say anything related to the mod, please either use the comments on the project, or for a quicker response, join my discord using the link below! Discord - https://discord.gg/GnWt4HeZUh Alternative mod download page: CurseForge - https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/demogorgon

Burrowers.title: Burrowers
Burrowers.body: Participant MCreator x CurseForge ModJam 2024 Villagers, Illagers, and now introducing: ¡Burrowers! ‎ ‎ _A hidden society of distant relatives of the villager has adapted to the lack of light underground by turning into molemen, hoarding any resources they find while tunneling and building their homes. They seem friendly enough, but... What could they be hiding? _ ‎ ‎‎ Blocks & Items Spoiler Tough Roots & Rootwood The underground's main source of food. Break the roots that hang from the village ceiling to get a handful of them. While not having much nutritional value, you can find them really useful to build all the blocks and items you would expect from a new wood type, the rootwood Cave Fern A new vegetation block that can be potted and serves as decoration. Lichen Lantern Burrowers don't really care for lights as glowing lichen grow rampant in their homes. But when they feel fancy, they hang a lichen lantern , made from glass , iron , and said lichen . These emit a dimmer light than the regular lanterns, but the glass exterior looks really good! Cave Stew A nutritious meal made with a tough root, silver dweller meat, and any mushroom. Haste Potion Haste potions can now be crafted by using either a dweller dung or its meat in an awkward potion over the brewing stand. There are also splash , lingering , and arrow variants. Pottery Patterns Try to find new Wail and Memory pottery sherds! They seem designed by the burrowers, so what could these patterns mean for them? It also introduces a blank pottery sherd, which you can get by using the stonecutter with any other sherd. Music Disc A new track called " Placebo ", by my friend elgavira ‎‎ Entities Spoiler The mod includes three different entities, all featuring custom sounds and animations ! A lot of care went into these to make them feel as alive as possible given the limited time frame and my coding knowledge. The new creatures are the following: Silver Dwellers A bigger and domesticated silverfish . They are bred to help the burrowers build their villages and serve as a food source . They feed on different types of stone, and if they notice a stone block on the ground, they'll rush to eat it and will spit it out turned into its smooth variant . While doing this, they have a chance to drop a dung item . These creatures are neutral but will attack back any attacker, alerting other dwellers. They can be bred with live silverfish . Silver Dweller Meat Dropped by silver dwellers. A viable food source . Dweller Dung Functions like bone meal but for ore veins . Use it on an ore block to generate another one beside it. It generates murky ore blocks , which cannot be duplicated. It also has a chance to convert the original block into a murky one, but this won't affect its drop rates. Murky Ore Variants They have the same functionality as regular ores and deepslate ores. They only generate when you use the dweller dung. Burrowers The protagonists of this mod, featuring seven different variants ! These creatures lurk underground in their own cities, mainly around their giant root trees. They may flee from you at first, but will stop running if you bring any fruit item in your hand. If you drop them any kind of fruit, they'll stop to inspect it and barter with you, playing a cute custom animation. The barter loot table is the following, ordered by rarity: - Memory Pottery Sherd, Dweller Dung, Invisibility Potion, Invisibility Splash Potion, Emeralds, Shears, Murky Deepslate Redstone Ores, Silver Dweller Meat, Raw Iron, Rootwood Planks, Glow Lichen, Cave Fern, Raw Copper, Tough Root, Infested Deepslate Blocks, Clay Balls, Mud Blocks, Cobbled Deepslate Chief Burrower Meet the chief! In Burrower society, the wealthiest individual becomes the chief in charge of the town. You can find one per village, and they'll spend their time in the town market, where they store their goods. Unlike the regular burrowers, these won't chase any fruit themselves , but you can trade with them in a custom me

Unusual Prehistory 2.title: Unusual Prehistory 2
Unusual Prehistory 2.body: About Unusual Prehistory 2 Unusual Prehistory 2 is a complete remake of Unusual Prehistory! This mod adds the ability to revive a variety of prehistoric creatures and plants with various ways to interact with them. Quick Start Guide To begin your journey to resurrect prehistoric plants and animals, you need to find fossils found throughout the world. Fossils can be found in various biomes on the surface, including plains, badlands, stony shores, mountains, and swamps. Once you find a fossil, use a brush to dust off the matrix blocks and then break the revealed fossil bed with a pickaxe! Fossils are only step one though, to revive prehistoric plants and animals you need a transmogrifier. Abandoned Labs can be found in forest biomes occasionally and inside you can find a transmogrifier. To fuel the transmogrifier you need to create some organic ooze, which can be crafted with rotten flesh, slime balls, milk, and sugar. When Farmer's Delight is installed, organic ooze is crafted with a Cooking Pot instead. Mod Loader and Version This mod is currently being developed for NeoForge 1.21.1. No backports are planned.

Animal Garden - Crocodile.title: Animal Garden - Crocodile
Animal Garden - Crocodile.body: This mod adds crocodiles to your world to make the swamp a bit more dangerous place. Spoiler (You can change this and other spawn settings by editing the json files in the data - biome tags and biome modifier folders or via resource pack, but in fabric some spawn settings like the weight, min, max mob number have to be edited in the config file) When a creature comes near to them then after a while, they will feel threatened and might attack. (They show this by opening their mouth for some second) You can breed them with meat and fish items (custom item tag json file added for this so you can change it) They have a behavior where they randomly decide if they want to be on land or in water and they have 9 color variants. When on land they will sometimes lay down to rest a bit. And if a crocodile is damaged and there is a nearby food item on the ground that it can consume, then it will eat it to restore some of its lost health, also feeding, resting or staying in water will restore its health a little bit too. (from version 1.1.0) If they are in the water for a long time (10-20 minutes) then they will get moss/algae on their back until you clean them. You can scrub that off from them with a sponge or brush. and while doing that they will drop an item too that got stuck on their back while wandering the waters. Sponge will not get destroyed when using it on them. Mutationcraft.title: Mutationcraft
Mutationcraft.body: Mutationcraft adds a mutant outbreak to Minecraft. Hello Mutationcraft lovers! I'm Sxilverr, the new owner of Mutationcraft (the former author is ASEStefan). I have big plans for this mod, which includes a huge overhaul in the future. Right now, I have released the "Mutationcraft Legacy" which is the fixed version of the classic mod before the overhaul comes, so you can still play and enjoy the original!! :D Curseforge Page Requires: Geckolib Outbreak System: Every world has an outbreak timer that counts up overtime. At first only Miters will roam around. As the timer goes higher, stronger tiers of mutants start spawning: - Common: Assimilated Villagers, Pillagers, Witches, Wandering Traders, Humans and Roamers, assimilated animals (pigs, cows, sheep, horses, donkeys, wolves, foxes, bears, spiders), Assimilated Jockeys and Rotten Skeletons. Assimilated Piglins spawn in the Nether. - Parasites: Necroptors and Reductors. - Advanced: Human Stages 1 to 3, the Assimilated Enderman, the Assimilated Evoker and the Carnivorae. - Elite: the Assimilated Creeper, the Flayer, the Parasitic Ram and Roller, and Light and Medium Hooks. - Bosses: the Corrosion Queen, the Human Herder, the Resenter, the Parasitic Shooter and the Heavy Hook. The stage (0 to 4) sets how early each tier unlocks. You can change it with /mutationcraft stage or the config. Spreading infection and Evolving: - Mobs and players killed by mutants are converted into mutants. - Mutagen Sickness turns mobs into mutants when it runs out or when they are killed. - Human Stages evolve into the next stage over time. - Assimilated Humans become Flayers after killing 5 Skeletons, and Necroptors become Reductors after killing 5 Zombies. - Hooks grow from Light to Medium to Heavy hooks. - Interacting with a Rotten Skeleton spawns The Intoxicator. Mutants are hostile to every other creature. Hazmats: Hazmat Guards, Leaders, Medics and Flamethrowers patrol the Overworld with Scientists, and Hazmat Helicopters drop in more of them. They hunt mutants, so they can be good allies, or not. Gear: - Infected weapons: the Rapier, Battle Axe, Nordic Axe, Pole Axe, Halberd, Cavalry Sword and Flanged Mace. - Flamethrower: runs on furnace fuel, overheats if you hold the trigger too long, and sets mutants on fire. Burning mutants take double damage. - Special items: the Fang Staff, Necroptor Bomb, Poisoned Orb, Assimilated Ender Pearl, Mutagen Serum and Totem of Immunity. - Armor: Metal and Rusted Metal armor. - Mutation Bane: an enchantment that deals extra damage to mutants. - Effects: Bleeding, Corrosion, Severen, Rage, Mutagen Sickness, Sign of Fire and Magic Exhaustion. Config and Commands: The config file lets you change mob stats, spawns, stages, evolution, items, and more. The /mutationcraft command covers stage, time, pause, resume, reset, infect, cure, count and purge. Credits: - Sxilverr (Owner/Author) - ASEStefan (Former Author) - songsofsorrow and Jordaan (Legacy artists) - Nightfox (Legacy models) - Quicksounds, Freesound, Zapsplat and others were used for sounds. - The Some Items and Last Days resource packs were used for some assets. - Scape and Run: Parasites and other parasite mods for inspiration! Mutationcraft Legacy is MIT licensed. The Revamp of Mutationcraft will be ARR.

Animal Garden - Harp Seal.title: Animal Garden - Harp Seal
Animal Garden - Harp Seal.body: This mod adds the harp seal as tamable mob to the frozen ocean biome! They are piscivores, so they need fish items for taming . And for breeding, they have to be in the water to be able to mate. Because they are a bit shy they will avoid players (also polar bears). They still fight back though when attacked! They heal a bit when resting, eating food items from the ground or when fed by hand. To get the food they hunt fishes sometimes , tamed ones only hunt if their health is not max. Also at a random time they will stand up if not resting and flap their bellies. Babies are always white colored (whitecoat). While adults have some texture variants.(just a little different, not much) When tamed and in following mode they will fight alongside their owner. And at every 15-30 minutes they molt a bit (dropping leather, timer resets when the server stops, the minimum time can be changed in the config and the max time is always (minimum 2)) (In reality they molt like once a year and its just their skin and some old fur, but here leather will be a better choice) As mentioned they spawn in the frozen ocean biome You can change this and other spawn settings by editing the json files in the data - biome tags and biome modifier folders or via resource pack, but in fabric some spawn settings like the weight, min, max have to be edited in the config file This mod currently supports: Forge 26.x 1.21.x 1.20.1 Neoforge 26.x 1.21.x Fabric 26.x 1.21.x 1.20.1 Follow me on X (twitter) https://x.com/Aquarius_playz THIS MOD REQUIRES AQUARIUSLIBS TO BE INSTALLED

Zombified Player - Kill Your Inner Zombi.title: Zombified Player - Kill Your Inner Zombie
Zombified Player - Kill Your Inner Zombi.body: .svg) Zombified Player This Mod spawns a zombified version of the player after death . Beta Version! Please report any problems you find under: issues Features - spawns a zombified version of the player after death - uses the players actuall skin (uses the steve skin as fallback) - applies a zombified overlay to the skin - the dead players inventory can be tranfered to his zombified version The zombified player mob will use the same skin as the player (with a zombify overlay). Bountiful Critters.title: Bountiful Critters
Bountiful Critters.body: This mod aims to bring new animals to spice up your experience playing Minecraft. From the slow paces Oceanic Sunfish, to Noisy Emu Birds. You will be able to find new critters to collect and add to your own base and Zoos. Some will also come with little items or special mechanics to give them a bit more life . Mobs Spoiler Sunfish: They spawn in cold oceans and normal oceans, each biome has its own variant. You can bucket them to take them anywhere you go. They will also drop meat that when cooked it has a possibility to give you the water breathing effect. Sting Ray: Sting Rays will spawn in cold oceans, warm oceans and swamps, each biome has its own variant based of the real life animal. Be careful, if you get too close they might sting you! Emu: Emu birds spawn in the wooded badlands biome, they will lay eggs that work same as chicken eggs. The eggs can be 'boiled' in a furnace or smoker. You can get a cute baby that has a custom texture from breeding or throwing the egg! Krill: These little fellas swim in schools and are another tasty addition to the frozen and cold oceans! they drop Raw Krill which can be cooked to get Fried Krill. In v1.2.0: Raw Krill can also be used to make a Krill Cocktail. Marine Iguana: These funny reptiles spawn at stony shores. They come in 5 variants, can be bred with Kelp and are also bucketable. They can sneeze out salt after a few minutes, Salt can be used to craft Salted Kelp or a Salt Lamp, Salted Kelp has a chance of giving the dolphins grace effect. When fed Seagrass the iguana will spit it back out as a Seagrass Ball, this is a sticky substance which when placed down, acts like glue. it can also be crafted into a Seagrass Ball Block, for decorative purposes and can also be used as alternative for slimeballs. Longhorn Cow: These large cows spawn in the savanna biome. When hurt, they will charge at the player, when blocked with a shield they have a chance of dropping a horn, which can be used to craft a didgeridoo. they can be milked and can also be tamed with grass! Pillbug: These silly arthropods can climb and spawn in forest biomes. They attack undead mobs and when you get nearby a pill bug it will roll up, unless you crouch. When it is rolled up, you can pick it up and use it as a weapon, when it isn't rolled up you can pick it up with a Flower Pot. When they die they drop a Pillbug Scute and Raw PillBug item which can be cooked to get Roasted Pill Bug which is place-able just like a cake and when they have the poison effect they turn purple (iridovirus) and upon death drop a Poisonous PillBug item and a Poisonous Pillbug Scute. The scutes can be used to craft Pillblock blocksets! Toucan: These big beaked tropical birds spawn in jungles, they come in two variants and are tamable with melon slices, they are also quite noisy fellas. Humpback Whale: These majestic water animals spawn in the deep cold oceans, they feast upon krill and can be bred with Raw Krill. When fed Sand, Red Sand or Gravel they will filter it and blow treasure out. Lion: These felines are a must have in your minecraft zoo! they truly are king of the jungle. They are tamable and in the future can even have armor equipped! Lions are the perfect guard for your base. Gecko: These small reptilians are a new colorful addition to the jungle biomes. When a monster is near, they will alert by screaming loudly! You can catch these with Reptile Bags! Fiddle String Snake: These funny silly looking snakes are a new slithering addition to jungles. They are very fast. So when trying to catch one with a Snake Hook, make sure to have your speedy boots on! Pheasant: These majestic looking birds can spawn in every forest biome. They can be killed for a delightful piece of meat and maybe even a fancy looking feather! Credits: Dylanvhs: Creator, artist and programmer Omaypaty: Artist Ghoul: Animator TheValiantSquidward: Contributor Lyof: Contributor SashaKYotoz: Contributor Join the Barl Inc. discord so you dont miss out on new things! h

Animal Garden - Lion.title: Animal Garden - Lion
Animal Garden - Lion.body: This mod adds lions as tamable animals to your world. You can find them in the savanna biomes. Spoiler (In forge you can change this and other spawn settings by editing the json files in the data - biome tags and biome modifier folders or via resource pack and in fabric there is a config file for it) You can tame them with any food item. (10% chance per tries) If untamed then it will sometimes attack mobs around it, except if its a lioness. When they roar then every mob near except lions will try to run away. They also eat meat and fish items from the ground and doing so will restore their health. Resting and attacking will restore its health a little bit too. Only male and female can mate and baby lions wont have a mane. Babies will follow adults and lionesses will follow male lions. Male Lions have 15 body color variants, while females have 5 because they dont have manes, and they also have eye color variants. They have 3 type of behaviors (aquarius libs 1.0.1+ shows message when their owner is changing their behavior) -wandering (wanders around, if tamed then it will wander around the block you put it into wandering mode) -resting(stays in place) -following (follows owner) Mod currently supports Forge 26.x 1.21.x 1.20.4 1.20.1 1.18.2 Neoforge 26.x 1.21.x Fabric 26.x 1.21.x 1.20.4 1.20.1 Follow me on X (twitter) https://x.com/Aquarius_playz THIS MOD REQUIRES AQUARIUSLIBS TO BE INSTALLED

Animal Garden - Hippopotamus.title: Animal Garden - Hippopotamus
Animal Garden - Hippopotamus.body: This mod adds hippos to your world. You can find them only in the savanna biome. (You can change this and other spawn settings by editing the json files in the data - biome tags and biome modifier folders or via resource pack, but in fabric some spawn settings like the weight, min, max mob number have to be edited in the config file) They are easily agitated. If there is a someone nearby that does not go away from them, then after a while they will go on a rampage and attack that creature. You can tame and breed them with items like wheat, grass, apple, melon slice and other vegetables. (10% chance per tries, custom item tag json file added for this so you can change it) But even if its tamed it can still attack you sometimes and by feeding it it will calm down and stop attacking you. You change the config option "can_attack_randomly" to false if you dont want them to attack randomly anymore after taming or by increasing the "random_attack_chance" value, it will attack less often. Also breeding can only happen in the water and they can only breed with the opposite gender! You can find males less often and are larger. On daytime they will try to search for water and cool themselves down in there and at nighttime they will set out to search for food. (eat grass, like sheep) Resting or staying in water will restore its health a little bit too. They have 3 type of behaviors (aquarius libs 1.0.1+ shows message when their owner is changing their behavior) -wandering (wanders around, if tamed then it will wander around the block you put it into wandering mode) -resting(stays in place) -following (follows owner) Forge 26.x 1.21.x 1.20.1 Neoforge 26.x 1.21.x Fabric 26.x 1.21.x 1.20.1 Follow me on X (twitter) https://x.com/Aquarius_playz THIS MOD REQUIRES AQUARIUSLIBS TO BE INSTALLED credits: Earth's echo hippo sounds

Jurassic Revived.title: Jurassic Revived
Jurassic Revived.body: A free dinosaur mod for 1.20.1 and 1.21.1, inspired by the classic JurassiCraft experience – no paywalls, no nonsense. 📦 About the Mod: Jurassic Revived is a fan-made dinosaur mod for Minecraft 1.20.1 and 1.21.1, inspired by the gameplay and features of the original JurassiCraft mod. 🧬 Core Features: - 🦴 Fossil & DNA System Dig up fossils, extract DNA, and bring dinosaurs back to life using high-tech machines. - 🧠 Dynamic Dinosaur AI Species-specific behaviors such as aggression, fleeing, roaming, and herding. - 🏞️ Park-Building Tools Create enclosures, labs, research zones, and viewing areas. 💡 Why Jurassic Revived? When JurassiCraft went private and its downloads disappeared, this mod was made to continue the legacy — for the community, by the community. Jurassic Revived offers the same immersive dinosaur gameplay — without restrictions. ⚠️ Disclaimer: This is a fan project and is not affiliated with the newer JurassiCraft team (everything that appears in this mod comes either from the assets that the former team members have provided us with or was directly created by us) or any associated franchises. The mod is non-commercial and only inspired by the legacy of JurassiCraft. 💾 Installation (if not using a launcher): Requires Minecraft Forge for 1.20.1 or Neoforge for 1.21.1 Download the mod - Download Geckolib for your chosen version - As with any mod/modpack a mod like JEI or EMI is recommended, again, download for your chosen version - Drop all downloaded mods into the mods folder - Compatible with most Forge/Neoforge-based modpacks for 1.20.1 and most Neoforge-based modpacks for 1.21.1 🚧 Early Development Warning ⚠️ This mod is in a VERY early stage of development. Expect bugs, missing features, and frequent changes. Feedback is welcome, but please be patient!

Alex's Caves Continued.title: Alex's Caves Continued
Alex's Caves Continued.body: Alex's Caves Continued is a continuation of Alex's Caves by AlexModGuy, the same six enormous, hand-authored cave biomes, the same 43 mobs and 350-odd blocks, brought forward to Minecraft 1.20.1 through 26.2 and to Fabric and NeoForge alongside Forge. Nothing about the mod's content has been changed. It is the original mod, ported, same biomes, same mobs, same recipes, same progression, same cave book. Server tools — /acc Alex's Caves shipped with ~200 config options and no way to reach them via /acc menu What "Continued" means Alex's Caves shipped for Forge on Minecraft 1.20.1 only. This project brings the identical mod to 58 builds every Minecraft version from 1.20.1 to 26.2, on all three loaders that shipped for it. Credits Alex's Caves is AlexModGuy's work the biomes, the mobs, the art, the music, the design, all of it. This project exists to keep that work playable on current Minecraft and on every loader. - Original mod: AlexModGuy/AlexsCaves - Citadel (bundled): AlexModGuy/Citadel Links - Source: https://github.com/Codx-org/AlexsCavesContinued - Issues / bug reports: https://github.com/Codx-org/AlexsCavesContinued/issues Licensed under LGPL-3.0 , the same licence as the original.

Abyssbound.body: This mod is under the DarkMax Mod license, read before distribution (This mod is currently not being activley developed as I'm focusing on eternalink, my youtube Series, but I will come back to this) Abyssbound adds brand-new biomes and a dimension called Abyssbound Depths — a lost realm of voidbound monsters, equiptment which are more than just for damage and protection and lore lost in the fog. Designed for players seeking eerie atmosphere, custom boss fights, new mechanics, new materials, blocks to decorate with and much new content. Features New Dimension – Abyssbound Depths A dark and unsettling realm with many contrasting biomes, voidful resources and a layered lore-based ecosystem. But it just scratches the surface of how dangerous the real Void can be (the Void will be added in "The Void" expansion of this mod) Main Boss: – Gravorax, A terrifying, multi-phase boss summoned after breaking its seal. Bosses: - Chorvax - A giant crab creature which houses inside the Chintinhold Bastion. - Fodravax - A Blazezard turned "god" sealed off in its throne room. - Voltavax - The boss for the storm subtheme (not even designed yet) Mini Bosses: - Oblivious Watcher - drops one of the most valuable resources of the mod, the Voideye. - Nullform_Assasin - drops a resource to make powerful weapons like the Shrowdkiller. - Fallen Vortex - A boss that drops The pure vortex core used to craft double jump boots. Mobs - Voidpiercer – Fast ranged entity that harasses the player in packs. - Failed Construct – Failed remnant of a forgotten guardian. - Voidlurker - A creature which spawns at night, always alone. - Crabbling - A hostile crab found in Aetherswamps, its shell can be used to make Armor pieces effective to use in Water. - Shroomlurker - A mob which camouflages itself as a Mushroom. - Ashhopper - A species living in the blazes of the Abyss, trying to maintain their civilisation while fighting against predators Crafting Materials & Progression - Voidshards: Can be used to craft weapons, tools, or items. - Voideye: the most powerful and important resource of the mod. - Nullcrystal: a crystal found in geodes which can be used to brew antivoiding potions. join the discord Server for Support and to report Bugs Future plans: - New Biomes, strucutres, creature sounds, bosses and advanced Visual update - New crafting/upgrading system with void rituals Planned Expansions: (expansions work like dlcs that will be added after the main mod is finished) - Cruel judgement (Nether biomes, new mobs that get stronger the more Void Creatures you have killed...) - Celestials (Another dimension high above, contrasting the abyss, will go more in dephts of the creation of the Abyss and which role the celestials played in it) - The Void (Adding harder Versions of the main bosses, once defeated grant the player a dimension even deeper than the abyssbound depths, new challanging bosses and more) Credits to Lyno for the Voidfloater and Chorvax , aswell as concepts for mobs like the shroomling and Crabling and some textures for blocks and items If you want to support me in any way , go to my tiktok account @dev__dark , where I also make updates on the development of this mod
