Snekcraft.title: Snekcraft
Snekcraft.body: Overview Snekcraft adds ball pythons, corn snakes, and western hognose snakes with multiple color and pattern variants that can be obtained by breeding. Become a snake breeder and use your knowledge of snake genetics to make the prettiest snakes you can! They don't do much yet, but they sure are cute :) --- Breeding Snakes can be bred by feeding them raw chicken or rabbit, which will let them lay eggs if there is enough space around that hatch similarly to turtle eggs, albeit much quicker. Eggs will only hatch on sand or dirt, and won't retain genetics if picked up at the moment. Only the basic "wild type" color and pattern can be found in the wild; all other variants have to be obtained through breeding. --- Genetics mechanics A short explanation on how the genetics work. No need to get in-depth knowledge if you don't want to, experimenting and finding out what works yourself is half the fun anyway! Only wild type snakes, aka "normals" will spawn in the wild. Breeding two normals together will usually result in more normals, but they have a small chance of producing a base gene to get you started. All genes are either dominant, incomplete dominant, or recessive. Dominant genes will always show if the snake has it. Recessive genes will only show if there are no dominant genes present. Incomplete dominant genes will combine with dominant or recessive genes to make something new, or show especially well if combined with another incomplete dominant gene. Snakes cannot be bred to be het for a gene (having a dominant gene and a recessive one that does not visually show but affects breeding) to reduce complexity, but all normals can be used as if they were het for base genes when bred to another base gene snake. Combine and breed to try and figure out what in-game genes are what, and what they can each combine to produce! Note: Rainbow and corned snakes are their own things. You'll only have the (small) chance to get one if you can breed the ultimate mish-mosh of genes! --- Spawning Hognose snakes spawn in deserts, plains, sunflower plains, and meadows. Ball pythons spawn in plains and savannahs. Corn snakes spawn in swamps and jungles. --- Additional items Also adds different terrariums to house your snakes (and other mobs) such as the wire cage, terrarium, aquarium and lavaquarium. Use the terrarium key to change the solidness of external walls of any of the types of terrariums (external non-solid walls will only be outlined when holding the key). Terrariums will work with different types of terrariums next to each other. Terrariums work better when at least 3x3x1. Make your snakes happy with different types of hides and a heat lamp! To place a hide or any decoration inside an enclosure, remove the enclosure block, place the hide, and toggle the surrounding walls off with the enclosure key. Snake bags can be used to pick up and transport snakes. Snakes will occasionally drop shed skins which can be used to make snake bags or scutes, and fangs, which can be made into bone meal but may become more useful in future updates! --- Questions? Come check out our Discord! Versions for MC 1.18.2 require geckolib. Coding and textures by Raspix. Models, more textures, and animations by PiedPipecleaner. Fabric version thanks to Brent and Snektron.

Animal Garden - Narwhal.title: Animal Garden - Narwhal
Animal Garden - Narwhal.body: This mod adds the unicorns of the sea, the narwhals to the frozen ocean biomes. They are considered piscivores (fish-eaters), so they need fish items for taming and breeding . Also they heal a bit after every 30 second when in the water, eating fish items in the water by sucking them into their mouth or when fed by hand. To get the food they hunt fishes sometimes , tamed ones only hunt if their health is not max. And babies are always dark colored. Just like in my other animal mods the mobs have 3 type of behavior that can be changed when interaction with them (a message shows up so you know which behavior it is using) (wandering - resting - following) When tamed and in following mode they will fight alongside their owner, but they wont teleport to their owner when far away. And they can spawn with a tusk in different sizes. When they are attacked there is a 1% chance that they drop a part of their tusk that can be crafted into 5 bone meal . If their tusk is fully removed then they wont drop any tusk part anymore. Also when their owner is being targeted by a nearby creature then they will let out a loud sound to warn about the danger. As mentioned they spawn in the frozen ocean biomes You can change this and other spawn settings by editing the json files in the data - biome tags and biome modifier folders or via resource pack, but in fabric some spawn settings like the weight, min, max have to be edited in the config file This mod currently supports: Forge 26.x 1.21.x 1.20.1 1.18.2 Neoforge 26.x 1.21.x Fabric 26.x 1.21.x 1.20.1 Follow me on X (twitter) https://x.com/Aquarius_playz THIS MOD REQUIRES AQUARIUSLIBS TO BE INSTALLED

Wings Of Fire!.title: Wings Of Fire!
Wings Of Fire!.body: WINGS OF FIRE Is a mod that adds SIX different Phoenix Breeds to Minecraft! Find eggs around your world and hatch them to create powerful new mounts! Find PETRIFIED Phoenix Eggs in different structures in your world, and warm them up inside the new INFERNO CRADLE block. After 15 minutes, your phoenix egg will be warmed up! (Using magma cream on an unignited inferno cradle lets you light it for decorative purposes) Combining your newly warm Phoenix Eggs with TEMPERED LANTERNS , a new item, will bind the lantern and the egg, giving you the item capable of summoning the legendary phoenix! Right click your bound lantern to summon your Phoenix! You automatically begin to ride the phoenix once summoned, and once you get off, POOF! _(beware of fall damage!)_ Find and collect all 6 different breeds, with more to come in future updates! The different eggs are located in the following structures: Fire Phoenix: Woodland Mansions & Pillager Outposts Wind Phoenix: Abandoned Mineshafts Red Phoenix: Nether Fortresses Nature Phoenix: Jungle Temples Dark Phoenix: Ancient Cities Gilded Phoenix: Bastion Remnants RECIPES FOR THE INFERNO CRADLE & TEMPERED LANTERN: _I permit the use of this mod in any modpack_ _ Inferno Cradle and Phoenix Texture by @TheModderG - HUGE thank you for helping me redesign these, they came out looking great!_

Bats Galore.title: Bats Galore
Bats Galore.body: General Info Spooky Bats is a mod being made for Mycelium Network's 2023 Spooky Jam. It adds a ton of unique bat variations to the game! Most bats can naturally be found throughout the overworld as well as some in the Nether. More Details In addition to spookily flying around, each bat drops a specific type of candy when it's killed. Each of these candies can be consumed, but beware because not all of them are beneficial! The mod also adds a special bat type called the Void Bat. This bat does not naturally spawn in game. But, if you click it, you'll be sent to the end, as if you made contact with an ender portal. Altar of Turmoil In the Spooky Oak biome, there is a chance of stumbling across a structure called the Altar of Turmoil. The structure consists of four pedestals along the perimeter. Four very special bats in the mod drop four different types of cores. Once you have obtained these cores, try placing one on each pedestal and see what happens! Note: This mod has versions for both Forge and Fabric! Links Discord server: https://discord.gg/wM4CKTbFVN

Biodiverse.title: Biodiverse
Biodiverse.body: Biodiverse adds a total of 26 interesting animals to a range of minecraft biomes. Animals exhibit a variety of different behaviours, from sneaking up on prey during a hunt, to just taking a long nap. Many animals can provide useful perks to the player, but all serve to make the world and your zoos more interesting and diverse. Animals: Anglerfish Found in deep ocean biomes, anglerfish are hostile toward players. Defeating one drops its glowing bulb and anglerfish meat, which can be cooked and eaten. The angler bulb can also be brewed into Night Vision potions. Beluga Whale Belugas roam frozen ocean biomes and, like dolphins, are curious and intelligent. They will follow nearby players and help them fend off hostile mobs. BlackBear Black bears appear in six different colors across forest biomes. Normally timid, they avoid players but will fight back when attacked. Offering honey or berries makes them beg, and feeding them builds trust so they won’t flee. Black bears can be sheared for fur, which can be crafted into a makeshift bear-head helmet. Blue Whale Graceful giants of the deep ocean, blue whales embody the beauty of the sea. Swimming nearby grants the Ancient Blessing effect, which boosts regeneration and resistance. Bowhead Whale Bowhead Whales lurch around frozen ocean biomes, indicating their huge prescence. They frequently require to break ice on the surface to breath, which has a rare chance of chipping away and dropping a cranium shard, crafting a large radius pickaxe. Capybara Capybaras inhabit jungle biomes and are known for their calm, sleepy nature. Their drowsiness radiates as a debuff effect that weakens nearby mobs, helping them avoid predators. Cassowary Cassowaries are hostile, flightless birds found in bamboo jungles. Feeding them melon slices may pacify them briefly, during which they can dig up random seeds when given more. They can also be bred with melon blocks, producing eggs that may hatch or be eaten. Cassowaries drop multiple feathers and raw meat. Cheetah Cheetahs roam savanna biomes, hunting smaller animals like pigs and sheep. They can be tamed with raw beef, pork, or mutton, though their speed and skittishness make them tricky to feed. Cougar Cougars dwell in cold mountain regions, preying on sheep and goats. They attack players who wander too close, so keep your distance. Crab Crabs scuttle across beaches in many colors. Their claws can be wielded in the off-hand to extend reach, while their legs drop as a tasty, cookable food source. Elk Elk can be found in herds or solitary males in any forest biome. They are large and tough creatures who will defend themselves from attackers, while the rest of the herd runs away. They seem to have a lot of meat and leather on them... and perhaps drop their skull Fennec Fox Hippopotomus Hippos live near water in the savanna. Aggressive and powerful, they deal heavy damage when provoked. They drop teeth—used to craft fast-hitting daggers—and meat that can be cooked. Humpback Whale Humpbacks are enormous, majestic creatures of the deep ocean, singing their songs as they migrate across the seas. Jaguar Jaguars stalk jungle biomes, hunting capybaras. Make sure to keep your eyes on them, as they are known to hunt from behind... few have also spotted a rare, fully black coloured jaguar. Lion Lions form prides in the great plains of the savanna. they are strong and rough felines, that protect their kids from any players approaching. If one does manage to lure away a cub without upsetting any of the pride members, meat may be used to tame and provide a strong and resilient companion, which may be able to be decorated with different armors. Meerkat Meerkats live in burrows scattered across the savanna. They sense danger from hostile mobs and quickly retreat underground. Feeding them spider eyes temporarily reveals hostile mobs in the area. Musk Ox Musk oxen roam snowy biomes in herds. When grass is available, they grow a layer of wool that can be sheared for Qiviut,

Symbiote: A Bonding Experience.title: Symbiote: A Bonding Experience
Symbiote: A Bonding Experience.body: Symbiote Find an asteroid, bond. Try and live with it at your own risk. Symbiote adds one creature to Minecraft: one that lives inside you. It protects you better than you can protect yourself. Symbiotes lie dormant in asteroids, waiting for a player to get close. The entity has desires. Refusal causes stress, eventually forcing the symbiote to take what it wants. There are 5 unique strains of symbiote, as follows: Predator: Built to chase. Feeds on the hunt, but starves fast. Keep it fed. Guardian: Protection is the game. Holds the lines, blocks anything and everything. Shadow: Doesn't like the sun. Night feeds it. Moves quicker in the night and sees even better. Sculk: Hears the world move. Tracks their movements, hears their heartbeats. What it shows you, only you see. Royal: Pure Apex. Pridefully the strongest, and it's not close. Fights for control more often than not. Usage notice: Free to use in any modpack. Anything else, ask. Note: I highly recommend shaders with this mod! (ITRP works best) How it works/FAQ Controls (all rebindable) Key Action X Radial menu: commands (Protect Me / Hunt / Hide) + the Status panel (bottom node) B Feed the symbiote (hold meat in either hand) G Living Armor on/off R Tendril Yank: pull enemies in, or launch yourself C Wall Cling U Consume: grab and eat the nearest creature K Apex Form O Assign held item to a Symbiote Arm slot L Furl / unfurl the mantle N Symbiote build: Wall / bridge / staircase from blocks in its arm slots (look slightly up for staircase, straight ahead and slightly downward for bridge, and straight ahead centered for wall) Understanding your symbiote Open the radial (X) and pick the bottom node: the Status panel shows your strain, stage, mood, and every meter. This explains most of the symbiote's behaviors. Bond: How deep it's rooted. Grows from feeding, fighting together, and time. Drives your STAGE. If it hits zero, it consumes you. Trust: How much it listens. Feed it, fulfill its requests, fight beside it. Stress: How wound up it is. Ignored requests and pain raise it. Stressed symbiotes act out. Hunger: The fuel that keeps the symbiote going. It drains naturally through the day now, and a starving symbiote takes matters into its own hands. Mood: New in 1.1. Content, Anxious, Coiled, or Grieving, driven by how you treat it and what you live through together. You feel it from the inside: the screen bleeds at the edges when it's wound tight, its voice warms or curdles, and a grieving symbiote goes quiet. INTEGRATING: shown for ~20 minutes after a fresh bond while it settles in. It stays quiet through this window, and most of what it is (its senses, the yank, the mantle, its combat reflexes) arrives all at once when the window closes. It will still save your life from minute one. Random misfires during this phase are normal. Stage is not obedience Two different dials, most common mix-up: Stage (Attached → Integrated → Cooperative → Dominant) comes from Bond. Higher stages = more power for you, more of the wheel for it. "Dominant" means that it is deeply bonded, not obedient. Helpfulness comes from Trust and Stress. A symbiote that ignores commands, refuses abilities, or acts on its own has LOW TRUST or HIGH STRESS, regardless of the stage. Feeding it, fulfilling its requests, and fighting beside it naturally calms and builds trust with the symbiote. Feeding Hold any raw or cooked meat and press B. It refuses when full. Rotten flesh counts as food for all strains except Royal. The royal strain finds carrion disgusting. It asks for things Periodically, your symbiote will request things: meat, a kill, the deep underground, a hunt under the open night sky, or to be worn. Fulfilling these requests builds trust. Ignoring it builds stress, and will cause your symbiote to deal with it itself. When it takes control Sometimes your keys stop answering. This is the mod working. Every hijack ends on its own. Sometimes the symbiote will control you and take you somewhere, dig down, or

Desert Behemoths: Sandworms!.title: Desert Behemoths: Sandworms!
Desert Behemoths: Sandworms!.body: Desert Behemoths: Sandworms! brings the iconic sandworms from the Dune franchise into the world of Minecraft. Feel the thrill and danger of the desert like never before with this exciting addition. Feel free to use this mod in your modpacks! Features: Sandworms! - Experience the terror of massive sandworms emerging from the desert sands. Sprinting or rhythmic jumping in the desert will attract these formidable creatures, bringing the Dune universe's essence to your Minecraft adventures and mandating cautious traversal within the desert sands. - Once a sandworm is on your tail, the only way to escape its relentless pursuit is to leave the desert. Plan your movements carefully and stay alert to avoid becoming a sandworm snacks The Thumper: - Crafted with a piston above a redstone repeater, thumpers can be placed in the desert to quickly call a sandworm to your position. The sandworm will first destroy the thumper, before shifting its attention to you! Spoiler Challenging the worm: - Combat and Rewards: Brave players can take on the sandworm by targeting its head with explosives. But be careful and keep your distance, lest you be swallowed whole! - Successfully drive it away to earn a valuable reward: the coveted sandworm tooth The Sandworm Tooth: - Unleash the ancient power of the desert with the Sandworm Tooth! This rare and potent ingredient, harvested from the mighty Shai-Hulud itself, revolutionizes your brewing capabilities. Just like glowstone dust, the sandworm tooth amplifies your potions, but with a unique twist—it’s compatible with potions already enhanced by both redstone and glowstone. - Use the sandworm tooth to craft long-lasting Level 2 potions, perfect for enduring challenges, or brew short but immensely powerful Level 3 potions to gain the upper hand in critical moments. Whether you're preparing for an epic battle or a daunting exploration, the sandworm tooth is your key to unmatched alchemical mastery. Embrace the power of the sands and transform your brewing with this legendary ingredient! - Harnessing the power of the sandworm tooth adds a thrilling incentive to face the formidable Shai-Hulud, rewarding brave adventurers with unparalleled brewing enhancements. Spoiler Planned features: Spoiler - Configs - Worm Riding - Feel free to make suggestions in the comments! Prepare yourself for an adventure in the deserts of Minecraft with Desert Behemoths: Sandworms! Will you survive the onslaught of these giant creatures, or will you succumb to the sands?

Choup's Drakvyrn Mod.title: Choup's Drakvyrn Mod
Choup's Drakvyrn Mod.body: Choup's Drakvyrn Mod brings the Drakvyrn : a smaller yet undeniably cooler dragon like entity. Dependencies : To run the mod you'll need to download Geckolib and also Curios API in the correct version, i also recommend to download JEI ! With Epic Fight you should also download this datapack : https://legacy.curseforge.com/minecraft/data-packs/choups-drakvyrn-mod-x-epic-fight-datapack ! Where to start ? Drakvyrns : Are you more like an adventurer ? Then try to find the Drakvyrn Hand structure : a rare ancient monument that look like a tower and that houses an Ancient Egg. The Ancient Egg can be break to recover it or hatch by right clicking on it and then spawn a Drakvyrn. The spawned Drakvyrn need to be fight to drop a Drakvyrn Egg. To spawn a nether version of the Drakvyrns you'll need to bring the Ancient Egg to the Nether and then hatch it ! When you'll right click on a Tamed version of a Drakvyrn with the Ancient Ring, they will cycle between four modes : _Staying, Following, Agressive, Rideable !_ After he died, the Drakvyrn will drop some scales to make armor, some bones for tools and Ignition Breath Ball to make a cool Staff and some Ignition Potion ! They exist in 8 colors with 2 of them (Warped, Crimson) for the Nether. Drakvyrns drop "Drakvyrn Scales", you can make some armors with them, and some "Drakvyrn Bones" to make some Tools. The Drakvyrn Hand : The Draklets : The Draklets are the new entities from the v2.2.0 version of the mod. They spawn in Forests biomes (Birch forest, Dark forest, Flower forest, Old growth birch forest, Forest) in a small structure called the Draklet Nest. They will always spawn in a group of three. They are quite dangerous because they inflict you poison and are pretty fast ! They can be tamed with Raw meat on a Bone and the cooked verison and have 3 states like Drakvyrns (Following, Agressive Staying). To cycle between the states use The Ancient Ring. When killed they'll drop some Draklet Scute to make an armor that will give you a permanent Resistance I potion effect when fully equipped. The Draklet Tooth can also be dropped to make stronger poison potion or when combine with the rare Draklet Horn you can make a Draklet Dagger! The "Poisonous" enchantment book was also made to fit with that dagger and increases the strenght of the poison ! The Draves : The Drave is the new entity from the v2.3.0 version of the mod ! They are quite massive and have a small pair of wings, but due to their underground habitat (in caves), evolution has rendered their wings flightless. They exist in 5 color variations (amethyst, topaz, emerald, sapphire and ruby) and when killed they will drop you some Crystal powder (used to make Crystallised Iron Tools ) and if you are lucky an Intact Geode. Intact Geode can be also obtained by feed the Drake with either a Raw Meat on a Bone or its cooked version. And this item can be smashed onto the ground to discover his hidden loot ! Crystallised Iron Tools are a new version of Iron tools set they are more efficient and more durable than the regular Iron Tools ! The Drozens: The Drozen is a friendly Drake that will spawn only in snow Plains and Groves biomes in their nest (choups_drakvyrn_mod:drozen_nest) . They are tameable with Frozen Meat on a Bone and can be rided. They're pretty fast, can't jump and can walk on water! If you hit them, they'll hit you back! Be careful with them! When killed they will drop an Eternal Frost that is used to make The Eternal Frosted Blade and they also drop a Drozen Horn that is used to make a Drozen Spear that can be upgrade into a Frozed Drozen Spear ! The Draekhalde : The Draekhalde (=Dune Drake) is a serpent-like entity that you can find in the desert, in its den (choups_drakvyrn_mod:draekhalde_den). It cannot be tamed and is aggressive toward players. It also has a special AOE attack, the sandy 'cloud' attack, which deals 12 damage to the player and inflicts blindness. Upon death, it'll drop some cool stuff like its scales, toxin

Chiikawa.title: Chiikawa
Chiikawa.body: Chiikawa Mod Website · Source · Discord · Report a Bug The Chiikawa Mod brings the world of Chiikawa into Minecraft : the characters of Chiikawa come to live in your world, so you can experience the world of Chiikawa in Minecraft. Come and chat on Discord or in the QQ group 995178570 . More on the website. Supported Versions Minecraft version Loaders Java ------------------------------------------------------------------------ ---------------- ---- 1.20.1, 1.20.2, 1.20.4 Fabric, Forge 17 1.20.6, 1.21.1, 1.21.4, 1.21.5, 1.21.6, 1.21.7, 1.21.8, 1.21.10, 1.21.11 Fabric, NeoForge 21 26.1.2, 26.2 Fabric, NeoForge 25 The mod runs on both sides: on a server, install it on the server and on every client . Getting Started 1. Explore. Wander around your Minecraft world and you will meet the characters of Chiikawa. 2. Try taming them. Some of them can be tamed with food and become your pets, _keeping you company all the way_. 3. Tell them what to do. Pets can act in several ways: follow you, stay where they are, or roam freely near home and live their own lives. Pets take on all kinds of jobs: hand one a different tool and it does different work , such as farming, hunting or playing music. Your pets also live the way they do in Chiikawa: they go to work for money, go shopping, sit exams for licences, and bring you presents. The first time you join a world you get _Chiikawa's Work Handbook_; right-click it to read. More on the website. License and Disclaimer The Chiikawa Mod is an unofficial fan-made mod , not affiliated with Nagano, the creator of Chiikawa, or the rights holders. Chiikawa and its characters belong to their creator. The source code is released under LGPL-3.0, and the art (models, textures, animations) under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; see licenses/ASSETS.txt. Thanks Thanks to every player who follows, downloads and plays the Chiikawa Mod, and to the contributors who reported issues and sent code. Thanks to zoe\_1000 for the art.

SoniCraft Demons.title: SoniCraft Demons
SoniCraft Demons.body: Note: This mod requires both GeckoLib and  SoniCraft  in order to work!   Halloween is upon us, and that means the spirits of hell are coming out to play. With this in mind, I, EnderPreston, the creator of SoniCraft, am devilishly proud to present... This addon introduces tons of new blocks, new items, a new armor/tool type, new bosses and 4 new explorable dimensions! This has been in the works for the past several months, with a lot of research and hard work put into it. No disrespect towards the awesome team that made the Vs Sonic.EXE mod for Friday Night Funkin', but I want to be able to show people the true origins and capabilities of these not-so-musical nightmares, and even show some other famous creepypastas from the Sonic fanbase. All of the current creepypastas included and/or referenced are listed below.   Creepypastas: Sonic.EXE (Crimson X) Xenophanes Tails Doll Genocide City Friendship Sink (from Below The Depths FNF mod) Needlem0use Starved (with Furnace Metal Sonic included) Soulless Sonic (Lord X) EYX (SonicEDIT.ROM) Sally.EXE (right now, it's only the stuff from KINDANDFAIR, probably not going to be supported anymore) FatalVerse (Fatal Error) No More Innocence DX (From the FNF song GAMEBREAKER) Zephaniah (SEGASONIC.zip)   Of course, credit for all of these goes to their original creators.   It should certainly be noted that the mod won't drop you straight into the spooky stuff right off the bat. First, you'll need a pentagram, crafted by surrounding blaze powder with redstone and nether wart in a crafting table. Then, place the pentagram, place 4 candles around the pentagram in a circle, and light the candles. What happens next is up to you. If you're not sure what to do with the pentagram, or what items you can use on it, there are pentagram recipes (along with bios for each creepypasta demon) available on SoniCraft's official website: Link to Website   If you're still confused about something, or you want to report a bug, come talk to me about it on my Discord server! Link to Discord   Older versions of this mod can be found on  CurseForge .

Mutant Iceologer Mod.title: Mutant Iceologer Mod
Mutant Iceologer Mod.body: Woah this is one Buff Illager, Meet the Mutant Iceologer. This guy is a BEAST when it comes to fighting so be careful or you might be in for not a N-Ice time! In the Mutant Iceologer Mod, it adds a new mob that is a recreation of a popular Bedrock Add-on of mine based on the Iceologer from Minecraft Dungeons It is part of the illager team that spawns in the snowy biomes at night time and will throw Ice Chunks at its targets such as villagers, iron golems, players, and snow golems! This is a BEAST of a mob so be prepared for a battle! Mutant Iceologer: An ice-summoning Illager who is the real deal when it comes to fighting, you do NOT want to mess with this guy, He uses his magic to summon huge ice chunks and throws them at you, and even ground pounds! It spawns in snow biomes at night time, killing it will drop some emeralds along with blue ice, snow blocks, and a new type of Ice block called The Chilled Spike Block. Health 150 (75 hearts) If you manage to kill this fierce foe, it has a chance to drop a new block called The Chilled Spike Block This block is used as ammo for the Iceologer Staff and can also be found in the creative menu along with the Mutant Iceologer and the Iceologer Staff. Want to harness the power of the Mutant Iceologer? Well now you can with the Iceologer Staff! To craft the Iceologer Staff you will need 2 Iron Rod's, Iron Rod's can be crafted as shown below. Once crafted you will need to Chill them, to Chill them you can right click a Cauldron full of Powdered Snow. And finally to craft the Iceologer Staff you will need 2 Chilled Iron Rod's, and 1 Chilled Spike block. If you would like to report any bugs or suggestions you can by joining my official discord server below Discord Server: https://discord.gg/cDbJwQB

Animal Garden - Springhare.title: Animal Garden - Springhare
Animal Garden - Springhare.body: This mod adds another useful tamable critter to the savanna biomes, the Springhare! They are herbivorous, so they need plant based items for taming. Eats grass type block sometimes for faster growth and heal and can jump really high. The edible block list can be changed with the edible_blocks.json file in the tags/block(s) folder, just like how the tamable food items list can be changed with the food_items.json file in the tags/item(s) folder. They are nocturnal! So they sleep during the day and are active at night. And their special behavior is Digging -around every 5-10 minutes they dig up an item (80% chance) -item list can be changed with the random_item.json file in the tags/item(s) folder and Block Searching (tamed ones can smell out a block of interest even from underground in a small distance) -when the owner is near, they will let out a loud squeak to alert the owner that there is a rare block nearby, such as emerald, diamond, nether quartz or amethyst. -can be used once every 30 second -block list can be changed with the search_block.json file in the tags/block(s) folder As mentioned they spawn in the savanna biomes You can change this and other spawn settings by editing the json files in the data - biome tags and biome modifier folders or via resource pack, but in fabric some spawn settings like the weight, min, max have to be edited in the config file This mod currently supports: Forge 26.x 1.21.x 1.20.6 1.20.1 Neoforge 26.x 1.21.x Fabric 26.x 1.21.x 1.20.6 1.20.1 SEND ME A PRIVATE MESSAGE IF YOU ENCOUNTER ANY BUGS AT CURSEFORGE https://legacy.curseforge.com/members/aquarius_playz/projects Follow me on X (twitter) https://x.com/Aquarius_playz THIS MOD REQUIRES AQUARIUSLIBS TO BE INSTALLED

Zelda: Hyrule Terrors.title: Zelda: Hyrule Terrors
Zelda: Hyrule Terrors.body: Step into a Zelda-inspired world where danger lurks in every biome and the spoils of battle bring legendary power. _Hyrule Terrors_ brings iconic enemies, weapons, and armor from Breath of the Wild and Tears of the Kingdom into the world of Minecraft, breathing new life into your adventures. Features Hyrule Terrors Summon or encounter four iconic creatures, each with their own behaviors, spawn rules, and custom attributes: Bokoblin – Mischievous, chaotic creatures that spawn in large groups. Leaders can spawn with a horn and alert nearby Bokoblins to come to their aid. Leaders can drop a head that you can wear to prevent Bokoblins from attacking or alerting. Lizalfos – Agile lizard warriors with poisonous traits. Some Lizalfos will spawn carrying an obtainable spear. Chuchu – Bouncy blobs that spawn in packs. Shoot them with a flaming projectile or light them on fire to turn them into a Red Chuchu ! Red Chuchus drop Red Chuchu Jelly. Keese – Flying nuisances with an eerily large eye! Keese can drop a Keese Eyeball that you can wear on your head. Weapons & Mob Drop Loot Vanquish foes and earn custom items and rare monster parts: Bokoblin Fang and Bokoblin Horn Lizalfos Horn , Lizalfos Tail , and Lizalfos Talon Chuchu Jelly and Red Chuchu Jelly Legendary weapons include: Lizalfos Horn Dagger – Quick and deadly. Bokoblin Arm – A creepy, still-living arm taken from a Bokoblin! Silver Longsword , Knight's Claymore , and Boulder Breaker – Each has unique damage and attack speed. Lizal Spear – Right-click to perform a powerful diving attack. The Master Sword – An extremely powerful weapon. The sword awakens while in the Nether or End, and can also awaken when fighting bosses or configured entities, granting it additional damage. Hylian Shield – A strong and durable shield with powerful abilities. Armor Sets Equip yourself for war with handcrafted armor inspired by Zelda: Zora Armor – Sleek aquatic gear. Hero Armor – Hero of the Wild. Barbarian Armor – Unleash your wild side. Knight Armor – A strong defense against dark forces. Evil Spirit Armor – For those who walk the shadowy path. Structures Discover Bokoblin forts and hideouts throughout the world! Possible Future Plans Future updates may include: More unique Zelda gear Additional structures Boss mobs and mini-bosses Possibly even more, depending on the mod's popularity! Required Dependencies Architectury API AzureLib and Cloth Config Discord CLICK ME FOR LINK! Join the Adventure Whether you’re a seasoned adventurer or just starting your journey, _Hyrule Terrors_ brings the thrill of Zelda into the blocky world of Minecraft. Do you dare to face the terrors of Hyrule? This mod is a fan-made project and is not affiliated with Nintendo or the official Legend of Zelda series.

Antarchy.title: Antarchy
Antarchy.body: This mod requires AntOS, Integrated API, Geckolib, Sizeable Foliage, and optionally Infinite Dimensions What is Antarchy? Antarchy includes 3 fleshed-out dimensions, infinite randomly generated dimensions, 45+ mobs, 8 bosses (with 2 more on the way, including the King and Queen!), insane weapons, dungeons, and more. All of this is up to quality in terms of design and looks with modern Minecraft mods. I want this mod to make you feel like a kid discovering mods for the first time. I am making the perfect mod for my child-self and hopefully yours as well! For the Brown ant, you need mossy ouranwood wood. For termite, you need Myrmite. I know, it's so sad the poor ants have to go to make the portals Uranium, Titanium, Ultimate Gear, and Royal Gear Antarchy adds two new ores you can find that are much rarer than diamond. Each ore only gives one nugget. These are used to craft the Ultimate Armor, Ultimate Tools with toggle-able 3x3 mining, Squidzooka, Gravity Gun, R.P.O. Launcher, and the Shrink and Growth Rays. Uranium and Titanium also have full block sets. As of 2.0 the mod also includes Royal Guardian and Assailant gear, which as you can imagine is insane. The Brown Ant Dimension, AKA Elythia Elythia is a lush paradise with towering Ouranwood forests and vast rolling meadows Try to tame yourself a flying squirrel and find the Brutalfly in it's massive caccoon Elythia is also home to the King and his massive tree, in the tallest structure ever made in Minecraft. It also contains various statues and nostalgic structures you may recognize! The Red Ant Dimension, AKA Thoraxis Thoraxis isn't quite as nice as Elythia. Even the plants try to kill you! This nightmare of a dimension is built around the mechanic of inverted gravity. Various mobs, gesyers, and blocks will give you the inverted effect, flipping your gravity to upwards. Thoraxis is also home to the Underside, a second region full of dunes and dungeons below the bedrock of the dimension. There is the home of the Queen. This might be one of the hardest dimensions in all of modded mc, good luck! :) Cavaryn, aka the Termite Dimension Cavaryn is a horrifying place full of all sorts of creepy crawls. Plus Stink Bug and Rolly Pollys! Big Bertha Crafted with mobs drops from all over Antarchy, this is the new best weapon in any modpack. It has a mode for each boss used to make it, granting you all of thier abilites! The Kraken The Kraken Boss can be summoned by killing squids, so be careful where you swing your sword! It is the hardest boss in the game, summoning lightning, flying around, and shooting Octopus Bombs and Missile squids at you. Planned Features An untitled crystal dimension An untitled futuristic dimension Whatever I feel like adding on any given day! Q: Will you backport to X? A: Probably not. I will update the mod to later versions as they become popular but it's much easier for me to maintain and improve the mod on one version. Fabric version might be coming though. Q: Are you affiliated with the Orespawn mod? A: Antarchy does not have any affiliation with the original Orespawn mod and uses no assets or code from the original. The mod is very distinct with almost as much original content as content from Orespawn. Q: Can I use this mod in a modpack? A: Yes! Go crazy! Q: Why are there so many required dependencies? A: Throughout the lifespan of Antarchy I keep making features I either want for other mods, or people want to play without Antarchy itself. This is not to download farm, I would not do it if I didn't have to. It makes maintaining these features much easier rather than updating them all sepereately for different projects. Q: How do I configure/change _? A: There is a ridiculous amount of config options for you to tune the mod. If it's not in the config it might be something you can change with a datapack. If you want something added to the config let me know and I'll make it configurable! Join the discord if you have any other questions or want to follow the

Antlers of Hunger.title: Antlers of Hunger
Antlers of Hunger.body: Antlers of Hunger is a creature-stalker horror mod with a focus on combat & atmosphere. This mod adds the Wendigo from the 2021 Film "Antlers" into Minecraft, adapting it into the blocky realm and keeping things accurate with a bit of creative freedom! There are 2 visually distinct skins for the Wendigo available, as signified by VIBRANT and MOVIE versions of the mod in the files section, use VIBRANT for the black-white-red version good for thumbnails and snowy biomes, and MOVIE for the darker brown with a glowing chest version good for movie accuracy and map immersion. Required mods: GECKOLIB Recommendations: Intended to be experienced with the official Antlers of Hunger - The Experience modpack, official "Coal Creek Basin" map and custom shader config available in the modpack, also meant to be experienced as the only threat / horror mod in a modpack. If you want to receive updates on this mod, want to report bugs / issues or suggest new additions, join my discord server! The Wendigo will awaken shortly after you join your world and will begin to roam on its own , making its presence felt with distant screeches and roars . The Wendigo is an intelligent stalker and will go through multiple behaviours before fully attacking you. You'll catch glimpses of it roaming in the distance, stalking through the woods on its own. It watches from a far or occasionally feasts on the animals , desparately trying to satiate its infinite hunger . Creeping through the woods you will hear it scream and push trees apart on its way to you. When it does get closer to you, it acts incredibly aggressively , violently charging as it starts the combat part of this mod: His attacks hit hard and cannot be blocked by shield or armor , he's able to destroy blocks when swinging his hands, and with perfectly calibrated speed making escape nearly impossible , you'll be forced to fight back . At your disposal there is an old Hunting Knife and a Flare . The Knife is a crucial thing required for defeating the Wendigo and the Flare allows you to temporarily blind the Wendigo to get distance or a window to get a few hits on him before he resumes his rampage. A few things have been left out of this description to not spoil some of the best encounters this mod has to offer and to keep the fear of not knowing what you're up against ;) This mod is a collaborative project and has been created by MSSHD, Azenski, ezY for the sake of bringing life and uniqueness back to the Minecraft Horror niche. MSSHD: Coding, Textures, Modelling, Sound-Design, Marketing, Secondary Project Director Azenski: Modelling, Animation, Textures, Project Director ezY: Animation Property of MSSHD and by extension Azenski, ezY. Attempts to copy, redistribute, port to Bedrock Edition, steal assets, remake this mod will be followed with action and removed immediately.

Wildlife Expanded: Skunk.title: Wildlife Expanded: Skunk
Wildlife Expanded: Skunk.body: This mod adds tamable skunks to the game! About the skunk: - sweet berry bush won't hurt it - breedable with carrots - tamable with sweet berries, if already tamed then it will only heal it - can be tempted with sweet berries or with the Skunk Commanding Stick - panics when attacked and sprays at the attacker - child skunk will follow its parent - follows owner after 20 blocks if tamed - glowing eyes in the dark - can be put on the shoulders - scares mobs away when on the shoulder except undeads and the other tamed mobs of the player - sprays on the attacker of the owner - It will drop off from your shoulders when you go into water, die or if you shift + right click the ground - nether skunk sprays fire - nethersroom skunk sprays poison - if skunk is named as Dreamy then give it the Dreamy skin - can remove the spray ability on tamed skunks if a shear is used on it - when tamed you can change its behaviour with the Skunk Commanding Stick (made with sweet berries and a stick) - follows owner if in follow mode - wanders around if in wander mode - sits down if in rest mode 10 variants for the skunk: - hooded (forest) - striped (forest) - vanilla (forest) - albino (snowy taiga) - copper (craftable with 9 copper block and 1 heart of the sea, they don't spray, but they won't panic after getting attacked) - ghost - end - endvoid (the end) - nether (nether) - nethersroom (warped and crimson forest) - Dreamy skin when named as Dreamy - copper and endvoid can attack and wield tiered weapons like swords - leather, iron, golden and diamond armor are available too for the skunks Suggested by oakuskunk Artist Tenchigon

Simple Enemy.title: Simple Enemy
Simple Enemy.body: \[SEM\] Simple Enemy Mod is an Addon that works with TaCZ and adds NPCs to the game equipped with weapons from the latter mod, with the goal of balancing the presence of weapons in the game. Now you will have a reason to carry a weapon. Warning: Simple Enemy Mod is in early development, which is why it might contain bugs. I highly recommend backing up your worlds to avoid any issues. Quick Users Guide Recruiting Use a _Recruit Table_ to recruit a PMC Unit, or use a spawn egg. If you use a spawn egg, Right-Click the NPC to recruit them. Orders Open the _Commander Menu_ with Ctrl + C . Select the units and send your order. Inventory Press Shift + Right-Click on the NPC. Minecraft Forge: 47.4.0+ Dependency: TaCZ 1.1.7 Recommended: Cloth Config 11.1.136 Factions 3 Factions that will dominate the Minecraft world: Russian Soldiers American Soldiers Recruitable Allied Soldiers Advanced Soldier Behavior Long, Mid, and Close-range combat tactics Cover system Flanking system Squad Leader and Member system Allies Soldiers who, for a couple of emeralds, will help you forge the resistance. Recruit Table: Right-click the block with 16 Emeralds to recruit an Allied Soldier! Inventory Management: Shift + Right Click on your ally to edit their customizable inventory. Perfectly integrated for survival mode Customizable inventories Support for most TaCZ weapons Support for Vanilla, Forge, and Gecko 4.4.6 armors Commander Menu Take control of the battlefield. Press Ctrl + C to open the menu and give orders to your allies directly: Follow Me Hold Position Free Fire Ceasefire Attack that Target Formation Column Formation Wedge Event-based Spawn System Spawns are based on different dynamic events that occur in-game: Squad patrols Distant firefights for atmosphere Soldier spawns in Villages and Mines Commands /sem event (name of the event) active (True / False) To Disable or Enable a specific spawnEvent /sem event (name of the event) spawn To Force a spawnEvent Config File Too easy? Don't worry, you can adjust the soldiers' behavior through the mod's config file! You can edit: Basic entity attributes Engagement range Render distance Soldier accuracy Amount of shots per burst Cooldowns between bursts World spawn probabilities Find the config file here: .minecraft/config/sem-common.toml Custom Textures Don't like the soldier skins? That's not a problem! Simple Enemy Mod uses the standard Forge resource path. You can create your own texture pack for the soldiers. Make sure to follow this folder path in your Zip file: assets/simpleenemymod/textures/entity/[type of Unit]/texture.png Type of Unit: pmc_unit ru_unit us_unit Texture naming: [type of Unit]_variant1.png _Examples:_ pmc_unit_variant3.png ru_unit_variant1.png us_unit_variant2.png Custom Weapons If you want to customize the current weapons of the units, you can use datapacks. Official datapack templates can be found on my GitHub DataPack Guide Community Addons [TACZ] Simple Enemy: Guns Config PMC Structures Russian Army Structures US Army Structures [TaCZ/SBW] Combined Arms A special thanks to the TaCZ team for providing an API that made it possible to bring Simple Enemy Mod to life. I also want to give a special thanks to Default642172 , who authorized me to use their impressive skins in my project. Big Thanks to Aleksandr Iagofarov Volunteer Developer — Tactical AI & Test Infrastructure Special thanks to Berezka and NeoAlive for creating community addons for the mod Finally, I want to thank my small community that has always supported me from the beginning and has been very patient.

Annihilation Recreated.title: Annihilation Recreated
Annihilation Recreated.body: Annihilation Recreated mom can we have Annihilation at home ? no we already have Annihilation at home Annihilation at home : description Minecraft datapack that aim to recreate the boss Annihilation from the Wynncraft server WARNING This datapack is a fan project , all credits goes to the Wynncraft team I only recreate the boss model/texture and attacks, the music and the structure were directly taken from Wynncraft require attributefix if you're not playing on vanilla difficulty in /function annihilation:admin/_/set_config Or if you are challenging the boss with more than 3 players All animations in this datapack where made using Animated Java anyone from Wynncraft content team is allowed to claim full ownership of the datapack features This datapack have a config menu, wich you can access it using /function annihilation:admin/_/set_config Warning When loading the datapack for the first time, a massive structure, the corruption portal , will be placed from 195,-60,-1330 to 393,45,-1245 Unless the gamerule doMobSpawning is set to false So please if you are loading this datapack in an already existing world, please check that there are nothing important in this region You can tp to it using /function annihilation:admin/_/tp_to_portal Want the structure to be in the nether ? Check out this addon: AnniR - Nether Spawn Or you want the structure to be it's in own dimension ? welp there this addon: Annir - Corrupted Gateway • summoning Annihilation : for Minecraft 1.21.1 You can summon Annihilation by going to the corruption portal and giving the portal (right-clicking) a Corrupted Star here the recipe for it: Or summon anywhere in the world using /function annihilation:admin/_/summon , or at the portal using /function annihilation:admin/_/summon_at_portal for Minecraft 1.20.1 to 1.20.4 You can summon Annihilation by going to the corruption portal and giving the portal (right-clicking) the items it demand (nether_star and 2 netherite_ingot) Or summon anywhere in the world using /function annihilation:admin/_/summon , or at the portal using /function annihilation:boss_summoner/struct_boss_summon The difficulty of the boss can be change in /function annihilation:admin/_/set_config - vanilla : 800 Health - modded : 2500 Health - heavy_modded : 8000 Health The damage also change depending on the diffculty The boss health scale depanding on how many players there are in 64 blocks area and if there are more than 3 players scaling stop at 6 players but it can be change manualy in the file: /data/annihilation/functions/boss/health_scale.mcfunction • Annihilation behavior : All Annihilation attacks are base from the wiki The boss can change/damage target (player or mob) as long as it doesn't have the tag: anniR.immune (previously 'anni_immune' for the mc1.20.x version) You can manually change target using /execute as run function annihilation:set_target Or /tag add anniR.target , but make sure that there only 1 target (previously 'anni_target' for the mc1.20.x version) Incompatibilities Spoiler An incompatibility with the mod Server Core has been reported, I haven't manage to reproduce it so If you're having issue with that mod installed you can either temporarily modify Server Core settings or disable it. Otherwise the datapack should be compatible with most of the mods. Problems you might encounter Spoiler 1. When summoning the boss I only see giant nether brick That mean the resource pack need an higher priority . Go to the resource pack and make Fabric mods (on fabric) / Mod ressources (forge) higher on the list. If that doesn't solve the issue, or create more issues, since other mods can affect the mod resource file. You can download the required resource pack individually (you will found it on the datapack platform where you can download the datapack .zip file at the bottom of the page) 2. Structure didn't generated This problem can happen due to mod incompatibility, mainly mods that change how the world is generated/loaded. If that ha

Muffin's Slime Golem.title: Muffin's Slime Golem
Muffin's Slime Golem.body: Add Slime Golem to Minecraft. A good ally for finding Slime Chunks! Slime Golem Adds Slime Golems to Minecraft. A good ally for finding Slime Chunks! Slime Golem - Place a Carved Pumpkin on a Slime Block or a Packed Slime Block to build a Slime Golem. - Slime Golems are aggressive toward all hostile mobs except for Slimes. - Once a Slime Golem enters a slime chunk, they will produce Slime Algae on the ground, similar to Snow Golems. - Using Shears on them will take their pumpkin off. - Using Honey Comb on them will stop them from producing Slime Algae when they are in a slime chunk, visually covering them in honey. - Using a Slime Ball on a honey-covered Slime Golem will clean the honey off, allowing it to produce Slime Algae in slime chunks again. (A Slime Golem covered in honey with pumpkin off) Block - Packed Slime Block - Used as the base for a Soul Campfire to disable Slime Chunks! (for those annoyed by slime chunks). - Can bounce on them just like on a Slime Block but does not stick when used with pistons. - Block. - Slime Algae - When destroyed with Shears or Silk Touch tools, it drops Slime Algae. Otherwise, it has a low chance to drop a Slime Ball. - Occasionally spawns in Slime Chunks below Y=40. Item - Slime Pie - Restores 2 Hunger and 1 Saturation. - Causes Bounce effect for 20 seconds - Has a 50% chance to cause Nausea for 5 seconds. Having Bugs? Report the bug here! --- (Description revision by : Keaton42)
